                    <button class="menu-toggle" id="menu-toggle" aria-label="Bookmark options">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                            <circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2" />
                            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2" />
                            <circle cx="12" cy="19" r="2" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    <div class="menu-dropdown hidden" id="menu-dropdown">
                        <button class="menu-item" id="import-button">Import from HTML…</button>
                        <button class="menu-item" id="export-button">Export to HTML…</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <input type="file" id="import-file" accept=".html,text/html" hidden />
            </header>

            <div class="rows" id="rows" role="list"></div>
        </main>

        <script type="module">
            const FOLDER_SVG = `<svg class="folder-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 4.2c0-.6.4-1 1-1h3.3l1.4 1.5H13c.6 0 1 .4 1 1v6.6c0 .6-.4 1-1 1H3c-.6 0-1-.4-1-1z"/></svg>`;
            const GLOBE_SVG = `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="5.5"/><path d="M2.5 8h11M8 2.5c1.6 1.6 2.3 3.5 2.3 5.5S9.6 11.9 8 13.5M8 2.5C6.4 4.1 5.7 6 5.7 8s.7 3.9 2.3 5.5"/></svg>`;
            const MORE_SVG = `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="3.5" cy="8" r="1.3"/><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.3"/><circle cx="12.5" cy="8" r="1.3"/></svg>`;

            let BOOKMARKS = [];
            // The folder shown on the right, or null for the bookmarks bar itself.
            let CURRENT_FOLDER_ID = null;
            let DRAGGED_ITEM_ID = null;
            let SEARCH_QUERY = "";

            const foldersNav = document.getElementById("folders");
            const rowsContainer = document.getElementById("rows");
            const folderTitle = document.getElementById("folder-title");

            function createElement(tagName, properties = {}, children = []) {
                const element = document.createElement(tagName);
                Object.assign(element, properties);
                element.append(...children);
                return element;
            }

            function findFolder(items, id) {
                for (const item of items) {
                    if (item.type !== "folder") continue;
                    if (item.id === id) return item;
                    const found = findFolder(item.children || [], id);
                    if (found) return found;
                }
                return null;
            }

            function currentItems() {
                if (CURRENT_FOLDER_ID === null) return BOOKMARKS;
                return findFolder(BOOKMARKS, CURRENT_FOLDER_ID)?.children || [];
            }

            function bookmarkCount(count) {
                return count === 1 ? "1 bookmark" : `${count} bookmarks`;
            }

            function displayUrl(url) {
                return (url || "").replace(/^https?:\/\//, "").replace(/\/$/, "");
            }

            function highlightText(text, query) {
                if (!query) return [document.createTextNode(text)];

                const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();
                const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
                const fragments = [];
                let lastIndex = 0;
                for (
                    let index = lowerText.indexOf(lowerQuery);
                    index !== -1;
                    index = lowerText.indexOf(lowerQuery, lastIndex)
                ) {
                    if (index > lastIndex) fragments.push(document.createTextNode(text.slice(lastIndex, index)));
                    fragments.push(
                        createElement("mark", {
                            className: "search-highlight",
                            textContent: text.slice(index, index + query.length),
                        })
                    );
                    lastIndex = index + query.length;
                }
                if (lastIndex < text.length) fragments.push(document.createTextNode(text.slice(lastIndex)));
                return fragments;
            }

            function matchingItems(items, query, parentId = null, result = []) {
                const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
                for (const item of items) {
                    const title = (item.title || "").toLowerCase();
                    const url = (item.url || "").toLowerCase();
                    if (title.includes(lowerQuery) || url.includes(lowerQuery)) result.push({ item, parentId });
                    if (item.type === "folder") matchingItems(item.children || [], query, item.id, result);
                }
                return result;
            }

            function showContextMenu(event, item, parentId, anchor) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();

                let clientX = event.clientX;
                let clientY = event.clientY;
                if (anchor) {
                    const rect = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
                    clientX = Math.round(rect.left);
                    clientY = Math.round(rect.bottom + 4);
                }

                ladybird.sendMessage("showContextMenu", {
                    clientX,
                    clientY,
                    id: item.id,
                    targetFolderId: item.type === "folder" ? item.id : parentId,
                    parentFolderId: parentId,
                });
            }

            function moveDraggedItem(targetFolderId, targetIndex) {
                if (!DRAGGED_ITEM_ID || DRAGGED_ITEM_ID === targetFolderId) return;
                ladybird.sendMessage("moveItem", { id: DRAGGED_ITEM_ID, index: targetIndex, targetFolderId });
                DRAGGED_ITEM_ID = null;
            }

            function clearDropMarks() {
                for (const element of document.querySelectorAll(".drop-above, .drop-below, .drop-inside"))
                    element.classList.remove("drop-above", "drop-below", "drop-inside");
            }

            // A row takes a dragged item above or below itself, and a folder's row also takes it inside.
            function dropPosition(event, row, item) {
                const rect = row.getBoundingClientRect();
                const ratio = (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
                if (item.type === "folder" && ratio > 0.25 && ratio < 0.75) return "inside";
                return ratio < 0.5 ? "above" : "below";
            }

            function setUpDragAndDrop(row, item, index) {
                if (SEARCH_QUERY) return;
                row.draggable = true;

                row.addEventListener("dragstart", event => {
                    DRAGGED_ITEM_ID = item.id;
                    row.classList.add("dragging");
                    event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
                    event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", item.id);
                });
                row.addEventListener("dragend", () => {
                    DRAGGED_ITEM_ID = null;
                    row.classList.remove("dragging");
                    clearDropMarks();
                });
                row.addEventListener("dragover", event => {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "move";
                    clearDropMarks();
                    row.classList.add(`drop-${dropPosition(event, row, item)}`);
                });
                row.addEventListener("drop", event => {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    clearDropMarks();
                    const position = dropPosition(event, row, item);
                    if (position === "inside") moveDraggedItem(item.id, item.children?.length || 0);
                    else moveDraggedItem(CURRENT_FOLDER_ID, position === "above" ? index : index + 1);
                });
            }

            function renderFolderLink(folder, depth) {
                const id = folder ? folder.id : null;
                const children = folder ? folder.children || [] : BOOKMARKS;
                const link = createElement("a", { href: "#", className: "folder-link" });
                link.style.paddingLeft = `${10 + depth * 20}px`;
                link.innerHTML = FOLDER_SVG;
                link.append(
                    createElement("span", {
                        className: "name",
                        textContent: folder ? folder.title || "(no title)" : "Bookmarks bar",
                    }),
                    createElement("span", { className: "count", textContent: String(children.length) })
                );
                if (!SEARCH_QUERY && id === CURRENT_FOLDER_ID) link.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");

                link.addEventListener("click", event => {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    CURRENT_FOLDER_ID = id;
                    searchInput.value = "";
                    SEARCH_QUERY = "";
                    render();
                });
                link.addEventListener("dragover", event => {
                    if (!DRAGGED_ITEM_ID) return;
                    event.preventDefault();
                    clearDropMarks();
                    link.classList.add("drop-inside");
                });
                link.addEventListener("dragleave", () => link.classList.remove("drop-inside"));
                link.addEventListener("drop", event => {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    clearDropMarks();
                    moveDraggedItem(id, children.length);
                });
                if (folder) link.addEventListener("contextmenu", event => showContextMenu(event, folder, null));
                foldersNav.append(link);

                for (const child of children) {
                    if (child.type === "folder") renderFolderLink(child, depth + 1);
                }
            }

            function renderRow(item, parentId, index) {
                const row = createElement("div", { className: "row" });
                row.setAttribute("role", "listitem");

                if (item.type === "folder") {
                    row.append(createElement("span", { className: "favicon", innerHTML: FOLDER_SVG }));
                    const title = createElement("a", { href: "#", className: "title", draggable: false });
                    title.append(...highlightText(item.title || "(no title)", SEARCH_QUERY));
                    title.addEventListener("click", event => {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        CURRENT_FOLDER_ID = item.id;
                        searchInput.value = "";
                        SEARCH_QUERY = "";
                        render();
                    });
                    row.append(
                        title,
                        createElement("span", {
                            className: "detail",
                            textContent: bookmarkCount((item.children || []).length),
                        })
                    );
                } else {
                    const favicon = createElement("span", { className: "favicon" });
                    if (item.favicon)
                        favicon.append(createElement("img", { src: `data:image/png;base64,${item.favicon}`, alt: "" }));
                    else favicon.innerHTML = GLOBE_SVG;
                    const title = createElement("a", { href: item.url, className: "title", draggable: false });
                    title.append(...highlightText(item.title || item.url, SEARCH_QUERY));
                    const detail = createElement("span", { className: "detail" });
                    detail.append(...highlightText(displayUrl(item.url), SEARCH_QUERY));
                    row.append(favicon, title, detail);
                }

                const moreButton = createElement("button", { className: "more-button", innerHTML: MORE_SVG });
                moreButton.setAttribute("aria-label", `More actions for ${item.title || item.url || "folder"}`);
                moreButton.addEventListener("click", event => showContextMenu(event, item, parentId, moreButton));
                row.append(moreButton);

                row.addEventListener("contextmenu", event => showContextMenu(event, item, parentId));
                setUpDragAndDrop(row, item, index);
                rowsContainer.append(row);
            }

            function render() {
                for (const link of foldersNav.querySelectorAll(".folder-link")) link.remove();
                renderFolderLink(null, 0);

                rowsContainer.replaceChildren();

                if (SEARCH_QUERY) {
                    folderTitle.textContent = "Search results";
                    const matches = matchingItems(BOOKMARKS, SEARCH_QUERY);
                    if (matches.length === 0) {
                        rowsContainer.append(
                            createElement("div", { className: "empty", textContent: "No bookmarks match your search." })
                        );
                        return;
                    }
                    matches.forEach(({ item, parentId }, index) => renderRow(item, parentId, index));
                    return;
                }

                const folder = CURRENT_FOLDER_ID === null ? null : findFolder(BOOKMARKS, CURRENT_FOLDER_ID);
                if (CURRENT_FOLDER_ID !== null && !folder) CURRENT_FOLDER_ID = null;
                folderTitle.textContent = folder ? folder.title || "(no title)" : "Bookmarks bar";

                const items = currentItems();
                if (items.length === 0) {
                    rowsContainer.append(
                        createElement("div", { className: "empty", textContent: "No bookmarks here yet." })
                    );
                    return;
                }
                items.forEach((item, index) => renderRow(item, CURRENT_FOLDER_ID, index));
            }
            const renderTree = render;

            rowsContainer.addEventListener("dragover", event => {
                if (!DRAGGED_ITEM_ID) return;
                event.preventDefault();
                event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "move";
            });
            rowsContainer.addEventListener("drop", event => {
                event.preventDefault();
                clearDropMarks();
                moveDraggedItem(CURRENT_FOLDER_ID, currentItems().length);
            });

            document.querySelector("main").addEventListener("contextmenu", event => {
                if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
                event.preventDefault();
                ladybird.sendMessage("showContextMenu", {
                    clientX: event.clientX,
                    clientY: event.clientY,
                    targetFolderId: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID,
                });
            });

            document.getElementById("new-folder-button").addEventListener("click", () => {
                ladybird.sendMessage("newFolder", { targetFolderId: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID });
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUILoaded", () => {
                ladybird.sendMessage("loadBookmarks");
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
                if (event.detail.name === "loadBookmarks") {
                    BOOKMARKS = event.detail.data;
                    render();
                }
            });

            const menuToggle = document.getElementById("menu-toggle");
            const menuDropdown = document.getElementById("menu-dropdown");
            const importButton = document.getElementById("import-button");
            const exportButton = document.getElementById("export-button");
            const importFileInput = document.getElementById("import-file");

            function closeMenu() {
                menuDropdown.classList.add("hidden");
            }

            menuToggle.addEventListener("click", event => {
                event.stopPropagation();
                menuDropdown.classList.toggle("hidden");
            });

            document.addEventListener("click", event => {
                if (!menuDropdown.contains(event.target) && event.target !== menuToggle) {
                    closeMenu();
                }
            });

            // Import: parse Netscape Bookmark HTML format using DOMParser
            function parseNetscapeBookmarks(html) {
                const parser = new DOMParser();
                const doc = parser.parseFromString(html, "text/html");

                function parseItems(dl) {
                    const items = [];
                    if (!dl) {
                        return items;
                    }

                    for (const dt of dl.children) {
                        if (dt.tagName !== "DT") {
                            continue;
                        }

                        const anchor = dt.querySelector(":scope > A");
                        if (anchor) {
                            const item = {
                                id: crypto.randomUUID(),
                                type: "bookmark",
                                url: anchor.getAttribute("href") || "",
                                title: anchor.textContent.trim() || null,
                            };

                            const icon = anchor.getAttribute("icon");
                            if (icon) {
                                const match = icon.match(/^data:image\/png;base64,(.+)$/i);
                                if (match) {
                                    item.favicon = match[1];
                                }
                            }

                            const addDate = anchor.getAttribute("add_date");
                            if (addDate && addDate !== "0") {
                                item.dateAdded = Number(addDate) * 1000;
                            }

                            const lastModified = anchor.getAttribute("last_modified");
                            if (lastModified && lastModified !== "0") {
                                item.lastModified = Number(lastModified) * 1000;
                            }

                            if (item.url) {
                                items.push(item);
                            }
                            continue;
                        }

                        const heading = dt.querySelector(":scope > H3");
                        if (heading) {
                            const childDl = dt.querySelector(":scope > DL");
                            const folder = {
                                id: crypto.randomUUID(),
                                type: "folder",
                                title: heading.textContent.trim() || null,
                                children: parseItems(childDl),
                            };

                            const addDate = heading.getAttribute("add_date");
                            if (addDate && addDate !== "0") {
                                folder.dateAdded = Number(addDate) * 1000;
                            }

                            const lastModified = heading.getAttribute("last_modified");
                            if (lastModified && lastModified !== "0") {
                                folder.lastModified = Number(lastModified) * 1000;
                            }

                            items.push(folder);
                            continue;
                        }
                    }

                    return items;
                }

                // The top-level <DL> is the root bookmark list
                const topDl = doc.querySelector("DL");
                return parseItems(topDl);
            }

            importButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
                closeMenu();
                importFileInput.value = "";
                importFileInput.click();
            });

            importFileInput.addEventListener("change", () => {
                const file = importFileInput.files[0];
                if (!file) {
                    return;
                }

                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = () => {
                    const items = parseNetscapeBookmarks(reader.result);
                    if (items.length > 0) {
                        ladybird.sendMessage("importBookmarks", items);
                    }
                };
                reader.readAsText(file);
            });

            // Export: generate Netscape Bookmark HTML format from current bookmarks
            function escapeHtml(text) {
                return text.replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => `&#${c.charCodeAt(0)}`);
            }

            function generateBookmarkHtml(items, indent) {
                const pad = "    ".repeat(indent);
                let html = `${pad}<DL><p>\n`;

                for (const item of items) {
                    if (item.type === "bookmark") {
                        const title = item.title ? escapeHtml(item.title) : escapeHtml(item.url);
                        const addDate = item.dateAdded ? Math.floor(item.dateAdded / 1000) : 0;
                        let attrs = `HREF="${escapeHtml(item.url)}" ADD_DATE="${addDate}"`;

                        if (item.favicon) {
                            attrs += ` ICON="data:image/png;base64,${item.favicon}"`;
                        }

                        html += `${pad}    <DT><A ${attrs}>${title}</A>\n`;
                    } else if (item.type === "folder") {
                        const title = item.title ? escapeHtml(item.title) : "Untitled Folder";
                        const addDate = item.dateAdded ? Math.floor(item.dateAdded / 1000) : 0;
                        const lastModified = item.lastModified ? Math.floor(item.lastModified / 1000) : 0;

                        html += `${pad}    <DT><H3 ADD_DATE="${addDate}" LAST_MODIFIED="${lastModified}">${title}</H3>\n`;
                        html += generateBookmarkHtml(item.children || [], indent + 1);
                    }
                }

                html += `${pad}</DL><p>\n`;
                return html;
            }

            const searchInput = document.getElementById("search-input");

            searchInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
                SEARCH_QUERY = searchInput.value.trim();
                renderTree();
            });

            exportButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
                closeMenu();

                let html = "<!DOCTYPE NETSCAPE-Bookmark-file-1>\n";
                html += '<META HTTP-EQUIV="Content-Type" CONTENT="text/html; charset=UTF-8">\n';
                html += "<TITLE>Bookmarks</TITLE>\n";
                html += "<H1>Bookmarks</H1>\n";
                html += generateBookmarkHtml(BOOKMARKS, 0);

                // FIXME: Route bookmark export through a web platform save/download API
                //        once one is implemented in Ladybird.
                ladybird.sendMessage("exportBookmarks", html);
            });
        </script>
    </body>
</html>

        <script>
            function formatFingerprint(fingerprint) {
                return fingerprint
                    .toUpperCase()
                    .match(/.{1,2}/g)
                    .join(":");

            // Answers name the warning they were given, so they can't apply to one shown after it.
            let reviewedWarning = null;

            function answer(name) {
                if (reviewedWarning)
                    ladybird.sendMessage(name, { url: reviewedWarning.url, fingerprint: reviewedWarning.fingerprint });
            }

            document.getElementById("reject").addEventListener("click", () => answer("rejectCertificate"));

                    return;

                for (const host of document.querySelectorAll(".host")) host.textContent = warning.host;
                document.getElementById("origin").textContent = warning.origin;
                document.getElementById("fingerprint").textContent = formatFingerprint(warning.fingerprint);
                document.getElementById("resends-form").hidden = !warning.resendsForm;
                document.getElementById("form-not-resent").hidden = !warning.formIsNotResent;
                document.getElementById("warning").hidden = false;

                // Autofocus skips the initially hidden button.

                    document.getElementById("reject").focus();
            });

<html lang="en">

        <template id="report-template">
            <section class="report">
                <div class="report-row">
                    <button class="report-toggle">
                        <svg class="report-chevron" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden="true">
                            <path d="M4.5 2.5 8 6l-3.5 3.5" />

                        <span class="report-name"></span>

                        What were you doing? (optional)
                        <textarea maxlength="4096"></textarea>

                        <span class="report-websites-title">Include website addresses</span>
                        <div class="report-website-list"></div>
                    </div>
                    <p class="report-text-note hidden"></p>
                    <pre class="report-text hidden"></pre>
                    <div class="report-footer">
                        <span class="report-included">
                            Crash details, Ladybird version and platform.
                            <button class="report-show">Show report</button>
                        </span>
                        <button class="quiet-button report-delete">Delete</button>
                        <button class="secondary-button report-send">Send</button>
                    </div>
                </div>

        <script type="module">
            const reportsElement = document.querySelector("#reports");
            const emptyElement = document.querySelector("#empty");
            const countElement = document.querySelector("#count");
            const actionsElement = document.querySelector("#actions");
            const deleteAllButton = document.querySelector("#delete-all");
            const sendAllButton = document.querySelector("#send-all");
            const template = document.querySelector("#report-template");

            // The cards outlive each update of the list, so what was typed into one or opened on it stays.
            const cards = new Map();
            const collapsedByUser = new Set();
            let groups = [];

            const minute = 60 * 1000;
            const hour = 60 * minute;
            const day = 24 * hour;

            function plural(count, noun) {
                return `${count} ${noun}${count === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
            }

            function startOfDay(date) {
                return new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate()).getTime();
            }

            function describeTime(milliseconds) {
                if (milliseconds === undefined) return "";

                const now = new Date();
                const then = new Date(milliseconds);
                const age = now - then;
                const daysAgo = Math.round((startOfDay(now) - startOfDay(then)) / day);

                if (age < minute) return "Just now";
                if (age < hour) return `${plural(Math.floor(age / minute), "minute")} ago`;
                if (daysAgo === 0) return `${plural(Math.floor(age / hour), "hour")} ago`;
                if (daysAgo === 1) {
                    const time = then.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false });
                    return `Yesterday, ${time}`;
                }
                return `${daysAgo} days ago`;
            }

            function describeGroup(group) {
                const when = describeTime(group.lastCrashedAt);
                if (group.names.length === 1) return when;
                if (!when) return `${group.names.length} times`;
                return `${group.names.length} times · last ${when.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${when.slice(1)}`;
            }

            function tickedWebsites(card) {
                const ticked = card.querySelectorAll(".report-website input:checked");
                return new Set([...ticked].map(input => input.value));
            }

            function createWebsite(website, isOnlyWebsite) {
                const label = document.createElement("label");
                label.className = "report-website";

                const input = document.createElement("input");
                input.type = "checkbox";
                input.value = website;
                label.append(input);

                if (isOnlyWebsite) label.append("Include website address");

                const address = document.createElement("span");
                address.className = "report-website-address";
                address.textContent = website;
                label.append(address);
                return label;
            }

            // Every website that would be sent is listed with its own box, so nothing leaves that the user did not tick.
            function updateWebsites(card, group) {
                const list = card.querySelector(".report-website-list");
                const key = JSON.stringify(group.websites);
                if (list.dataset.websites !== key) {
                    const ticked = tickedWebsites(card);
                    list.dataset.websites = key;
                    list.replaceChildren(
                        ...group.websites.map(website => createWebsite(website, group.websites.length === 1))
                    );
                    list.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(input => {
                        input.checked = ticked.has(input.value);
                    });
                }

                list.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(input => {
                    input.disabled = group.isSending;
                });
                card.querySelector(".report-websites").classList.toggle("hidden", group.websites.length === 0);
                card.querySelector(".report-websites-title").classList.toggle("hidden", group.websites.length < 2);
            }

            function restoreChoices(card, group) {
                card.querySelector("textarea").value = group.note;
                card.querySelectorAll(".report-website input").forEach(input => {
                    input.checked = group.includedWebsites.includes(input.value);
                });
            }

            function reportsToSend(group, card) {
                const description = card.querySelector("textarea").value;
                const ticked = tickedWebsites(card);
                return group.names.map((name, index) => ({
                    name,
                    description,
                    includeWebsite: ticked.has(group.websiteOfEachReport[index]),
                }));
            }

            function createCard(id) {
                const card = template.content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);
                const toggle = card.querySelector(".report-toggle");
                const showButton = card.querySelector(".report-show");
                const reportText = card.querySelector(".report-text");

                const group = () => groups.find(candidate => candidate.id === id);

                toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
                    if (card.classList.toggle("expanded")) collapsedByUser.delete(id);
                    else collapsedByUser.add(id);
                    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", card.classList.contains("expanded"));
                });
                card.querySelectorAll(".report-delete").forEach(button => {
                    button.addEventListener("click", () => ladybird.sendMessage("deleteReports", group().names));
                });
                card.querySelectorAll(".report-send").forEach(button => {
                    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
                        ladybird.sendMessage("sendReports", reportsToSend(group(), card));
                    });
                });
                showButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
                    if (reportText.classList.contains("hidden")) {
                        ladybird.sendMessage("showReport", group().names[0]);
                    } else {
                        reportText.classList.add("hidden");
                        showButton.textContent = "Show report";
                        updateCard(card, group());
                    }
                });

                return card;
            }

            function updateCard(card, group) {
                card.querySelector(".report-name").textContent = group.process;
                card.querySelector(".report-when").textContent = describeGroup(group);

                // Only the latest report of a group is shown, so say what stands behind it.
                const reportTextNote = card.querySelector(".report-text-note");
                const reportIsHidden = card.querySelector(".report-text").classList.contains("hidden");
                reportTextNote.textContent = `Showing the latest of ${group.names.length}. The others are the same crash.`;
                reportTextNote.classList.toggle("hidden", reportIsHidden || group.names.length === 1);

                const status = card.querySelector(".report-status");
                status.textContent = group.isSending ? "Sending…" : group.couldNotSend ? "Couldn’t send" : "";
                status.classList.toggle("failed", !group.isSending && group.couldNotSend);

                card.querySelectorAll(".report-delete, .report-send").forEach(button => {
                    button.disabled = group.isSending;
                });
                card.querySelector("textarea").disabled = group.isSending;

                updateWebsites(card, group);

                const expanded =
                    card.classList.contains("expanded") || (groups.length === 1 && !collapsedByUser.has(group.id));
                card.classList.toggle("expanded", expanded);
                card.querySelector(".report-toggle").setAttribute("aria-expanded", expanded);
            }

            function render() {
                const ids = new Set(groups.map(group => group.id));
                for (const [id, card] of cards) {
                    if (ids.has(id)) continue;
                    card.remove();
                    cards.delete(id);
                }

                // Moving a card takes the focus from its note, so one already in its place stays untouched.
                groups.forEach((group, index) => {
                    const isNewCard = !cards.has(group.id);
                    if (isNewCard) cards.set(group.id, createCard(group.id));
                    const card = cards.get(group.id);
                    updateCard(card, group);
                    if (isNewCard) restoreChoices(card, group);
                    const current = reportsElement.children[index];
                    if (current !== card) reportsElement.insertBefore(card, current ?? null);
                });

                const reportCount = groups.reduce((count, group) => count + group.names.length, 0);
                const allSending = groups.every(group => group.isSending);
                countElement.textContent = reportCount > 0 ? `${reportCount} not sent` : "";
                actionsElement.classList.toggle("hidden", reportCount === 0);
                emptyElement.classList.toggle("hidden", reportCount > 0);
                deleteAllButton.disabled = allSending;
                sendAllButton.disabled = allSending;
            }

            deleteAllButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
                const idle = groups.filter(group => !group.isSending);
                ladybird.sendMessage(
                    "deleteReports",
                    idle.flatMap(group => group.names)
                );
            });

            sendAllButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
                const idle = groups.filter(group => !group.isSending);
                ladybird.sendMessage(
                    "sendReports",
                    idle.flatMap(group => reportsToSend(group, cards.get(group.id)))
                );
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
                if (event.detail.name === "loadReports") {
                    groups = event.detail.data;
                    render();
                } else if (event.detail.name === "showReport") {
                    const { name, text } = event.detail.data;
                    const group = groups.find(candidate => candidate.names[0] === name);
                    if (!group) return;

                    const card = cards.get(group.id);
                    const reportText = card.querySelector(".report-text");
                    reportText.textContent = text;
                    reportText.classList.remove("hidden");
                    card.querySelector(".report-show").textContent = "Hide report";
                    updateCard(card, group);
                }
            });

            // The times on the page age, and a report can be answered from a crashed tab's own screen.
            document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
                if (!document.hidden) ladybird.sendMessage("loadReports");
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUILoaded", () => ladybird.sendMessage("loadReports"));
        </script>
    </body>
</html>

    <body>
        <header>
            <h1>Downloads</h1>
            <button id="prune-inactive-downloads" class="secondary-button" disabled>Clear finished</button>
        </header>

        <div class="downloads-content">
            <div id="downloads-status" class="downloads-status">Loading downloads…</div>
            <div id="downloads-empty" class="downloads-empty hidden"></div>
            <div id="downloads-list" class="downloads-list"></div>
        </div>

        <script type="module">
            const downloadsStatus = document.querySelector("#downloads-status");
            const downloadsEmpty = document.querySelector("#downloads-empty");
            const downloadsList = document.querySelector("#downloads-list");
            const pruneInactiveDownloadsButton = document.querySelector("#prune-inactive-downloads");

            const sizeFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat([], {
                maximumFractionDigits: 1,
            });
            const sizeUnits = [
                { divisor: 1, suffix: "bytes" },
                { divisor: 1000, suffix: "KB" },
                { divisor: 1000 ** 2, suffix: "MB" },
                { divisor: 1000 ** 3, suffix: "GB" },
                { divisor: 1000 ** 4, suffix: "TB" },
            ];

            let downloads = [];
            const downloadRows = new Map();

            function createElement(tagName, properties = {}, children = []) {
                const element = document.createElement(tagName);
                Object.assign(element, properties);
                element.append(...children);
                return element;
            }

            function pluralize(count, singular, plural = `${singular}s`) {
                return `${count} ${count === 1 ? singular : plural}`;
            }

            function unitForDownloadSize(size) {
                for (let i = sizeUnits.length - 1; i > 0; --i) {
                    if (size >= sizeUnits[i].divisor) return sizeUnits[i];
                }
                return sizeUnits[0];
            }

            function rateLabel(bytesPerSecond) {
                const unit = unitForDownloadSize(bytesPerSecond);
                return `${sizeFormatter.format(bytesPerSecond / unit.divisor)} ${unit.suffix}/s`;
            }

            function timeRemainingLabel(seconds) {
                if (seconds < 60) return `${pluralize(Math.max(seconds, 1), "second")} left`;

                const totalMinutes = Math.ceil(seconds / 60);
                if (totalMinutes < 60) return `${pluralize(totalMinutes, "minute")} left`;

                const hours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
                const minutes = totalMinutes % 60;
                if (minutes === 0) return `${pluralize(hours, "hour")} left`;
                return `${pluralize(hours, "hour")} ${pluralize(minutes, "minute")} left`;
            }

            function statusLabel(download) {
                if (download.status === "completed") return "Completed";
                if (download.status === "canceled") return "Canceled";
                if (download.status === "failed") return "Failed";
                if (download.status === "paused") return "Paused";
                return "Downloading";
            }

            function detailLabel(download) {
                if (download.status === "canceled") return "Partial file removed.";
                if (download.status === "failed") return download.error || "The download failed.";
                if (download.status === "paused" && download.error) return download.error;
                if (download.status === "in-progress" && download.isWaitingToRetry)
                    return "The server asked us to slow down, so Ladybird is waiting to retry.";
                if (download.status !== "completed" && download.totalSize > 0) {
                    const unit = unitForDownloadSize(download.totalSize);
                    const parts = [
                        `${sizeFormatter.format(download.downloadedSize / unit.divisor)} of ${sizeFormatter.format(download.totalSize / unit.divisor)} ${unit.suffix}`,
                    ];

                    if (download.status === "in-progress") {
                        if (download.bytesPerSecond > 0) parts.push(rateLabel(download.bytesPerSecond));
                        if (download.secondsRemaining !== null && download.secondsRemaining !== undefined)
                            parts.push(timeRemainingLabel(download.secondsRemaining));
                        if (download.connectionCount > 1) parts.push(`${download.connectionCount} connections`);
                    }

                    return parts.join(" · ");
                }

                const unit = unitForDownloadSize(download.downloadedSize);
                return `${sizeFormatter.format(download.downloadedSize / unit.divisor)} ${unit.suffix}`;
            }

            function createActionButton(className, textContent, message, downloadId) {
                return createElement("button", {
                    className,
                    textContent,
                    onclick: () => ladybird.sendMessage(message, { id: downloadId }),
                });
            }

            function updateActions(actions, download) {
                const canResume = `${download.canResume === true}`;
                if (
                    actions.dataset.downloadId === `${download.id}` &&
                    actions.dataset.status === download.status &&
                    actions.dataset.canResume === canResume
                )
                    return;

                actions.dataset.downloadId = download.id;
                actions.dataset.status = download.status;
                actions.dataset.canResume = canResume;

                if (download.status === "in-progress") {
                    const buttons = [];
                    if (download.canResume)
                        buttons.push(createActionButton("secondary-button", "Pause", "pauseDownload", download.id));
                    buttons.push(createActionButton("secondary-button", "Cancel", "cancelDownload", download.id));

                    actions.replaceChildren(...buttons);
                    return;
                }

                if (download.status === "paused") {
                    actions.replaceChildren(
                        createActionButton("secondary-button", "Cancel", "cancelDownload", download.id),
                        createActionButton("primary-button", "Resume", "resumeDownload", download.id)
                    );
                    return;
                }

                if (download.status !== "completed") {
                    actions.replaceChildren();
                    return;
                }

                actions.replaceChildren(
                    createActionButton("secondary-button", "Show in folder", "showDownloadInFolder", download.id),
                    createActionButton("primary-button", "Open", "openDownload", download.id)
                );
            }

            function createDownloadRow(download) {
                const row = createElement("div", { className: "download-entry" }, [
                    createElement("div", { className: "download-main" }, [
                        createElement("div", {
                            className: "download-title",
                        }),
                        createElement("div", {
                            className: "download-url",
                        }),
                        createElement("div", {
                            className: "download-destination",
                        }),
                        createElement("div", { className: "download-state" }, [
                            createElement("div", { className: "download-progress" }, [
                                createElement("progress"),
                                createElement("div", { className: "download-segments" }),
                            ]),
                            createElement("span", {
                                className: "download-status",
                            }),
                            createElement("span", {
                                className: "download-detail",
                            }),
                        ]),
                    ]),
                    createElement("div", { className: "download-actions" }),
                ]);

                updateDownloadRow(row, download);
                return row;
            }

            function updateSegments(segments, download) {
                const downloadSegments = download.segments || [];
                if (downloadSegments.length < 2) {
                    segments.hidden = true;
                    segments.replaceChildren();
                    return;
                }

                segments.hidden = false;

                if (segments.children.length !== downloadSegments.length) {
                    segments.replaceChildren(
                        ...downloadSegments.map(() =>
                            createElement("div", { className: "download-segment" }, [
                                createElement("div", { className: "download-segment-fill" }),
                            ])
                        )
                    );
                }

                downloadSegments.forEach((segment, index) => {
                    const size = segment.end - segment.start + 1;
                    const downloaded = Math.min(Math.max(segment.next - segment.start, 0), size);

                    const block = segments.children[index];
                    block.style.flexGrow = `${size}`;
                    block.firstChild.style.width = `${(downloaded / size) * 100}%`;
                });
            }

            function updateDownloadRow(row, download) {
                const title = row.querySelector(".download-title");
                title.textContent = download.fileName;
                title.title = download.fileName;

                const url = row.querySelector(".download-url");
                url.textContent = download.url;
                url.title = download.url;

                const destination = row.querySelector(".download-destination");
                destination.textContent = download.destination;
                destination.title = download.destination;

                const progress = row.querySelector("progress");
                const showProgress =
                    (download.status === "in-progress" || download.status === "paused") &&
                    download.totalSize !== null &&
                    download.totalSize !== undefined &&
                    download.totalSize !== 0;
                progress.hidden = !showProgress;
                if (showProgress) {
                    progress.max = download.totalSize;
                    progress.value = Math.min(download.downloadedSize, download.totalSize);
                }

                updateSegments(row.querySelector(".download-segments"), download);

                const status = row.querySelector(".download-status");
                status.className = `download-status ${download.status}`;
                status.textContent = statusLabel(download);

                row.querySelector(".download-detail").textContent = detailLabel(download);
                updateActions(row.querySelector(".download-actions"), download);
            }

            function updateDownloadList(sortedDownloads) {
                const downloadIds = new Set(sortedDownloads.map(download => download.id));
                for (const [id] of downloadRows) {
                    if (!downloadIds.has(id)) downloadRows.delete(id);
                }

                const rows = sortedDownloads.map(download => {
                    let row = downloadRows.get(download.id);
                    if (!row) {
                        row = createDownloadRow(download);
                        downloadRows.set(download.id, row);
                    } else {
                        updateDownloadRow(row, download);
                    }
                    return row;
                });

                rows.forEach((row, index) => {
                    if (downloadsList.children[index] !== row)
                        downloadsList.insertBefore(row, downloadsList.children[index] || null);
                });

                while (downloadsList.children.length > rows.length) downloadsList.lastChild.remove();
            }

            function render() {
                const sortedDownloads = [...downloads].sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id);
                const activeCount = downloads.filter(download => download.status === "in-progress").length;
                const pausedCount = downloads.filter(download => download.status === "paused").length;
                const inactiveCount = downloads.length - activeCount - pausedCount;

                updateDownloadList(sortedDownloads);
                pruneInactiveDownloadsButton.disabled = inactiveCount === 0;

                const isEmpty = downloads.length === 0;
                downloadsEmpty.classList.toggle("hidden", !isEmpty);
                downloadsEmpty.textContent = "Files you download in this session will show up here.";

                if (isEmpty) {
                    downloadsStatus.textContent = "No downloads yet.";
                } else if (activeCount > 0) {
                    const paused = pausedCount > 0 ? `, ${pausedCount} paused` : "";
                    downloadsStatus.textContent = `${pluralize(activeCount, "active download")}${paused} · ${pluralize(downloads.length, "item")} total.`;
                } else if (pausedCount > 0) {
                    downloadsStatus.textContent = `${pluralize(pausedCount, "paused download")} · ${pluralize(downloads.length, "item")} total.`;
                } else {
                    downloadsStatus.textContent = `${pluralize(downloads.length, "download")} in this session.`;
                }
            }

            function updateDownload(download) {
                const index = downloads.findIndex(candidate => candidate.id === download.id);
                if (index === -1) {
                    downloads.push(download);
                } else {
                    downloads[index] = download;
                }
                render();
            }

            function removeDownload(downloadId) {
                downloads = downloads.filter(download => download.id !== downloadId);
                downloadRows.delete(downloadId);
                render();
            }

            pruneInactiveDownloadsButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
                ladybird.sendMessage("pruneInactiveDownloads");
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUILoaded", () => {
                ladybird.sendMessage("loadDownloads");
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
                const { name, data } = event.detail;
                if (name === "loadDownloads") {
                    downloads = data;
                    render();
                } else if (name === "downloadAdded" || name === "downloadUpdated") {
                    updateDownload(data);
                } else if (name === "downloadRemoved") {
                    removeDownload(data);
                }
            });
        </script>
    </body>
</html>

    <body>
        <div class="history-header">
            <h1>History</h1>
            <label class="search-field">
                <span class="visually-hidden">Search history</span>
                <svg
                    viewBox="0 0 16 16"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    stroke-width="1.5"
                    stroke-linecap="round"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                >
                    <path d="M7 2.5a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0 9a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0-9zM10.5 10.5L14 14" />
                </svg>
                <input id="history-search" type="search" placeholder="Search history" spellcheck="false" autofocus />
            </label>
            <button id="clear-history" class="secondary-button">Clear history…</button>
        </div>

        <div id="history-status" class="history-status">Loading history…</div>
        <div id="history-empty" class="history-empty hidden"></div>
        <div id="history-groups" class="history-groups"></div>
        <div id="history-actions" class="history-actions hidden">
            <button id="load-more" class="secondary-button">Load more</button>
        </div>

        <script type="module">
            const PAGE_SIZE = 50;
            const SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_DELAY = 200;

            const searchInput = document.querySelector("#history-search");
            const historyStatus = document.querySelector("#history-status");
            const historyEmpty = document.querySelector("#history-empty");
            const historyGroups = document.querySelector("#history-groups");
            const historyActions = document.querySelector("#history-actions");
            const loadMoreButton = document.querySelector("#load-more");

            const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat([], { timeStyle: "short" });
            const todayFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat([], { weekday: "long", month: "long", day: "numeric" });
            const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat([], {
                weekday: "long",
                month: "long",
                day: "numeric",
                year: "numeric",
            });

            let searchTimer = null;
            let latestRequestId = 0;
            let openMenu = null;
            let state = {
                entries: [],
                hasMore: false,
                isLoading: false,
                query: "",
            };

            function startOfDay(date) {
                return new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate());
            }

            function historyDayLabel(timestamp) {
                const entryDate = new Date(timestamp);
                const today = startOfDay(new Date());
                const entryDay = startOfDay(entryDate);
                const dayDelta = Math.round((today.getTime() - entryDay.getTime()) / 86400000);

                if (dayDelta === 0) return `Today · ${todayFormatter.format(entryDate)}`;
                if (dayDelta === 1) return "Yesterday";

                return dateFormatter.format(entryDate);
            }

            function entryTimeLabel(entry) {
                return timeFormatter.format(new Date(entry.lastVisitedTime));
            }

            function faviconFallbackLabel(entry) {
                const source = entry.title || entry.siteKey || entry.url;
                const firstAlphaNumeric = Array.from(source).find(character => /[a-z0-9]/i.test(character));
                return firstAlphaNumeric ? firstAlphaNumeric.toUpperCase() : "?";
            }

            function createElement(tagName, properties = {}, children = []) {
                const element = document.createElement(tagName);
                Object.assign(element, properties);
                element.append(...children);
                return element;
            }

            function createFavicon(entry) {
                if (entry.faviconBase64Png) {
                    return createElement("div", { className: "entry-favicon" }, [
                        createElement("img", {
                            src: `data:image/png;base64,${entry.faviconBase64Png}`,
                            alt: "",
                        }),
                    ]);
                }

                return createElement("div", {
                    className: "entry-favicon",
                    textContent: faviconFallbackLabel(entry),
                });
            }

            function refreshHistory() {
                state.entries = [];
                state.hasMore = false;
                render();
                requestHistory(0);
            }

            function removeEntry(entry) {
                const name = entry.title || entry.url;
                if (!window.confirm(`Remove ${name} from browsing history?`)) return;

                ladybird.sendMessage("removeHistoryEntry", { url: entry.url });
                refreshHistory();
            }

            function forgetSite(entry) {
                if (!entry.siteKey) return;

                if (!window.confirm(`Forget all history from ${entry.siteKey}?`)) return;

                ladybird.sendMessage("forgetHistorySite", { url: entry.url });
                refreshHistory();
            }

            function closeOpenMenu() {
                if (!openMenu) return;

                openMenu.dropdown.classList.add("hidden");
                openMenu.toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
                openMenu = null;
            }

            function createEntryMenu(entry, title) {
                const toggle = createElement("button", {
                    className: "menu-toggle",
                    title: "History entry options",
                    innerHTML: `
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                            <circle cx="3.5" cy="8" r="1.25" />
                            <circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.25" />
                            <circle cx="12.5" cy="8" r="1.25" />
                        </svg>
                    `,
                });
                toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", `Actions for ${title}`);
                toggle.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "menu");
                toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");

                const forgetButton = createElement("button", {
                    className: "menu-item",
                    textContent: "Forget site",
                    onclick: event => {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        closeOpenMenu();
                        forgetSite(entry);
                    },
                });
                forgetButton.setAttribute("role", "menuitem");
                if (!entry.siteKey) forgetButton.classList.add("hidden");

                const removeButton = createElement("button", {
                    className: "menu-item",
                    textContent: "Remove from history",
                    onclick: event => {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        closeOpenMenu();
                        removeEntry(entry);
                    },
                });
                removeButton.setAttribute("role", "menuitem");

                const dropdown = createElement("div", { className: "menu-dropdown hidden" }, [
                    forgetButton,
                    removeButton,
                ]);
                dropdown.setAttribute("role", "menu");

                const menu = createElement("div", { className: "entry-actions" }, [toggle, dropdown]);

                toggle.addEventListener("click", event => {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();

                    if (openMenu?.dropdown === dropdown) {
                        closeOpenMenu();
                        return;
                    }

                    closeOpenMenu();
                    dropdown.classList.remove("hidden");
                    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
                    openMenu = { dropdown, toggle, menu };
                });

                return menu;
            }

            function entryDomain(entry) {
                try {
                    return new URL(entry.url).host;
                } catch {
                    return "";
                }
            }

            function createEntryRow(entry) {
                const title = entry.title || entry.url;

                return createElement("div", { className: "history-entry" }, [
                    createElement("span", { className: "entry-time", textContent: entryTimeLabel(entry) }),
                    createFavicon(entry),
                    createElement("a", {
                        className: "entry-title",
                        href: entry.url,
                        textContent: title,
                        title: entry.url,
                    }),
                    createElement("span", { className: "entry-domain", textContent: entryDomain(entry) }),
                    createEntryMenu(entry, title),
                ]);
            }

            function renderEntries() {
                closeOpenMenu();
                historyGroups.replaceChildren();

                let currentGroup = null;
                let currentList = null;

                state.entries.forEach(entry => {
                    const groupLabel = historyDayLabel(entry.lastVisitedTime);
                    if (groupLabel !== currentGroup) {
                        currentGroup = groupLabel;
                        currentList = createElement("div", { className: "history-entry-list" });
                        historyGroups.append(
                            createElement("section", { className: "history-group" }, [
                                createElement("h2", { className: "history-group-title", textContent: groupLabel }),
                                currentList,
                            ])
                        );
                    }

                    currentList.append(createEntryRow(entry));
                });
            }

            function renderStatus() {
                if (state.isLoading && state.entries.length === 0) {
                    historyStatus.textContent = "Loading history…";
                    return;
                }

                if (state.query) {
                    if (state.isLoading) {
                        historyStatus.textContent = `Searching for "${state.query}"…`;
                        return;
                    }

                    historyStatus.textContent = "";
                    return;
                }

                if (state.isLoading) {
                    historyStatus.textContent = "Loading more history…";
                    return;
                }

                // The list speaks for itself, and the empty state explains an empty one.
                historyStatus.textContent = "";
            }

            function renderEmptyState() {
                const shouldShowEmpty = !state.isLoading && state.entries.length === 0;
                historyEmpty.classList.toggle("hidden", !shouldShowEmpty);

                if (!shouldShowEmpty) return;

                historyEmpty.textContent = state.query
                    ? "No history entries match this search."
                    : "Pages you visit will show up here, grouped by day.";
            }

            function renderLoadMore() {
                const shouldShowLoadMore = state.hasMore || state.isLoading;
                historyActions.classList.toggle("hidden", !shouldShowLoadMore);
                loadMoreButton.disabled = state.isLoading;
                loadMoreButton.textContent = state.isLoading ? "Loading…" : "Load more";
            }

            function render() {
                renderStatus();
                renderEntries();
                renderEmptyState();
                renderLoadMore();
            }

            function requestHistory(offset) {
                const requestId = ++latestRequestId;
                const query = searchInput.value.trim();
                offset = offset || state.entries.length;

                state.isLoading = true;
                state.query = query;
                render();

                ladybird.sendMessage("loadHistoryEntries", {
                    requestId,
                    query,
                    offset,
                    limit: PAGE_SIZE,
                });
            }

            function scheduleSearch() {
                clearTimeout(searchTimer);
                searchTimer = setTimeout(() => refreshHistory(), SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_DELAY);
            }

            // Clearing history is one of the choices in Settings' dialog for clearing browsing data.
            document.querySelector("#clear-history").addEventListener("click", () => {
                location.href = "about:settings#clearBrowsingData";
            });

            searchInput.addEventListener("input", scheduleSearch);
            searchInput.addEventListener("search", scheduleSearch);
            loadMoreButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
                if (!state.isLoading) requestHistory();
            });
            document.addEventListener("click", event => {
                if (!openMenu || openMenu.menu.contains(event.target)) return;
                closeOpenMenu();
            });
            document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
                if (event.key === "Escape") closeOpenMenu();
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUILoaded", () => {
                requestHistory(0);
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
                if (event.detail.name !== "loadHistoryEntries") return;

                const data = event.detail.data;
                if (data.requestId !== latestRequestId) return;

                state.isLoading = false;
                state.hasMore = Boolean(data.hasMore);
                state.query = data.query || "";

                if (data.offset === 0) {
                    state.entries = data.entries;
                } else {
                    state.entries = state.entries.concat(data.entries);
                }

                render();
            });
        </script>
    </body>
</html>

<html lang="en">
    <head>
        <meta charset="UTF-8" />
        <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark" />
        <title>Licenses</title>
        <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="resource://icons/48x48/app-browser.png" />
        <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="resource://ladybird/ladybird.css" />
        <style>
            body {
                max-width: 920px;
                margin: 0 auto;
                padding: 30px 24px;
            }

            h1 {
                margin-bottom: 18px;
                font-size: 22px;
                font-weight: 600;
            }

            pre {
                font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
                font-size: 12px;
                line-height: 1.45;
                white-space: pre-wrap;
                overflow-wrap: anywhere;
            }
        </style>
    </head>
    <body>
        <h1>Licenses</h1>
        <pre id="licenses">Loading…</pre>
        <script type="module">
            const LICENSES_URL = "resource://ladybird/LICENSES.txt";

            async function loadLicenses() {
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(`${LICENSES_URL}.br`);
                    const decompressed = response.body.pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("brotli"));
                    return await new Response(decompressed).text();
                } catch {
                    // A build without a brotli tool installs the licenses uncompressed.
                    const response = await fetch(LICENSES_URL);
                    return await response.text();
                }
            }

            const licenses = document.querySelector("#licenses");
            try {
                licenses.textContent = await loadLicenses();
            } catch {
                licenses.textContent = "The licenses could not be loaded.";
            }
        </script>
    </body>
</html>

<html lang="en">
    <head>

        <script>
            // FIXME: When we support per-glyph font fallbacks, replace these SVGs with analogous code points.
            //        https://github.com/LadybirdBrowser/ladybird/issues/864
            const upwardArrowSVG =
                '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="18 15 12 9 6 15"></polyline></svg>';
            const downwardArrowSVG =
                '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline></svg>';

            const containsValidURL = input => {
                return input.value.length !== 0 && input.checkValidity();
            };

            const ensureURLHasScheme = value => {
                value = value.trim();
                if (!value) {
                    return value;
                }

                const hasScheme = /^[a-z][a-z\d+.-]*:/i.test(value);
                // A host followed by a port can parse as a scheme with an opaque path.
                const isHostWithPort =
                    URL.parse(value)?.origin === "null" &&
                    /^[^:/?#]+:\d+(?:[/?#]|$)/.test(value) &&
                    !/^(?:about|blob|data|file|javascript|mailto|tel|urn):/i.test(value);
                if (hasScheme && !isHostWithPort) {
                    return value;
                }

                return value.startsWith("//") ? `https:${value}` : `https://${value}`;
            };
        </script>
