        <script type="module">
            import { tabForDeepLink } from "resource://ladybird/about-pages/settings/dialog-deep-link.js";

            const tabButtons = [...document.querySelectorAll(".tab-button")];
            const searchInput = document.querySelector("#settings-search");
            const searchEmpty = document.querySelector("#search-empty");

            // Each setting is a row of a card, or a card of its own.
            function searchableItems(card) {
                return [card, ...card.querySelectorAll(".card-group, .card-body")].filter(
                    item => item.matches(".card-group, .card-body") && !item.querySelector(".card-group")
                );
            }

            function matches(element, query) {
                return element.textContent.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query);
            }

            // While searching, every section shows the settings whose text matches. A section or a card whose title
            // matches shows all of its settings.
            function search() {
                const query = searchInput.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
                const searching = query.length !== 0;
                document.body.classList.toggle("searching", searching);

                let anyMatch = false;
                document.querySelectorAll(".tab-panel").forEach(panel => {
                    panel.hidden = !searching && !panel.classList.contains("active");
                    const panelMatches = searching && panel.dataset.title.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query);
                    let panelHasMatch = panelMatches;
                    panel.querySelectorAll(".card").forEach(card => {
                        const title = card.previousElementSibling?.classList.contains("card-title")
                            ? card.previousElementSibling
                            : null;
                        const cardMatches = panelMatches || (title && searching && matches(title, query));
                        let cardHasMatch = cardMatches;
                        searchableItems(card).forEach(item => {
                            const itemMatches = !searching || cardMatches || matches(item, query);
                            item.classList.toggle("search-miss", !itemMatches);
                            cardHasMatch ||= itemMatches && !item.classList.contains("hidden");
                        });
                        card.classList.toggle("search-miss", searching && !cardHasMatch);
                        title?.classList.toggle("search-miss", searching && !cardHasMatch);
                        panelHasMatch ||= cardHasMatch;
                    });
                    panel.classList.toggle("search-miss", searching && !panelHasMatch);
                    anyMatch ||= panelHasMatch;
                });
                searchEmpty.hidden = !searching || anyMatch;
            }

            searchInput.addEventListener("input", search);
            searchInput.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
                if (event.key === "Escape" && searchInput.value.length !== 0) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    searchInput.value = "";
                    search();
                }
            });

            function switchTab(name) {
                const button = document.querySelector(`.tab-button[data-tab="${name}"]`);
                const panel = document.getElementById(`tab-${name}`);
                if (!button || !panel) {
                    return;
                }

                tabButtons.forEach(tabButton => {
                    const active = tabButton === button;
                    tabButton.classList.toggle("active", active);
                    tabButton.setAttribute("aria-selected", active ? "true" : "false");
                    tabButton.tabIndex = active ? 0 : -1;
                });
                document.querySelectorAll(".tab-panel").forEach(tabPanel => {
                    const active = tabPanel === panel;
                    tabPanel.classList.toggle("active", active);
                    tabPanel.hidden = !active;
                });

                button.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" });
            }

            tabButtons.forEach((button, index) => {
                const panel = document.getElementById(`tab-${button.dataset.tab}`);
                button.setAttribute("aria-controls", panel.id);
                panel.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");
                panel.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", button.id);

                button.addEventListener("click", () => {
                    if (searchInput.value.length !== 0) {
                        searchInput.value = "";
                        search();
                    }
                    switchTab(button.dataset.tab);
                    history.replaceState(null, "", `#${button.dataset.tab}`);
                });
                button.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
                    let targetIndex;
                    if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
                        targetIndex = (index - 1 + tabButtons.length) % tabButtons.length;
                    } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
                        targetIndex = (index + 1) % tabButtons.length;
                    } else if (event.key === "Home") {
                        targetIndex = 0;
                    } else if (event.key === "End") {
                        targetIndex = tabButtons.length - 1;
                    } else {
                        return;
                    }

                    event.preventDefault();
                    tabButtons[targetIndex].click();
                    tabButtons[targetIndex].focus();
                });
            });

            const hash = location.hash.slice(1);
            switchTab(hash ? tabForDeepLink(hash) : "appearance");

            // FIXME: Remove this once closedby="any" triggers for Esc key.
            document.querySelectorAll("dialog").forEach(dialog => {
                dialog.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
                    if (event.key === "Escape") {
                        dialog.close();
                    }
                });
            });

            // A label names a field to type a new value into, so clicking it selects the field's text, and typing
            // replaces it.
            const TEXT_FIELD_SELECTOR = 'input:is([type="text"], [type="url"], [type="number"], [type="search"])';

            document.addEventListener("click", event => {
                const field = event.target.closest?.("label[for]")?.control;
                if (!field || field.disabled || !field.matches(TEXT_FIELD_SELECTOR)) {
                    return;
                }

                event.preventDefault();
                field.focus();
                field.select();
            });

            // Enter commits a field's new value and leaves the field, and Escape restores the value the field had when it
            // took focus and leaves it. A search field holds no setting to restore, so Escape clears it, and leaves it once
            // it is empty. A field in a dialog keeps the dialog's keys instead, and a textarea keeps Enter for new lines
            // and keeps its text on Escape, as its changes are saved with a button of their own.
            const valueAtFocus = new WeakMap();

            document.addEventListener("focusin", event => {
                if (event.target.matches?.(TEXT_FIELD_SELECTOR)) {
                    valueAtFocus.set(event.target, event.target.value);
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
                if ((event.key !== "Enter" && event.key !== "Escape") || event.defaultPrevented) {
                    return;
                }

                const field = event.target;
                if (field.closest?.("dialog")) {
                    return;
                }

                if (field.matches?.(TEXT_FIELD_SELECTOR)) {
                    const isSearch = field.type === "search";
                    const restoredValue = isSearch ? "" : valueAtFocus.get(field);
                    if (event.key === "Escape" && restoredValue !== undefined && field.value !== restoredValue) {
                        field.value = restoredValue;
                        // NB: Filters and the like follow the field as it is edited, so they learn of the new value.
                        field.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
                        if (isSearch) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                } else if (!(event.key === "Escape" && field.matches?.("textarea"))) {
                    return;
                }

                event.preventDefault();
                field.blur();
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUILoaded", () => {
                ladybird.sendMessage("loadFeatures");
                ladybird.sendMessage("loadCurrentSettings");
            });
        </script>
    </body>
</html>

const configFilter = document.querySelector("#config-filter");
const configList = document.querySelector("#config-list");

const CONFIG_VARIABLES = new Map();

function sendConfigVariableValue(variable, value) {
    ladybird.sendMessage("setConfigVariable", {
        name: variable.name,
        value,
    });
}

function createControl(variable) {
    const type = variable.type === "array" && variable.elementType === "string" ? "textarea" : "input";
    const input = document.createElement(type);
    input.id = variable.name;
    // NB: Configuration values are names, numbers and addresses, not words to check the spelling of.
    input.spellcheck = false;

    if (variable.type === "boolean") {
        input.type = "checkbox";
        input.switch = true;
        input.checked = !!variable.value;
        input.addEventListener("change", () => {
            sendConfigVariableValue(variable, input.checked);
        });

        return input;
    }

    if (type === "textarea") {
        input.rows = 3;
        input.value = Array.isArray(variable.value) ? variable.value.join("\n") : "";
        input.addEventListener("change", () => {
            const value = input.value
                .split(/\r?\n/)
                .map(entry => entry.trim())
                .filter(entry => entry.length !== 0);

            sendConfigVariableValue(variable, value);
        });

        return input;
    }

    input.value = variable.value ?? "";

    if (variable.type === "number") {
        input.type = "number";
        input.step = "any";
        input.addEventListener("change", () => {
            const value = Number.parseFloat(input.value);
            if (!Number.isNaN(value)) {
                sendConfigVariableValue(variable, value);
            }
        });
    } else {
        input.type = "text";
        input.addEventListener("change", () => {
            sendConfigVariableValue(variable, input.value);
        });
    }

    return input;
}

function createRow(variable) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.classList.add("card-group");
    row.classList.add("config-row");
    row.classList.add("inline-container");
    row.classList.add("control-row");
    row.dataset.filterText = `${variable.title} ${variable.description}`.toLowerCase();

    const title = document.createElement("p");
    title.textContent = variable.title;

    const description = document.createElement("p");
    description.classList.add("description");
    description.textContent = variable.description;

    const label = document.createElement("label");
    label.htmlFor = variable.name;
    label.append(title, description);

    row.append(label, createControl(variable));
    return row;
}

function applyFilter() {
    const filter = configFilter.value.trim().toLowerCase();

    document.querySelectorAll(".config-row").forEach(row => {
        row.classList.toggle("hidden", filter.length !== 0 && !row.dataset.filterText.includes(filter));
    });
}

function loadConfigVariables(settings) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(settings, "configVariableDefinitions")) {
        return;
    }

    const configVariables = settings.configVariableDefinitions || [];
    configVariables.forEach(variable => {
        // This one has its own switch on the Feedback tab.
        if (variable.name === "ui.toolbar.show_feedback_button") {
            return;
        }
        // This one has its own switch on the Appearance tab.
        if (variable.name === "ui.window.use_client_side_decorations") {
            return;
        }

        const previous = CONFIG_VARIABLES.get(variable.name);
        if (previous && JSON.stringify(previous.value) === JSON.stringify(variable.value)) {
            return;
        }

        CONFIG_VARIABLES.set(variable.name, variable);

        const row = createRow(variable);
        const existing = document.getElementById(variable.name)?.closest(".config-row");
        if (existing) {
            existing.replaceWith(row);
        } else {
            configList.append(row);
        }
    });

    applyFilter();
}

configFilter.addEventListener("input", applyFilter);

document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
    if (event.detail.name === "loadSettings") {
        loadConfigVariables(event.detail.data);
    }
});

const showMenuBar = document.querySelector("#show-menu-bar");
const alwaysShowScrollbars = document.querySelector("#always-show-scrollbars");

const windowDecorations = document.querySelector("#use-client-side-window-decorations");
const windowDecorationsGroup = document.querySelector("#window-decorations-group");
const showBookmarksBar = document.querySelector("#show-bookmarks-bar");
const interfaceTheme = document.querySelector("#interface-theme");
const websiteColorScheme = document.querySelector("#website-color-scheme");
const colorTheme = document.querySelector("#color-theme");

const WINDOW_DECORATIONS_VARIABLE = "ui.window.use_client_side_decorations";

function segmentedValue(control) {
    return control.querySelector("input:checked")?.value;
}

function setSegmentedValue(control, value) {
    for (const input of control.querySelectorAll("input")) input.checked = input.value === value;
}

let APPEARANCE = {};

const loadFeatures = features => {
    showMenuBarGroup.classList.toggle("hidden", !features?.menuBar);
};

const loadSettings = settings => {
    const windowDecorationsVariable = settings.configVariableDefinitions?.find(
        variable => variable.name === WINDOW_DECORATIONS_VARIABLE
    );
    if (windowDecorationsVariable) {
        windowDecorations.checked = windowDecorationsVariable.value;
        windowDecorationsGroup.classList.remove("hidden");
    }

    if (!Object.hasOwn(settings, "appearance")) {
        return;
    }

    APPEARANCE = settings.appearance || {};

    showMenuBar.checked = !!APPEARANCE.showMenuBar;
    alwaysShowScrollbars.checked = !!APPEARANCE.alwaysShowScrollbars;
    showBookmarksBar.value = APPEARANCE.showBookmarksBar || "never";
    setSegmentedValue(interfaceTheme, APPEARANCE.interfaceTheme || "system");
    setSegmentedValue(websiteColorScheme, APPEARANCE.websiteColorScheme || "system");
    setSegmentedValue(colorTheme, APPEARANCE.colorTheme || "neutral");
};

function saveAppearance() {
    ladybird.sendMessage("setAppearance", APPEARANCE);
}

showMenuBar.addEventListener("change", () => {
    APPEARANCE.showMenuBar = showMenuBar.checked;
    saveAppearance();
});

windowDecorations.addEventListener("change", () => {
    ladybird.sendMessage("setConfigVariable", {
        name: WINDOW_DECORATIONS_VARIABLE,
        value: windowDecorations.checked,
    });
});

alwaysShowScrollbars.addEventListener("change", () => {
    APPEARANCE.alwaysShowScrollbars = alwaysShowScrollbars.checked;
    saveAppearance();
});

showBookmarksBar.addEventListener("change", () => {
    APPEARANCE.showBookmarksBar = showBookmarksBar.value;
    saveAppearance();
});

interfaceTheme.addEventListener("change", () => {
    APPEARANCE.interfaceTheme = segmentedValue(interfaceTheme);
    saveAppearance();
});

colorTheme.addEventListener("change", () => {
    APPEARANCE.colorTheme = segmentedValue(colorTheme);
    saveAppearance();
});

websiteColorScheme.addEventListener("change", () => {
    APPEARANCE.websiteColorScheme = segmentedValue(websiteColorScheme);
    saveAppearance();
});

document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
    if (event.detail.name === "loadFeatures") {
        loadFeatures(event.detail.data);
    } else if (event.detail.name === "loadSettings") {
        loadSettings(event.detail.data);
    }
});

function createListRow(list, removable = false) {
    const row = document.querySelector("#filter-list-row").content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);
    const toggle = row.querySelector("input");
    const label = row.querySelector("label");
    const labelText = row.querySelector(".label");
    const details = row.querySelector(".description");

    const id = `content-blocker-list-${list.identifier}`;
    const name = list.name ?? list.url;

    toggle.id = id;
    label.htmlFor = id;
    labelText.textContent = name;

    // A list added by the user has no description of its own, so it is described by where it comes from.
    details.textContent = list.description || (list.url ? new URL(list.url).host : "Local file");

    toggle.checked = list.enabled;
    toggle.addEventListener("change", () => {
        ladybird.sendMessage("setContentBlockerListEnabled", { identifier: list.identifier, enabled: toggle.checked });
    });

    const remove = row.querySelector("button");
    if (removable) {
        remove.setAttribute("aria-label", `Remove ${name}`);
        remove.addEventListener("click", () => ladybird.sendMessage("removeContentBlockerList", list.identifier));
    } else {
        remove.remove();
    }

    return row;
}

function createDisabledSiteRow(site) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");

    const tile = document.createElement("span");
    tile.className = "letter-tile";
    tile.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    tile.textContent = site.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

    const name = document.createElement("span");
    name.className = "item-name";
    name.textContent = site;

    const turnBackOn = document.createElement("button");
    turnBackOn.className = "link-button";
    turnBackOn.textContent = "Turn back on";
    turnBackOn.setAttribute("aria-label", `Turn content blocking back on for ${site}`);
    turnBackOn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        ladybird.sendMessage("setContentBlockerEnabledForSite", { site, enabled: true });
    });

    row.append(tile, name, turnBackOn);
    return row;
}

function loadSettings(settings) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(settings, "contentBlockers")) {
        const contentBlockers = settings.contentBlockers;
        enableContentBlocking.checked = contentBlockers.enabled;

        if (customFilters.value === savedCustomFilters) {
            customFilters.value = contentBlockers.customFilters;
        }

        savedCustomFilters = contentBlockers.customFilters;

        const sites = [...(contentBlockers.disabledSites ?? [])].sort();
        disabledSites.replaceChildren(...sites.map(createDisabledSiteRow));
        disabledSitesSection.hidden = sites.length === 0;
    }

    if (Object.hasOwn(settings, "contentBlockerLists")) {
        contentBlockerLists.replaceChildren();
        languageLists.replaceChildren();

        for (const list of settings.contentBlockerLists) {
            const container = list.builtIn && list.languageSpecific ? languageLists : contentBlockerLists;
            container.append(createListRow(list, !list.builtIn));
        }
    }

    if (Object.hasOwn(settings, "contentBlockerListUpdateInProgress")) {
        updateLists.disabled = settings.contentBlockerListUpdateInProgress;
        updateLists.innerText = settings.contentBlockerListUpdateInProgress ? "Updating…" : "Update enabled lists";

        clearInterval(updateTimer);
        if (settings.contentBlockerListUpdateInProgress) {
            updateTimer = setInterval(() => ladybird.sendMessage("refreshSettings"), 1000);
        }
    }
}

addFilterList.addEventListener("click", () => {

addSubscription.addEventListener("click", () => {
    subscriptionUrl.value = ensureURLHasScheme(subscriptionUrl.value);
    if (!subscriptionUrl.reportValidity() || subscriptionUrl.value.length === 0) {
        return;
    }
    const url = new URL(subscriptionUrl.value);
    if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") {
        subscriptionStatus.innerText = "Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL.";
        return;
    }
    ladybird.sendMessage("addCustomContentBlockerSubscription", subscriptionUrl.value);
    subscriptionUrl.value = "";
});

importLocalList.addEventListener("click", () => localListPicker.click());
localListPicker.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    const file = localListPicker.files[0];
    if (!file) {
        return;
    }
    if (file.size > 64 * 1024 * 1024) {
        localListStatus.innerText = "The selected list is larger than 64 MiB.";
        localListPicker.value = "";
        return;
    }
    const data = {
        name: file.name,
        contents: await file.text(),
    };
    // IPC's JSON serializer uses six-byte escapes for carriage returns and form feeds.
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(data, (_, value) =>
        typeof value === "string" ? value.replace(/[\r\f]/g, "\0") : value
    );
    // Leave room for the IPC message headers and method name.
    const maximumPayloadSize = 64 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024;
    if (
        serialized.length > maximumPayloadSize ||
        new TextEncoder().encode(serialized).byteLength > maximumPayloadSize
    ) {
        localListStatus.innerText = "The encoded list is too large to import.";
        localListPicker.value = "";
        return;
    }
    ladybird.sendMessage("importLocalContentBlockerList", data);
    localListPicker.value = "";
});

saveCustomFilters.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (new TextEncoder().encode(customFilters.value).byteLength > maximumCustomFilterSize) {
        customFiltersStatus.innerText = "Custom filters must be 4 MiB or smaller.";
        customFilters.focus();
        return;
    }
    ladybird.sendMessage("setCustomContentBlockerFilters", customFilters.value);
    customFiltersStatus.innerText = "Saved";
});

document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
    if (event.detail.name === "loadSettings") {
        loadSettings(event.detail.data);
    } else if (event.detail.name === "contentBlockerResult") {
        const result = event.detail.data;
        const status = result.operation === "subscription" ? subscriptionStatus : localListStatus;
        status.innerText = result.message;
    }
});

const loadSettings = settings => {

        document.querySelector(`#${setting}-settings`).hidden = Object.keys(CONTENT[key] ?? {}).length === 0;
    }

    const snapped = snapToClosestFactor(CONTENT.defaultZoomLevelFactor);
    if (snapped !== null) {
        defaultZoomLevel.value = snapped.toString();
    } else {
        console.warn("No close match found for zoom factor: ", CONTENT.defaultZoomLevelFactor);
    }

    enableForceDark.checked = !!CONTENT.enableForceDark;
    if (hostSettings.open) {
        renderHostSettings();
    }

const ZOOM_LEVEL_FACTORS = [1 / 3.0, 0.5, 2 / 3.0, 0.75, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 4.0, 5.0];
const ZOOM_LEVEL_FACTOR_MAP = ZOOM_LEVEL_FACTORS.map(factor => ({
    factor,
    label: `${Math.round(factor * 100)}%`,
}));

ZOOM_LEVEL_FACTOR_MAP.forEach(item => {
    const zoomLevelOption = document.createElement("option");
    zoomLevelOption.textContent = item.label;
    zoomLevelOption.value = item.factor.toString();
    defaultZoomLevel.appendChild(zoomLevelOption);
});

function snapToClosestFactor(value) {
    const tolerance = 0.001;

    let closest = ZOOM_LEVEL_FACTOR_MAP[0].factor;
    let minDiff = Math.abs(value - closest);

    for (const item of ZOOM_LEVEL_FACTOR_MAP) {
        const diff = Math.abs(value - item.factor);
        if (diff < minDiff) {
            minDiff = diff;
            closest = item.factor;
        }
    }

    return minDiff <= tolerance ? closest : null;
}

defaultZoomLevel.addEventListener("change", () => {
    CONTENT.defaultZoomLevelFactor = parseFloat(defaultZoomLevel.value);
    ladybird.sendMessage("setContentSettings", CONTENT);
});

enableForceDark.addEventListener("change", () => {
    CONTENT.enableForceDark = enableForceDark.checked;
    ladybird.sendMessage("setContentSettings", CONTENT);
});

document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
    if (event.detail.name === "loadSettings") {
        loadSettings(event.detail.data);
    }
});

FILE: Base/res/ladybird/about-pages/settings/dialog-deep-link.js
const REGISTRY = new Map();
let globalListenersInstalled = false;

function syncDialogs() {
    if (!window.ladybird) {
        return;
    }

    const activeHash = location.hash.slice(1);
    const active = REGISTRY.get(activeHash);

    for (const { dialog } of REGISTRY.values()) {
        if (dialog !== active?.dialog && dialog.open) {
            dialog.close();
        }
    }

    if (active) {
        active.onOpen?.();
        if (!active.dialog.open) {
            active.dialog.showModal();
        }
    }
}

export function registerDialogDeepLink({ hash, tab, dialog, onOpen }) {
    REGISTRY.set(hash, { tab, dialog, onOpen });

    dialog.addEventListener("close", () => {
        if (location.hash.slice(1) === hash) {
            history.back();
        }
    });

    if (globalListenersInstalled) {
        return;
    }
    globalListenersInstalled = true;

    window.addEventListener("hashchange", syncDialogs);

    document.addEventListener("WebUILoaded", () => {
        const hash = location.hash.slice(1);
        const config = REGISTRY.get(hash);
        if (!config) {
            return;
        }

        history.replaceState(null, "", `#${config.tab}`);
        location.hash = hash;
    });
}

export function tabForDeepLink(hash) {
    return REGISTRY.get(hash)?.tab ?? hash;
}

function loadSettings(settings) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(settings, "languages")) {
        return;
    }

    LANGUAGES = settings.languages;

    if (languagesDialog.open) {
        showLanguages();
    }
}

function languageDisplayName(language) {
    const item = AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES.find(item => item.language === language);
    return item.displayName;
}

function saveLanguages() {
    ladybird.sendMessage("setLanguages", LANGUAGES);
}

function moveLanguage(from, to) {
    [LANGUAGES[from], LANGUAGES[to]] = [LANGUAGES[to], LANGUAGES[from]];
    saveLanguages();
}

function removeLanguage(index) {
    LANGUAGES.splice(index, 1);
    saveLanguages();
}

function loadLanguages() {
    for (const language of AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES) {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.text = language.displayName;
        option.value = language.language;

        languagesSelect.add(option);
    }
}

function showLanguages() {
    languagesList.innerHTML = "";

    LANGUAGES.forEach((language, index) => {
        const name = document.createElement("span");
        name.className = "dialog-list-item-label";
        name.textContent = languageDisplayName(language);

        const moveUp = document.createElement("button");
        moveUp.className = "dialog-button";
        moveUp.innerHTML = upwardArrowSVG;
        moveUp.title = "Move up";

        if (index === 0) {
            moveUp.disabled = true;
        } else {
            moveUp.addEventListener("click", () => {
                moveLanguage(index, index - 1);
            });
        }

        const moveDown = document.createElement("button");
        moveDown.className = "dialog-button";
        moveDown.innerHTML = downwardArrowSVG;
        moveDown.title = "Move down";

        if (index === LANGUAGES.length - 1) {
            moveDown.disabled = true;
        } else {
            moveDown.addEventListener("click", () => {
                moveLanguage(index, index + 1);
            });
        }

        const remove = document.createElement("button");
        remove.className = "dialog-button";
        remove.innerHTML = "&times;";
        remove.title = "Remove";

        if (LANGUAGES.length <= 1) {
            remove.disabled = true;
        } else {
            remove.addEventListener("click", () => {
                removeLanguage(index);
            });
        }

        const controls = document.createElement("div");
        controls.className = "dialog-controls";
        controls.appendChild(moveUp);
        controls.appendChild(moveDown);
        controls.appendChild(remove);

        const item = document.createElement("div");
        item.className = "dialog-list-item";
        item.appendChild(name);
        item.appendChild(controls);

        languagesList.appendChild(item);
    });

    for (const language of languagesSelect.options) {
        language.disabled = LANGUAGES.includes(language.value);
    }

    if (!languagesDialog.open) {
        setTimeout(() => languagesSelect.focus());
        languagesDialog.showModal();
    }
}

languagesAdd.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const language = languagesSelect.value;

    languagesAdd.disabled = true;
    languagesSelect.selectedIndex = 0;

const customDnsSettings = document.querySelector("#custom-dns-settings");
const dnsForciblyEnabled = document.querySelector("#dns-forcibly-enabled");
const dnsProxyNote = document.querySelector("#dns-proxy-note");

const dnsUpstream = document.querySelector("#dns-upstream");
const dnsType = document.querySelector("#dns-type");
const dnsServer = document.querySelector("#dns-server");
const dnsPort = document.querySelector("#dns-port");
const dnssecToggle = document.querySelector("#dnssec-toggle");

let DNS_SETTINGS = {};

function loadSettings(settings) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(settings, "dnsSettings")) {
        return;
    }

    DNS_SETTINGS = settings.dnsSettings || {};
    loadDnsSettings();
}

function loadDnsSettings() {
    dnsUpstream.value = DNS_SETTINGS.mode || "system";

    if (dnsUpstream.value === "custom") {
        dnsType.value = DNS_SETTINGS.type;
        dnsServer.value = DNS_SETTINGS.server;
        dnsPort.value = DNS_SETTINGS.port;
        dnssecToggle.checked = DNS_SETTINGS.dnssec;

        customDnsSettings.classList.remove("hidden");
    } else {
        dnsType.value = "udp";
        dnsServer.value = "";
        dnsPort.value = "53";
        dnssecToggle.checked = false;

        customDnsSettings.classList.add("hidden");
    }

    if (DNS_SETTINGS.forciblyEnabled) {
        dnsForciblyEnabled.classList.remove("hidden");

        dnsUpstream.disabled = true;
        dnsType.disabled = true;
        dnsServer.disabled = true;
        dnsPort.disabled = true;
        dnssecToggle.disabled = true;
    } else {
        dnsForciblyEnabled.classList.add("hidden");

        dnsUpstream.disabled = false;
        dnsType.disabled = false;
        dnsServer.disabled = false;
        dnsPort.disabled = false;
        dnssecToggle.disabled = false;
    }

    const proxy = DNS_SETTINGS.proxy;

    if (proxy) {
        dnsProxyNote.textContent = proxy.resolvesAllHostnames
            ? `The proxy at ${proxy.server} resolves hostnames itself, so these settings do not apply to web requests and DNSSEC cannot be validated.`
            : `The proxy at ${proxy.server} resolves hostnames itself, so these settings do not apply to requests sent through it and DNSSEC cannot be validated for them.`;
        dnsProxyNote.classList.remove("hidden");

        if (proxy.resolvesAllHostnames) {
            dnssecToggle.checked = false;
            dnssecToggle.disabled = true;
        }
    } else {
        dnsProxyNote.classList.add("hidden");
    }
}

        mode: "custom",
        type: dnsType.value,
        server: dnsServer.value,
        port: dnsPort.value | 0,
        // Keep the saved DNSSEC setting while the proxy makes it inapplicable.
        dnssec: DNS_SETTINGS.proxy?.resolvesAllHostnames ? !!DNS_SETTINGS.dnssec : dnssecToggle.checked,
    });
}

dnssecToggle.addEventListener("change", updateDnsSettings);

import { registerDialogDeepLink } from "./dialog-deep-link.js";

const siteSettings = document.querySelector("#site-settings");
const siteSettingsAdd = document.querySelector("#site-settings-add");
const siteSettingsClose = document.querySelector("#site-settings-close");
const siteSettingsList = document.querySelector("#site-settings-list");
const siteSettingsInput = document.querySelector("#site-settings-input");
const siteSettingsDecision = document.querySelector("#site-settings-decision");
const siteSettingsRemoveAll = document.querySelector("#site-settings-remove-all");
const siteSettingsTitle = document.querySelector("#site-settings-title");

const PERMISSION_POLICIES = [
    { value: "allow", label: "Allow" },
    { value: "block", label: "Block" },
];

const SITE_SETTINGS = {
    autoplay: {
        title: "Autoplay",
        policies: Array.from(document.querySelector("#autoplay-policy").options, option => ({
            value: option.value,
            label: option.textContent,
        })),
    },
    geolocation: { title: "Location", policies: PERMISSION_POLICIES },
    microphone: { title: "Microphone", policies: PERMISSION_POLICIES },
    notifications: { title: "Notifications", policies: PERMISSION_POLICIES },
};

let SETTINGS = {};
let CURRENT_SETTING = null;

function loadSiteSettings(data) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(data, "siteSettings")) {
        return;
    }

    SETTINGS = data.siteSettings;

    for (const setting of Object.keys(SITE_SETTINGS)) {
        const control = document.querySelector(`#${setting}-policy`);
        if (control.type === "checkbox") {
            control.checked = SETTINGS[setting].policy === "ask";
        } else {
            control.value = SETTINGS[setting].policy;
        }
    }

    if (siteSettings.open) {
        renderSiteSettings();
    }
}

function forciblyEnableSiteSettings(settings) {
    settings.forEach(setting => {
        const label = document.querySelector(`#${setting}-forcibly-enabled`);
        label.classList.remove("hidden");

        const controls = document.querySelector(`#${setting}-controls`);
        controls.classList.add("hidden");
    });
}

function populatePolicySelect(select, value) {
    const policies = SITE_SETTINGS[CURRENT_SETTING].policies;
    select.replaceChildren();

    for (const { value, label } of policies) {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = value;
        option.textContent = label;
        select.appendChild(option);
    }

    if (value === "allow-once") {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = value;
        option.textContent = "Allow this time";
        select.appendChild(option);
    }

    select.value = value ?? policies[0].value;
}

function renderSiteSettings() {
    siteSettingsList.replaceChildren();

    // A deep link can open the dialog before settings have loaded.
    const siteFilters = SETTINGS[CURRENT_SETTING]?.siteFilters ?? [];
    if (siteFilters.length === 0) {
        const placeholder = document.createElement("div");
        placeholder.className = "dialog-list-item-placeholder";
        placeholder.textContent = "No sites added";
        siteSettingsList.appendChild(placeholder);
    }

    siteFilters.forEach(site => {
        const siteFilter = site.filter;
        const filter = document.createElement("span");
        filter.className = "dialog-list-item-label";
        filter.textContent = siteFilter;

        const select = document.createElement("select");
        select.setAttribute("aria-label", `Policy for ${siteFilter}`);
        populatePolicySelect(select, site.policy);
        select.addEventListener("change", () => {
            ladybird.sendMessage("addSiteSettingFilter", {
                setting: CURRENT_SETTING,
                filter: siteFilter,
                policy: select.value,
            });
        });

        const remove = document.createElement("button");
        remove.className = "dialog-button";
        remove.title = `Remove ${siteFilter}`;
        remove.innerHTML =
            '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3l10 10M13 3L3 13" /></svg>';
        remove.addEventListener("click", () => {
            ladybird.sendMessage("removeSiteSettingFilter", {
                setting: CURRENT_SETTING,
                filter: siteFilter,
            });
        });

        const item = document.createElement("div");
        item.className = "dialog-list-item";
        item.dataset.filter = siteFilter;
        item.appendChild(filter);
        item.appendChild(select);
        item.appendChild(remove);

        siteSettingsList.appendChild(item);
    });
}

function showSiteSettings(setting) {
    if (CURRENT_SETTING !== setting) {
        siteSettingsInput.value = "";
        siteSettingsInput.setCustomValidity("");
    }

    const selectedPolicy = CURRENT_SETTING === setting ? siteSettingsDecision.value : undefined;
    CURRENT_SETTING = setting;

    siteSettingsTitle.innerText = SITE_SETTINGS[setting].title;
    populatePolicySelect(siteSettingsDecision, selectedPolicy);
    renderSiteSettings();

    setTimeout(() => siteSettingsInput.focus());
}

function addSiteSettingFilter() {
    let filter = ensureURLHasScheme(siteSettingsInput.value);
    if (!filter) {
        return;
    }

    const url = URL.parse(filter);
    if (!url || url.origin === "null") {
        siteSettingsInput.setCustomValidity("Enter a site URL, such as https://example.com.");
        siteSettingsInput.reportValidity();
        return;
    }
    filter = url.origin;

    ladybird.sendMessage("addSiteSettingFilter", {
        setting: CURRENT_SETTING,
        filter,
        policy: siteSettingsDecision.value,
    });

    siteSettingsInput.classList.add("success");
    siteSettingsInput.value = "";

    setTimeout(() => {
        siteSettingsInput.classList.remove("success");
    }, 1000);

    setTimeout(() => siteSettingsInput.focus());
}

siteSettingsAdd.addEventListener("click", addSiteSettingFilter);

siteSettingsInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
    siteSettingsInput.setCustomValidity("");
});

siteSettingsInput.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    if (event.key === "Enter") {
        addSiteSettingFilter();
    }
});

siteSettingsClose.addEventListener("click", () => {
    siteSettings.close();
});

siteSettingsRemoveAll.addEventListener("click", () => {
    ladybird.sendMessage("removeAllSiteSettingFilters", { setting: CURRENT_SETTING });
});

for (const setting of Object.keys(SITE_SETTINGS)) {

        hash: setting,
        tab: "permissions",
        dialog: siteSettings,

const byteFormatter = getByteFormatter(unit => {
    return {
        unitDisplay: unit === "byte" ? "long" : "short",
        maximumFractionDigits: 1,
    };
});

const browsingDataSettings = document.querySelector("#browsing-data-settings");
const browsingDataSettingsClose = document.querySelector("#browsing-data-settings-close");

const clearBrowsingDataCachedFiles = document.querySelector("#clear-browsing-data-cached-files");
const clearBrowsingDataCachedFilesSize = document.querySelector("#clear-browsing-data-cached-files-size");
const clearBrowsingDataDownloadHistory = document.querySelector("#clear-browsing-data-download-history");
const clearBrowsingDataHistory = document.querySelector("#clear-browsing-data-history");
const clearBrowsingDataRemoveData = document.querySelector("#clear-browsing-data-remove-data");
const clearBrowsingDataSiteData = document.querySelector("#clear-browsing-data-site-data");
const clearBrowsingDataSiteDataSize = document.querySelector("#clear-browsing-data-site-data-size");
const clearBrowsingDataTimeRange = document.querySelector("#clear-browsing-data-time-range");

const globalPrivacyControlToggle = document.querySelector("#global-privacy-control-toggle");

function loadSettings(settings) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(settings, "globalPrivacyControl")) {
        globalPrivacyControlToggle.checked = settings.globalPrivacyControl;
    }
}

function updateBrowsingDataSizes(sizes) {
    const totalSize = sizes.totalCacheSize + sizes.totalSiteDataSize;

    browsingDataTotalSize.innerText = `Your browsing data is currently using ${byteFormatter.formatBytes(totalSize)} of disk space`;

    clearBrowsingDataCachedFilesSize.innerText = ` (remove ${byteFormatter.formatBytes(sizes.cacheSizeSinceRequestedTime)})`;
    clearBrowsingDataSiteDataSize.innerText = ` (remove ${byteFormatter.formatBytes(sizes.siteDataSizeSinceRequestedTime)})`;
}

function computeTimeRange() {
    const now = Temporal.Now.zonedDateTimeISO();

    switch (clearBrowsingDataTimeRange.value) {
        case "lastHour":
            return now.subtract({ hours: 1 });
        case "last4Hours":
            return now.subtract({ hours: 4 });
        case "today":
            return now.startOfDay();
        case "all":
            return null;
        default:
            console.error(`Unrecognized time range: ${clearBrowsingDataTimeRange.value}`);
            return now;
    }
}

function estimateBrowsingDataSizes() {
    const since = computeTimeRange();

    ladybird.sendMessage("estimateBrowsingDataSizes", {
        since: since?.epochMilliseconds,
    });
}

registerDialogDeepLink({
    hash: "clearBrowsingData",
    tab: "privacy",
    dialog: browsingDataSettingsDialog,
    onOpen: estimateBrowsingDataSizes,
});

    clearBrowsingDataRemoveData.disabled =
        !clearBrowsingDataCachedFiles.checked &&
        !clearBrowsingDataHistory.checked &&
        !clearBrowsingDataDownloadHistory.checked &&
        !clearBrowsingDataSiteData.checked;
}

clearBrowsingDataHistory.addEventListener("change", setRemoveDataEnabledState);
clearBrowsingDataDownloadHistory.addEventListener("change", setRemoveDataEnabledState);
clearBrowsingDataSiteData.addEventListener("change", setRemoveDataEnabledState);

clearBrowsingDataRemoveData.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const since = computeTimeRange();

    ladybird.sendMessage("clearBrowsingData", {
        since: since?.epochMilliseconds,
        cachedFiles: clearBrowsingDataCachedFiles.checked,
        history: clearBrowsingDataHistory.checked,
        downloadHistory: clearBrowsingDataDownloadHistory.checked,
        siteData: clearBrowsingDataSiteData.checked,
    });

    browsingDataSettingsDialog.close();
});

    ladybird.sendMessage("setGlobalPrivacyControl", globalPrivacyControlToggle.checked);
});

    } else if (event.detail.name === "estimatedBrowsingDataSizes") {

const searchClose = document.querySelector("#search-close");

const searchSuggestionsDescription = document.querySelector("#search-suggestions-description");

let SEARCH_ENGINE = {};
let ENGINES = [];

function selectedEngine() {
    return searchEngine.querySelector("input:checked");
}

// Each engine is a row of the list, with its initial on a tile, and a check mark when it's the one chosen.
function createEngineChoice(name, supportsSuggestions) {
    const choice = document.createElement("label");
    choice.className = "engine-choice";

    const radio = document.createElement("input");
    radio.type = "radio";
    radio.name = "search-engine";
    radio.value = name;
    radio.dataset.supportsSuggestions = supportsSuggestions;

    const tile = document.createElement("span");
    tile.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    if (name) {
        tile.className = "letter-tile";
        tile.textContent = name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
    } else {
        tile.className = "empty-tile";
    }

    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.className = "engine-name";
    label.textContent = name || "None";

    const check = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
    check.setAttribute("class", "engine-check");
    check.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 16 16");
    check.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    const path = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
    path.setAttribute("d", "M3.5 8.5l3 3 6-7");
    check.append(path);

    choice.append(radio, tile, label, check);
    return choice;
}

function updateSearchSuggestionsControl() {
    const engine = selectedEngine();
    const supportsSuggestions = engine?.dataset.supportsSuggestions === "true";
    searchSuggestionsEnabled.disabled = !supportsSuggestions;
    if (!engine?.value) searchSuggestionsDescription.textContent = "Choose a search engine to use search suggestions.";
    else if (!supportsSuggestions)
        searchSuggestionsDescription.textContent = `Search suggestions aren't available for ${engine.value}.`;
    else searchSuggestionsDescription.textContent = `Sends what you type to ${engine.value}.`;
}

function renderEngineSettings() {
    const engines = [...ENGINES, ...(SEARCH_ENGINE.custom || [])];
    searchEngine.replaceChildren(
        createEngineChoice("", false),
        ...engines.map(engine =>
            createEngineChoice(engine.name, Boolean(engine.supportsSuggestions || engine.suggestionsUrl))
        )
    );
    const chosen = [...searchEngine.querySelectorAll("input")].find(
        radio => radio.value === (SEARCH_ENGINE.engine || "")
    );
    if (chosen) chosen.checked = true;

    searchSuggestionsEnabled.checked = SEARCH_ENGINE.suggestions === true;
    updateSearchSuggestionsControl();
    if (searchDialog.open) showSearchEngineSettings();
}

function saveSearchEngineSettings() {
    ladybird.sendMessage("setSearchEngineSettings", {
        engine: selectedEngine()?.value || null,
        suggestions: searchSuggestionsEnabled.checked,
    });
}

searchEngine.addEventListener("change", saveSearchEngineSettings);
searchSuggestionsEnabled.addEventListener("change", saveSearchEngineSettings);

function showSearchEngineSettings() {
    searchCustomName.classList.remove("error");
    searchCustomURL.classList.remove("error");
    searchCustomSuggestionsURL.classList.remove("error");
    searchList.innerHTML = "";

    const custom = SEARCH_ENGINE.custom || [];

    if (custom.length === 0) {

        placeholder.className = "dialog-list-item-placeholder";
        placeholder.textContent = "No custom search engines added";

        searchList.appendChild(placeholder);
    }

        const name = document.createElement("span");
        name.textContent = custom.name;

        url.style = "padding-left: 0";
        url.textContent = ` · ${custom.url}`;

        const engine = document.createElement("span");

function addCustomSearchEngine() {
    searchCustomName.classList.remove("error");
    searchCustomURL.classList.remove("error");
    searchCustomSuggestionsURL.classList.remove("error");

    if (!searchCustomName.value.trim()) {
        searchCustomName.classList.add("error");
        return;
    }

    for (const radio of searchEngine.querySelectorAll("input")) {
        if (searchCustomName.value === radio.value) {
            searchCustomName.classList.add("error");
            return;
        }
    }

    searchCustomURL.value = ensureURLHasScheme(searchCustomURL.value);
    searchCustomSuggestionsURL.value = ensureURLHasScheme(searchCustomSuggestionsURL.value);

    if (!containsValidURL(searchCustomURL)) {
        searchCustomURL.classList.add("error");
        return;
    }

    if (
        searchCustomSuggestionsURL.value &&
        (!containsValidURL(searchCustomSuggestionsURL) ||
            !searchCustomSuggestionsURL.value.includes("%s") ||
            !["http:", "https:"].includes(new URL(searchCustomSuggestionsURL.value).protocol))
    ) {
        searchCustomSuggestionsURL.classList.add("error");
        return;
    }

    ladybird.sendMessage("addCustomSearchEngine", {
        name: searchCustomName.value,
        url: searchCustomURL.value,
        suggestionsUrl: searchCustomSuggestionsURL.value,
    });

    searchCustomName.value = "";
    searchCustomURL.value = "";
    searchCustomSuggestionsURL.value = "";

    setTimeout(() => searchCustomName.focus());
}

searchCustomAdd.addEventListener("click", addCustomSearchEngine);

for (const input of [searchCustomName, searchCustomURL, searchCustomSuggestionsURL]) {

    });
}

const restorePreviousSession = document.querySelector("#restore-previous-session");
const newTabPageURL = document.querySelector("#new-tab-page-url");
const newTabPageURLReset = document.querySelector("#new-tab-page-url-reset");
const defaultBrowserGroup = document.querySelector("#default-browser-group");
const defaultBrowserLabel = document.querySelector("#default-browser-label");
const defaultBrowserStatus = document.querySelector("#default-browser-status");
const makeDefaultBrowser = document.querySelector("#make-default-browser");

const DEFAULT_BROWSER_STATUS = {
    default: "Links from other apps open in Ladybird.",
    "not-default": "Links from other apps open in another browser.",
    unavailable: "Ladybird cannot determine or set the default browser on this system.",
};

let defaultBrowser;
// Why the last attempt to make Ladybird the default browser failed, which is shown in place of the status.
let defaultBrowserFailure = null;

const updateDefaultBrowser = () => {
    const canMakeDefault = defaultBrowser === "not-default";

    defaultBrowserGroup.classList.toggle("hidden", !defaultBrowser);
    defaultBrowserStatus.textContent = defaultBrowserFailure ?? DEFAULT_BROWSER_STATUS[defaultBrowser] ?? "";
    makeDefaultBrowser.classList.toggle("hidden", !canMakeDefault);

    // A control row is filled under the pointer, and a click anywhere on it reaches the control its label names. This
    // row is one only while there is something for the button to do.
    defaultBrowserGroup.classList.toggle("control-row", canMakeDefault);
    if (canMakeDefault) {
        defaultBrowserLabel.htmlFor = makeDefaultBrowser.id;
    } else {
        defaultBrowserLabel.removeAttribute("for");
    }
};

const loadSettings = settings => {
    if (Object.hasOwn(settings, "defaultBrowser")) {
        defaultBrowser = settings.defaultBrowser;
        defaultBrowserFailure = null;
        updateDefaultBrowser();
    }

    if (Object.hasOwn(settings, "restorePreviousSession")) {
        restorePreviousSession.checked = settings.restorePreviousSession === true;
    }

    if (Object.hasOwn(settings, "defaultNewTabPageURL")) {
        newTabPageURLReset.classList.remove("hidden");
        newTabPageURL.placeholder = settings.defaultNewTabPageURL;
    }
    if (Object.hasOwn(settings, "newTabPageURL")) {
        newTabPageURL.classList.remove("error");
        newTabPageURL.value = settings.newTabPageURL;
    }
};

// The system may ask before it changes the default browser, so the button waits for its answer.
makeDefaultBrowser.addEventListener("click", () => {
    makeDefaultBrowser.disabled = true;
    defaultBrowserFailure = null;
    updateDefaultBrowser();

    ladybird.sendMessage("makeDefaultBrowser");
});

restorePreviousSession.addEventListener("change", () => {
    ladybird.sendMessage("setRestorePreviousSession", restorePreviousSession.checked);
});

newTabPageURL.addEventListener("change", () => {
    newTabPageURL.classList.remove("success");
    newTabPageURL.classList.remove("error");

    newTabPageURL.value = ensureURLHasScheme(newTabPageURL.value);

    if (!containsValidURL(newTabPageURL)) {
        newTabPageURL.classList.add("error");
        return;
    }

    ladybird.sendMessage("setNewTabPageURL", newTabPageURL.value);
    newTabPageURL.classList.add("success");

    setTimeout(() => {
        newTabPageURL.classList.remove("success");
    }, 1000);
});

newTabPageURLReset.addEventListener("click", () => {
    newTabPageURL.value = newTabPageURL.placeholder;
    newTabPageURL.dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
});

FILE: Base/res/ladybird/about-pages/settings/tabs.js
const tabLayoutGroup = document.querySelector("#tab-layout-group");
const tabLayoutInputs = tabLayoutGroup.querySelectorAll('input[name="tab-layout"]');
const verticalTabsExpandOnHover = document.querySelector("#vertical-tabs-expand-on-hover");
const verticalTabsPosition = document.querySelector("#vertical-tabs-position");
const showBookmarksBar = document.querySelector("#show-bookmarks-bar");
const discardHiddenTabsAfter = document.querySelector("#discard-hidden-tabs-after");
const tabProcesses = document.querySelector("#tab-processes");

let TAB_SETTINGS = {};

const loadFeatures = features => {
    // Without vertical tabs, there is no choice of tab layout to make.
    tabLayoutGroup.classList.toggle("hidden", !features?.verticalTabs);
    if (!features?.verticalTabs) {
        verticalTabsExpandOnHover.parentElement.classList.add("hidden");
        verticalTabsPosition.parentElement.classList.add("hidden");
    }
};

const updateVerticalTabsDependentSettings = () => {
    const verticalTabsEnabled = !!TAB_SETTINGS.verticalTabsEnabled && !tabLayoutGroup.classList.contains("hidden");
    verticalTabsExpandOnHover.parentElement.classList.toggle("hidden", !verticalTabsEnabled);
    // With everything in the sidebar, the sidebar is always on the left.
    verticalTabsPosition.parentElement.classList.toggle(
        "hidden",
        !verticalTabsEnabled || !!TAB_SETTINGS.everythingInSidebar
    );
    showBookmarksBar.parentElement.classList.toggle(
        "hidden",
        verticalTabsEnabled && !!TAB_SETTINGS.everythingInSidebar
    );
};

const tabLayout = () => {
    if (!TAB_SETTINGS.verticalTabsEnabled) return "horizontal";
    return TAB_SETTINGS.everythingInSidebar ? "sidebar" : "vertical";
};

const loadSettings = settings => {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(settings, "tabs")) {
        return;
    }

    TAB_SETTINGS = settings.tabs || {};

    const layout = tabLayout();
    for (const input of tabLayoutInputs) input.checked = input.value === layout;
    verticalTabsExpandOnHover.checked = !!TAB_SETTINGS.verticalTabsExpandOnHover;
    verticalTabsPosition.value = TAB_SETTINGS.verticalTabsPosition || "left";
    const discardMinutes = String(TAB_SETTINGS.discardHiddenTabsAfterMinutes ?? 120);
    // A value set outside this page, such as in the settings file, gets an option of its own, so the menu shows it.
    if (![...discardHiddenTabsAfter.options].some(option => option.value === discardMinutes)) {
        discardHiddenTabsAfter.add(new Option(`After ${discardMinutes} minutes`, discardMinutes));
    }
    discardHiddenTabsAfter.value = discardMinutes;
    tabProcesses.value = TAB_SETTINGS.tabProcesses || "perOrigin";
    updateVerticalTabsDependentSettings();
};

function saveTabSettings() {
    ladybird.sendMessage("setTabSettings", TAB_SETTINGS);
}

for (const input of tabLayoutInputs) {
    input.addEventListener("change", () => {
        if (!input.checked) return;
        TAB_SETTINGS.verticalTabsEnabled = input.value !== "horizontal";
        TAB_SETTINGS.everythingInSidebar = input.value === "sidebar";
        updateVerticalTabsDependentSettings();
        saveTabSettings();
    });
}

verticalTabsExpandOnHover.addEventListener("change", () => {
    TAB_SETTINGS.verticalTabsExpandOnHover = verticalTabsExpandOnHover.checked;
    saveTabSettings();
});

verticalTabsPosition.addEventListener("change", () => {
    TAB_SETTINGS.verticalTabsPosition = verticalTabsPosition.value;
    saveTabSettings();
});

discardHiddenTabsAfter.addEventListener("change", () => {
    TAB_SETTINGS.discardHiddenTabsAfterMinutes = Number(discardHiddenTabsAfter.value);
    saveTabSettings();
});

tabProcesses.addEventListener("change", () => {
    TAB_SETTINGS.tabProcesses = tabProcesses.value;
    saveTabSettings();
});

document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
    if (event.detail.name === "loadFeatures") {
        loadFeatures(event.detail.data);
    } else if (event.detail.name === "loadSettings") {
        loadSettings(event.detail.data);
    }
});

    <body>
        <header>
            <h1>Support</h1>
        </header>

        <div class="card-title">System</div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-body" id="system"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="card-title">Platform features</div>

                        <div>Feature</div>

                </details>

        <script>
            const featuresElement = document.querySelector("#feature-grid");
            const headingRow = featuresElement.querySelector(".heading");
            const systemElement = document.querySelector("#system");
            const reportElement = document.querySelector("#report");

            const collapsedStorageKey = "support.collapsedFeatures";
            let collapsed = new Set();
            try {
                collapsed = new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(collapsedStorageKey) ?? "[]"));
            } catch {}

            let report = null;

            function stateClass(state) {
                return "state-" + state.toLowerCase().replaceAll(" ", "-");
            }

            // The state names the feature that blocked this one, and anything more it does not say goes under it.
            function describeStatus(feature) {
                const status = document.createElement("div");
                status.className = "status";

                const state = document.createElement("div");
                state.className = stateClass(feature.state);
                if (feature.blocked_by) {
                    const blockingFeature = document.createElement("span");
                    blockingFeature.className = "status-feature";
                    blockingFeature.textContent = feature.blocked_by;
                    state.append("Blocked by ", blockingFeature);
                } else if (feature.forced) {
                    state.textContent = "Enabled (forced)";
                } else {
                    state.textContent = feature.state;
                }
                status.append(state);

                if (feature.reason) {
                    const detail = document.createElement("div");
                    detail.className = "status-detail";
                    detail.textContent = feature.rule ? `${feature.reason} [${feature.rule}]` : feature.reason;
                    status.append(detail);
                }
                return status;
            }

            function renderFeatures() {
                // The rows are rebuilt, so focus moves to the new toggle of the feature whose toggle had it.
                const focusedFeatureId = document.activeElement?.dataset.featureId;
                let toggleToFocus = null;
                featuresElement.replaceChildren(headingRow);

                const children = new Map();
                for (const feature of report.features) {
                    const parent = feature.dependency ?? null;
                    if (!children.has(parent)) children.set(parent, []);
                    children.get(parent).push(feature);
                }

                function appendRows(feature, depth) {
                    const row = document.createElement("div");
                    row.className = "feature-row";
                    row.style.setProperty("--depth", depth);
                    const hasChildren = children.has(feature.id);

                    const nameContents = document.createElement("div");
                    nameContents.className = "feature-name";
                    nameContents.style.paddingLeft = `calc(${depth} * var(--indent))`;
                    if (hasChildren) {
                        const toggle = document.createElement("button");
                        toggle.className = "toggle";
                        toggle.dataset.featureId = feature.id;
                        if (feature.id === focusedFeatureId) toggleToFocus = toggle;
                        const isCollapsed = collapsed.has(feature.id);
                        toggle.textContent = isCollapsed ? "▸" : "▾";
                        toggle.title = `${isCollapsed ? "Show" : "Hide"} the features that depend on this one`;
                        toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
                            if (collapsed.has(feature.id)) collapsed.delete(feature.id);
                            else collapsed.add(feature.id);
                            try {
                                localStorage.setItem(collapsedStorageKey, JSON.stringify([...collapsed]));
                            } catch {}
                            renderFeatures();
                        });
                        nameContents.append(toggle);
                    } else {
                        const spacer = document.createElement("span");
                        spacer.className = "toggle-spacer";
                        nameContents.append(spacer);
                    }
                    // A nested feature is named without the prefix its parent's row already shows.
                    let shownId = feature.id;
                    if (feature.dependency && feature.id.startsWith(`${feature.dependency}.`))
                        shownId = feature.id.slice(feature.dependency.length + 1);
                    const id = document.createElement("span");
                    id.className = "feature-id";
                    id.title = feature.id;
                    shownId.split(".").forEach((part, index) => {
                        if (index > 0) id.append(".", document.createElement("wbr"));
                        id.append(part);
                    });
                    nameContents.append(id);

                    const process = document.createElement("div");
                    process.className = "process";
                    process.textContent = feature.process;

                    row.append(nameContents, process, describeStatus(feature));
                    featuresElement.append(row);

                    if (hasChildren && !collapsed.has(feature.id)) {
                        for (const child of children.get(feature.id)) appendRows(child, depth + 1);
                    }
                }

                for (const root of children.get(null) ?? []) appendRows(root, 0);
                toggleToFocus?.focus();
            }

            function hex(value, digits = 4) {
                return "0x" + value.toString(16).padStart(digits, "0");
            }

            function vulkanVersion(value) {
                return `${(value >>> 22) & 0x7f}.${(value >>> 12) & 0x3ff}.${value & 0xfff}`;
            }

            // Each driver packs its version its own way. These are VkDriverId's values for the ones that differ.
            function driverVersion(driverId, value) {
                const nvidiaProprietary = 4;
                const intelProprietaryWindows = 5;
                if (driverId === nvidiaProprietary)
                    return `${value >>> 22}.${(value >>> 14) & 0xff}.${(value >>> 6) & 0xff}.${value & 0x3f}`;
                if (driverId === intelProprietaryWindows) return `${value >>> 14}.${value & 0x3fff}`;
                return vulkanVersion(value);
            }

            function libraryVersion(value) {
                return `${value >>> 16}.${(value >>> 8) & 0xff}.${value & 0xff}`;
            }

            function yesNo(value) {
                return value ? "Yes" : "No";
            }

            function appendSection(title, entries) {
                const heading = document.createElement("div");
                heading.className = "section-title";
                heading.textContent = title;

                const list = document.createElement("dl");
                const descriptionElements = entries.map(([term, description]) => {
                    const termElement = document.createElement("dt");
                    termElement.textContent = term;
                    const descriptionElement = document.createElement("dd");
                    descriptionElement.textContent = description;
                    list.append(termElement, descriptionElement);
                    return descriptionElement;
                });
                systemElement.append(heading, list);
                return descriptionElements;
            }

            // Asked through the Media Capabilities API, so that the answers are the ones pages get. Only hardware
            // decoders report that they decode power efficiently.
            const videoDecodingQueries = [
                ["H.264 High", 'video/mp4; codecs="avc1.640028"'],
                ["HEVC Main", 'video/mp4; codecs="hvc1.1.6.L123.B0"'],
                ["HEVC Main 10", 'video/mp4; codecs="hvc1.2.4.L123.B0"'],
                ["VP9 Profile 0", 'video/webm; codecs="vp09.00.40.08"'],
                ["VP9 Profile 2 (10-bit)", 'video/webm; codecs="vp09.02.40.10"'],
                ["AV1 Main (8-bit)", 'video/mp4; codecs="av01.0.08M.08"'],
                ["AV1 Main (10-bit)", 'video/mp4; codecs="av01.0.08M.10"'],
            ];

            async function describeVideoDecoding(contentType) {
                try {
                    const info = await navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({
                        type: "file",
                        video: { contentType, width: 1920, height: 1080, bitrate: 8_000_000, framerate: 30 },
                    });
                    if (!info.supported) return "Not supported";
                    return info.powerEfficient ? "Hardware" : "Software";
                } catch {
                    return "Unknown";
                }
            }

            function appendVideoDecodingSection() {
                const descriptions = appendSection(
                    "Video decoding at 1080p",
                    videoDecodingQueries.map(([name]) => [name, "Checking…"])
                );
                videoDecodingQueries.forEach(([, contentType], index) => {
                    describeVideoDecoding(contentType).then(text => {
                        descriptions[index].textContent = text;
                    });
                });
            }

            // What the GPU reported for decoding a codec through Vulkan, worded after Vulkan's flags, before any feature
            // decided whether to use it.
            function describeVulkanVideoDecoding(codec) {
                if (!codec.supported) return "Not supported";
                const capabilities = ["Supported"];
                if (codec.dpb_and_output_coincide) capabilities.push("DPB and output coincide");
                if (codec.dpb_and_output_distinct) capabilities.push("DPB and output distinct");
                if (codec.dpb_supports_drm_format_modifiers) capabilities.push("DPB supports DRM format modifiers");
                return capabilities.join(", ");
            }

            function describeGpuVideoDecoding(gpu) {
                if (gpu.cannot_decode_video_because)
                    return [["Vulkan video decoding", gpu.cannot_decode_video_because]];
                return [
                    ["H.264 through Vulkan", describeVulkanVideoDecoding(gpu.h264)],
                    ["HEVC through Vulkan", describeVulkanVideoDecoding(gpu.h265)],
                    ["VP9 through Vulkan", describeVulkanVideoDecoding(gpu.vp9)],
                    ["AV1 through Vulkan", describeVulkanVideoDecoding(gpu.av1)],
                ];
            }

            function describeFFmpeg(ffmpeg) {
                return [
                    ["libavcodec", libraryVersion(ffmpeg.avcodec_version)],
                    ["libavutil", libraryVersion(ffmpeg.avutil_version)],
                    ["Has a Vulkan decoder built for its version", yesNo(ffmpeg.has_vulkan_decoder_for_its_version)],
                ];
            }

            function renderSystem() {
                systemElement.replaceChildren();
                const facts = report.facts;

                if (report.probe_failure) appendSection("Probe", [["Failure", report.probe_failure]]);

                const gpu = facts.gpu;
                if (!report.describes_gpu) {
                    appendSection("GPU", [["Device", "Not described by this build"]]);
                } else if (gpu) {
                    appendSection("GPU", [
                        ["Device", gpu.device_name],
                        ["Vendor and device ID", `${hex(gpu.vendor_id)}:${hex(gpu.device_id)}`],
                        ["Driver", `${gpu.driver_name} ${gpu.driver_info} (driver ID ${gpu.driver_id})`],
                        [
                            "Driver version",
                            `${driverVersion(gpu.driver_id, gpu.driver_version)} (${hex(gpu.driver_version, 8)})`,
                        ],
                        ["Vulkan", vulkanVersion(gpu.api_version)],
                        ["Identity", gpu.device_identity],
                        ["YCbCr sampling", yesNo(gpu.supports_ycbcr_sampling)],
                        ["Video maintenance 2", yesNo(gpu.supports_video_maintenance2)],
                        ...describeGpuVideoDecoding(gpu),
                    ]);
                } else if (!report.probe_failure) {
                    appendSection("GPU", [["Device", "None described"]]);
                }

                if (report.describes_ffmpeg) {
                    if (facts.bundled_ffmpeg) appendSection("Bundled FFmpeg", describeFFmpeg(facts.bundled_ffmpeg));
                    if (facts.system_ffmpeg) appendSection("System FFmpeg", describeFFmpeg(facts.system_ffmpeg));
                    else appendSection("System FFmpeg", [["Library", "None found"]]);
                }

                appendVideoDecodingSection();
            }

            function render() {
                renderSystem();
                renderFeatures();
                reportElement.textContent = JSON.stringify(report, null, 4);
            }

            document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
                if (event.detail.name === "loadPlatformFeatures") {
                    report = event.detail.data;
                    render();
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUILoaded", () => ladybird.sendMessage("loadPlatformFeatures"));
        </script>
    </body>
</html>

        <script type="module">
            const copyButton = document.querySelector("#copy");
            let detailsText = "";

            function renderVersionInfo(versionInfo) {
                document.title = `About ${versionInfo.productName}`;
                document.querySelector("#browser-name").innerText = versionInfo.browserName;
                document.querySelector("#release-stage").innerText = versionInfo.releaseStage || "Development";
                document.querySelector("#release-stage").hidden = false;
                document.querySelector("#browser-version").innerText = versionInfo.browserVersion;
                document.querySelector("#browser-commit").innerText = `from ${versionInfo.browserCommit.slice(0, 10)}`;
                document.querySelector("#platform").innerText = `${versionInfo.platformName}, ${versionInfo.arch}`;

                // What is copied includes the details a bug report needs beyond what the page shows.
                detailsText = [
                    `${versionInfo.productName} ${versionInfo.browserVersion} (${versionInfo.browserCommit})`,
                    `Platform: ${versionInfo.platformName}, ${versionInfo.arch}`,
                    `User agent: ${navigator.userAgent}`,
                    `Command line: ${versionInfo.commandLine}`,
                    `Executable path: ${versionInfo.executablePath}`,
                ].join("\n");
            }

            copyButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(detailsText);
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUILoaded", () => {
                ladybird.sendMessage("loadVersionInfo");
            });

            document.addEventListener("WebUIMessage", event => {
                if (event.detail.name === "renderVersionInfo") {
                    renderVersionInfo(event.detail.data);
                }
            });
        </script>
    </body>
