FILE: Libraries/LibCompositing/FontServiceClient.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <LibCompositing/FontClientEndpoint.h>
#include <LibCompositing/FontServerEndpoint.h>
#include <LibCompositing/FontServiceClient.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/Process.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/FontDatabase.h>
#include <LibIPC/ConnectionToServer.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>

namespace Compositing {

class FontServiceConnectionToServer final : public IPC::ConnectionToServer<FontClientEndpoint, FontServerEndpoint> {
    C_OBJECT(FontServiceConnectionToServer);

private:
    explicit FontServiceConnectionToServer(NonnullOwnPtr<IPC::Transport> transport)
        : IPC::ConnectionToServer<FontClientEndpoint, FontServerEndpoint>(*this, move(transport))
    {
        set_peer_owns_this_process(true);
    }

    // The UI process serves the fonts, so a process that loses it can answer no font question and exits, as it does
    // when its main connection to the UI process goes.
    virtual void die() override { Core::Process::terminate_immediately(0); }
};

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<FontServiceClient>> FontServiceClient::create(IPC::TransportHandle handle)
{
    auto client = adopt_ref(*new FontServiceClient(move(handle)));

    MutexLocker locker(client->m_mutex);
    client->m_condition.wait_while([&] { return !client->m_initialized; });
    if (!client->m_connected)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Unable to connect to the font service");
    return client;
}

FontServiceClient::FontServiceClient(IPC::TransportHandle handle)
    : m_transport_handle(move(handle))
    , m_thread(Threading::Thread::construct("Font service client"sv, [this] {
        return thread_main();
    }))
{
    m_thread->start();
}

FontServiceClient::~FontServiceClient()
{
    {
        MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
        m_should_quit = true;
        m_condition.broadcast();
    }
    if (m_thread->needs_to_be_joined())
        (void)m_thread->join();
}

void FontServiceClient::ask(Question const& question)
{
    MutexLocker caller_locker(m_caller_mutex);
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    m_question = &question;
    m_condition.broadcast();
    m_condition.wait_while([&] { return m_question; });
}

Gfx::BrokeredFont FontServiceClient::open_font(u64 generation, u64 face_id)
{
    Gfx::BrokeredFont font;
    ask([&](FontServiceConnectionToServer& connection) {
        if (auto response = connection.send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::FontServer::OpenFont>(generation, face_id))
            font = response->take_font();
    });
    return font;
}

Gfx::BrokeredFont FontServiceClient::match_font(String const& family, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope)
{
    Gfx::BrokeredFont font;
    ask([&](FontServiceConnectionToServer& connection) {
        if (auto response = connection.send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::FontServer::MatchFont>(family, weight, width, slope))
            font = response->take_font();
    });
    return font;
}

Gfx::BrokeredFont FontServiceClient::match_local_font(String const& name)
{
    Gfx::BrokeredFont font;
    ask([&](FontServiceConnectionToServer& connection) {
        if (auto response = connection.send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::FontServer::MatchLocalFont>(name))
            font = response->take_font();
    });
    return font;
}

Gfx::BrokeredFont FontServiceClient::match_font_for_code_point(u32 code_point, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope, bool prefer_color_emoji)
{
    Gfx::BrokeredFont font;
    ask([&](FontServiceConnectionToServer& connection) {
        if (auto response = connection.send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::FontServer::MatchFontForCodePoint>(code_point, weight, width, slope, prefer_color_emoji))
            font = response->take_font();
    });
    return font;
}

Optional<FlyString> FontServiceClient::resolve_generic_family(String const& family, u16 weight, u8 slope)
{
    Optional<FlyString> resolved_family;
    ask([&](FontServiceConnectionToServer& connection) {
        if (auto response = connection.send_sync_but_allow_failure<Messages::FontServer::ResolveGenericFamily>(family, weight, slope)) {
            if (auto name = response->take_resolved_family(); name.has_value())
                resolved_family = FlyString { name.release_value() };
        }
    });
    return resolved_family;
}

intptr_t FontServiceClient::thread_main()
{
    // Never run: LibIPC needs a loop on this thread, because a connection registers a notifier when it is
    // constructed and defers a call after every drain.
    Core::EventLoop event_loop;

    RefPtr<FontServiceConnectionToServer> connection;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
        if (auto transport = m_transport_handle->create_transport(); !transport.is_error())
            connection = FontServiceConnectionToServer::construct(transport.release_value());
        m_transport_handle.clear();
        m_connected = connection != nullptr;
        m_initialized = true;
        m_condition.broadcast();
    }
    if (!connection)
        return 1;

    for (;;) {
        Question const* question = nullptr;
        {
            MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
            m_condition.wait_while([&] { return !m_question && !m_should_quit; });
            if (m_should_quit)
                break;
            question = m_question;
        }

        (*question)(*connection);

        // The drain that delivered the answer deferred a call to this thread's loop. Nothing else ever runs
        // it, so run it here rather than let one accumulate per answer.
        event_loop.pump(Core::EventLoop::WaitMode::PollForEvents);

        MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
        m_question = nullptr;
        m_condition.broadcast();
    }

    // A client that is done closes its side, which is not losing the service: shutdown() would end the process.
    if (connection->is_open())
        connection->transport().close();
    return 0;
}

ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<Gfx::SharedFontProvider>> create_font_provider(IPC::TransportHandle handle, IPC::File catalog, u64 catalog_size, u64 generation)
{
    auto client = TRY(FontServiceClient::create(move(handle)));

    Gfx::SharedFontProviderCallbacks callbacks;
    callbacks.open_font = [client](u64 generation, u64 face_id) {
        return client->open_font(generation, face_id);
    };
    callbacks.match_local_font = [client](String const& name) {
        return client->match_local_font(name);
    };
    callbacks.match_font = [client](String const& family, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope) {
        return client->match_font(family, weight, width, slope);
    };
    callbacks.match_font_for_code_point = [client](u32 code_point, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope, bool prefer_color_emoji) {
        return client->match_font_for_code_point(code_point, weight, width, slope, prefer_color_emoji);
    };
    callbacks.resolve_generic_family = [client](String const& family, u16 weight, u8 slope) {
        return client->resolve_generic_family(family, weight, slope);
    };
    return Gfx::SharedFontProvider::create_from_catalog_file_or_empty(move(catalog), catalog_size, generation, move(callbacks));
}

ErrorOr<Gfx::SystemFontProvider*> install_font_service(IPC::TransportHandle handle, IPC::File catalog, u64 catalog_size, u64 generation)
{
    auto provider = TRY(create_font_provider(move(handle), move(catalog), catalog_size, generation));
    return &Gfx::FontDatabase::the().install_system_font_provider(move(provider));
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibCompositing/FontServiceClient.h
/*

 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#pragma once

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/ConditionVariable.h>
#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/Function.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <LibCompositing/Export.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/SharedFontProvider.h>
#include <LibIPC/TransportHandle.h>
#include <LibThreading/Forward.h>

namespace Compositing {

class FontServiceConnectionToServer;

// A process's one connection to the font service, which any thread may ask on.
//
// LibIPC pins a connection to the thread that constructed it, and that thread must have a
// Core::EventLoop. This client owns a thread that does nothing else: a caller hands it a question
// and blocks until the answer comes back, and needs neither a connection nor an event loop of its
// own. So no font question waits for a busy main thread on either end.
class COMPOSITING_API FontServiceClient final : public AtomicRefCounted<FontServiceClient> {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(FontServiceClient);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(FontServiceClient);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<FontServiceClient>> create(IPC::TransportHandle);
    ~FontServiceClient();

    // If the font service goes away, every question answers as if nothing matched.
    Gfx::BrokeredFont open_font(u64 generation, u64 face_id);
    Gfx::BrokeredFont match_font(String const& family, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope);
    Gfx::BrokeredFont match_local_font(String const& name);
    Gfx::BrokeredFont match_font_for_code_point(u32 code_point, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope, bool prefer_color_emoji);
    Optional<FlyString> resolve_generic_family(String const& family, u16 weight, u8 slope);

private:
    using Question = Function<void(FontServiceConnectionToServer&)>;

    explicit FontServiceClient(IPC::TransportHandle);
    intptr_t thread_main();
    void ask(Question const&);

    // Serializes callers, so that one question is in flight at a time.
    Mutex m_caller_mutex;

    Mutex m_mutex;
    ConditionVariable m_condition { m_mutex };
    Optional<IPC::TransportHandle> m_transport_handle;
    bool m_initialized { false };
    bool m_connected { false };
    bool m_should_quit { false };
    Question const* m_question { nullptr };

    NonnullRefPtr<Threading::Thread> m_thread;
};

// Connects to the font service and creates a font provider over its catalog that asks every question, from any
// thread, on that one connection.
COMPOSITING_API ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<Gfx::SharedFontProvider>> create_font_provider(IPC::TransportHandle, IPC::File catalog, u64 catalog_size, u64 generation);

// Installs such a provider as this process's system font provider.
COMPOSITING_API ErrorOr<Gfx::SystemFontProvider*> install_font_service(IPC::TransportHandle, IPC::File catalog, u64 catalog_size, u64 generation);

}

FILE: Libraries/LibCompositing/FrameFitting.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/StdLibExtras.h>
#include <LibGfx/Rect.h>
#include <LibGfx/Size.h>

namespace Compositing {

// Where a frame shows when it is scaled to fit within the target, keeping its aspect ratio, in the target's middle.
inline Gfx::IntRect rect_fitting_frame(Gfx::IntSize frame_size, Gfx::IntSize target_size)
{
    auto scale = min(static_cast<float>(target_size.width()) / frame_size.width(), static_cast<float>(target_size.height()) / frame_size.height());
    auto fitted_size = frame_size.to_type<float>().scaled(scale).to_rounded<int>();
    fitted_size = { max(1, fitted_size.width()), max(1, fitted_size.height()) };
    return Gfx::IntRect { {}, fitted_size }.centered_within({ {}, target_size });
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibCompositing/OverlayGeometry.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/Math.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <LibCompositing/Export.h>
#include <LibGfx/Point.h>
#include <LibGfx/Rect.h>

namespace Compositing {

// A length of an overlay in CSS pixels, in whole device pixels.
COMPOSITING_API int scaled_overlay_length(int length, double device_pixel_ratio);

enum class OverlayButtonShape : u8 {
    Rectangle,
    Circle,
};

template<typename Action>
struct OverlayButton {
    Action action;
    Gfx::IntRect bounds;
    OverlayButtonShape shape { OverlayButtonShape::Rectangle };

    // A round button leaves the corners of its bounds to whatever is below it.
    bool contains(Gfx::IntPoint position) const
    {
        if (shape == OverlayButtonShape::Rectangle)
            return bounds.contains(position);

        auto radius = bounds.width() / 2.0;
        auto distance_x = position.x() + 0.5 - (bounds.x() + radius);
        auto distance_y = position.y() + 0.5 - (bounds.y() + radius);
        return distance_x * distance_x + distance_y * distance_y <= radius * radius;
    }
};

template<typename Action, size_t button_count>
Optional<Action> overlay_action_at(Array<OverlayButton<Action>, button_count> const& buttons, Gfx::IntPoint position)
{
    for (auto const& button : buttons) {
        if (button.contains(position))
            return button.action;
    }
    return {};
}

template<typename Action, size_t button_count>
Gfx::IntRect overlay_buttons_bounds(Array<OverlayButton<Action>, button_count> const& buttons)
{
    Gfx::IntRect bounds;
    for (auto const& button : buttons)
        bounds.unite(button.bounds);
    return bounds;
}

}

use std::env;
use std::error::Error;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;

#[path = "generate/webgl_wire.rs"]
mod webgl_wire;

#[allow(dead_code, reason = "the model is for the generators of the other crates as well")]
#[path = "generate/webgl_wire_model.rs"]
mod webgl_wire_model;

// AK::Optional is not trivial for calls under every C++ ABI: Apple clang returns it through memory, where Rust
// returns the matching #[repr(C)] struct in registers. Keep it out of extern "C" signatures; pass a plain
// #[repr(C)] struct and convert it to an Optional on the C++ side.
fn reject_optional_in_extern_c_signatures(header: &Path) {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(header).unwrap_or_default();
    for block in text.split("extern \"C\" {").skip(1) {
        let (signatures, _) = block.split_once("}  // extern \"C\"").unwrap_or((block, ""));
        if let Some(line) = signatures.lines().find(|line| line.contains("Optional<")) {
            panic!(
                "{}: AK::Optional in an extern \"C\" signature: {line}",
                header.display()
            );
        }
    }
}

fn generate_ffi_header(config: cbindgen::Config, sources: &[PathBuf], out_dir: &Path, header: &Path) {
    let builder = sources
        .iter()
        .fold(cbindgen::Builder::new().with_config(config), |builder, source| {
            builder.with_src(source)
        });
    builder.generate().map_or_else(
        |error| match error {
            cbindgen::Error::ParseSyntaxError { .. } => {
                // Do nothing, the build will fail later with a nicer error message when compiling with rustc
            }
            other => panic!("{other:?}"),
        },
        |bindings| {
            let output_header = out_dir.join(header);
            std::fs::create_dir_all(output_header.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
            bindings.write_to_file(&output_header);
            reject_optional_in_extern_c_signatures(&output_header);
        },
    );
}

fn generate_ffi_header_strict(config: cbindgen::Config, sources: &[PathBuf], out_dir: &Path, header: &Path) {
    let builder = sources
        .iter()
        .fold(cbindgen::Builder::new().with_config(config), |builder, source| {
            builder.with_src(source)
        });
    builder.generate().map_or_else(
        |error| panic!("{error}"),
        |bindings| {
            let output_header = out_dir.join(header);
            std::fs::create_dir_all(output_header.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
            bindings.write_to_file(&output_header);
            reject_optional_in_extern_c_signatures(&output_header);
        },
    );
}

fn expose_css_pixel_types_as_web_types(config: &mut cbindgen::Config) {
    for (rust_name, cpp_name) in [
        ("CssPixels", "Web::CSSPixels"),
        ("FfiCssPixelPoint", "Web::CSSPixelPoint"),
        ("FfiCssPixelSize", "Web::CSSPixelSize"),
        ("FfiCssPixelRect", "Web::CSSPixelRect"),
    ] {
        config.export.exclude.push(rust_name.to_string());
        config.export.rename.insert(rust_name.to_string(), cpp_name.to_string());
    }
    config.includes.push("LibWebCommon/PixelUnits.h".to_string());
}

// The types the C++ side defines itself, which the generated header refers to by their C++ names.
fn expose_shared_abi_types_as_cpp_types(config: &mut cbindgen::Config) {
    config.export.exclude.extend(
        [
            "OptionalFloatRect",
            "OptionalColor",
            "OptionalU32",
            "OptionalF32",
            "OptionalAffineTransform",
            "OptionalCssPixels",
            "OptionalCssPixelRect",
            "OptionalIntRect",
            "OptionalFloatPoint",
            "OptionalFloatSize",
            "OptionalI64",
            "OptionalUsize",
            "ClipMode",
            "SpatialNodeIndex",
            "ClipNodeIndex",
            "EffectNodeIndex",
            "ContextRef",
            "DisplayListCommandType",
            "FillRoundedRectRing",
            "ReplayClip",
            "ReplayLayer",
            "ReplayMask",
            "CanvasId",
            "VideoSinkHandle",
            "Canvas2DPaintKind",
            "Canvas2DPatternRepetition",
            "PathGeometryData",
            "CompositorScrollNodeKind",
            "CompositorScrollNodeRecord",
            "CompositorSnapContainerRecord",
            "CompositorSnapAreaRecord",
        ]
        .map(String::from),
    );
    for (rust_name, cpp_name) in [
        ("IntPoint", "Gfx::IntPoint"),
        ("FloatPoint", "Gfx::FloatPoint"),
        ("IntSize", "Gfx::IntSize"),
        ("FloatSize", "Gfx::FloatSize"),
        ("FloatVector3", "Gfx::FloatVector3"),
        ("IntRect", "Gfx::IntRect"),
        ("FloatRect", "Gfx::FloatRect"),
        ("Color", "Gfx::Color"),
        ("AffineTransform", "Gfx::AffineTransform"),
        ("FloatMatrix4x4", "Gfx::FloatMatrix4x4"),
        ("CornerRadius", "Gfx::CornerRadius"),
        ("CornerRadii", "Gfx::CornerRadii"),
        ("GradientInterpolationMethod", "Gfx::GradientInterpolationMethod"),
        ("WindingRule", "Gfx::WindingRule"),
        ("MaskKind", "Gfx::MaskKind"),
        ("CompositingAndBlendingOperator", "Gfx::CompositingAndBlendingOperator"),
        ("ColorFilterType", "Gfx::ColorFilterType"),
        ("ScalingMode", "Gfx::ScalingMode"),
        ("InterpolationColorSpace", "Gfx::InterpolationColorSpace"),
        ("OptionalFloatRect", "Optional<Gfx::FloatRect>"),
        ("OptionalColor", "Optional<Gfx::Color>"),
        ("OptionalU32", "Optional<u32>"),
        ("OptionalF32", "Optional<float>"),
        ("OptionalAffineTransform", "Optional<Gfx::AffineTransform>"),
        ("OptionalCssPixels", "Optional<Web::CSSPixels>"),
        ("OptionalCssPixelRect", "Optional<Web::CSSPixelRect>"),
        ("OptionalIntRect", "Optional<Gfx::IntRect>"),

        ("ClipMode", "Compositing::ClipMode"),

        ("ClipNodeIndex", "Compositing::ClipNodeIndex"),
        ("EffectNodeIndex", "Compositing::EffectNodeIndex"),
        ("ContextRef", "Compositing::ContextRef"),
        ("DisplayListCommandType", "Compositing::DisplayListCommandType"),
        ("FillRoundedRectRing", "Compositing::FillRoundedRectRing"),
        ("ReplayClip", "Compositing::ReplayClip"),
        ("ReplayLayer", "Compositing::ReplayLayer"),
        ("ReplayMask", "Compositing::ReplayMask"),
        ("CanvasId", "Compositing::CanvasId"),
        ("VideoSinkHandle", "Media::VideoSinkHandle"),
        ("Canvas2DPaintKind", "Compositing::Canvas2DPaintKind"),
        ("Canvas2DPatternRepetition", "Compositing::Canvas2DPatternRepetition"),
        ("CapStyle", "Gfx::CapStyle"),
        ("JoinStyle", "Gfx::JoinStyle"),
        ("PathGeometryData", "Gfx::FFI::PathGeometryData"),
        ("CompositorScrollNodeKind", "Compositing::CompositorScrollNodeKind"),
        ("CompositorScrollNodeRecord", "Compositing::CompositorScrollNodeRecord"),
        (
            "CompositorSnapContainerRecord",
            "Compositing::CompositorSnapContainerRecord",
        ),
        ("CompositorSnapAreaRecord", "Compositing::CompositorSnapAreaRecord"),
    ] {
        config.export.rename.insert(rust_name.to_string(), cpp_name.to_string());
    }

    config.includes.extend(
        [
            "AK/Optional.h",
            "LibGfx/AffineTransform.h",
            "LibGfx/Color.h",
            "LibGfx/ColorFilterType.h",
            "LibGfx/CompositingAndBlendingOperator.h",
            "LibGfx/CornerRadii.h",
            "LibGfx/GradientInterpolation.h",
            "LibGfx/InterpolationColorSpace.h",
            "LibGfx/Matrix4x4.h",
            "LibGfx/PathData.h",
            "LibGfx/Point.h",
            "LibGfx/Rect.h",
            "LibGfx/ScalingMode.h",
            "LibGfx/Size.h",
            "LibGfx/StrokeStyle.h",
            "LibGfx/Vector3.h",
            "LibGfx/WindingRule.h",
            "LibCompositing/DisplayList/ContextRef.h",
            "LibCompositing/Forward.h",
            "LibCompositing/DisplayList/DisplayListCommandsGenerated.h",
        ]
        .map(String::from),
    );
}

fn public_type_names(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>, Box<dyn Error>> {
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", path.display());
    let mut names = Vec::new();
    for line in std::fs::read_to_string(path)?.lines() {
        for prefix in ["pub struct ", "pub enum "] {
            if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(prefix) {
                let name: String = rest.chars().take_while(|c| c.is_alphanumeric() || *c == '_').collect();
                if !name.is_empty() {
                    names.push(name);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(names)
}

fn display_list_command_names(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>, Box<dyn Error>> {
    let source = std::fs::read_to_string(path)?;
    let mut names = Vec::new();
    for line in source.lines() {
        let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("impl DisplayListCommand for ") else {
            continue;
        };
        let name: String = rest.chars().take_while(|c| c.is_alphanumeric() || *c == '_').collect();
        if name.is_empty() {
            return Err(format!("unparsable DisplayListCommand impl header: {line}").into());
        }
        names.push(name);
    }
    if names.is_empty() {
        return Err("no DisplayListCommand impls found".into());
    }
    Ok(names)
}

// The variants of DisplayListCommandType in declaration order, which is the order of their discriminants.
fn display_list_command_type_variants(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>, Box<dyn Error>> {
    let source = std::fs::read_to_string(path)?;
    let (_, body) = source
        .split_once("pub enum DisplayListCommandType {")
        .ok_or("DisplayListCommandType not found")?;
    let (body, _) = body.split_once('}').ok_or("unterminated DisplayListCommandType")?;
    let variants: Vec<String> = body
        .lines()
        .map(|line| line.trim().trim_end_matches(','))
        .filter(|line| !line.is_empty() && !line.starts_with("//"))
        .map(String::from)
        .collect();
    if variants.is_empty() || variants.iter().any(|name| !name.chars().all(|c| c.is_alphanumeric())) {
        return Err(format!("unparsable DisplayListCommandType variants: {variants:?}").into());
    }
    Ok(variants)
}

fn display_list_payload_alignment(path: &Path) -> Result<String, Box<dyn Error>> {
    let source = std::fs::read_to_string(path)?;
    let value = source
        .lines()
        .find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("pub const COMMAND_ALIGNMENT: usize = "))
        .and_then(|rest| rest.strip_suffix(';'))
        .ok_or("COMMAND_ALIGNMENT not found")?;
    if value.is_empty() || !value.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
        return Err(format!("unparsable COMMAND_ALIGNMENT: {value}").into());
    }
    Ok(value.to_string())
}

fn generate_ipc_definitions(manifest_dir: &Path, out_dir: &Path) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let source_dir = manifest_dir.join("../../..");
    let generator = source_dir.join("Meta/Generators/generate_ipc_definitions.py");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", generator.display());
    for module in ["lexer.py", "utils.py"] {
        println!(
            "cargo:rerun-if-changed={}",
            source_dir.join("Meta/Utils").join(module).display()
        );
    }

    println!("cargo:rerun-if-env-changed=PYTHON");
    let python = env::var_os("PYTHON").unwrap_or_else(|| if cfg!(windows) { "python" } else { "python3" }.into());
    for (definition, generated_file) in [
        (
            "Libraries/LibCompositing/DisplayList/DisplayListProperties.ipc",
            "DisplayListProperties.rs",
        ),
        ("Libraries/LibCompositing/Types.ipc", "Types.rs"),
        ("Libraries/LibCompositing/UIOverlays.ipc", "UIOverlays.rs"),
        ("Libraries/LibWebCommon/UIEvents/KeyCode.ipc", "KeyCode.rs"),
        ("Libraries/LibWebCommon/UIEvents/MouseButton.ipc", "MouseButton.rs"),
        (
            "Libraries/LibWebCommon/Page/AsyncScrollNodeStableID.ipc",
            "AsyncScrollNodeStableID.rs",
        ),
        ("Libraries/LibWebCommon/Page/InputEvent.ipc", "InputEvent.rs"),
        (
            "Libraries/LibWebCommon/Page/InputRoutingDecision.ipc",
            "InputRoutingDecision.rs",
        ),
        ("Libraries/LibWebCommon/Page/InputTrace.ipc", "InputTrace.rs"),
        (
            "Libraries/LibWebCommon/Page/TextEditingCommand.ipc",
            "TextEditingCommand.rs",
        ),
        (
            "Services/Compositor/CompositorWebContentClient.ipc",
            "CompositorWebContentClientEndpoint.rs",
        ),
        (
            "Services/Compositor/CompositorWebContentServer.ipc",
            "CompositorWebContentServerEndpoint.rs",
        ),
        (
            "Services/Compositor/CompositorControlServer.ipc",
            "CompositorControlServerEndpoint.rs",
        ),
        (
            "Services/Compositor/CompositorPresentationClient.ipc",
            "CompositorPresentationClientEndpoint.rs",
        ),
        (
            "Services/Compositor/CompositorPresentationServer.ipc",
            "CompositorPresentationServerEndpoint.rs",
        ),
        (
            "Services/Compositor/RenderClockClient.ipc",
            "RenderClockClientEndpoint.rs",
        ),
        (
            "Services/Compositor/RenderClockServer.ipc",
            "RenderClockServerEndpoint.rs",
        ),
    ] {
        let definition = source_dir.join(definition);
        println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", definition.display());
        let status = Command::new(&python)
            .arg(&generator)
            .arg("--input")
            .arg(&definition)
            .arg("--rust-output")
            .arg(out_dir.join(generated_file))
            .status()?;
        if !status.success() {
            return Err(format!("IPC compiler failed for {}", definition.display()).into());
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// The vocabulary of the WebGL command stream, which src/webgl/vocabulary.rs includes.
fn generate_webgl_wire_vocabulary(manifest_dir: &Path, out_dir: &Path) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let functions_path = manifest_dir.join("../WebGL/GLFunctions.json");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", functions_path.display());
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=generate");
    let json = std::fs::read_to_string(&functions_path)?;
    let generate = |json: &str| -> Result<String, String> {
        let functions = webgl_wire_model::parse_functions(json)?;
        Ok(webgl_wire::write_wire_vocabulary(&webgl_wire_model::vocabulary(
            &functions,
        )?))
    };
    let vocabulary = generate(&json).map_err(|error| format!("{}: {error}", functions_path.display()))?;
    std::fs::write(out_dir.join("webgl_wire.rs"), vocabulary)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env::var("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")?);
    let out_dir = PathBuf::from(env::var("OUT_DIR")?);

    generate_ipc_definitions(&manifest_dir, &out_dir)?;
    generate_webgl_wire_vocabulary(&manifest_dir, &out_dir)?;

    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=build.rs");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=cbindgen.toml");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=src");

    let base_config = cbindgen::Config::from_file(manifest_dir.join("cbindgen.toml"))?;

    // The entry points and the plain values that cross the boundary - namespace Compositing::RustFFI.
    let mut ffi_config = base_config.clone();
    ffi_config.namespaces = Some(vec!["Compositing".to_string(), "RustFFI".to_string()]);
    expose_css_pixel_types_as_web_types(&mut ffi_config);
    expose_shared_abi_types_as_cpp_types(&mut ffi_config);
    ffi_config.export.exclude.extend([
        "MOMENTUM_DISTANCE_SHARE_PER_FRAME".to_string(),
        "MOMENTUM_FRAME_DURATION_IN_SECONDS".to_string(),
        "MAXIMUM_MOMENTUM_DURATION_IN_SECONDS".to_string(),
    ]);
    // An ak::Span is laid out as an AK ReadonlySpan, which C++ passes it as.
    ffi_config
        .export
        .rename
        .insert("Span".to_string(), "AK::ReadonlySpan".to_string());
    ffi_config
        .export
        .rename
        .insert("EncodedValue".to_string(), "AK::ReadonlyBytes".to_string());
    // The IPC compiler checks that these enums have the numbers in C++ that they have in Rust.
    for (rust_name, cpp_name) in [
        ("ScrollAnimationKind", "Compositing::ScrollAnimationKind"),
        ("InputRoutingDecision", "Web::InputRoutingDecision"),
        ("AsyncScrollNodeKind", "Web::AsyncScrollNodeKind"),
    ] {
        ffi_config
            .export
            .rename
            .insert(rust_name.to_string(), cpp_name.to_string());
    }
    ffi_config.after_includes = Some(
        "\nnamespace Compositing { enum class ScrollAnimationKind : uint8_t; }\nnamespace Web { enum class \
         InputRoutingDecision : uint8_t; enum class AsyncScrollNodeKind : uint8_t; }"
            .to_string(),
    );
    ffi_config.includes.push("AK/Span.h".to_string());
    // The values the entry points of WebContent and of the compositor's scroll logic take and return, which their
    // headers refer to here.
    ffi_config.export.include = [
        "NodeSlotId",
        "FfiFilterFunction",
        "FfiFilterFunctionKind",
        "FfiVisualContextTreeInputs",
        "FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind",
        "FfiVisualAnimationTransformOperationKind",
        "FfiCompositorAnimationPublishOutcome",
        "FfiVisualAnimationSummary",
        "FfiRasterPainter",
        "FfiEasingDescriptor",
        "FfiEasingKind",
        "FfiLinearEasingPoint",
        "SnapSelectionStrategyType",
    ]
    .map(String::from)
    .to_vec();
    generate_ffi_header(
        ffi_config,
        &[
            manifest_dir.join("src/node_slot_id.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/css_pixels.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/easing.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/filter_bytes.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/visual_context/ffi_types.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/host/replay.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/overlays.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/display_list/storage.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/display_list/canvas_2d.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/display_list/canvas_2d_recorder.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/scrolling/smooth_scroll_animation.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/scrolling/scroll_snap_selection.rs"),
            manifest_dir.join("src/ffi.rs"),
        ],
        &out_dir,
        Path::new("RustFFI.h"),
    );

    // The mirrors of the LibGfx value types, which the C++ side checks its own layouts against.
    let mut types_config = base_config.clone();
    types_config.namespaces = Some(vec!["Compositing".to_string(), "RustFFI".to_string()]);
    expose_css_pixel_types_as_web_types(&mut types_config);
    let libgfx_src_dir = manifest_dir.join("../../LibGfx/Rust/src");
    // Every type declared in these is exported; `commands.rs` is parsed only so cbindgen can
    // resolve the signatures that mention its types, which are defined in C++.
    let libgfx_type_sources = [
        libgfx_src_dir.join("geometry.rs"),
        libgfx_src_dir.join("matrix.rs"),
        libgfx_src_dir.join("color.rs"),
        libgfx_src_dir.join("corner_radii.rs"),
        libgfx_src_dir.join("paint_enums.rs"),
    ];
    let commands_source = manifest_dir.join("src/display_list/commands.rs");
    let scroll_table_source = manifest_dir.join("src/visual_context/scroll_table.rs");
    let types_sources: Vec<PathBuf> = libgfx_type_sources
        .iter()
        .cloned()
        .chain([commands_source.clone()])
        .collect();
    types_config.export.include = Vec::new();
    for libgfx_source in &libgfx_type_sources {
        types_config.export.include.extend(public_type_names(libgfx_source)?);
    }
    types_config.export.include.extend(
        [
            "OptionalFloatRect",
            "OptionalColor",
            "OptionalU32",
            "OptionalF32",
            "OptionalAffineTransform",
            "FontResourceId",
            "ImageFrameResourceId",
            "VideoSinkHandle",
            "DisplayListResourceId",
            "CanvasId",
            "CompositorContextId",
            "UniqueNodeId",
        ]
        .map(String::from),
    );
    generate_ffi_header_strict(types_config, &types_sources, &out_dir, Path::new("TypesRustFFI.h"));

    // The display list commands, which are the same struct on both sides of the boundary.
    let mut commands_config = base_config;
    commands_config.layout.aligned_n = Some("alignas".to_string());
    commands_config.namespaces = Some(vec!["Compositing".to_string()]);
    let types_with_existing_cpp_definitions = [
        "SpatialNodeIndex",
        "ClipNodeIndex",
        "EffectNodeIndex",
        "ContextRef",
        "FontResourceId",
        "ImageFrameResourceId",
        "VideoSinkHandle",
        "DisplayListResourceId",
        "CanvasId",
        "CompositorContextId",
        "UniqueNodeId",
        "OptionalFloatRect",
        "OptionalColor",
        "OptionalU32",
        "OptionalF32",
        "OptionalAffineTransform",
        "VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX",
        "DISPLAY_LIST_COMMAND_TYPE_COUNT",
    ];
    commands_config.export.include = public_type_names(&commands_source)?
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|name| !types_with_existing_cpp_definitions.contains(&name.as_str()))
        .collect();
    commands_config.export.include.extend(
        public_type_names(&scroll_table_source)?
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|name| name != "CompositorScrollTable"),
    );
    commands_config.export.exclude = types_with_existing_cpp_definitions
        .iter()
        .map(|name| name.to_string())
        .collect();
    let references_renamed_to_real_types = [
        ("IntPoint", "Gfx::IntPoint"),
        ("FloatPoint", "Gfx::FloatPoint"),
        ("IntSize", "Gfx::IntSize"),
        ("FloatSize", "Gfx::FloatSize"),
        ("IntRect", "Gfx::IntRect"),
        ("FloatRect", "Gfx::FloatRect"),
        ("Color", "Gfx::Color"),
        ("AffineTransform", "Gfx::AffineTransform"),
        ("FloatMatrix4x4", "Gfx::FloatMatrix4x4"),
        ("CornerRadius", "Gfx::CornerRadius"),
        ("CornerRadii", "Gfx::CornerRadii"),
        ("GradientInterpolationMethod", "Gfx::GradientInterpolationMethod"),
        ("GradientInterpolationType", "Gfx::GradientInterpolationMethod::Type"),
        ("RectangularColorSpace", "Gfx::RectangularColorSpace"),
        ("PolarColorSpace", "Gfx::PolarColorSpace"),
        ("HueInterpolationMethod", "Gfx::HueInterpolationMethod"),
        ("InterpolationColorSpace", "Gfx::InterpolationColorSpace"),
        ("WindingRule", "Gfx::WindingRule"),
        ("LineStyle", "Gfx::LineStyle"),
        ("CapStyle", "Gfx::CapStyle"),
        ("JoinStyle", "Gfx::JoinStyle"),
        ("ScalingMode", "Gfx::ScalingMode"),
        ("CompositingAndBlendingOperator", "Gfx::CompositingAndBlendingOperator"),
        ("ColorFilterType", "Gfx::ColorFilterType"),
        ("Orientation", "Gfx::Orientation"),
        ("GlyphRunOrientation", "Gfx::GlyphRunOrientation"),
        ("MaskKind", "Gfx::MaskKind"),
        ("ShouldAntiAlias", "Gfx::ShouldAntiAlias"),
        ("CssPixels", "Web::CSSPixels"),
        ("FfiCssPixelPoint", "Web::CSSPixelPoint"),
        ("FfiCssPixelRect", "Web::CSSPixelRect"),
        ("OptionalFloatRect", "Optional<Gfx::FloatRect>"),
        ("OptionalColor", "Optional<Gfx::Color>"),
        ("OptionalU32", "Optional<u32>"),
        ("OptionalF32", "Optional<float>"),
        ("OptionalAffineTransform", "Optional<Gfx::AffineTransform>"),
        ("CompositorContextId", "Web::CompositorContextId"),
        ("UniqueNodeId", "Web::UniqueNodeID"),
        ("VideoSinkHandle", "Media::VideoSinkHandle"),
    ];
    for (rust_name, cpp_name) in references_renamed_to_real_types {
        commands_config
            .export
            .rename
            .insert(rust_name.to_string(), cpp_name.to_string());
    }
    commands_config.includes = [
        "AK/Forward.h",
        "AK/Optional.h",
        "AK/Types.h",
        "LibGfx/AffineTransform.h",
        "LibGfx/AntiAliasing.h",
        "LibGfx/Color.h",
        "LibGfx/CompositingAndBlendingOperator.h",
        "LibGfx/CornerRadii.h",
        "LibGfx/Forward.h",
        "LibGfx/GradientInterpolation.h",
        "LibGfx/InterpolationColorSpace.h",
        "LibGfx/LineStyle.h",
        "LibGfx/Orientation.h",
        "LibGfx/Point.h",
        "LibGfx/Rect.h",
        "LibGfx/ScalingMode.h",
        "LibGfx/Size.h",
        "LibGfx/StrokeStyle.h",
        "LibGfx/WindingRule.h",
        "LibCompositing/DisplayList/ContextRef.h",
        "LibCompositing/DisplayList/DisplayListResourceIds.h",
        "LibCompositing/Forward.h",
        "LibMedia/VideoSinkHandle.h",
        "LibWebCommon/PixelUnits.h",
        "LibCompositing/Types.h",
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .map(String::from)
    .collect();
    // The commands of the canvas 2D stream go into a list of their own, as only the canvas player plays them.
    let variants = display_list_command_type_variants(&commands_source)?;
    let mut after_includes = String::new();
    // The replay resolves these commands for the frame and hands the painter what they draw, or plays them itself.
    let commands_the_replay_resolves = [
        "FillRect",
        "FillRectWithRoundedCorners",
        "PaintScrollBar",
        "DrawCompositedContext",
        "DeclareMaskContent",
        "DrawIsolatedGroup",
        "PaintVectorImage",
    ];
    let belongs_to_list = |macro_name: &str, name: &str| {
        let is_canvas_2d_command = name.starts_with("Canvas2D");
        match macro_name {
            "ENUMERATE_CANVAS_2D_COMMANDS" => is_canvas_2d_command,
            "ENUMERATE_DISPLAY_LIST_COMMANDS_PLAYED_AS_RECORDED" => {
                !is_canvas_2d_command
                    && !name.starts_with("Compositor")
                    && !commands_the_replay_resolves.contains(&name)
            }
            _ => !is_canvas_2d_command,
        }
    };
    for macro_name in [
        "ENUMERATE_DISPLAY_LIST_COMMANDS",
        "ENUMERATE_DISPLAY_LIST_COMMANDS_PLAYED_AS_RECORDED",
        "ENUMERATE_CANVAS_2D_COMMANDS",
    ] {
        after_includes.push_str(&format!("\n#define {macro_name}(V)"));
        for name in variants.iter().filter(|name| belongs_to_list(macro_name, name)) {
            after_includes.push_str(&format!(" \\\n    V({name})"));
        }
        after_includes.push('\n');
    }
    after_includes.push_str(&format!(
        "\nnamespace Compositing {{\n\n// Every record and every payload starts at a multiple of this.\nconstexpr size_t display_list_payload_alignment = {};\n\n}}",
        display_list_payload_alignment(&manifest_dir.join("src/display_list/builder.rs"))?
    ));
    commands_config.after_includes = Some(after_includes);
    for name in display_list_command_names(&commands_source)? {
        commands_config.export.pre_body.insert(
            name.clone(),
            format!("    static constexpr DisplayListCommandType command_type = DisplayListCommandType::{name};"),
        );
    }
    generate_ffi_header_strict(
        commands_config,
        &[commands_source, scroll_table_source],
        &out_dir,
        Path::new("DisplayList/DisplayListCommandsGenerated.h"),
    );

    Ok(())
}

//! The tests of the model of the WebGL functions, which run with those of libcompositing_rust only, as every crate
//! whose build script generates from the model includes it.

use crate::webgl_wire_model::*;

fn fields(types_and_names: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Vec<FieldSpec> {
    types_and_names
        .iter()
        .map(|(cpp_type, name)| FieldSpec {
            cpp_type: (*cpp_type).into(),
            name: (*name).into(),
            argument: None,
        })
        .collect()
}

#[test]
fn a_struct_is_laid_out_as_the_c_abi_does() {
    let layout = wire_struct(
        "Commands::Example".into(),
        fields(&[
            ("GLenum", "target"),
            ("GLintptr", "offset"),
            ("GLboolean", "flag"),
            ("WebGLDataSpan", "data"),
        ]),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let offsets: Vec<usize> = layout.fields.iter().map(|field| field.offset).collect();
    assert_eq!(offsets, [0, 8, 16, 20]);
    assert_eq!((layout.size, layout.alignment), (32, 8));
}

#[test]
fn a_struct_without_fields_is_one_byte() {
    let layout = wire_struct("SyncCalls::Finish::Request".into(), Vec::new()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!((layout.size, layout.alignment), (1, 1));
}

#[test]
fn a_field_of_an_unknown_type_is_rejected() {
    let error = wire_struct("Commands::Example".into(), fields(&[("GLdouble", "depth")])).unwrap_err();
    assert!(
        error.contains("Commands::Example.depth has the type GLdouble"),
        "{error}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn names_are_converted_as_the_cpp_generators_convert_them() {
    for (name, snake_case) in [
        ("ActiveTexture", "active_texture"),
        ("TexImage3DRobustANGLE", "tex_image3d_robust_angle"),
        ("GetInteger64vRobustANGLE", "get_integer64v_robust_angle"),
        ("UniformMatrix4fv", "uniform_matrix4fv"),
        ("bufSize", "buf_size"),
        ("srcX0", "src_x0"),
        ("uniformBlockName", "uniform_block_name"),
    ] {
        assert_eq!(title_case_to_snake_case(name), snake_case);
    }
}

#[test]
fn the_structs_of_a_function_follow_from_its_signature() {
    let functions = parse_functions(
        r#"[
            {"name": "glBufferData", "return": "void", "category": "command", "args": [
                {"type": "GLenum", "name": "target"},
                {"type": "GLsizeiptr", "name": "size"},
                {"type": "void const*", "name": "data", "payload": "size", "nullable": true},
                {"type": "GLenum", "name": "usage"}]},
            {"name": "glGetActiveAttrib", "return": "void", "category": "sync", "args": [
                {"type": "GLuint", "name": "program", "object": true},
                {"type": "GLsizei", "name": "bufSize"},
                {"type": "GLsizei*", "name": "length", "out": true},
                {"type": "GLchar*", "name": "name", "out": true, "payload": "bufSize * sizeof(GLchar)"}]},
            {"name": "glCreateShader", "return": "GLuint", "category": "gen", "args": [
                {"type": "GLenum", "name": "type"}]}
        ]"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let vocabulary = vocabulary(&functions).unwrap();
    let described = |layout: &WireStruct| -> Vec<String> {
        layout
            .fields
            .iter()
            .map(|field| format!("{} {} @{}", field.spec.cpp_type, field.spec.name, field.offset))
            .collect()
    };
    assert_eq!(vocabulary.commands[0].layout.cpp_name, "Commands::BufferData");
    assert_eq!(
        described(&vocabulary.commands[0].layout),
        [
            "GLenum target @0",
            "GLsizeiptr size @8",
            "bool has_data @16",
            "WebGLDataSpan data @20",
            "GLenum usage @28"
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        described(&vocabulary.commands[1].layout),
        ["WebGLObjectId id @0", "GLenum type @4"]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        vocabulary.sync_calls[0].request.cpp_name,
        "SyncCalls::GetActiveAttrib::Request"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        described(&vocabulary.sync_calls[0].request),
        ["WebGLObjectId program @0", "GLsizei buf_size @4"]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        described(&vocabulary.sync_calls[0].reply),
        ["GLsizei length @0", "WebGLDataSpan name @4"]
    );
}

#[test]
fn what_the_model_does_not_know_is_rejected() {
    let unknown_function_key =
        r#"[{"name": "glFlush", "return": "void", "category": "command", "args": [], "flushes": true}]"#;
    assert!(
        parse_functions(unknown_function_key)
            .unwrap_err()
            .contains("glFlush has the key \"flushes\"")
    );
    let unknown_argument_key = r#"[{"name": "glEnable", "return": "void", "category": "command", "args": [
        {"type": "GLenum", "name": "cap", "validated": true}]}]"#;
    assert!(
        parse_functions(unknown_argument_key)
            .unwrap_err()
            .contains("has the key \"validated\"")
    );
    let unknown_category = r#"[{"name": "glFlush", "return": "void", "category": "deferred", "args": []}]"#;
    assert!(
        parse_functions(unknown_category)
            .unwrap_err()
            .contains("has the category \"deferred\"")
    );
    let unhandled_pointer = r#"[{"name": "glGetPointerv", "return": "void", "category": "command", "args": [
        {"type": "void**", "name": "params"}]}]"#;
    let functions = parse_functions(unhandled_pointer).unwrap();
    assert!(
        vocabulary(&functions)
            .err()
            .unwrap()
            .contains("does not handle the pointer argument params")
    );
}

#[test]
fn what_the_replayer_needs_is_read_from_the_json() {
    let functions = parse_functions(
        r#"[
            {"name": "glDeleteBuffers", "return": "void", "category": "command", "deletes_objects": true, "args": [
                {"type": "GLsizei", "name": "n"},
                {"type": "GLuint const*", "name": "buffers", "object": true, "payload": "n * sizeof(GLuint)"}]},
            {"name": "glBindFramebuffer", "return": "void", "category": "command", "args": [
                {"type": "GLenum", "name": "target"},
                {"type": "GLuint", "name": "framebuffer", "object": true, "zero_means_default": "default_framebuffer"}]},
            {"name": "glClientWaitSync", "return": "GLenum", "category": "sync", "args": [
                {"type": "GLsync", "name": "sync", "object": true},
                {"type": "GLuint64", "name": "timeout", "host_override": "0"}]},
            {"name": "glClearBufferfv", "return": "void", "category": "command", "args": [
                {"type": "GLenum", "name": "buffer"},
                {"type": "GLfloat const*", "name": "value", "payload": "(buffer == GL_COLOR ? 4 : 1) * sizeof(GLfloat)"}]}
        ]"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert!(functions[0].deletes_objects);
    assert!(!functions[1].deletes_objects);
    assert_eq!(
        functions[0].payload_size(&functions[0].arguments[1]).unwrap(),
        [PayloadFactor::Argument(0), PayloadFactor::Constant(4)]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        functions[1].arguments[1].zero_means_default,
        Some(DefaultObject::Framebuffer)
    );
    assert_eq!(functions[2].arguments[1].host_override.as_deref(), Some("0"));
    assert_eq!(
        functions[3].payload_size(&functions[3].arguments[1]).unwrap(),
        [PayloadFactor::ColorBufferComponents(0), PayloadFactor::Constant(4)]
    );
    let unknown_default = r#"[{"name": "glBindTexture", "return": "void", "category": "command", "args": [
        {"type": "GLuint", "name": "texture", "object": true, "zero_means_default": "default_texture"}]}]"#;
    assert!(
        parse_functions(unknown_default)
            .unwrap_err()
            .contains("default object \"default_texture\"")
    );
}

/*

//! The model of Libraries/LibCompositing/WebGL/GLFunctions.json: which entries the command stream carries and which
//! structs they serialize to. The model rejects everything in the JSON that it does not know.

use serde_json::{Map, Value};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Category {
    Command,
    Gen,
    Sync,
    Custom,
    BuiltinCommand,
}

/// The object that the replayer passes for the object id 0.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DefaultObject {
    Framebuffer,
    Renderbuffer,
}

/// A factor of the number of bytes that a pointer argument points at.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PayloadFactor {
    Constant(u64),
    /// The value of the argument of this index.
    Argument(usize),
    /// 4 where the argument of this index is GL_COLOR, and 1 otherwise.
    ColorBufferComponents(usize),
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Argument {
    pub cpp_type: String,
    pub name: String,
    /// The C++ expression for the number of bytes that a pointer argument points at.
    pub payload: Option<String>,
    pub is_object: bool,
    pub is_out: bool,
    pub is_offset: bool,
    pub is_string: bool,
    pub is_nullable: bool,
    pub zero_means_default: Option<DefaultObject>,
    /// What the replayer passes instead of what the recorder sent.
    pub host_override: Option<String>,
}

impl Argument {
    pub fn is_pointer(&self) -> bool {
        self.cpp_type.ends_with('*')
    }

    pub fn is_const_pointer(&self) -> bool {
        self.is_pointer() && self.cpp_type.contains("const")
    }

    pub fn pointee_cpp_type(&self) -> String {
        self.cpp_type.replace('*', "").trim().to_string()
    }
}

/// A field of a struct of the command stream, before it has a place in the struct.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct FieldSpec {
    pub cpp_type: String,
    pub name: String,
    /// The index of the argument that the field carries, for a field that follows from the signature of the function.
    pub argument: Option<usize>,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Function {
    pub name: String,
    pub category: Category,
    /// The built-in commands, which are no GL functions, have none.
    pub return_type: Option<String>,
    pub arguments: Vec<Argument>,
    pub deletes_objects: bool,
    wire_command: Option<Vec<FieldSpec>>,
    wire_request: Option<Vec<FieldSpec>>,
    wire_reply: Option<Vec<FieldSpec>>,
}

const FUNCTION_KEYS: [&str; 8] = [
    "name",
    "category",
    "return",
    "args",
    "deletes_objects",
    "wire_command",
    "wire_request",
    "wire_reply",
];

const ARGUMENT_KEYS: [&str; 10] = [
    "type",
    "name",
    "payload",
    "object",
    "out",
    "offset",
    "string",
    "nullable",
    "zero_means_default",
    "host_override",
];

fn reject_unknown_keys(object: &Map<String, Value>, known_keys: &[&str], what: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    match object.keys().find(|key| !known_keys.contains(&key.as_str())) {
        Some(key) => Err(format!(
            "{what} has the key {key:?}, which the model of the WebGL functions does not know"
        )),
        None => Ok(()),
    }
}

fn string_member(object: &Map<String, Value>, key: &str, what: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
    match object.get(key) {
        None => Ok(None),
        Some(Value::String(string)) => Ok(Some(string.clone())),
        Some(other) => Err(format!("{what} has {other} for {key:?}, which is not a string")),
    }
}

fn required_string_member(object: &Map<String, Value>, key: &str, what: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    string_member(object, key, what)?.ok_or_else(|| format!("{what} has no {key:?}"))
}

fn flag(object: &Map<String, Value>, key: &str, what: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
    match object.get(key) {
        None => Ok(false),
        Some(Value::Bool(true)) => Ok(true),
        Some(other) => Err(format!("{what} has {other} for {key:?}, which can only be true")),
    }
}

fn parse_argument(value: &Value, function_name: &str) -> Result<Argument, String> {
    let what = format!("an argument of {function_name}");
    let object = value.as_object().ok_or_else(|| format!("{what} is not an object"))?;
    reject_unknown_keys(object, &ARGUMENT_KEYS, &what)?;
    let zero_means_default = match string_member(object, "zero_means_default", &what)?.as_deref() {
        None => None,
        Some("default_framebuffer") => Some(DefaultObject::Framebuffer),
        Some("default_renderbuffer") => Some(DefaultObject::Renderbuffer),
        Some(other) => {
            return Err(format!(
                "{what} has the default object {other:?}, which the model does not know"
            ));
        }
    };
    Ok(Argument {
        zero_means_default,
        host_override: string_member(object, "host_override", &what)?,
        cpp_type: required_string_member(object, "type", &what)?,
        name: required_string_member(object, "name", &what)?,
        payload: string_member(object, "payload", &what)?,
        is_object: flag(object, "object", &what)?,
        is_out: flag(object, "out", &what)?,
        is_offset: flag(object, "offset", &what)?,
        is_string: flag(object, "string", &what)?,
        is_nullable: flag(object, "nullable", &what)?,
    })
}

fn parse_wire_fields(
    object: &Map<String, Value>,
    key: &str,
    function_name: &str,
) -> Result<Option<Vec<FieldSpec>>, String> {
    let Some(value) = object.get(key) else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let what = format!("{key:?} of {function_name}");
    let fields = value.as_array().ok_or_else(|| format!("{what} is not an array"))?;
    let mut field_specs = Vec::new();
    for field in fields {
        let field = field
            .as_object()
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("a field of {what} is not an object"))?;
        reject_unknown_keys(field, &["type", "name"], &format!("a field of {what}"))?;
        field_specs.push(FieldSpec {
            cpp_type: required_string_member(field, "type", &what)?,
            name: required_string_member(field, "name", &what)?,
            argument: None,
        });
    }
    Ok(Some(field_specs))
}

fn parse_function(value: &Value) -> Result<Function, String> {
    let object = value
        .as_object()
        .ok_or("an entry of the WebGL functions is not an object")?;
    let name = required_string_member(object, "name", "an entry of the WebGL functions")?;
    reject_unknown_keys(object, &FUNCTION_KEYS, &name)?;
    let category = match required_string_member(object, "category", &name)?.as_str() {
        "command" => Category::Command,
        "gen" => Category::Gen,
        "sync" => Category::Sync,
        "custom" => Category::Custom,
        "builtin-command" => Category::BuiltinCommand,
        other => {
            return Err(format!(
                "{name} has the category {other:?}, which the model of the WebGL functions does not know"
            ));
        }
    };
    let mut arguments = Vec::new();
    if let Some(values) = object.get("args") {
        let values = values
            .as_array()
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("\"args\" of {name} is not an array"))?;
        for value in values {
            arguments.push(parse_argument(value, &name)?);
        }
    }
    let function = Function {
        return_type: string_member(object, "return", &name)?,
        arguments,
        deletes_objects: flag(object, "deletes_objects", &name)?,
        wire_command: parse_wire_fields(object, "wire_command", &name)?,
        wire_request: parse_wire_fields(object, "wire_request", &name)?,
        wire_reply: parse_wire_fields(object, "wire_reply", &name)?,
        category,
        name,
    };
    function.check_shape()?;
    Ok(function)
}

/// In the order of the JSON, which is the order of the command types.
pub fn parse_functions(json: &str) -> Result<Vec<Function>, String> {
    let value: Value =
        serde_json::from_str(json).map_err(|error| format!("the WebGL functions are not JSON: {error}"))?;
    let entries = value.as_array().ok_or("the WebGL functions are not an array")?;
    entries.iter().map(parse_function).collect()
}

impl Function {
    fn check_shape(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        let name = &self.name;
        let has_signature = self.return_type.is_some();
        let has_wire_structs = self.wire_command.is_some() || self.wire_request.is_some() || self.wire_reply.is_some();
        match self.category {
            Category::BuiltinCommand => {
                if has_signature || !self.arguments.is_empty() || self.wire_command.is_none() {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "{name} is a built-in command, which is its \"wire_command\" and nothing else"
                    ));
                }
            }
            Category::Command | Category::Gen | Category::Sync => {
                if !has_signature || has_wire_structs {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "the structs of {name} follow from its signature, which is all it can have"
                    ));
                }
            }
            Category::Custom => {
                if !has_signature {
                    return Err(format!("{name} has no \"return\""));
                }
            }
        }
        if self.wire_request.is_some() != self.wire_reply.is_some() {
            return Err(format!("{name} has only one of \"wire_request\" and \"wire_reply\""));
        }
        if self.wire_command.is_some() && self.wire_request.is_some() {
            return Err(format!("{name} is both a command and a synchronous call"));
        }
        if !self.is_builtin() && !self.name.starts_with("gl") {
            return Err(format!("the name of {name} does not start with \"gl\""));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn is_builtin(&self) -> bool {
        self.category == Category::BuiltinCommand
    }

    pub fn returns_void(&self) -> bool {
        self.return_type.as_deref() == Some("void")
    }

    pub fn command_name(&self) -> &str {
        if self.is_builtin() { &self.name } else { &self.name[2..] }
    }

    pub fn method_name(&self) -> String {
        title_case_to_snake_case(self.command_name())
    }

    pub fn is_command_stream_entry(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.category, Category::Command | Category::Gen) || self.wire_command.is_some()
    }

    pub fn is_sync_call(&self) -> bool {
        self.category == Category::Sync || self.wire_request.is_some()
    }

    /// The factors of the number of bytes that an argument with a payload points at.
    pub fn payload_size(&self, argument: &Argument) -> Result<Vec<PayloadFactor>, String> {
        let payload = argument.payload.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
            format!(
                "the argument {} of {} points at data without a size",
                argument.name, self.name
            )
        })?;
        let unknown = |factor: &str| {
            format!(
                "the size {payload:?} of the argument {} of {} has the factor {factor:?}, which the model does not know",
                argument.name, self.name
            )
        };
        let argument_index = |name: &str| {
            self.arguments
                .iter()
                .position(|other| other.name == name && !other.is_out && !other.is_pointer())
        };
        payload
            .split(" * ")
            .map(|factor| {
                if let Ok(constant) = factor.parse() {
                    return Ok(PayloadFactor::Constant(constant));
                }
                if let Some(gl_type) = factor.strip_prefix("sizeof(").and_then(|rest| rest.strip_suffix(')')) {
                    let size = match gl_type {
                        "GLchar" | "GLboolean" => 1,
                        "GLint" | "GLuint" | "GLfloat" | "GLenum" => 4,
                        "GLint64" => 8,
                        _ => return Err(unknown(factor)),
                    };
                    return Ok(PayloadFactor::Constant(size));
                }
                if factor == "(buffer == GL_COLOR ? 4 : 1)" {
                    return argument_index("buffer")
                        .map(PayloadFactor::ColorBufferComponents)
                        .ok_or_else(|| unknown(factor));
                }
                argument_index(factor)
                    .map(PayloadFactor::Argument)
                    .ok_or_else(|| unknown(factor))
            })
            .collect()
    }

    fn unhandled_pointer(&self, argument: &Argument) -> String {
        format!(
            "the model of the WebGL functions does not handle the pointer argument {} of {}",
            argument.name, self.name
        )
    }

    pub fn command_fields(&self) -> Result<Vec<FieldSpec>, String> {
        if let Some(fields) = &self.wire_command {
            return Ok(fields.clone());
        }
        let is_gen = self.category == Category::Gen;
        let mut fields = Vec::new();
        if is_gen && !self.returns_void() {
            fields.push(FieldSpec {
                cpp_type: "WebGLObjectId".into(),
                name: "id".into(),
                argument: None,
            });
        }
        for (index, argument) in self.arguments.iter().enumerate() {
            let name = title_case_to_snake_case(&argument.name);
            let cpp_type = if is_gen && argument.is_pointer() && !argument.is_const_pointer() {
                // The ids that the recorder allocated.
                "WebGLDataSpan"
            } else if argument.is_object && !argument.is_pointer() {
                "WebGLObjectId"
            } else if (argument.is_object && argument.is_const_pointer()) || argument.is_string {
                "WebGLDataSpan"
            } else if argument.is_offset {
                "GLintptr"
            } else if argument.payload.is_some() {
                if argument.is_nullable {
                    fields.push(FieldSpec {
                        cpp_type: "bool".into(),
                        name: format!("has_{name}"),
                        argument: Some(index),
                    });
                }
                "WebGLDataSpan"
            } else if argument.is_pointer() {
                return Err(self.unhandled_pointer(argument));
            } else {
                &argument.cpp_type
            };
            fields.push(FieldSpec {
                cpp_type: cpp_type.to_string(),
                name,
                argument: Some(index),
            });
        }
        Ok(fields)
    }

    pub fn sync_request_fields(&self) -> Result<Vec<FieldSpec>, String> {
        if let Some(fields) = &self.wire_request {
            return Ok(fields.clone());
        }
        let mut fields = Vec::new();
        for (index, argument) in self.arguments.iter().enumerate() {
            if argument.is_out {
                continue;
            }
            let cpp_type = if argument.is_object && !argument.is_pointer() {
                "WebGLObjectId"
            } else if argument.is_string || argument.payload.is_some() {
                "WebGLDataSpan"
            } else if argument.is_pointer() {
                return Err(self.unhandled_pointer(argument));
            } else {
                &argument.cpp_type
            };
            fields.push(FieldSpec {
                cpp_type: cpp_type.to_string(),
                name: title_case_to_snake_case(&argument.name),
                argument: Some(index),
            });
        }
        Ok(fields)
    }

    /// The return value, then every output, a buffer as a span into the data that follows the struct.
    pub fn sync_reply_fields(&self) -> Vec<FieldSpec> {
        if let Some(fields) = &self.wire_reply {
            return fields.clone();
        }
        let mut fields = Vec::new();
        if let Some(return_type) = &self.return_type
            && return_type != "void"
        {
            fields.push(FieldSpec {
                cpp_type: return_type.clone(),
                name: "return_value".into(),
                argument: None,
            });
        }
        for (index, argument) in self.arguments.iter().enumerate() {
            if !argument.is_out {
                continue;
            }
            let cpp_type = if argument.payload.is_some() {
                "WebGLDataSpan".to_string()
            } else {
                argument.pointee_cpp_type()
            };
            fields.push(FieldSpec {
                cpp_type,
                name: title_case_to_snake_case(&argument.name),
                argument: Some(index),
            });
        }
        fields
    }
}

/// Mirrors title_case_to_snake_case() in Meta/Utils/utils.py.
pub fn title_case_to_snake_case(value: &str) -> String {
    let characters: Vec<char> = value.chars().collect();
    let mut snake_case = String::new();
    for (index, &character) in characters.iter().enumerate() {
        if character.is_uppercase() && index > 0 {
            let previous_is_lowercase = characters[index - 1].is_lowercase();
            let next_is_lowercase = characters.get(index + 1).is_some_and(|next| next.is_lowercase());
            if previous_is_lowercase || next_is_lowercase {
                snake_case.push('_');
            }
        }
        snake_case.extend(character.to_lowercase());
    }
    snake_case
}

/// The Rust identifier for a name of the JSON, which can be a keyword.
pub fn rust_identifier(name: &str) -> String {
    const KEYWORDS: [&str; 6] = ["type", "ref", "match", "move", "loop", "in"];
    if KEYWORDS.contains(&name) {
        format!("r#{name}")
    } else {
        name.to_string()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum WireType {
    U8,
    Bool,
    U32,
    I32,
    F32,
    I64,
    U64,
    DataSpan,
}

impl WireType {
    pub fn of(cpp_type: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        Some(match cpp_type {
            "GLboolean" => Self::U8,
            "bool" => Self::Bool,
            "GLenum" | "GLuint" | "GLbitfield" | "WebGLObjectId" | "u32" => Self::U32,
            "GLint" | "GLsizei" | "int" => Self::I32,
            "GLfloat" => Self::F32,
            "GLintptr" | "GLsizeiptr" => Self::I64,
            "GLuint64" => Self::U64,
            "WebGLDataSpan" => Self::DataSpan,
            _ => return None,
        })
    }

    pub fn rust_type(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::U8 => "u8",
            Self::Bool => "bool",
            Self::U32 => "u32",
            Self::I32 => "i32",
            Self::F32 => "f32",
            Self::I64 => "i64",
            Self::U64 => "u64",
            Self::DataSpan => "DataSpan",
        }
    }

    pub fn size(self) -> usize {
        match self {
            Self::U8 | Self::Bool => 1,
            Self::U32 | Self::I32 | Self::F32 => 4,
            Self::I64 | Self::U64 | Self::DataSpan => 8,
        }
    }

    pub fn alignment(self) -> usize {
        match self {
            Self::U8 | Self::Bool => 1,
            Self::U32 | Self::I32 | Self::F32 | Self::DataSpan => 4,
            Self::I64 | Self::U64 => 8,
        }
    }

    pub fn accepts_every_bit_pattern(self) -> bool {
        self != Self::Bool
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct WireField {
    pub spec: FieldSpec,
    pub wire_type: WireType,
    pub offset: usize,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct WireStruct {
    /// The name of the struct, such as `Commands::BufferData`.
    pub cpp_name: String,
    pub fields: Vec<WireField>,
    pub size: usize,
    pub alignment: usize,
}

impl WireStruct {
    /// The Rust struct has fields of its own for the bytes that are not part of a field of the model.
    pub fn has_unused_bytes(&self) -> bool {
        let size_of_fields: usize = self.fields.iter().map(|field| field.wire_type.size()).sum();
        size_of_fields != self.size
    }
}

pub fn wire_struct(cpp_name: String, field_specs: Vec<FieldSpec>) -> Result<WireStruct, String> {
    let mut fields = Vec::new();
    let mut end_of_fields: usize = 0;
    let mut alignment: usize = 1;
    for spec in field_specs {
        let Some(wire_type) = WireType::of(&spec.cpp_type) else {
            return Err(format!(
                "{cpp_name}.{} has the type {}, which the model of the WebGL functions has no layout for",
                spec.name, spec.cpp_type
            ));
        };
        let offset = end_of_fields.next_multiple_of(wire_type.alignment());
        end_of_fields = offset + wire_type.size();
        alignment = alignment.max(wire_type.alignment());
        fields.push(WireField {
            spec,
            wire_type,
            offset,
        });
    }
    // NB: A struct without fields has the size 1 in C++, and the replayer rejects a request that is shorter than
    //     its struct.
    let size = end_of_fields.next_multiple_of(alignment).max(1);
    Ok(WireStruct {
        cpp_name,
        fields,
        size,
        alignment,
    })
}

pub struct CommandEntry<'a> {
    pub function: &'a Function,
    pub layout: WireStruct,
}

pub struct SyncCallEntry<'a> {
    pub function: &'a Function,
    pub request: WireStruct,
    pub reply: WireStruct,
}

/// Everything that crosses the command stream, in the order of the command types and of the synchronous call types.
pub struct Vocabulary<'a> {
    pub commands: Vec<CommandEntry<'a>>,
    pub sync_calls: Vec<SyncCallEntry<'a>>,
}

pub fn vocabulary(functions: &[Function]) -> Result<Vocabulary<'_>, String> {
    let mut commands = Vec::new();
    let mut sync_calls = Vec::new();
    for function in functions {
        let name = function.command_name();
        if function.is_command_stream_entry() {
            let layout = wire_struct(format!("Commands::{name}"), function.command_fields()?)?;
            commands.push(CommandEntry { function, layout });
        }
        if function.is_sync_call() {
            let request = wire_struct(format!("SyncCalls::{name}::Request"), function.sync_request_fields()?)?;
            let reply = wire_struct(format!("SyncCalls::{name}::Reply"), function.sync_reply_fields())?;
            if let Some(field) = reply
                .fields
                .iter()
                .find(|field| !field.wire_type.accepts_every_bit_pattern())
            {
                return Err(format!(
                    "{}.{} is a {}, which cannot be read from the bytes of a reply",
                    reply.cpp_name, field.spec.name, field.spec.cpp_type
                ));
            }
            sync_calls.push(SyncCallEntry {
                function,
                request,
                reply,
            });
        }
    }
    Ok(Vocabulary { commands, sync_calls })
}

//! Writes the vocabulary of the WebGL command stream: the command types, the synchronous call types and the struct of
//! each, which src/webgl/vocabulary.rs includes.

use std::fmt::Write;

use crate::webgl_wire_model::{Vocabulary, WireStruct, WireType, rust_identifier};

/// A field of the Rust struct: one of the model, or the bytes that the C ABI leaves unused, which the struct spells
/// out so that all of its bytes are initialized and it can be written to the stream as bytes.
struct RustField {
    name: String,
    rust_type: String,
    zero: String,
}

fn rust_fields(layout: &WireStruct) -> Vec<RustField> {
    let mut fields = Vec::new();
    if layout.fields.is_empty() {
        fields.push(RustField {
            name: "_empty".into(),
            rust_type: "u8".into(),
            zero: "0".into(),
        });
        return fields;
    }
    for (index, field) in layout.fields.iter().enumerate() {
        let end = field.offset + field.wire_type.size();
        let next_offset = layout.fields.get(index + 1).map_or(layout.size, |next| next.offset);
        let zero = match field.wire_type {
            WireType::Bool => "false",
            WireType::F32 => "0.0",
            WireType::DataSpan => "DataSpan::EMPTY",
            WireType::U8 | WireType::U32 | WireType::I32 | WireType::I64 | WireType::U64 => "0",
        };
        fields.push(RustField {
            name: rust_identifier(&field.spec.name),
            rust_type: field.wire_type.rust_type().into(),
            zero: zero.into(),
        });
        if next_offset > end {
            let padding = next_offset - end;
            fields.push(RustField {
                name: format!("_padding_after_{}", field.spec.name),
                rust_type: format!("[u8; {padding}]"),
                zero: format!("[0; {padding}]"),
            });
        }
    }
    fields
}

fn write_struct(out: &mut String, rust_name: &str, layout: &WireStruct) {
    let fields = rust_fields(layout);
    writeln!(out, "    /// `{}`", layout.cpp_name).unwrap();
    out.push_str("    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]\n    #[repr(C)]\n");
    writeln!(out, "    pub struct {rust_name} {{").unwrap();
    for field in &fields {
        writeln!(out, "        pub {}: {},", field.name, field.rust_type).unwrap();
    }
    out.push_str("    }\n");
    // NB: The assertions below are what the safety of the implementation rests on: the fields are where the C ABI
    //     puts them and fill the struct, so it has no byte that the compiler could leave uninitialized.
    out.push_str("    // SAFETY: The struct is repr(C) and made of plain values that fill it, as asserted below.\n");
    writeln!(out, "    unsafe impl WireStruct for {rust_name} {{").unwrap();
    out.push_str("        const ZEROED: Self = Self {\n");
    for field in &fields {
        writeln!(out, "            {}: {},", field.name, field.zero).unwrap();
    }
    out.push_str("        };\n");
    let bool_field_offsets: Vec<String> = layout
        .fields
        .iter()
        .filter(|field| field.wire_type == WireType::Bool)
        .map(|field| field.offset.to_string())
        .collect();
    if !bool_field_offsets.is_empty() {
        writeln!(
            out,
            "        const BOOL_FIELD_OFFSETS: &'static [usize] = &[{}];",
            bool_field_offsets.join(", ")
        )
        .unwrap();
    }
    out.push_str("    }\n");
    out.push_str("    const _: () = {\n");
    writeln!(out, "        assert!(size_of::<{rust_name}>() == {});", layout.size).unwrap();
    writeln!(
        out,
        "        assert!(align_of::<{rust_name}>() == {});",
        layout.alignment
    )
    .unwrap();
    for field in &layout.fields {
        let name = rust_identifier(&field.spec.name);
        writeln!(
            out,
            "        assert!(offset_of!({rust_name}, {name}) == {});",
            field.offset
        )
        .unwrap();
    }
    out.push_str("    };\n\n");
}

fn write_type_enum(out: &mut String, enum_name: &str, count_name: &str, description: &str, names: &[&str]) {
    writeln!(out, "/// {description}").unwrap();
    out.push_str("#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\n#[repr(u16)]\n");
    writeln!(out, "pub enum {enum_name} {{").unwrap();
    for name in names {
        writeln!(out, "    {name},").unwrap();
    }
    out.push_str("}\n\n");
    writeln!(out, "impl {enum_name} {{").unwrap();
    out.push_str("    pub fn from_number(number: u16) -> Option<Self> {\n        Some(match number {\n");
    for (number, name) in names.iter().enumerate() {
        writeln!(out, "            {number} => Self::{name},").unwrap();
    }
    out.push_str("            _ => return None,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n");
    // NB: Only the tests of the vocabulary ask how many types there are.
    writeln!(out, "#[cfg(test)]\npub const {count_name}: u16 = {};\n", names.len()).unwrap();
}

pub fn write_wire_vocabulary(vocabulary: &Vocabulary) -> String {
    let mut out = String::from("// Generated by build.rs from Libraries/LibCompositing/WebGL/GLFunctions.json.\n\n");

    let command_names: Vec<&str> = vocabulary
        .commands
        .iter()
        .map(|entry| entry.function.command_name())
        .collect();
    write_type_enum(
        &mut out,
        "CommandType",
        "COMMAND_TYPE_COUNT",
        "What a record of the command stream is.",
        &command_names,
    );
    let sync_call_names: Vec<&str> = vocabulary
        .sync_calls
        .iter()
        .map(|entry| entry.function.command_name())
        .collect();
    write_type_enum(
        &mut out,
        "SyncCallType",
        "SYNC_CALL_TYPE_COUNT",
        "What a synchronous call is.",
        &sync_call_names,
    );
    let max_command_struct_size = vocabulary
        .commands
        .iter()
        .map(|entry| entry.layout.size)
        .max()
        .unwrap_or(0);
    out.push_str("/// The size of the largest struct of a record.\n");
    writeln!(
        out,
        "pub const MAX_COMMAND_STRUCT_SIZE: usize = {max_command_struct_size};\n"
    )
    .unwrap();

    out.push_str("/// The structs of the records of the command stream.\n");
    out.push_str("pub mod commands {\n");
    out.push_str("    use core::mem::offset_of;\n\n");
    out.push_str("    use super::CommandType;\n");
    out.push_str("    use crate::webgl::wire::{Command, DataSpan, WireStruct};\n\n");
    for entry in &vocabulary.commands {
        let name = entry.function.command_name();
        write_struct(&mut out, name, &entry.layout);
        writeln!(out, "    impl Command for {name} {{").unwrap();
        writeln!(out, "        const TYPE: CommandType = CommandType::{name};").unwrap();
        out.push_str("    }\n\n");
    }
    out.push_str("}\n\n");

    out.push_str("/// The structs of the synchronous calls.\n");
    out.push_str("pub mod sync_calls {\n");
    out.push_str("    use core::mem::offset_of;\n\n");
    out.push_str("    use super::SyncCallType;\n");
    out.push_str("    use crate::webgl::wire::{DataSpan, SyncReply, SyncRequest, WireStruct};\n\n");
    for entry in &vocabulary.sync_calls {
        let name = entry.function.command_name();
        write_struct(&mut out, &format!("{name}Request"), &entry.request);
        write_struct(&mut out, &format!("{name}Reply"), &entry.reply);
        writeln!(out, "    impl SyncRequest for {name}Request {{").unwrap();
        writeln!(out, "        const TYPE: SyncCallType = SyncCallType::{name};").unwrap();
        writeln!(out, "        type Reply = {name}Reply;").unwrap();
        out.push_str("    }\n");
        // NB: vocabulary() rejects a reply with a field that some bit pattern is no value of.
        out.push_str("    // SAFETY: Every field of the struct is a number or made of numbers.\n");
        writeln!(out, "    unsafe impl SyncReply for {name}Reply {{}}\n").unwrap();
    }
    out.push_str("}\n\n");

    out
}
