/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

use ak::math;
use libipc_rust::wire::{Decode, Encode};

// CSSPixels fixed-point arithmetic, bit-exact with the C++ implementation in
// PixelUnits.h: an i32 with 6 fractional bits. The parity test on the C++
// side compares every operation against the original.
//
// Rounding notes, matching C++ exactly:
// - Conversion from floating point rounds half to even (the C++ path goes
//   through the x87 fistp instruction in the default rounding mode) and
//   saturates at the i32 bounds.
// - Multiplication rounds the cut-off fraction half away from zero when more
//   fraction bits follow, and half to even otherwise.
// - Fraction-to-value conversion truncates (plain integer division).

pub const FRACTIONAL_BITS: u32 = 6;
/// The largest magnitude of the larger term of a fraction made from two floating-point terms, which keeps the fraction
/// precise while products of its terms with any CSS pixel value still fit in 64 bits.
const FRACTION_TERM_MAGNITUDE: f64 = (1 << 20) as f64;
pub const FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR: i32 = 1 << FRACTIONAL_BITS;
pub const RADIX_MASK: i32 = FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR - 1;
pub const MAX_INTEGER_VALUE: i32 = i32::MAX >> FRACTIONAL_BITS;
pub const MIN_INTEGER_VALUE: i32 = i32::MIN >> FRACTIONAL_BITS;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Debug, Encode, Decode)]
#[repr(transparent)]
pub struct CssPixels(i32);

impl std::ops::Mul for CssPixels {
    type Output = CssPixels;
    fn mul(self, other: CssPixels) -> CssPixels {
        self.fixed_point_multiply(other)
    }
}

fn clamp_i64_to_i32(value: i64) -> i32 {
    value.clamp(i32::MIN as i64, i32::MAX as i64) as i32
}

fn clamp_f64_to_i32(value: f64) -> i32 {
    if value >= i32::MAX as f64 {
        return i32::MAX;
    }
    if value <= i32::MIN as f64 {
        return i32::MIN;
    }
    value.round_ties_even() as i32
}

fn clamp_f32_to_i32(value: f32) -> i32 {
    if value >= i32::MAX as f32 {
        return i32::MAX;
    }
    if value <= i32::MIN as f32 {
        return i32::MIN;
    }
    value.round_ties_even() as i32
}

impl CssPixels {
    pub fn from_raw(raw: i32) -> Self {
        Self(raw)
    }

    pub fn raw_value(self) -> i32 {
        self.0
    }

    pub fn from_integer(value: i64) -> Self {
        if value > MAX_INTEGER_VALUE as i64 {
            Self(i32::MAX)
        } else if value < MIN_INTEGER_VALUE as i64 {
            Self(i32::MIN)
        } else {
            Self((value as i32) << FRACTIONAL_BITS)
        }
    }

    pub fn nearest_value_for(value: f64) -> Self {
        if value.is_nan() {
            return Self(0);
        }
        Self(clamp_f64_to_i32(value * FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR as f64))
    }

    pub fn truncated_value_for(value: f64) -> Self {
        if value.is_nan() {
            return Self(0);
        }
        Self(clamp_f64_to_i32((value * FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR as f64).trunc()))
    }

    /// Matches `CSSPixels::nearest_value_for(float)`: the scaling and
    /// ties-to-even conversion both stay on the f32 path.
    pub fn nearest_value_for_f32(value: f32) -> Self {
        if value.is_nan() {
            return Self(0);
        }
        Self(clamp_f32_to_i32(value * FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR as f32))
    }

    pub fn round(self) -> Self {
        let half = Self(FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR >> 1);
        if self.0 > 0 {
            (self + half).floor()
        } else {
            (self - half).ceil()
        }
    }

    pub fn floor(self) -> Self {
        Self(self.0 & !RADIX_MASK)
    }

    pub fn ceil(self) -> Self {
        let floor = self.0 & !RADIX_MASK;
        let increment = if self.0 & RADIX_MASK != 0 {
            FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR
        } else {
            0
        };
        Self(floor.wrapping_add(increment))
    }

    pub fn to_int(self) -> i32 {
        self.0 / FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR
    }

    pub fn to_double(self) -> f64 {
        self.0 as f64 / FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR as f64
    }

    pub fn to_float(self) -> f32 {
        self.0 as f32 / FIXED_POINT_DENOMINATOR as f32
    }

    fn fixed_point_multiply(self, other: CssPixels) -> Self {
        let value = self.0 as i64 * other.0 as i64;
        let mut int_value = clamp_i64_to_i32(value >> FRACTIONAL_BITS);

        // Rounding: if the last bit cut off was 1:
        if value & (1i64 << (FRACTIONAL_BITS - 1)) != 0 {
            // If any bit after was 1 as well, round away from zero.
            if value & (RADIX_MASK as i64 >> 1) != 0 {
                int_value = int_value.saturating_add(1);
            } else {
                // Otherwise round to the next even value, adding the least
                // significant bit of the raw integer value.
                int_value = int_value.saturating_add(int_value & 1);
            }
        }
        Self(int_value)
    }

    /// Division through CSSPixelFraction: the conversion back to a value is a
    /// truncating integer division of the widened numerator.
    pub fn div_as_fraction(self, denominator: CssPixels) -> Self {
        let wide_value = (self.0 as i64) << FRACTIONAL_BITS;
        Self(clamp_i64_to_i32(wide_value / denominator.0 as i64))
    }

    pub fn mul_by_fraction(self, fraction: CssPixelFraction) -> Self {
        let mut wide_value = self.0 as i64;
        wide_value *= fraction.numerator.0 as i64;
        wide_value /= fraction.denominator.0 as i64;
        Self(clamp_i64_to_i32(wide_value))
    }

    pub fn div_by_fraction(self, fraction: CssPixelFraction) -> Self {
        let mut wide_value = self.0 as i64;
        wide_value *= fraction.denominator.0 as i64;
        wide_value /= fraction.numerator.0 as i64;
        Self(clamp_i64_to_i32(wide_value))
    }

    pub fn scaled(self, factor: f64) -> Self {
        Self::nearest_value_for(self.to_double() * factor)
    }

    /// Like the floating-point `CSSPixelFraction(double, double)` constructor,
    /// a denominator that rounds to zero CSSPixels is rescued by folding it
    /// into the numerator before the fixed-point conversion. Unlike it, the
    /// terms are scaled by a power of two first, so the fraction keeps the
    /// precision of the ratio.
    pub fn fraction_nearest_values_for(numerator: f64, denominator: f64) -> (CssPixels, CssPixels) {
        let ratio = numerator / denominator;
        if !ratio.is_finite() || ratio == 0.0 {
            return Self::unscaled_fraction_nearest_values_for(numerator, denominator);
        }
        // NB: The terms are scaled by a power of two before they are rounded to our fixed-point precision, so that a
        //     ratio such as 1.6 / 1 keeps its precision instead of becoming 1.59375 / 1, while terms such as 16 / 9 stay
        //     exact. Terms that are not exact in binary, such as 1e-13 / 1e-14, can still describe an exact ratio, so
        //     the fraction rebuilt from the ratio is used where it is closer to it.
        let scaled = |numerator: f64, denominator: f64| {
            let largest_term = numerator.abs().max(denominator.abs());
            let scale = math::exp2(math::log2(FRACTION_TERM_MAGNITUDE / largest_term).floor());
            Self::unscaled_fraction_nearest_values_for(numerator * scale, denominator * scale)
        };
        let error = |(numerator, denominator): (CssPixels, CssPixels)| {
            if denominator.raw_value() == 0 {
                return f64::INFINITY;
            }
            (numerator.to_double() / denominator.to_double() - ratio).abs()
        };
        let from_terms = scaled(numerator, denominator);
        let from_ratio = scaled(ratio, 1.0);
        if error(from_ratio) < error(from_terms) {
            from_ratio
        } else {
            from_terms
        }
    }

    fn unscaled_fraction_nearest_values_for(mut numerator: f64, mut denominator: f64) -> (CssPixels, CssPixels) {
        if Self::nearest_value_for(denominator).raw_value() == 0 {
            numerator /= denominator;
            denominator = 1.0;
        }
        (Self::nearest_value_for(numerator), Self::nearest_value_for(denominator))
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct CssPixelFraction {
    numerator: CssPixels,
    denominator: CssPixels,
}

impl CssPixelFraction {
    pub fn zero() -> Self {
        Self {
            numerator: CssPixels::from_raw(0),
            denominator: CssPixels::from_integer(1),
        }
    }

    pub fn one() -> Self {
        Self {
            numerator: CssPixels::from_integer(1),
            denominator: CssPixels::from_integer(1),
        }
    }

    pub fn ratio_of(numerator: CssPixels, denominator: CssPixels) -> Self {
        assert!(denominator.raw_value() != 0);
        Self { numerator, denominator }
    }

    pub fn to_double(self) -> f64 {
        self.numerator.to_double() / self.denominator.to_double()
    }

    fn cross_products(self, other: Self) -> (i64, i64) {
        let left = self.numerator.raw_value() as i64 * other.denominator.raw_value() as i64;
        let right = other.numerator.raw_value() as i64 * self.denominator.raw_value() as i64;
        (left, right)
    }

    pub fn min(self, other: Self) -> Self {
        let (left, right) = self.cross_products(other);
        if left <= right { self } else { other }
    }

    pub fn is_at_least_one(self) -> bool {
        let (left, right) = self.cross_products(Self::one());
        left >= right
    }
}

const MAX_DIMENSION_RAW: i32 = 17_895_700 * 64;

pub fn max_dimension_value() -> CssPixels {
    CssPixels::from_raw(MAX_DIMENSION_RAW)
}

pub fn clamp_to_max_dimension_value(value: CssPixels) -> CssPixels {
    if matches!(value.raw_value(), i32::MIN | i32::MAX) {
        max_dimension_value()
    } else {
        value
    }
}

pub fn css_clamp(value: CssPixels, min: CssPixels, max: CssPixels) -> CssPixels {
    min.max(value.min(max))
}

impl std::ops::Add for CssPixels {
    type Output = Self;

    fn add(self, other: Self) -> Self {
        Self::from_raw(self.raw_value().saturating_add(other.raw_value()))
    }
}

impl std::ops::AddAssign for CssPixels {
    fn add_assign(&mut self, other: Self) {
        *self = *self + other;
    }
}

impl std::ops::Sub for CssPixels {
    type Output = Self;

    fn sub(self, other: Self) -> Self {
        Self::from_raw(self.raw_value().saturating_sub(other.raw_value()))
    }
}

impl std::ops::SubAssign for CssPixels {
    fn sub_assign(&mut self, other: Self) {
        *self = *self - other;
    }
}

impl std::ops::Neg for CssPixels {
    type Output = Self;

    fn neg(self) -> Self {
        Self::from_raw(0i32.saturating_sub(self.raw_value()))
    }
}

impl std::ops::Mul<usize> for CssPixels {
    type Output = Self;

    fn mul(self, other: usize) -> Self {
        let raw = (self.raw_value() as i64).saturating_mul(other as i64);
        Self::from_raw(raw.clamp(i32::MIN as i64, i32::MAX as i64) as i32)
    }
}

impl std::ops::Mul<CssPixels> for usize {
    type Output = CssPixels;

    fn mul(self, other: CssPixels) -> CssPixels {
        other * self
    }
}

impl std::ops::Div<usize> for CssPixels {
    type Output = Self;

    fn div(self, other: usize) -> Self {
        assert_ne!(other, 0);
        Self::from_raw((self.raw_value() as i64 / other as i64) as i32)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Encode, Decode)]
pub struct CssPixelPoint {
    pub x: CssPixels,
    pub y: CssPixels,
}

impl CssPixelPoint {
    pub fn is_zero(self) -> bool {
        self.x == CssPixels::default() && self.y == CssPixels::default()
    }

    pub const fn new(x: CssPixels, y: CssPixels) -> Self {
        Self { x, y }
    }
    pub fn translated(self, dx: CssPixels, dy: CssPixels) -> Self {
        Self {
            x: self.x + dx,
            y: self.y + dy,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct CssPixelSize {
    pub width: CssPixels,
    pub height: CssPixels,
}

impl CssPixelSize {
    pub const fn new(width: CssPixels, height: CssPixels) -> Self {
        Self { width, height }
    }
    pub fn is_empty(self) -> bool {
        self.width <= CssPixels::from_raw(0) || self.height <= CssPixels::from_raw(0)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct CssPixelRect {
    pub x: CssPixels,
    pub y: CssPixels,
    pub width: CssPixels,
    pub height: CssPixels,
}

impl CssPixelRect {
    pub const fn new(x: CssPixels, y: CssPixels, width: CssPixels, height: CssPixels) -> Self {
        Self { x, y, width, height }
    }
    pub const fn from_location_and_size(location: CssPixelPoint, size: CssPixelSize) -> Self {
        Self {
            x: location.x,
            y: location.y,
            width: size.width,
            height: size.height,
        }
    }
    pub const fn location(self) -> CssPixelPoint {
        CssPixelPoint { x: self.x, y: self.y }
    }
    pub const fn size(self) -> CssPixelSize {
        CssPixelSize {
            width: self.width,
            height: self.height,
        }
    }
    pub fn left(self) -> CssPixels {
        self.x
    }
    pub fn top(self) -> CssPixels {
        self.y
    }
    pub fn right(self) -> CssPixels {
        self.x + self.width
    }
    pub fn bottom(self) -> CssPixels {
        self.y + self.height
    }
    pub fn is_empty(self) -> bool {
        self.width <= CssPixels::from_raw(0) || self.height <= CssPixels::from_raw(0)
    }
    pub fn translated(self, dx: CssPixels, dy: CssPixels) -> Self {
        Self {
            x: self.x + dx,
            y: self.y + dy,
            ..self
        }
    }
    pub fn translated_by(self, offset: CssPixelPoint) -> Self {
        self.translated(offset.x, offset.y)
    }
    pub fn set_left(&mut self, left: CssPixels) {
        self.width = self.right() - left;
        self.x = left;
    }
    pub fn set_top(&mut self, top: CssPixels) {
        self.height = self.bottom() - top;
        self.y = top;
    }
    pub fn set_right(&mut self, right: CssPixels) {
        self.width = right - self.x;
    }
    pub fn set_bottom(&mut self, bottom: CssPixels) {
        self.height = bottom - self.y;
    }
    pub fn unite_horizontally(&mut self, other: Self) {
        let new_left = self.left().min(other.left());
        let new_right = self.right().max(other.right());
        self.set_left(new_left);
        self.set_right(new_right);
    }
    pub fn unite_vertically(&mut self, other: Self) {
        let new_top = self.top().min(other.top());
        let new_bottom = self.bottom().max(other.bottom());
        self.set_top(new_top);
        self.set_bottom(new_bottom);
    }
    pub fn edge_adjacent_intersects(self, other: Self) -> bool {
        self.left().max(other.left()) <= self.right().min(other.right())
            && self.top().max(other.top()) <= self.bottom().min(other.bottom())
    }
    pub fn intersects(self, other: Self) -> bool {
        !self.is_empty()
            && !other.is_empty()
            && self.left() < other.right()
            && self.right() > other.left()
            && self.top() < other.bottom()
            && self.bottom() > other.top()
    }
    pub fn intersected(self, other: Self) -> Self {
        let left = self.left().max(other.left());
        let right = self.right().min(other.right());
        let top = self.top().max(other.top());
        let bottom = self.bottom().min(other.bottom());
        if left > right || top > bottom {
            return Self::default();
        }
        Self {
            x: left,
            y: top,
            width: right - left,
            height: bottom - top,
        }
    }
    pub fn center(self) -> CssPixelPoint {
        let two = CssPixels::from_integer(2);
        CssPixelPoint {
            x: self.x + self.width.div_as_fraction(two),
            y: self.y + self.height.div_as_fraction(two),
        }
    }
    pub fn unite(&mut self, other: Self) {
        if self.is_empty() {
            *self = other;
            return;
        }
        if other.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        self.unite_horizontally(other);
        self.unite_vertically(other);
    }
    pub fn shrink(&mut self, top: CssPixels, right: CssPixels, bottom: CssPixels, left: CssPixels) {
        self.x += left;
        self.width = self.width - left - right;
        self.y += top;
        self.height = self.height - top - bottom;
    }
    pub fn shrunken(mut self, top: CssPixels, right: CssPixels, bottom: CssPixels, left: CssPixels) -> Self {
        self.shrink(top, right, bottom, left);
        self
    }
    pub fn inflate(&mut self, top: CssPixels, right: CssPixels, bottom: CssPixels, left: CssPixels) {
        self.x -= left;
        self.width = self.width + left + right;
        self.y -= top;
        self.height = self.height + top + bottom;
    }
    pub fn inflated(mut self, top: CssPixels, right: CssPixels, bottom: CssPixels, left: CssPixels) -> Self {
        self.inflate(top, right, bottom, left);
        self
    }
    pub fn contains_rect(self, other: Self) -> bool {
        self.left() <= other.left()
            && self.right() >= other.right()
            && self.top() <= other.top()
            && self.bottom() >= other.bottom()
    }
    pub fn contains_point(self, point: CssPixelPoint) -> bool {
        point.x >= self.x && point.x < self.right() && point.y >= self.y && point.y < self.bottom()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[allow(clippy::items_after_test_module)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn integer_construction_shifts_and_saturates() {
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::from_integer(3).raw_value(), 3 << 6);
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::from_integer(1 << 40).raw_value(), i32::MAX);
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::from_integer(-(1 << 40)).raw_value(), i32::MIN);
    }

    #[test]
    fn nearest_value_rounds_half_to_even() {
        // 0.0078125 * 64 = 0.5: ties to even -> 0.
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::nearest_value_for(0.0078125).raw_value(), 0);
        // 0.0234375 * 64 = 1.5: ties to even -> 2.
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::nearest_value_for(0.0234375).raw_value(), 2);
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::nearest_value_for(f64::NAN).raw_value(), 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn truncated_value_rounds_toward_zero() {
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::truncated_value_for(0.0234375).raw_value(), 1);
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::truncated_value_for(-0.0234375).raw_value(), -1);
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::truncated_value_for(f64::NAN).raw_value(), 0);
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::truncated_value_for(f64::INFINITY).raw_value(), i32::MAX);
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::truncated_value_for(f64::NEG_INFINITY).raw_value(), i32::MIN);
    }

    #[test]
    fn f32_nearest_value_keeps_the_float_instantiation() {
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(0.0078125).raw_value(), 0);
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(0.0234375).raw_value(), 2);
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(f32::NAN).raw_value(), 0);
        assert_eq!(CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(f32::INFINITY).raw_value(), i32::MAX);
        assert_eq!(
            CssPixels::nearest_value_for_f32(f32::NEG_INFINITY).raw_value(),
            i32::MIN
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn fixed_point_floor_and_ceil_match_cpp_bit_operations() {
        for (raw, floor, ceil) in [
            (0, 0, 0),
            (1, 0, 64),
            (63, 0, 64),
            (64, 64, 64),
            (65, 64, 128),
            (-1, -64, 0),
            (-63, -64, 0),
            (-64, -64, -64),
            (-65, -128, -64),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(CssPixels::from_raw(raw).floor().raw_value(), floor);
            assert_eq!(CssPixels::from_raw(raw).ceil().raw_value(), ceil);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn multiplication_rounding_modes() {
        // 0.5 * 0.5 = 0.25: exact, no rounding.
        let half = CssPixels::from_raw(32);
        assert_eq!((half * half).raw_value(), 16);
        // Half-bit set with trailing bits rounds away from zero;
        // half-bit alone rounds to even.
        let x = CssPixels::from_raw(33); // 33 * 32 = 1056; 1056 >> 6 = 16 r 32 (half, no trailing) -> even
        assert_eq!((x * half).raw_value(), 16);
        let y = CssPixels::from_raw(35); // 35 * 33 = 1155 = 18 * 64 + 3; below half -> truncate
        assert_eq!((y * CssPixels::from_raw(33)).raw_value(), 18);
    }

    #[test]
    fn fraction_division_truncates() {
        // (10 << 6) << 6 / (3 << 6) = 640 / 3 * ... : 10/3 in fixed point = 213.33 -> 213.
        let ten = CssPixels::from_integer(10);
        let three = CssPixels::from_integer(3);
        assert_eq!(ten.div_as_fraction(three).raw_value(), 213);
        let minus_ten = CssPixels::from_integer(-10);
        assert_eq!(minus_ten.div_as_fraction(three).raw_value(), -213);
    }
}

/// FFI hooks for the C++ parity test.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_css_pixels_multiply(left_raw: i32, right_raw: i32) -> i32 {
    (CssPixels::from_raw(left_raw) * CssPixels::from_raw(right_raw)).raw_value()
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_css_pixels_divide_as_fraction(numerator_raw: i32, denominator_raw: i32) -> i32 {
    CssPixels::from_raw(numerator_raw)
        .div_as_fraction(CssPixels::from_raw(denominator_raw))
        .raw_value()
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_css_pixels_nearest_value_for(value: f64) -> i32 {
    CssPixels::nearest_value_for(value).raw_value()
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn rust_css_pixels_scaled(raw: i32, factor: f64) -> i32 {
    CssPixels::from_raw(raw).scaled(factor).raw_value()
}

    pub x: CssPixels,
    pub y: CssPixels,
}

    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            x: CssPixels::from_raw(0),
            y: CssPixels::from_raw(0),
        }
    }
}

pub struct FfiCssPixelSize {
    pub width: CssPixels,
    pub height: CssPixels,

#[repr(C)]
pub struct FfiCssPixelRect {
    pub x: CssPixels,
    pub y: CssPixels,
    pub width: CssPixels,
    pub height: CssPixels,
}

        Self { x: point.x, y: point.y }
    }
}

        Self { x: point.x, y: point.y }

            height: size.height,

    }

        Self {
            x: rect.x,
            y: rect.y,
            width: rect.width,
            height: rect.height,
        }
    }
}

//! The raster spaces at spatial nodes whose transform the compositor animates: which nodes get one, the scale their
//! content is rastered at, and where that content can show around the node wherever the animation takes it.

use crate::display_list::commands::{EffectNodeIndex, SpatialNodeIndex, VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX};
use crate::display_list::placement::ValuesFoldedDownSpatialChains;
use crate::easing::Easing;
use crate::host::{FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind, FfiVisualAnimationTransformOperationKind};
use crate::visual_animation::{VisualAnimation, VisualAnimationTransformOperation, VisualAnimationValue};
use crate::visual_context::{EffectNodeData, SpatialData, VisualContextTree};
use libgfx_rust::{FloatMatrix4x4, FloatRect};

pub const MAXIMUM_ANIMATED_TRANSFORM_SPACE_COUNT: usize = 32;
const LARGEST_RASTER_SCALE_PAST_PARENT_SCALE: f32 = 4.0;
pub(crate) const SMALLEST_RASTER_SCALE: f32 = 1.0 / 64.0;
const RASTER_SCALE_STEPS_PER_UNIT: f32 = 64.0;

fn transform_animations_of(tree: &VisualContextTree) -> impl Iterator<Item = &VisualAnimation> {
    tree.visual_animations()
        .iter()
        .filter(|animation| animation.target_kind == FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform)
}

/// The nodes whose transform the compositor animates that `is_root` takes.
pub(crate) fn roots_of_transform_animations(
    tree: &VisualContextTree,
    is_root: impl Fn(SpatialNodeIndex) -> bool,
) -> impl Iterator<Item = SpatialNodeIndex> {
    transform_animations_of(tree)
        .flat_map(|animation| animation.node_indices.iter().map(|&index| SpatialNodeIndex(index)))
        .filter(move |&node| is_root(node))
}

/// Per spatial node, whether it is or is under a node whose transform the compositor animates that `is_root` takes, or
/// empty where it takes none.
pub(crate) fn spatial_nodes_under_transform_animations(
    tree: &VisualContextTree,
    is_root: impl Fn(SpatialNodeIndex) -> bool,
) -> Vec<bool> {
    let roots: Vec<SpatialNodeIndex> = roots_of_transform_animations(tree, is_root).collect();
    if roots.is_empty() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    tree.spatial_nodes_in_subtrees_of(&roots)
}

fn matrix_of_operations(operations: &[VisualAnimationTransformOperation]) -> FloatMatrix4x4 {
    operations.iter().fold(FloatMatrix4x4::identity(), |matrix, operation| {
        matrix.multiplied(operation.to_matrix())
    })
}

fn transform_keyframe_matrices(animation: &VisualAnimation) -> impl Iterator<Item = FloatMatrix4x4> + '_ {
    animation.keyframes.iter().filter_map(|keyframe| match &keyframe.value {
        VisualAnimationValue::Transform(operations) => Some(matrix_of_operations(operations)),
        _ => None,
    })
}

/// Whether every sample of a transform animation keeps what it transforms in the plane, so that its samples are 2D
/// affine. A sample interpolates the values of each operation of two keyframes, so each operation has to stay in the
/// plane at every keyframe, and a rotation out of the plane has to keep its angle, as one between two angles that stay
/// in the plane can leave it.
pub fn transform_animation_stays_in_plane(animation: &VisualAnimation) -> bool {
    use FfiVisualAnimationTransformOperationKind as Kind;
    let Some(operations_of_keyframes) = animation
        .keyframes
        .iter()
        .map(|keyframe| match &keyframe.value {
            VisualAnimationValue::Transform(operations) => Some(operations.as_slice()),
            _ => None,
        })
        .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()
    else {
        return false;
    };
    let each_operation_stays_in_plane = operations_of_keyframes
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|operations| operations.iter())
        .all(|operation| operation.to_matrix().is_2d_affine());
    let each_rotation_out_of_plane_keeps_its_angle = operations_of_keyframes.windows(2).all(|pair| {
        pair[0]
            .iter()
            .zip(pair[1])
            .all(|(from, to)| !matches!(from.kind, Kind::RotateX | Kind::RotateY) || from.values() == to.values())
    });
    each_operation_stays_in_plane && each_rotation_out_of_plane_keeps_its_angle
}

/// The largest factor a 2D affine matrix scales lengths along either axis by.
fn largest_axis_scale(matrix: FloatMatrix4x4) -> f32 {
    let affine = matrix.extract_2d_affine();
    let x_axis_scale = (affine.a() * affine.a() + affine.b() * affine.b()).sqrt();
    let y_axis_scale = (affine.c() * affine.c() + affine.d() * affine.d()).sqrt();
    x_axis_scale.max(y_axis_scale)
}

fn matrix_from_root_to_node_space(tree: &VisualContextTree, node: SpatialNodeIndex) -> FloatMatrix4x4 {
    let mut chain = Vec::new();
    let mut index = node;
    loop {
        chain.push(index);
        if index == VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX {
            break;
        }
        index = tree.spatial_nodes[index.0 as usize].parent;
    }
    chain.iter().rev().fold(FloatMatrix4x4::identity(), |matrix, &index| {
        tree.local_transform(index, &[]).applied_to(matrix)
    })
}

/// The scale content under `anchor` is rastered at: as far as its parent scales it times the largest scale any of its
/// keyframes reach, so that the content stays as sharp as a direct raster at the largest, rounded so that samples
/// of one animation share it.
pub(crate) fn raster_scale_of(tree: &VisualContextTree, anchor: SpatialNodeIndex) -> f32 {
    let parent_scale = largest_axis_scale(matrix_from_root_to_node_space(
        tree,
        tree.spatial_nodes[anchor.0 as usize].parent,
    ));
    let largest_keyframe_scale = transform_animations_of(tree)
        .filter(|animation| animation.node_indices.contains(&anchor.0))
        .flat_map(transform_keyframe_matrices)
        .map(largest_axis_scale)
        .fold(0.0f32, f32::max);
    let scale_at_largest_keyframe = parent_scale * largest_keyframe_scale;
    if !parent_scale.is_finite() || scale_at_largest_keyframe.is_nan() {
        return 1.0;
    }
    // A parent that scales content down far enough puts the largest scale below the smallest one, which then wins.
    let largest_raster_scale = (parent_scale * LARGEST_RASTER_SCALE_PAST_PARENT_SCALE).max(SMALLEST_RASTER_SCALE);
    let raster_scale = scale_at_largest_keyframe
        .max(SMALLEST_RASTER_SCALE)
        .min(largest_raster_scale);
    if !raster_scale.is_finite() {
        return 1.0;
    }
    ((raster_scale * RASTER_SCALE_STEPS_PER_UNIT).round() / RASTER_SCALE_STEPS_PER_UNIT).max(SMALLEST_RASTER_SCALE)
}

fn effect_reads_what_is_below_it(data: &EffectNodeData) -> bool {
    match data {
        EffectNodeData::Effects(effects) => {
            effects.backdrop_filter.is_some()
                || effects.blend_mode != libgfx_rust::CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal
        }
        EffectNodeData::Mask(mask) => mask.masks_backdrop,
        _ => false,
    }
}

/// The spatial nodes whose transform the compositor animates that get raster spaces of their own, as the tree alone
/// decides: the outermost of them, whose animations stay in the plane, under 2D affine
/// transforms, holding no effect that reads what is below it and no part of a 3D sorting context, in tree order up
/// to as many as get one.
pub fn animated_transform_anchors(tree: &VisualContextTree) -> Vec<SpatialNodeIndex> {
    let mut is_animated_by_spatial_index = vec![false; tree.spatial_nodes.len()];
    let mut stays_in_plane_by_spatial_index = vec![true; tree.spatial_nodes.len()];
    for animation in transform_animations_of(tree) {
        let stays_in_plane = transform_animation_stays_in_plane(animation);
        for &node_index in &animation.node_indices {
            let Some(is_animated) = is_animated_by_spatial_index.get_mut(node_index as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            *is_animated = true;
            stays_in_plane_by_spatial_index[node_index as usize] &= stays_in_plane;
        }
    }
    if !is_animated_by_spatial_index.contains(&true) {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut chain_below_viewport_holds_animated_node = ValuesFoldedDownSpatialChains::<bool>::new();
    let mut matrices_from_root_to_node_spaces = ValuesFoldedDownSpatialChains::<FloatMatrix4x4>::new();
    let matrix_from_root_to_viewport_node_space = tree
        .local_transform(VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX, &[])
        .applied_to(FloatMatrix4x4::identity());
    let mut subtrees_that_keep_nodes_from_anchoring_spaces = None;
    let mut anchors = Vec::new();
    for (index, node) in tree.spatial_nodes.iter().enumerate() {
        if anchors.len() == MAXIMUM_ANIMATED_TRANSFORM_SPACE_COUNT {
            break;
        }
        let anchor = SpatialNodeIndex(index as u32);
        if !is_animated_by_spatial_index[index]
            || !stays_in_plane_by_spatial_index[index]
            || !matches!(node.data, SpatialData::Transform(_))
        {
            continue;
        }
        let is_outermost = node.parent == VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX
            || chain_below_viewport_holds_animated_node.value_of(
                tree,
                node.parent,
                false,
                |node, chain_above_holds| chain_above_holds || is_animated_by_spatial_index[node.0 as usize],
            ) == Some(false);
        if !is_outermost {
            continue;
        }
        let is_under_2d_affine_transforms = matrices_from_root_to_node_spaces
            .value_of(
                tree,
                node.parent,
                matrix_from_root_to_viewport_node_space,
                |node, matrix_from_root_to_parent_space| {
                    tree.local_transform(node, &[])
                        .applied_to(matrix_from_root_to_parent_space)
                },
            )
            .is_some_and(|matrix| matrix.is_2d_affine());
        if !is_under_2d_affine_transforms {
            continue;
        }
        let subtrees = subtrees_that_keep_nodes_from_anchoring_spaces
            .get_or_insert_with(|| SubtreesThatKeepNodesFromAnchoringSpaces::of(tree));
        if subtrees.touch_sorting_context_by_spatial_index[index]
            || subtrees.hold_effect_reading_below_it_by_spatial_index[index]
        {
            continue;
        }
        anchors.push(anchor);
    }
    anchors
}

// Per spatial node, whether its subtree holds part of a 3D sorting context, and whether it holds an effect that reads
// what is below it.
struct SubtreesThatKeepNodesFromAnchoringSpaces {
    touch_sorting_context_by_spatial_index: Vec<bool>,
    hold_effect_reading_below_it_by_spatial_index: Vec<bool>,
}

impl SubtreesThatKeepNodesFromAnchoringSpaces {
    fn of(tree: &VisualContextTree) -> Self {
        let mut touch_sorting_context_by_spatial_index: Vec<bool> = tree
            .roots_of_contexts_sorting_planes_by_depth()
            .iter()
            .map(Option::is_some)
            .collect();
        let mut hold_effect_reading_below_it_by_spatial_index = vec![false; tree.spatial_nodes.len()];
        for effect_node in &tree.effect_nodes {
            if effect_reads_what_is_below_it(&effect_node.data)
                && let Some(holds) =
                    hold_effect_reading_below_it_by_spatial_index.get_mut(effect_node.spatial.0 as usize)
            {
                *holds = true;
            }
        }
        let mut live_nodes_parents_first = Vec::with_capacity(tree.spatial_nodes.len());
        tree.visit_spatial_nodes_parents_first(|index| live_nodes_parents_first.push(index));
        for &index in live_nodes_parents_first.iter().rev() {
            if index == VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX.0 as usize {
                continue;
            }
            let parent = tree.spatial_nodes[index].parent.0 as usize;
            touch_sorting_context_by_spatial_index[parent] |= touch_sorting_context_by_spatial_index[index];
            hold_effect_reading_below_it_by_spatial_index[parent] |=
                hold_effect_reading_below_it_by_spatial_index[index];
        }
        Self {
            touch_sorting_context_by_spatial_index,
            hold_effect_reading_below_it_by_spatial_index,
        }
    }
}

/// Whether an effect reads what is below it, which content of a space whose anchor the compositor animates cannot be
/// placed under.
pub fn effect_reads_below_it(tree: &VisualContextTree, effect: EffectNodeIndex) -> bool {
    effect_reads_what_is_below_it(&tree.effect_nodes[effect.0 as usize].data)
}

pub(crate) fn easing_stays_within_unit_interval(easing: &Easing) -> bool {
    match easing {
        Easing::Linear(points) => points.iter().all(|point| (0.0..=1.0).contains(&point.output)),
        Easing::CubicBezier { y1, y2, .. } => (0.0..=1.0).contains(y1) && (0.0..=1.0).contains(y2),
        Easing::Steps { .. } => true,
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct ValueRange {
    lowest: f32,
    highest: f32,
}

impl ValueRange {
    fn of(value: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            lowest: value,
            highest: value,
        }
    }

    fn widened_to(self, value: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            lowest: self.lowest.min(value),
            highest: self.highest.max(value),
        }
    }

    fn times(self, lowest_factor: f32, highest_factor: f32) -> Self {
        let products = [
            self.lowest * lowest_factor,
            self.lowest * highest_factor,
            self.highest * lowest_factor,
            self.highest * highest_factor,
        ];
        Self {
            lowest: products.iter().copied().fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min),
            highest: products.iter().copied().fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max),
        }
    }
}

/// What a 2D operation can do to points, over the values its keyframes give it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum SweptOperation {
    Translate { x: ValueRange, y: ValueRange },
    Scale { x: ValueRange, y: ValueRange },
    Rotate,
}

fn x_and_y_of_operation(operation: &VisualAnimationTransformOperation) -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
    use FfiVisualAnimationTransformOperationKind as Kind;
    let values = operation.values();
    let first = values.first().copied().unwrap_or(0.0);
    let second = values.get(1).copied();
    Some(match operation.kind {
        Kind::Translate => (first, second.unwrap_or(0.0)),
        Kind::TranslateX => (first, 0.0),
        Kind::TranslateY => (0.0, first),
        Kind::Scale => (first, second.unwrap_or(first)),
        Kind::ScaleX => (first, 1.0),
        Kind::ScaleY => (1.0, first),
        Kind::Rotate | Kind::RotateZ => (0.0, 0.0),
        _ => return None,
    })
}

fn swept_operations_of(animation: &VisualAnimation) -> Option<Vec<SweptOperation>> {
    use FfiVisualAnimationTransformOperationKind as Kind;
    if !easing_stays_within_unit_interval(&animation.easing)
        || !animation
            .keyframes
            .iter()
            .all(|keyframe| easing_stays_within_unit_interval(&keyframe.easing))
    {
        return None;
    }
    let mut swept_operations: Option<Vec<SweptOperation>> = None;
    for keyframe in &animation.keyframes {
        let VisualAnimationValue::Transform(operations) = &keyframe.value else {
            return None;
        };
        let operations_of_keyframe = operations
            .iter()
            .map(|operation| {
                let (x, y) = x_and_y_of_operation(operation)?;
                Some(match operation.kind {
                    Kind::Translate | Kind::TranslateX | Kind::TranslateY => SweptOperation::Translate {
                        x: ValueRange::of(x),
                        y: ValueRange::of(y),
                    },
                    Kind::Scale | Kind::ScaleX | Kind::ScaleY => SweptOperation::Scale {
                        x: ValueRange::of(x),
                        y: ValueRange::of(y),
                    },
                    _ => SweptOperation::Rotate,
                })
            })
            .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()?;
        swept_operations = Some(match swept_operations {
            None => operations_of_keyframe,
            Some(swept_so_far) => {
                if swept_so_far.len() != operations_of_keyframe.len() {
                    return None;
                }
                swept_so_far
                    .into_iter()
                    .zip(operations_of_keyframe)
                    .map(|pair| match pair {
                        (
                            SweptOperation::Translate { x, y },
                            SweptOperation::Translate {
                                x: keyframe_x,
                                y: keyframe_y,
                            },
                        ) => Some(SweptOperation::Translate {
                            x: x.widened_to(keyframe_x.lowest),
                            y: y.widened_to(keyframe_y.lowest),
                        }),
                        (
                            SweptOperation::Scale { x, y },
                            SweptOperation::Scale {
                                x: keyframe_x,
                                y: keyframe_y,
                            },
                        ) => Some(SweptOperation::Scale {
                            x: x.widened_to(keyframe_x.lowest),
                            y: y.widened_to(keyframe_y.lowest),
                        }),
                        (SweptOperation::Rotate, SweptOperation::Rotate) => Some(SweptOperation::Rotate),
                        _ => None,
                    })
                    .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()?
            }
        });
    }
    swept_operations
}

fn swept_through(operation: SweptOperation, rect: FloatRect) -> FloatRect {
    let (x, y) = (
        ValueRange {
            lowest: rect.x,
            highest: rect.right(),
        },
        ValueRange {
            lowest: rect.y,
            highest: rect.bottom(),
        },
    );
    let (x, y) = match operation {
        SweptOperation::Translate {
            x: translation_x,
            y: translation_y,
        } => (
            ValueRange {
                lowest: x.lowest + translation_x.lowest,
                highest: x.highest + translation_x.highest,
            },
            ValueRange {
                lowest: y.lowest + translation_y.lowest,
                highest: y.highest + translation_y.highest,
            },
        ),
        SweptOperation::Scale { x: scale_x, y: scale_y } => (
            x.times(scale_x.lowest, scale_x.highest),
            y.times(scale_y.lowest, scale_y.highest),
        ),
        SweptOperation::Rotate => {
            let radius = [
                (x.lowest, y.lowest),
                (x.highest, y.lowest),
                (x.lowest, y.highest),
                (x.highest, y.highest),
            ]
            .iter()
            .map(|&(corner_x, corner_y)| (corner_x * corner_x + corner_y * corner_y).sqrt())
            .fold(0.0f32, f32::max);
            (
                ValueRange {
                    lowest: -radius,
                    highest: radius,
                },
                ValueRange {
                    lowest: -radius,
                    highest: radius,
                },
            )
        }
    };
    FloatRect::new(x.lowest, y.lowest, x.highest - x.lowest, y.highest - y.lowest)
}

/// Where content within `content_rect`, in the coordinates of `anchor`'s content, can show in those of the anchor's
/// parent wherever the compositor's animation of the anchor takes it, or what the tree holds while the animation shows
/// nothing; none where that cannot be bounded, as for a skew or an easing that overshoots.
pub fn swept_bounds_in_parent(
    tree: &VisualContextTree,
    anchor: SpatialNodeIndex,
    content_rect: FloatRect,
) -> Option<FloatRect> {
    let SpatialData::Transform(transform) = &tree.spatial_nodes[anchor.0 as usize].data else {
        return None;
    };
    let mut animations_of_anchor =
        transform_animations_of(tree).filter(|animation| animation.node_indices.contains(&anchor.0));
    let animation = animations_of_anchor.next()?;
    if animations_of_anchor.next().is_some() {
        return None;
    }
    let origin = transform.origin;
    let mut swept = content_rect.translated(-origin.x, -origin.y);
    for operation in swept_operations_of(animation)?.into_iter().rev() {
        swept = swept_through(operation, swept);
    }
    let swept = swept.translated(origin.x, origin.y);
    let where_tree_holds_it = transform
        .matrix_including_origin()
        .extract_2d_affine()
        .map_rect(content_rect);
    let bounds = swept.united(where_tree_holds_it);
    crate::display_list::placement::is_finite_rect(bounds).then_some(bounds)
}
