 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

//! The tape of a 2D canvas: the records that a recorder writes for the commands of the canvas, and how the compositor
//! reads a tape that it received.

use super::builder::{append_record, for_each_command};
use super::commands::*;
use super::ffi_bytes::FfiBytes;
use libgfx_rust::{
    AffineTransform, CapStyle, Color, CompositingAndBlendingOperator, FloatPoint, FloatRect, IntPoint, JoinStyle,
    ScalingMode, WindingRule,
};

/// The stops of a gradient, as parallel arrays of colors and positions.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct ColorStops<'a> {
    pub colors: &'a [Color],
    pub positions: &'a [f32],
}

/// The fill or stroke style of a draw. A pattern names its image by the id it travels with beside the tape.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub enum Paint<'a> {
    Color(Color),
    LinearGradient {
        start_point: FloatPoint,
        end_point: FloatPoint,
        color_stops: ColorStops<'a>,
    },
    RadialGradient {
        start_center: FloatPoint,
        start_radius: f32,
        end_center: FloatPoint,
        end_radius: f32,
        color_stops: ColorStops<'a>,
    },
    ConicGradient {
        center: FloatPoint,
        start_angle: f32,
        color_stops: ColorStops<'a>,
    },
    Pattern {
        image: Option<ImageFrameResourceId>,
        repetition: Canvas2DPatternRepetition,
        transform: Option<AffineTransform>,
    },
}

/// How a draw composites: the serialized filter graph of the context if it has one, the global alpha, the
/// compositing and blending operator, and the shadow that the draw casts if it casts one.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Compositing<'a> {
    pub filter: Option<&'a [u8]>,
    pub global_alpha: f32,
    pub compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator,
    pub shadow: Option<Canvas2DShadow>,
}

impl Default for Compositing<'_> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: None,
            global_alpha: 1.0,
            compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::SourceOver,
            shadow: None,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Stroke<'a> {
    pub thickness: f32,
    pub cap_style: CapStyle,
    pub join_style: JoinStyle,
    pub miter_limit: f32,
    pub dash_array: &'a [f32],
    pub dash_offset: f32,
}

// The data a record carries after its command struct. Its spans are offsets into the payload, which starts with the
// struct, at a multiple of the command alignment.
struct InlineData {
    struct_size: usize,
    bytes: Vec<u8>,
}

impl InlineData {
    fn new<C: DisplayListCommand>() -> Self {
        Self {
            struct_size: std::mem::size_of::<C>(),
            bytes: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    fn append(&mut self, data: &[u8], alignment: usize) -> DisplayListDataSpan {
        if data.is_empty() {
            return DisplayListDataSpan::default();
        }
        let offset = (self.struct_size + self.bytes.len()).next_multiple_of(alignment);
        self.bytes.resize(offset - self.struct_size, 0);
        self.bytes.extend_from_slice(data);
        DisplayListDataSpan {
            offset: u32::try_from(offset).expect("canvas 2D record exceeds u32"),
            size: u32::try_from(data.len()).expect("canvas 2D record exceeds u32"),
        }
    }

    fn append_objects<T: FfiBytes>(&mut self, objects: &[T]) -> DisplayListDataSpan {
        let size = std::mem::size_of::<T>();
        let mut bytes = vec![0u8; std::mem::size_of_val(objects)];
        for (object, out) in objects.iter().zip(bytes.chunks_exact_mut(size)) {
            object.write_ffi_bytes(out);
        }
        self.append(&bytes, std::mem::align_of::<T>())
    }

    fn append_paint(&mut self, paint: &Paint) -> Canvas2DPaint {
        let mut record = Canvas2DPaint::default();
        let append_color_stops = |inline_data: &mut Self, color_stops: &ColorStops| {
            debug_assert_eq!(color_stops.colors.len(), color_stops.positions.len());
            DisplayListGradientColorStops {
                colors: inline_data.append_objects(color_stops.colors),
                positions: inline_data.append_objects(color_stops.positions),
                repeating: false,
            }
        };
        match *paint {
            Paint::Color(color) => {
                record.kind = Canvas2DPaintKind::Color;
                record.color = color;
            }
            Paint::LinearGradient {
                start_point,
                end_point,
                color_stops,
            } => {
                record.kind = Canvas2DPaintKind::LinearGradient;
                record.start_point = start_point;
                record.end_point = end_point;
                record.color_stops = append_color_stops(self, &color_stops);
            }
            Paint::RadialGradient {
                start_center,
                start_radius,
                end_center,
                end_radius,
                color_stops,
            } => {
                record.kind = Canvas2DPaintKind::RadialGradient;
                record.start_point = start_center;
                record.start_radius = start_radius;
                record.end_point = end_center;
                record.end_radius = end_radius;
                record.color_stops = append_color_stops(self, &color_stops);
            }
            Paint::ConicGradient {
                center,
                start_angle,
                color_stops,
            } => {
                record.kind = Canvas2DPaintKind::ConicGradient;
                record.start_point = center;
                record.start_angle = start_angle;
                record.color_stops = append_color_stops(self, &color_stops);
            }
            Paint::Pattern {
                image,
                repetition,
                transform,
            } => {
                record.kind = Canvas2DPaintKind::Pattern;
                record.pattern_has_image = image.is_some();
                record.pattern_image_id = image.unwrap_or_default();
                record.pattern_repetition = repetition;
                record.pattern_transform = transform.into();
            }
        }
        record
    }

    fn append_compositing(&mut self, compositing: &Compositing) -> Canvas2DCompositing {
        Canvas2DCompositing {
            filter: compositing
                .filter
                .map_or_else(DisplayListDataSpan::default, |filter| self.append(filter, 1)),
            has_filter: compositing.filter.is_some(),
            global_alpha: compositing.global_alpha,
            compositing_and_blending_operator: compositing.compositing_and_blending_operator,
            has_shadow: compositing.shadow.is_some(),
            shadow: compositing.shadow.unwrap_or_default(),
        }
    }

    fn append_path(&mut self, path: &[u8]) -> DisplayListDataSpan {
        self.append(path, std::mem::align_of::<u32>())
    }
}

/// Writes the records of the commands of a 2D canvas to a tape, which a recorder hands on and clears.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct TapeWriter {
    bytes: Vec<u8>,
}

impl TapeWriter {
    pub fn bytes(&self) -> &[u8] {
        &self.bytes
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.bytes.clear();
    }

    fn append<C: DisplayListCommand>(&mut self, command: &C, inline_data: &InlineData) {
        append_record(&mut self.bytes, command, &inline_data.bytes);
    }

    fn append_plain<C: DisplayListCommand>(&mut self, command: &C) {
        append_record(&mut self.bytes, command, &[]);
    }

    /// `path` is a serialized `libgfx_rust::path::Path`.
    pub fn fill_path(&mut self, path: &[u8], paint: &Paint, winding_rule: WindingRule, compositing: &Compositing) {
        let mut inline_data = InlineData::new::<Canvas2DFillPath>();
        let command = Canvas2DFillPath {
            path_data: inline_data.append_path(path),
            paint: inline_data.append_paint(paint),
            winding_rule,
            compositing: inline_data.append_compositing(compositing),
        };
        self.append(&command, &inline_data);
    }

    /// `path` is a serialized `libgfx_rust::path::Path`.
    pub fn stroke_path(&mut self, path: &[u8], paint: &Paint, stroke: &Stroke, compositing: &Compositing) {
        let mut inline_data = InlineData::new::<Canvas2DStrokePath>();
        let command = Canvas2DStrokePath {
            path_data: inline_data.append_path(path),
            paint: inline_data.append_paint(paint),
            thickness: stroke.thickness,
            cap_style: stroke.cap_style,
            join_style: stroke.join_style,
            miter_limit: stroke.miter_limit,
            dash_array: inline_data.append_objects(stroke.dash_array),
            dash_offset: stroke.dash_offset,
            compositing: inline_data.append_compositing(compositing),
        };
        self.append(&command, &inline_data);
    }

    pub fn draw_glyph_runs(
        &mut self,
        runs: &[Canvas2DGlyphRun],
        glyphs: &[DisplayListGlyph],
        translation: FloatPoint,
        horizontal_scale: f32,
        paint: &Paint,
        compositing: &Compositing,
    ) {
        let mut inline_data = InlineData::new::<Canvas2DDrawGlyphRuns>();
        let command = Canvas2DDrawGlyphRuns {
            runs: inline_data.append_objects(runs),
            glyphs: inline_data.append_objects(glyphs),
            translation,
            horizontal_scale,
            paint: inline_data.append_paint(paint),
            compositing: inline_data.append_compositing(compositing),
        };
        self.append(&command, &inline_data);
    }

    pub fn clear_rect(&mut self, rect: FloatRect, color: Color) {
        self.append_plain(&Canvas2DClearRect { rect, color });
    }

    pub fn draw_image_frame(
        &mut self,
        frame_id: ImageFrameResourceId,
        dst_rect: FloatRect,
        src_rect: FloatRect,
        scaling_mode: ScalingMode,
        compositing: &Compositing,
    ) {
        let mut inline_data = InlineData::new::<Canvas2DDrawImageFrame>();
        let command = Canvas2DDrawImageFrame {
            frame_id,
            dst_rect,
            src_rect,
            scaling_mode,
            compositing: inline_data.append_compositing(compositing),
        };
        self.append(&command, &inline_data);
    }

    pub fn draw_canvas(
        &mut self,
        source_canvas_id: CanvasId,
        dst_rect: FloatRect,
        src_rect: FloatRect,
        scaling_mode: ScalingMode,
        compositing: &Compositing,
    ) {
        let mut inline_data = InlineData::new::<Canvas2DDrawCanvas>();
        let command = Canvas2DDrawCanvas {
            source_canvas_id,
            dst_rect,
            src_rect,
            scaling_mode,
            compositing: inline_data.append_compositing(compositing),
        };
        self.append(&command, &inline_data);
    }

    pub fn draw_video_frame(
        &mut self,
        video_sink_handle: u64,
        generation: u64,
        dst_rect: FloatRect,
        src_rect: FloatRect,
        scaling_mode: ScalingMode,
        compositing: &Compositing,
    ) {
        let mut inline_data = InlineData::new::<Canvas2DDrawVideoFrame>();
        let command = Canvas2DDrawVideoFrame {
            video_sink_handle,
            generation,
            dst_rect,
            src_rect,
            scaling_mode,
            compositing: inline_data.append_compositing(compositing),
        };
        self.append(&command, &inline_data);
    }

    pub fn set_transform(&mut self, transform: AffineTransform) {
        self.append_plain(&Canvas2DSetTransform { transform });
    }

    pub fn save(&mut self) {
        self.append_plain(&Canvas2DSave::default());
    }

    pub fn restore(&mut self) {
        self.append_plain(&Canvas2DRestore::default());
    }

    /// `path` is a serialized `libgfx_rust::path::Path`.
    pub fn clip_path(&mut self, path: &[u8], winding_rule: WindingRule) {
        let mut inline_data = InlineData::new::<Canvas2DClipPath>();
        let command = Canvas2DClipPath {
            path_data: inline_data.append_path(path),
            winding_rule,
        };
        self.append(&command, &inline_data);
    }

    pub fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.append_plain(&Canvas2DReset::default());
    }

    pub fn clear_canvas(&mut self, color: Color) {
        self.append_plain(&Canvas2DClearCanvas { color });
    }

    pub fn put_image_frame(&mut self, frame_id: ImageFrameResourceId, position: IntPoint) {
        self.append_plain(&Canvas2DPutImageFrame { frame_id, position });
    }
}

/// Calls `play` with the type and the payload of each record of a tape that passed `validate_canvas_2d_tape`, in order.
pub fn for_each_canvas_2d_command<'a>(tape: &'a [u8], mut play: impl FnMut(DisplayListCommandType, &'a [u8])) {
    for_each_command(tape, |header, _, payload| {
        debug_assert!(header.command_type.is_canvas_2d());
        play(header.command_type, payload);
    });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::display_list::builder::{HEADER_SIZE, read_command, read_header};
    use crate::display_list::nested_records::span_bytes;
    use crate::display_list::storage::write_run_with_zeroed_padding;
    use crate::display_list::validate::validate_canvas_2d_tape;
    use crate::display_list::validate::validate_tape;
    use libgfx_rust::IntRect;
    use libgfx_rust::filter::Filter;

    fn records(tape: &[u8]) -> Vec<(DisplayListCommandType, Vec<u8>)> {
        let mut records = Vec::new();
        for_each_command(tape, |header, _, payload| {
            records.push((header.command_type, payload.to_vec()));
        });
        records
    }

    fn linear_gradient<'a>(colors: &'a [Color], positions: &'a [f32]) -> Paint<'a> {
        Paint::LinearGradient {
            start_point: FloatPoint { x: 1.0, y: 2.0 },
            end_point: FloatPoint { x: 3.0, y: 4.0 },
            color_stops: ColorStops { colors, positions },
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_fill_carries_its_path_its_paint_and_its_filter_inline() {
        let colors = [Color(0xff00_00ff), Color(0xffff_0000)];
        let positions = [0.0, 1.0];
        let path = [1u8, 2, 3, 4, 5];
        let filter = Filter::hue_rotate(90.0, None).serialize();
        let mut writer = TapeWriter::default();
        writer.fill_path(
            &path,
            &linear_gradient(&colors, &positions),
            WindingRule::EvenOdd,
            &Compositing {
                filter: Some(&filter),
                global_alpha: 0.5,
                compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Multiply,
                shadow: None,
            },
        );
        assert_eq!(validate_canvas_2d_tape(writer.bytes()), Ok(()));
        let header = read_header(writer.bytes());
        assert_eq!(header.inline_clip_count, 0);
        let records = records(writer.bytes());
        assert_eq!(records.len(), 1);
        let (command_type, payload) = &records[0];
        assert_eq!(*command_type, DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DFillPath);
        let command = read_command::<Canvas2DFillPath>(payload);
        assert_eq!(span_bytes(payload, command.path_data), path);
        assert_eq!(command.paint.kind, Canvas2DPaintKind::LinearGradient);
        assert_eq!(command.paint.end_point, FloatPoint { x: 3.0, y: 4.0 });
        let stop_colors: Vec<u32> = span_bytes(payload, command.paint.color_stops.colors)
            .as_chunks::<4>()
            .0
            .iter()
            .map(|bytes| u32::from_ne_bytes(*bytes))
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(stop_colors, [0xff00_00ff, 0xffff_0000]);
        assert_eq!(command.paint.color_stops.positions.size, 8);
        assert_eq!(command.paint.color_stops.positions.offset % 4, 0);
        assert_eq!(command.winding_rule, WindingRule::EvenOdd);
        assert!(command.compositing.has_filter);
        assert_eq!(span_bytes(payload, command.compositing.filter), filter);
        assert_eq!(command.compositing.global_alpha, 0.5);
        assert_eq!(
            command.compositing.compositing_and_blending_operator,
            CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Multiply
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn records_follow_each_other_in_recording_order() {
        let mut writer = TapeWriter::default();
        writer.save();
        writer.set_transform(AffineTransform {
            values: [2.0, 0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 5.0, 6.0],
        });
        writer.clear_rect(FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0), Color(0));
        writer.clip_path(&[4, 4, 4, 4], WindingRule::Nonzero);
        writer.draw_glyph_runs(
            &[Canvas2DGlyphRun {
                font_id: FontResourceId(7),
                glyph_count: 1,
            }],
            &[DisplayListGlyph {
                position: FloatPoint { x: 1.0, y: 0.0 },
                glyph_id: 42,
            }],
            FloatPoint { x: 10.0, y: 20.0 },
            1.0,
            &Paint::Color(Color(0xff00_ff00)),
            &Compositing::default(),
        );
        writer.restore();
        writer.reset();
        writer.clear_canvas(Color(0xff00_0000));
        assert_eq!(validate_canvas_2d_tape(writer.bytes()), Ok(()));
        let types: Vec<_> = records(writer.bytes())
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(command_type, _)| command_type)
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(
            types,
            [
                DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DSave,
                DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DSetTransform,
                DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DClearRect,
                DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DClipPath,
                DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DDrawGlyphRuns,
                DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DRestore,
                DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DReset,
                DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DClearCanvas,
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(writer.bytes().len() % 8, 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_filter_that_the_player_cannot_build_is_rejected() {
        let validate = |filter: &[u8]| {
            let mut writer = TapeWriter::default();
            writer.fill_path(
                &[1],
                &Paint::Color(Color(0xff00_0000)),
                WindingRule::Nonzero,
                &Compositing {
                    filter: Some(filter),
                    ..Compositing::default()
                },
            );
            validate_canvas_2d_tape(writer.bytes())
        };
        let blur = Filter::blur(2.0, 2.0, None).serialize();
        assert_eq!(validate(&blur), Ok(()));

        let malformed = Err("Display list command has a malformed filter");
        assert_eq!(validate(&[]), malformed);
        assert_eq!(validate(&blur[..blur.len() - 1]), malformed);
        assert_eq!(validate(&[blur.as_slice(), &[0]].concat()), malformed);
        assert_eq!(validate(&[0xff]), malformed);

        let image = Filter::Image {
            frame_id: 1,
            src_rect: IntRect::new(0, 0, 1, 1),
            dest_rect: IntRect::new(0, 0, 1, 1).to_float(),
            scaling_mode: libgfx_rust::ScalingMode::NearestNeighbor,
        };
        assert_eq!(
            validate(&Filter::compose(Filter::blur(2.0, 2.0, None), image).serialize()),
            Err("Canvas 2D stream command has a filter that draws an image")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_draw_without_a_filter_carries_no_filter_bytes() {
        let mut writer = TapeWriter::default();
        writer.draw_image_frame(
            ImageFrameResourceId(3),
            FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, 4.0, 4.0),
            FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 2.0),
            ScalingMode::NearestNeighbor,
            &Compositing::default(),
        );
        let records = records(writer.bytes());
        let command = read_command::<Canvas2DDrawImageFrame>(&records[0].1);
        assert!(!command.compositing.has_filter);
        assert!(command.compositing.filter.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(command.frame_id, ImageFrameResourceId(3));
        assert_eq!(
            records[0].1.len(),
            size_of::<Canvas2DDrawImageFrame>().next_multiple_of(8)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_pattern_without_an_image_says_so() {
        let mut writer = TapeWriter::default();
        writer.stroke_path(
            &[1],
            &Paint::Pattern {
                image: None,
                repetition: Canvas2DPatternRepetition::RepeatY,
                transform: Some(AffineTransform {
                    values: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 3.0, 4.0],
                }),
            },
            &Stroke {
                thickness: 2.0,
                cap_style: CapStyle::Round,
                join_style: JoinStyle::Bevel,
                miter_limit: 10.0,
                dash_array: &[1.0, 2.0],
                dash_offset: 0.5,
            },
            &Compositing::default(),
        );
        assert_eq!(validate_canvas_2d_tape(writer.bytes()), Ok(()));
        let records = records(writer.bytes());
        let command = read_command::<Canvas2DStrokePath>(&records[0].1);
        assert!(!command.paint.pattern_has_image);
        assert_eq!(command.paint.pattern_repetition, Canvas2DPatternRepetition::RepeatY);
        assert_eq!(command.paint.pattern_transform.get().unwrap().values[4], 3.0);
        assert_eq!(command.dash_array.size, 8);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_tape_holds_only_the_commands_of_its_kind() {
        let mut writer = TapeWriter::default();
        writer.save();
        let mut run_bytes = vec![0u8; size_of::<DisplayListCommandRun>()];
        write_run_with_zeroed_padding(
            &DisplayListCommandRun {
                offset: 0,
                size: u32::try_from(writer.bytes().len()).unwrap(),
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &mut run_bytes,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            validate_tape(writer.bytes(), &run_bytes),
            Err("Display list holds a command of the canvas 2D stream")
        );
        let mut page_records = Vec::new();
        append_record(
            &mut page_records,
            &FillRect {
                rect: IntRect::new(0, 0, 1, 1),
                color: Color(0),
                compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
                background_color_animation_effect: EffectNodeIndex::NONE,
            },
            &[],
        );
        assert_eq!(
            validate_canvas_2d_tape(&page_records),
            Err("Canvas 2D stream holds a command of a display list")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_global_alpha_outside_0_to_1_is_rejected() {
        for (global_alpha, valid) in [
            (0.0, true),
            (1.0, true),
            (-0.5, false),
            (1.5, false),
            (f32::NAN, false),
            (f32::INFINITY, false),
        ] {
            let mut writer = TapeWriter::default();
            writer.fill_path(
                &[1],
                &Paint::Color(Color(0xff00_0000)),
                WindingRule::Nonzero,
                &Compositing {
                    global_alpha,
                    ..Compositing::default()
                },
            );
            let expected = if valid {
                Ok(())
            } else {
                Err("Canvas 2D stream command has a global alpha outside 0 to 1")
            };
            assert_eq!(validate_canvas_2d_tape(writer.bytes()), expected);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn glyph_runs_that_do_not_split_their_glyphs_exactly_are_rejected() {
        let glyph = DisplayListGlyph {
            position: FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 },
            glyph_id: 1,
        };
        let run = |glyph_count| Canvas2DGlyphRun {
            font_id: FontResourceId(1),
            glyph_count,
        };
        for (runs, scale, expected) in [
            (vec![run(1), run(1)], 1.0, Ok(())),
            (vec![run(2), run(0)], 0.5, Ok(())),
            (vec![run(1)], 1.0, Err("Canvas glyph runs do not cover their glyphs")),
            (
                vec![run(2), run(1)],
                1.0,
                Err("Canvas glyph runs do not cover their glyphs"),
            ),
            (
                vec![run(u64::MAX), run(3)],
                1.0,
                Err("Canvas glyph runs do not cover their glyphs"),
            ),
            (
                vec![run(2)],
                f32::NAN,
                Err("Canvas glyph runs have a horizontal scale that is not finite"),
            ),
        ] {
            let mut writer = TapeWriter::default();
            writer.draw_glyph_runs(
                &runs,
                &[glyph, glyph],
                FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 },
                scale,
                &Paint::Color(Color(0xff00_0000)),
                &Compositing::default(),
            );
            assert_eq!(validate_canvas_2d_tape(writer.bytes()), expected);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_span_outside_its_payload_is_rejected() {
        let mut writer = TapeWriter::default();
        writer.clip_path(&[1, 2, 3, 4], WindingRule::Nonzero);
        let mut tape = writer.bytes().to_vec();
        let size_offset = HEADER_SIZE
            + std::mem::offset_of!(Canvas2DClipPath, path_data)
            + std::mem::offset_of!(DisplayListDataSpan, size);
        tape[size_offset..size_offset + 4].copy_from_slice(&1000u32.to_ne_bytes());
        assert_eq!(
            validate_canvas_2d_tape(&tape),
            Err("Display list span exceeds its command payload")
        );
        let mut tape = writer.bytes().to_vec();
        tape[HEADER_SIZE + std::mem::offset_of!(Canvas2DClipPath, winding_rule)] = 7;
        assert_eq!(
            validate_canvas_2d_tape(&tape),
            Err("Display list command has an invalid enum value")
        );
    }
}

//! The chunks a tape is cut into.
//!
//! A producer of tapes ends a chunk where what it records next can change without what it recorded before. The tape
//! that replaces another is then mostly the same chunks, a recording reuses whole chunks of the one before it, and a
//! chunk is named by what it holds, so two tapes can be told apart chunk by chunk.

use super::builder::{for_each_command, has_inline_clip_in_its_own_space, inline_clips_of, read_command};
use super::commands::{DisplayListCommandRun, DisplayListCommandType, PaintScrollBar, SpatialNodeIndex};
use super::storage::write_run_with_zeroed_padding;
use std::hash::{BuildHasher, Hasher};

/// Names a chunk by what it holds: chunks with one id hold the same records in the same runs.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct ChunkId(pub [u64; 2]);

impl ChunkId {
    /// The id of a chunk whose records can still change.
    pub const UNSET: Self = Self([0, 0]);
}

/// A stretch of whole records with the runs that cover them, which name the records by their offsets from where the
/// chunk starts. A chunk is immutable once named, so that every holder of one name draws the same.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Chunk {
    pub id: ChunkId,
    pub records: Vec<u8>,
    pub runs: Vec<DisplayListCommandRun>,
}

impl Chunk {
    /// The chunk that holds `records` in `runs`, named by them.
    pub fn named(records: Vec<u8>, runs: Vec<DisplayListCommandRun>) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: chunk_id(&records, &runs, 0),
            records,
            runs,
        }
    }
}

/// How many of the latest display lists of a context both ends of a connection keep the chunks of.
pub const DISPLAY_LISTS_WHOSE_CHUNKS_ARE_KEPT: usize = 4;

/// The chunks both ends of a connection keep for one context: those its latest display lists name. A sender sends a
/// display list's chunks that are not kept, and both ends take in each list they send or receive in the same order,
/// so both always keep the same chunks without telling each other.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct KeptChunks {
    distinct_chunk_ids_of_latest_lists: std::collections::VecDeque<Box<[ChunkId]>>,
    count_of_kept_lists_naming_chunk: std::collections::HashMap<ChunkId, u32>,
}

impl KeptChunks {
    pub fn keeps(&self, id: ChunkId) -> bool {
        self.count_of_kept_lists_naming_chunk.contains_key(&id)
    }

    /// Takes in the display list the context presents next, which names `chunks`, and answers the chunks that no list
    /// still kept names.
    pub fn take_in(&mut self, chunks: &[ChunkId]) -> Vec<ChunkId> {
        let mut distinct_chunk_ids: Vec<ChunkId> = chunks.to_vec();
        distinct_chunk_ids.sort_unstable_by_key(|id| id.0);
        distinct_chunk_ids.dedup();
        for id in &distinct_chunk_ids {
            *self.count_of_kept_lists_naming_chunk.entry(*id).or_default() += 1;
        }
        self.distinct_chunk_ids_of_latest_lists
            .push_back(distinct_chunk_ids.into_boxed_slice());
        let mut dropped = Vec::new();
        while self.distinct_chunk_ids_of_latest_lists.len() > DISPLAY_LISTS_WHOSE_CHUNKS_ARE_KEPT {
            let oldest = self
                .distinct_chunk_ids_of_latest_lists
                .pop_front()
                .expect("more lists than are kept");
            for id in oldest {
                let count = self
                    .count_of_kept_lists_naming_chunk
                    .get_mut(&id)
                    .expect("a kept list names a kept chunk");
                *count -= 1;
                if *count == 0 {
                    self.count_of_kept_lists_naming_chunk.remove(&id);
                    dropped.push(id);
                }
            }
        }
        dropped
    }
}

/// Where a chunk of a tape ends. Chunks cover a tape, each starting where the one before it ends, and hold whole
/// runs: a run never continues into the next chunk, even where that one begins in the same visual context.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct DisplayListChunk {
    pub id: ChunkId,
    pub byte_end: u32,
    pub run_end: u32,
}

const RUN_SIZE: usize = std::mem::size_of::<DisplayListCommandRun>();

/// The id of the chunk that holds `bytes` in `runs`, which name the bytes by their offsets in the tape the chunk
/// starts at `chunk_start` of.
pub fn chunk_id(bytes: &[u8], runs: &[DisplayListCommandRun], chunk_start: u32) -> ChunkId {
    let write_runs = |hasher: &mut crate::fast_hash::FastHasher| {
        let mut run_bytes = [0; RUN_SIZE];
        for run in runs {
            write_run_with_zeroed_padding(
                &DisplayListCommandRun {
                    offset: run.offset - chunk_start,
                    ..*run
                },
                &mut run_bytes,
            );
            hasher.write(&run_bytes);
        }
    };
    let mut records_then_runs_hasher = foldhash::fast::FixedState::with_seed(0x6368_756e_6b5f_6964).build_hasher();
    records_then_runs_hasher.write(bytes);
    write_runs(&mut records_then_runs_hasher);
    let mut runs_then_records_hasher = foldhash::fast::FixedState::with_seed(0x7461_7065_5f63_7574).build_hasher();
    write_runs(&mut runs_then_records_hasher);
    runs_then_records_hasher.write(bytes);
    ChunkId([records_then_runs_hasher.finish(), runs_then_records_hasher.finish()])
}

/// The bytes and runs of each chunk of a tape, in tape order.
pub fn chunks_of<'a>(
    bytes: &'a [u8],
    runs: &'a [DisplayListCommandRun],
    chunks: &'a [DisplayListChunk],
) -> impl Iterator<Item = (&'a DisplayListChunk, &'a [u8], &'a [DisplayListCommandRun])> {
    let mut byte_start = 0;
    let mut run_start = 0;
    chunks.iter().map(move |chunk| {
        let chunk_bytes = &bytes[byte_start..chunk.byte_end as usize];
        let chunk_runs = &runs[run_start..chunk.run_end as usize];
        byte_start = chunk.byte_end as usize;
        run_start = chunk.run_end as usize;
        (chunk, chunk_bytes, chunk_runs)
    })
}

/// What a record depends on outside the visual context of its run, which a raster space that does not move with it
/// cannot raster it under.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ReachOutsideRunContext {
    ScrollbarThumbFollowsScrollOffsetOf(SpatialNodeIndex),
    InlineClipInSpaceOf(SpatialNodeIndex),
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct TopLevelRecordReachingOutsideRunContext {
    pub record_offset: u32,
    pub run_index: u32,
    pub reach_outside_run_context: ReachOutsideRunContext,
}

pub fn top_level_records_reaching_outside_run_context(
    bytes: &[u8],
    runs: &[DisplayListCommandRun],
) -> Vec<TopLevelRecordReachingOutsideRunContext> {
    let mut records = Vec::new();
    for (run_index, run) in runs.iter().enumerate() {
        let run_start = run.offset as usize;
        for_each_command(
            &bytes[run_start..run_start + run.size as usize],
            |header, offset_in_run, payload| {
                let mut note = |reach_outside_run_context| {
                    records.push(TopLevelRecordReachingOutsideRunContext {
                        record_offset: (run_start + offset_in_run) as u32,
                        run_index: run_index as u32,
                        reach_outside_run_context,
                    });
                };
                if header.command_type == DisplayListCommandType::PaintScrollBar {
                    note(ReachOutsideRunContext::ScrollbarThumbFollowsScrollOffsetOf(
                        read_command::<PaintScrollBar>(payload).scroll_node_index,
                    ));
                }
                if header.inline_clip_count != 0 && has_inline_clip_in_its_own_space(header, payload) {
                    for clip in inline_clips_of(header, payload).filter(|clip| clip.has_own_space) {
                        note(ReachOutsideRunContext::InlineClipInSpaceOf(clip.space));
                    }
                }
            },
        );
    }
    records
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::display_list::builder::{DisplayListBuilder, PendingInlineClip, RecordedDisplayList};
    use crate::display_list::commands::{ClipNodeIndex, ContextRef, EffectNodeIndex, FillRect, SpatialNodeIndex};
    use libgfx_rust::{Color, CompositingAndBlendingOperator, FloatRect, IntRect};

    fn context(spatial: u32) -> ContextRef {
        ContextRef {
            spatial: SpatialNodeIndex(spatial),
            clip: ClipNodeIndex::NONE,
            effect: EffectNodeIndex::NONE,
        }
    }

    fn fill_rect(y: i32) -> FillRect {
        FillRect {
            rect: IntRect::new(0, y, 10, 10),
            color: Color::default(),
            compositing_and_blending_operator: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
            background_color_animation_effect: EffectNodeIndex::NONE,
        }
    }

    // A tape of one chunk for each of `rows`, each a rect at that row in one context and one in another.
    fn tape_of_rows(rows: &[i32]) -> RecordedDisplayList {
        let mut builder = DisplayListBuilder::new();
        for &row in rows {
            builder.append(&fill_rect(row), &[], context(1));
            builder.append(&fill_rect(row + 1), &[], context(2));
            builder.end_chunk();
        }
        builder.finish()
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_chunk_is_kept_while_one_of_the_latest_lists_names_it() {
        let id = |value: u64| ChunkId([value, value]);
        let mut kept = KeptChunks::default();
        assert!(kept.take_in(&[id(1), id(2), id(1)]).is_empty());
        assert!(kept.keeps(id(1)) && kept.keeps(id(2)));
        for _ in 1..DISPLAY_LISTS_WHOSE_CHUNKS_ARE_KEPT {
            assert!(kept.take_in(&[id(2), id(3)]).is_empty());
        }
        // The list that named the first chunk twice leaves, and the one it named alone goes with it.
        assert_eq!(kept.take_in(&[id(3)]), vec![id(1)]);
        assert!(!kept.keeps(id(1)) && kept.keeps(id(2)) && kept.keeps(id(3)));
        for _ in 1..DISPLAY_LISTS_WHOSE_CHUNKS_ARE_KEPT {
            kept.take_in(&[id(3)]);
        }
        assert!(!kept.keeps(id(2)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_chunk_is_named_by_its_records_and_runs_wherever_it_is_in_a_tape() {
        let tape = tape_of_rows(&[10, 20, 10]);
        assert_eq!(tape.chunks.len(), 3);
        assert_eq!(tape.chunks[0].id, tape.chunks[2].id);
        assert_ne!(tape.chunks[0].id, tape.chunks[1].id);
        assert_ne!(tape.chunks[0].id, ChunkId::UNSET);

        // The same records in another visual context are another chunk.
        let mut builder = DisplayListBuilder::new();
        builder.append(&fill_rect(10), &[], context(1));
        builder.append(&fill_rect(11), &[], context(3));
        assert_ne!(builder.finish().chunks[0].id, tape.chunks[0].id);
    }

    #[test]
    fn records_that_reach_outside_their_chunk_are_found_with_what_they_reach() {
        let mut builder = DisplayListBuilder::new();
        builder.append(&fill_rect(0), &[], context(1));
        let paint_scrollbar_offset = builder.byte_size() as u32;
        builder.append(
            &PaintScrollBar {
                scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex(5),
                gutter_rect: IntRect::new(90, 0, 10, 100),
                thumb_rect: IntRect::new(90, 0, 10, 20),
                track_rect: IntRect::new(90, 0, 10, 100),
                expanded_gutter_rect: IntRect::new(86, 0, 14, 100),
                scroll_size: 0.5,
                thumb_color: Color::default(),
                thumb_outline_color: Color::default(),
                track_color: Color::default(),
                vertical: true,
            },
            &[],
            context(1),
        );
        let own_space_clip_offset = builder.byte_size() as u32;
        let clip = PendingInlineClip::intersecting_float_rect(FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, 5.0, 5.0));
        builder.append_with_inline_clips(
            &fill_rect(20),
            &[],
            context(2),
            &[clip.in_space(SpatialNodeIndex(4)), clip.in_space(SpatialNodeIndex(6))],
        );
        builder.append_with_inline_clips(&fill_rect(30), &[], context(2), &[clip]);
        let chunk = builder.take_chunk();

        let record = |record_offset, run_index, reach_outside_run_context| TopLevelRecordReachingOutsideRunContext {
            record_offset,
            run_index,
            reach_outside_run_context,
        };
        assert_eq!(
            top_level_records_reaching_outside_run_context(&chunk.records, &chunk.runs),
            [
                record(
                    paint_scrollbar_offset,
                    1,
                    ReachOutsideRunContext::ScrollbarThumbFollowsScrollOffsetOf(SpatialNodeIndex(5))
                ),
                record(
                    own_space_clip_offset,
                    2,
                    ReachOutsideRunContext::InlineClipInSpaceOf(SpatialNodeIndex(4))
                ),
                record(
                    own_space_clip_offset,
                    2,
                    ReachOutsideRunContext::InlineClipInSpaceOf(SpatialNodeIndex(6))
                ),
            ]
        );
    }
}

pub const DISPLAY_LIST_COMMAND_TYPE_COUNT: usize = DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DPutImageFrame as usize + 1;

impl DisplayListCommandType {
    pub fn from_u8(value: u8) -> Option<Self> {
        if (value as usize) < DISPLAY_LIST_COMMAND_TYPE_COUNT {
            // SAFETY: the enum is a dense u8 range starting at zero.
            Some(unsafe { std::mem::transmute::<u8, Self>(value) })
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    pub const fn is_compositor_metadata(self) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self,
            Self::CompositorWheelHitTestTarget
                | Self::CompositorWheelHitTestTargetWithCornerRadii
                | Self::CompositorMainThreadWheelEventRegion
                | Self::CompositorScrollbar
                | Self::CompositorBlockingWheelEventRegion
                | Self::CompositorNestedContextWheelRegion
        )
    }

    /// A top-level record of this command is the only record of its run: a canvas, video, nested context, caret or
    /// scroll bar, which the compositor can give a layer of its own between the records around it.
    pub const fn is_alone_in_its_run(self) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self,
            Self::DrawCanvas
                | Self::DrawVideoFrame
                | Self::DrawCompositedContext
                | Self::PaintCaret
                | Self::PaintScrollBar
        )
    }

    /// A command of the stream of a 2D canvas, which the canvas replays against its own surface in recording order,
    /// under the state that the commands before it saved, transformed, clipped and restored. Such a command draws no
    /// known rect, and the display list of a page never holds one. Its name starts with "Canvas2D", which is how the
    /// build script tells it apart.
    pub const fn is_canvas_2d(self) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self,
            Self::Canvas2DFillPath
                | Self::Canvas2DStrokePath
                | Self::Canvas2DDrawGlyphRuns
                | Self::Canvas2DClearRect
                | Self::Canvas2DDrawImageFrame
                | Self::Canvas2DDrawCanvas
                | Self::Canvas2DDrawVideoFrame
                | Self::Canvas2DSetTransform
                | Self::Canvas2DSave
                | Self::Canvas2DRestore
                | Self::Canvas2DClipPath
                | Self::Canvas2DReset
                | Self::Canvas2DClearCanvas
                | Self::Canvas2DPutImageFrame
        )
    }

    pub const fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::DrawGlyphRun => "DrawGlyphRun",
            Self::FillRect => "FillRect",
            Self::PaintCaret => "PaintCaret",
            Self::DrawScaledDecodedImageFrame => "DrawScaledDecodedImageFrame",
            Self::DrawRepeatedDecodedImageFrame => "DrawRepeatedDecodedImageFrame",
            Self::DrawRepeatedTile => "DrawRepeatedTile",
            Self::DrawTiledDecodedImageFrame => "DrawTiledDecodedImageFrame",
            Self::DrawCompositedContext => "DrawCompositedContext",
            Self::DrawCanvas => "DrawCanvas",
            Self::DrawVideoFrame => "DrawVideoFrame",
            Self::PaintLinearGradient => "PaintLinearGradient",
            Self::PaintRadialGradient => "PaintRadialGradient",
            Self::PaintConicGradient => "PaintConicGradient",
            Self::PaintOuterBoxShadow => "PaintOuterBoxShadow",
            Self::PaintInnerBoxShadow => "PaintInnerBoxShadow",
            Self::PaintPathBoxShadow => "PaintPathBoxShadow",
            Self::PaintTextShadow => "PaintTextShadow",
            Self::FillRectWithRoundedCorners => "FillRectWithRoundedCorners",
            Self::FillRoundedRectRing => "FillRoundedRectRing",
            Self::FillPath => "FillPath",
            Self::StrokePath => "StrokePath",
            Self::DrawEllipse => "DrawEllipse",
            Self::DrawLine => "DrawLine",
            Self::BackdropFilterRegion => "BackdropFilterRegion",
            Self::DrawRect => "DrawRect",
            Self::PaintVectorImage => "PaintVectorImage",
            Self::DrawIsolatedGroup => "DrawIsolatedGroup",
            Self::DeclareMaskContent => "DeclareMaskContent",
            Self::CompositorWheelHitTestTarget => "CompositorWheelHitTestTarget",
            Self::CompositorWheelHitTestTargetWithCornerRadii => "CompositorWheelHitTestTargetWithCornerRadii",
            Self::CompositorMainThreadWheelEventRegion => "CompositorMainThreadWheelEventRegion",
            Self::CompositorScrollbar => "CompositorScrollbar",
            Self::CompositorBlockingWheelEventRegion => "CompositorBlockingWheelEventRegion",
            Self::PaintScrollBar => "PaintScrollBar",
            Self::CompositorNestedContextWheelRegion => "CompositorNestedContextWheelRegion",
            Self::Canvas2DFillPath => "Canvas2DFillPath",
            Self::Canvas2DStrokePath => "Canvas2DStrokePath",
            Self::Canvas2DDrawGlyphRuns => "Canvas2DDrawGlyphRuns",
            Self::Canvas2DClearRect => "Canvas2DClearRect",
            Self::Canvas2DDrawImageFrame => "Canvas2DDrawImageFrame",
            Self::Canvas2DDrawCanvas => "Canvas2DDrawCanvas",
            Self::Canvas2DDrawVideoFrame => "Canvas2DDrawVideoFrame",

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord, Encode, Decode)]
#[repr(transparent)]
pub struct SpatialNodeIndex(pub u32);

impl FfiBytes for SpatialNodeIndex {
    #[inline]
    fn write_ffi_bytes(&self, out: &mut [u8]) {
        self.0.write_ffi_bytes(out);
    }
}

// Indices into the clip and effect trees. `u32::MAX` is the absent node.
macro_rules! optional_node_index {
    ($name:ident) => {
        #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord, Encode, Decode)]
        #[repr(transparent)]
        pub struct $name(pub u32);

        impl $name {
            pub const NONE: Self = Self(u32::MAX);

            pub const fn is_none(self) -> bool {
                self.0 == u32::MAX
            }
        }

        impl Default for $name {
            fn default() -> Self {
                Self::NONE
            }
        }

        impl FfiBytes for $name {
            #[inline]
            fn write_ffi_bytes(&self, out: &mut [u8]) {
                self.0.write_ffi_bytes(out);
            }
        }
    };
}

optional_node_index!(ClipNodeIndex);
optional_node_index!(EffectNodeIndex);

pub const VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX: SpatialNodeIndex = SpatialNodeIndex(0);

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct OptionalFloatRect {
    pub value: FloatRect,
    pub has_value: bool,
}
ffi_bytes_fields!(OptionalFloatRect { value, has_value });

impl OptionalFloatRect {
    pub const fn none() -> Self {
        Self {
            value: FloatRect {
                x: 0.0,
                y: 0.0,
                width: 0.0,
                height: 0.0,
            },
            has_value: false,
        }
    }
    pub const fn some(value: FloatRect) -> Self {
        Self { value, has_value: true }
    }
    pub fn get(self) -> Option<FloatRect> {
        self.has_value.then_some(self.value)
    }
}

impl From<Option<FloatRect>> for OptionalFloatRect {
    fn from(value: Option<FloatRect>) -> Self {
        match value {
            Some(value) => Self::some(value),
            None => Self::none(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]

pub struct Repeat {
    pub x: bool,
    pub y: bool,
}
display_list_record_fields!(Repeat { x, y });

pub trait DisplayListCommand: Copy + FfiBytes + super::record_fields::RecordFields {
    const COMMAND_TYPE: DisplayListCommandType;
    // Encloses everything the command draws. Only compositor metadata, which draws nothing, and the commands of the
    // canvas 2D stream, which draw under state that only replay knows, have none.
    fn bounding_rect(&self) -> Option<IntRect> {
        const {
            assert!(
                Self::COMMAND_TYPE.is_compositor_metadata() || Self::COMMAND_TYPE.is_canvas_2d(),
                "a draw command must report its bounding rect"
            );
        };
        None
    }
}

pub fn command_bounding_rect_computed_from_payload(
    command_type: DisplayListCommandType,
    payload: &[u8],
) -> Option<IntRect> {
    fn of<C: DisplayListCommand>(payload: &[u8]) -> Option<IntRect> {
        read_command::<C>(payload).bounding_rect()
    }
    use DisplayListCommandType as T;
    match command_type {
        T::DrawGlyphRun => of::<DrawGlyphRun>(payload),
        T::FillRect => of::<FillRect>(payload),
        T::PaintCaret => of::<PaintCaret>(payload),
        T::DrawScaledDecodedImageFrame => of::<DrawScaledDecodedImageFrame>(payload),
        T::DrawRepeatedDecodedImageFrame => of::<DrawRepeatedDecodedImageFrame>(payload),
        T::DrawRepeatedTile => of::<DrawRepeatedTile>(payload),
        T::DrawTiledDecodedImageFrame => of::<DrawTiledDecodedImageFrame>(payload),
        T::DrawCompositedContext => of::<DrawCompositedContext>(payload),
        T::DrawCanvas => of::<DrawCanvas>(payload),
        T::DrawVideoFrame => of::<DrawVideoFrame>(payload),
        T::PaintLinearGradient => of::<PaintLinearGradient>(payload),
        T::PaintRadialGradient => of::<PaintRadialGradient>(payload),
        T::PaintConicGradient => of::<PaintConicGradient>(payload),
        T::PaintOuterBoxShadow => of::<PaintOuterBoxShadow>(payload),
        T::PaintInnerBoxShadow => of::<PaintInnerBoxShadow>(payload),
        T::PaintPathBoxShadow => of::<PaintPathBoxShadow>(payload),
        T::PaintTextShadow => of::<PaintTextShadow>(payload),
        T::FillRectWithRoundedCorners => of::<FillRectWithRoundedCorners>(payload),
        T::FillRoundedRectRing => of::<FillRoundedRectRing>(payload),
        T::FillPath => of::<FillPath>(payload),
        T::StrokePath => of::<StrokePath>(payload),
        T::DrawEllipse => of::<DrawEllipse>(payload),
        T::DrawLine => of::<DrawLine>(payload),
        T::BackdropFilterRegion => of::<BackdropFilterRegion>(payload),
        T::DrawRect => of::<DrawRect>(payload),
        T::PaintVectorImage => of::<PaintVectorImage>(payload),
        T::DrawIsolatedGroup => of::<DrawIsolatedGroup>(payload),
        T::DeclareMaskContent => of::<DeclareMaskContent>(payload),
        T::CompositorWheelHitTestTarget => of::<CompositorWheelHitTestTarget>(payload),
        T::CompositorWheelHitTestTargetWithCornerRadii => of::<CompositorWheelHitTestTargetWithCornerRadii>(payload),
        T::CompositorMainThreadWheelEventRegion => of::<CompositorMainThreadWheelEventRegion>(payload),
        T::CompositorScrollbar => of::<CompositorScrollbar>(payload),
        T::CompositorBlockingWheelEventRegion => of::<CompositorBlockingWheelEventRegion>(payload),
        T::PaintScrollBar => of::<PaintScrollBar>(payload),
        T::CompositorNestedContextWheelRegion => of::<CompositorNestedContextWheelRegion>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DFillPath => of::<Canvas2DFillPath>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DStrokePath => of::<Canvas2DStrokePath>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DDrawGlyphRuns => of::<Canvas2DDrawGlyphRuns>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DClearRect => of::<Canvas2DClearRect>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DDrawImageFrame => of::<Canvas2DDrawImageFrame>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DDrawCanvas => of::<Canvas2DDrawCanvas>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DDrawVideoFrame => of::<Canvas2DDrawVideoFrame>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DSetTransform => of::<Canvas2DSetTransform>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DSave => of::<Canvas2DSave>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DRestore => of::<Canvas2DRestore>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DClipPath => of::<Canvas2DClipPath>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DReset => of::<Canvas2DReset>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DClearCanvas => of::<Canvas2DClearCanvas>(payload),
        T::Canvas2DPutImageFrame => of::<Canvas2DPutImageFrame>(payload),
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct PaintOuterBoxShadow {
    pub color: Color,
    pub blur_radius: i32,
    pub device_content_rect: IntRect,
    pub content_corner_radii: CornerRadii,
    pub shadow_rect: IntRect,
    pub shadow_corner_radii: CornerRadii,
}
display_list_record_fields!(PaintOuterBoxShadow {
    color,
    blur_radius,
    device_content_rect,
    content_corner_radii,
    shadow_rect,
    shadow_corner_radii
});

impl DisplayListCommand for PaintOuterBoxShadow {
    const COMMAND_TYPE: DisplayListCommandType = DisplayListCommandType::PaintOuterBoxShadow;
    fn bounding_rect(&self) -> Option<IntRect> {
        let blur_margin = i64::from(self.blur_radius) * 2;
        let rect = self.shadow_rect;
        Some(int_rect_of_edges_within_record_bounds_limit(
            i64::from(rect.x) - blur_margin,
            i64::from(rect.y) - blur_margin,
            i64::from(rect.x) + i64::from(rect.width) + blur_margin,
            i64::from(rect.y) + i64::from(rect.height) + blur_margin,
        ))
    }
}

/// A box shadow of a box whose shape is a path: an outer shadow drawn outside the shape, or an inner one drawn inside
/// it. The shadow's shape is the box's shape grown by the spread distance for an outer shadow, or what lies outside
/// the box's shape shrunk by it for an inner one, moved by the offset.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct PaintPathBoxShadow {
    pub color: Color,
    pub blur_radius: i32,
    pub spread_distance: f32,
    pub offset: FloatPoint,
    pub shape_path_bounding_rect: FloatRect,
    pub shape_path_data: DisplayListDataSpan,
    pub inner: bool,
}
display_list_record_fields!(PaintPathBoxShadow {
    color,
    blur_radius,
    spread_distance,
    offset,
    shape_path_bounding_rect,
    shape_path_data,
    inner
});

impl DisplayListCommand for PaintPathBoxShadow {
    const COMMAND_TYPE: DisplayListCommandType = DisplayListCommandType::PaintPathBoxShadow;
    fn bounding_rect(&self) -> Option<IntRect> {
        let shape_rect = enclosing_int_rect(self.shape_path_bounding_rect);
        if self.inner {
            return Some(shape_rect);
        }
        // NB: The player grows the shape by the outline of a miter-joined stroke, whose miters reach out to Skia's default
        //     miter limit of 4 times half the stroke width, so up to 4 times the spread at sharp corners.
        const MITER_LIMIT: f32 = 4.0;
        let margin = (self.spread_distance.max(0.0) * MITER_LIMIT).ceil() as i64 + i64::from(self.blur_radius) * 2;
        let left = i64::from(shape_rect.x) - margin + self.offset.x.floor() as i64;
        let top = i64::from(shape_rect.y) - margin + self.offset.y.floor() as i64;
        Some(int_rect_of_edges_within_record_bounds_limit(
            left,
            top,
            left + i64::from(shape_rect.width) + 2 * margin + 1,
            top + i64::from(shape_rect.height) + 2 * margin + 1,
        ))
    }
}

/// The band between a rounded rect and the same rect shrunk by an edge width on each side, with each corner
/// of the inner outline keeping the outer radius minus the widths of its two adjacent edges (square once
/// either reaches zero). This is the shape of a uniformly colored CSS border, painted in one draw.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct FillRoundedRectRing {
    pub rect: IntRect,
    pub corner_radii: CornerRadii,
    pub top_width: i32,
    pub right_width: i32,
    pub bottom_width: i32,
    pub left_width: i32,
    pub color: Color,
}
display_list_record_fields!(FillRoundedRectRing {
    rect,
    corner_radii,
    top_width,
    right_width,
    bottom_width,
    left_width,
    color
});

impl FillRoundedRectRing {
    /// The widths of the top, right, bottom and left edges, each cut to what the rect holds besides the edge across from
    /// it.
    pub fn widths_within_rect(&self) -> [i32; 4] {
        let top = self.top_width.clamp(0, self.rect.height.max(0));
        let bottom = self.bottom_width.clamp(0, (self.rect.height - top).max(0));
        let left = self.left_width.clamp(0, self.rect.width.max(0));
        let right = self.right_width.clamp(0, (self.rect.width - left).max(0));
        [top, right, bottom, left]
    }

    /// The rect inside the inner edge of the ring as if its corners were square, which the ring leaves unfilled. None
    /// where it lies past the coordinates a rect holds.
    pub fn unfilled_inner_rect(&self) -> Option<IntRect> {
        let [top, right, bottom, left] = self.widths_within_rect();
        Some(IntRect::new(
            self.rect.x.checked_add(left)?,
            self.rect.y.checked_add(top)?,
            self.rect.width - left - right,
            self.rect.height - top - bottom,
        ))
    }
}

impl DisplayListCommand for FillRoundedRectRing {
    const COMMAND_TYPE: DisplayListCommandType = DisplayListCommandType::FillRoundedRectRing;
    fn bounding_rect(&self) -> Option<IntRect> {
        Some(self.rect)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct StrokePath {
    pub cap_style: CapStyle,
    pub join_style: JoinStyle,
    pub miter_limit: f32,
    pub dash_array: DisplayListDataSpan,
    pub dash_offset: f32,
    pub path_bounding_rect: FloatRect,
    pub path_data: DisplayListDataSpan,
    pub opacity: f32,
    pub paint_kind: PathPaintKind,
    pub color: Color,
    pub paint_style: DisplayListPaintStyle,
    pub thickness: f32,
    pub should_anti_alias: ShouldAntiAlias,
}
display_list_record_fields!(StrokePath {
    cap_style,
    join_style,
    miter_limit = 4.0,
    dash_array,
    dash_offset,
    path_bounding_rect,
    path_data,
    opacity = 1.0,
    paint_kind,
    color,
    paint_style,
    thickness,
    should_anti_alias
});

impl DisplayListCommand for StrokePath {
    const COMMAND_TYPE: DisplayListCommandType = DisplayListCommandType::StrokePath;
    // The path bounding rect reaches half the thickness past the path, as far as round and bevel
    // joins and butt and round caps paint. Miter joins reach out to the miter limit times that, and
    // the corners of square caps reach out diagonally.
    fn bounding_rect(&self) -> Option<IntRect> {
        let mut reach_multiplier: f32 = 1.0;
        if self.join_style == JoinStyle::Miter {
            reach_multiplier = reach_multiplier.max(self.miter_limit);
        }
        if self.cap_style == CapStyle::Square {
            reach_multiplier = reach_multiplier.max(std::f32::consts::SQRT_2);
        }
        let reach_past_path_bounding_rect = self.thickness / 2.0 * (reach_multiplier - 1.0);
        Some(enclosing_int_rect(self.path_bounding_rect.inflated(
            2.0 * reach_past_path_bounding_rect,
            2.0 * reach_past_path_bounding_rect,
        )))
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
#[repr(C)]
pub struct DrawLine {
    pub color: Color,
    pub from: IntPoint,
    pub to: IntPoint,
    pub thickness: i32,
    pub style: LineStyle,
    pub alternate_color: Color,
}
display_list_record_fields!(DrawLine {
    color,
    from,
    to,
    thickness,
    style,
    alternate_color = Color::TRANSPARENT
});

impl DisplayListCommand for DrawLine {
    const COMMAND_TYPE: DisplayListCommandType = DisplayListCommandType::DrawLine;
    fn bounding_rect(&self) -> Option<IntRect> {
        let thickness = i64::from(self.thickness);
        let left = i64::from(self.from.x.min(self.to.x)) - thickness / 2;
        let top = i64::from(self.from.y.min(self.to.y)) - thickness / 2;
        Some(int_rect_of_edges_within_record_bounds_limit(
            left,
            top,
            left + (i64::from(self.from.x) - i64::from(self.to.x)).abs() + thickness,
            top + (i64::from(self.from.y) - i64::from(self.to.y)).abs() + thickness,
        ))
    }
}

// Paints the records an SVG image's document was recorded as, scaled from the size they were recorded at into `rect`.
// The records name no visual context of their own and sit in this command's payload. The process that records a tape

// copy of the image for each place that draws it.

    // or draw content that changes under them.
    pub requires_direct_replay: bool,
}
display_list_record_fields!(PaintVectorImage {
    vector_image_id,
    rect,
    recorded_size,
    records,
    requires_direct_replay
});

    const COMMAND_TYPE: DisplayListCommandType = DisplayListCommandType::PaintVectorImage;

        Some(enclosing_int_rect(self.rect))
    }
}

    const COMMAND_TYPE: DisplayListCommandType = DisplayListCommandType::Canvas2DReset;
}

/// How far from the origin the bounds of a record reach at most, so that the bounds of any two records unite into a rect
/// whose edges fit.
pub const RECORD_BOUNDS_LIMIT_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS: i64 = (1 << 30) - 1;

/// The rect between the edges, cut to `RECORD_BOUNDS_LIMIT_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS` from the origin.
pub fn int_rect_of_edges_within_record_bounds_limit(left: i64, top: i64, right: i64, bottom: i64) -> IntRect {
    let limit = RECORD_BOUNDS_LIMIT_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS;
    let [left, top, right, bottom] = [left, top, right, bottom].map(|edge| edge.clamp(-limit, limit) as i32);
    IntRect::new(left, top, right - left, bottom - top)
}

/// `rect` cut to `RECORD_BOUNDS_LIMIT_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS` from the origin, whatever its edges.
pub fn int_rect_within_record_bounds_limit(rect: IntRect) -> IntRect {
    int_rect_of_edges_within_record_bounds_limit(
        i64::from(rect.x),
        i64::from(rect.y),
        i64::from(rect.x) + i64::from(rect.width),
        i64::from(rect.y) + i64::from(rect.height),
    )
}

/// The smallest rect of whole pixels that holds `rect`, cut to `RECORD_BOUNDS_LIMIT_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS` from the origin.
pub fn enclosing_int_rect_within_record_bounds_limit(rect: FloatRect) -> IntRect {
    int_rect_of_edges_within_record_bounds_limit(
        rect.x.floor() as i64,
        rect.y.floor() as i64,
        rect.right().ceil() as i64,
        rect.bottom().ceil() as i64,
    )
}
