//! The lines the dump and the overlay of layers tell of a plan, and the layers the dump names for each record.

use super::{AnimatedNode, PlacedEffect, PlannedLayers, WhyEffectIsComposited, for_each_layer_records_go_into};
use crate::display_list::commands::EffectNodeIndex;
use crate::display_list::layers::{
    CompositedEffect, LayerContent, LayerIndex, NodeNamesFromIndices, VisualContextNodeNamer,
    WindowServerPlacementsOfEffects, WindowServerPresentationOfMedia, media_name, wire,
};
use crate::display_list::reach::Reach;
use crate::display_list::storage::ListPosition;
use libgfx_rust::{CornerRadii, IntRect};
use std::collections::HashMap;

impl PlannedLayers {
    // Each effect the stack composites, with why it is composited and what it reads of what is composited below it, as
    // where it is placed tells.
    pub(super) fn composited_effects_with_why_and_backdrop_read_reach(
        &self,
    ) -> impl Iterator<Item = (&CompositedEffect, WhyEffectIsComposited, Reach<IntRect>)> + '_ {
        let placed_effect_by_effect: HashMap<EffectNodeIndex, &PlacedEffect> = self
            .placement
            .placed_effects
            .iter()
            .map(|placed_effect| (placed_effect.effect, placed_effect))
            .collect();
        self.stack.composited_effects.iter().filter_map(move |composited| {
            let placed_effect = placed_effect_by_effect.get(&composited.effect)?;
            // A placed effect whose layer content decides whether it is composited is composited only for this.
            let why = placed_effect
                .why_composited_regardless_of_layer_content
                .unwrap_or(WhyEffectIsComposited::ItReadsWhatItsOwnLayerDoesNotHold);
            Some((composited, why, placed_effect.backdrop_read_reach))
        })
    }

    /// What the dump says of each effect the compositor composites: the space of its node, what it reads of what is
    /// composited below it, and why it is composited.
    pub fn lines_of_composited_effects<'a>(
        &'a self,
        node_namer: &'a dyn VisualContextNodeNamer,
        placements_of_effects: &'a WindowServerPlacementsOfEffects,
    ) -> impl Iterator<Item = String> + 'a {
        let stack = &self.stack;
        self.composited_effects_with_why_and_backdrop_read_reach()
            .map(move |(composited, why, backdrop_read_reach)| {
                let who_composites_it = match placements_of_effects.of_node(composited.placement_node_index) {
                    Some(Ok(_)) => String::from(", can be composited by the window server"),
                    Some(Err(why_window_server_cannot_composite)) => {
                        format!(", composited by the compositor: {why_window_server_cannot_composite}")
                    }
                    None => String::new(),
                };
                let parent_node_index = stack.nodes[composited.placement_node_index.0]
                    .parent_index
                    .expect("a composited node is inside another");
                let backdrop_read_text = match backdrop_read_reach {
                    Reach::Nothing => String::new(),
                    Reach::Within(rect) => format!(" reads=[{},{} {}x{}]", rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height),
                    Reach::Anywhere => " reads=anywhere".into(),
                };
                format!(
                    "composited {} space={}{backdrop_read_text}: {}{who_composites_it}",
                    node_namer.name_of_effect_node(composited.effect),
                    stack.name_of_node(parent_node_index, node_namer),
                    why
                )
            })
    }

    /// What the dump says of each backdrop filter or blend mode that finds all it reads in the layer it goes into, and
    /// reads it there rather than the compositor compositing it, in paint order.
    pub fn lines_of_effects_reading_only_own_layer<'a>(
        &'a self,
        node_namer: &'a dyn VisualContextNodeNamer,
    ) -> impl Iterator<Item = String> + 'a {
        let composited_effects = &self.stack.composited_effects;
        self.placement
            .backdrop_readers_in_paint_order
            .iter()
            .filter(|reader| {
                composited_effects
                    .iter()
                    .all(|composited| composited.effect != **reader)
            })
            .map(|effect| {
                format!(
                    "{} is not composited: it reads only its own layer",
                    node_namer.name_of_effect_node(*effect)
                )
            })
    }

    /// What the dump says of each drawing of live content that was not given a layer, and why.
    pub fn lines_of_media_without_layers(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = String> + '_ {
        self.placement
            .media_without_layers
            .iter()
            .map(|(content, why_no_layer)| format!("no layer for {}: {why_no_layer}", media_name(*content)))
    }

    /// The lines the overlay of layers shows of the stack past its layers, which WebContent sends with the plan: those
    /// of the effects the compositor composites, of the live content without layers, and of the effects that read only
    /// their own layer, with nodes named by their indices, as many and as long as a plan holds.
    /// A stack of one layer that replays the whole list has none.
    pub fn note_lines_for_layers_overlay(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        if self.stack.replays_whole_list() {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let placements_of_no_frame = WindowServerPlacementsOfEffects::default();
        wire::note_lines_a_plan_holds(
            self.lines_of_composited_effects(&NodeNamesFromIndices, &placements_of_no_frame)
                .chain(self.lines_of_media_without_layers())
                .chain(self.lines_of_effects_reading_only_own_layer(&NodeNamesFromIndices)),
        )
    }

    /// What the dump says of each node the compositor animates whose content was not given layers of its own, and why.
    pub fn lines_of_animations_without_layers<'a>(
        &'a self,
        node_namer: &'a dyn VisualContextNodeNamer,
    ) -> impl Iterator<Item = String> + 'a {
        self.placement
            .animations_without_layers
            .iter()
            .map(|(animated_node, why_no_layer)| {
                let node_name = match animated_node {
                    AnimatedNode::Transform(spatial) => node_namer.name_of_spatial_node(*spatial),
                    AnimatedNode::Effect(effect) => node_namer.name_of_effect_node(*effect),
                };
                format!("no layer for animated {node_name}: {why_no_layer}")
            })
    }

    /// The lines of the Layers section of the dump, each with the layer it is about, if it is about one. There is one
    /// line per layer, bottom to top: its index, what it holds, the space it is rastered in, what it sits above, the
    /// records `describe_records` names for it, what it is clipped to as it is composited, and whether the window
    /// server that `presentation` is of can show it. A layer below the base layer, or one that can hold nothing, is
    /// left out. Then a line for each effect the compositor composites, each drawing of live content without a layer,
    /// each animation without a layer, and each effect that reads only its own layer.
    pub fn layer_lines(
        &self,
        presentation: &WindowServerPresentationOfMedia,
        node_namer: &dyn VisualContextNodeNamer,
        describe_records: impl Fn(LayerIndex) -> Option<String>,
    ) -> Vec<(Option<LayerIndex>, String)> {
        let stack = &self.stack;
        let records_suffix_of = |layer_index: LayerIndex| {
            describe_records(layer_index).map_or_else(String::new, |records| format!(" records={records}"))
        };
        if let Some(why_list_is_one_layer) = stack.why_list_is_one_layer {
            let only_layer = LayerIndex(0);
            return vec![(
                Some(only_layer),
                format!(
                    "{}{}: {why_list_is_one_layer}",
                    stack.name_of_layer(only_layer, node_namer),
                    records_suffix_of(only_layer)
                ),
            )];
        }
        let mut lines = Vec::new();
        for (index, layer) in stack.layers.iter().enumerate() {
            let layer_index = LayerIndex(index);
            if layer_index < stack.base_layer || (layer_index != stack.base_layer && !layer.may_hold_content) {
                continue;
            }
            let node = &stack.nodes[layer.placement_node_index.0];
            let mut line = format!(
                "{}{}",
                stack.name_of_layer(layer_index, node_namer),
                records_suffix_of(layer_index)
            );
            for clip in &node.composite_clips {
                let clip_rect = clip.rect;
                line.push_str(&format!(
                    " composited within [{},{} {}x{}]{} of {}",
                    clip_rect.x,
                    clip_rect.y,
                    clip_rect.width,
                    clip_rect.height,
                    text_of_corner_radii_if_any(clip.corner_radii),
                    stack.name_of_space(clip.raster_space_index, node_namer)
                ));
            }
            if matches!(layer.content, LayerContent::Media { .. }) {
                match presentation.placements.of_layer(layer_index) {
                    Some(Ok(placement)) if presentation.layer_is_shown_by_window_server(layer_index) => {
                        line.push_str(&format!(" can be shown by the window server: {placement}"));
                    }
                    Some(Ok(_)) if stack.layer_is_inside_composited_effects(layer_index) => {
                        line.push_str(" replayed: inside an effect the compositor composites");
                    }
                    Some(Ok(_)) => line.push_str(" replayed: under a layer the frame holds"),
                    Some(Err(why_window_server_cannot_show)) => {
                        line.push_str(&format!(" replayed: {why_window_server_cannot_show}"));
                    }
                    None => {}
                }
            } else if let Some(why_frame_holds_layer) = presentation.why_frame_holds_painted_layer(stack, layer_index) {
                line.push_str(&format!(" held by the frame: {why_frame_holds_layer}"));
            }
            lines.push((Some(layer_index), line));
        }
        lines.extend(
            self.lines_of_composited_effects(node_namer, &presentation.placements_of_effects)
                .chain(self.lines_of_media_without_layers())
                .chain(self.lines_of_animations_without_layers(node_namer))
                .chain(self.lines_of_effects_reading_only_own_layer(node_namer))
                .map(|line| (None, line)),
        );
        lines
    }

    /// The layers that the record at `position` can be drawn into, in the tiles it reaches.
    pub fn layers_of_record(&self, position: ListPosition) -> Vec<LayerIndex> {
        let stack = &self.stack;
        if stack.replays_whole_list() {
            return vec![LayerIndex(0)];
        }
        for (index, layer) in stack.layers.iter().enumerate() {
            let (LayerContent::Media { record_span } | LayerContent::OwnSurface { record_span }) = &layer.content
            else {
                continue;
            };
            if record_span.contains(position) {
                return vec![LayerIndex(index)];
            }
        }
        let Some(stretch) = self
            .placement
            .record_stretches
            .iter()
            .find(|stretch| stretch.record_span.contains(position))
        else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        let Some(band_index) = stack
            .bands
            .iter()
            .position(|band| band.record_spans.iter().any(|span| span.contains(position)))
        else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        let band = &stack.bands[band_index];
        let mut layers = Vec::new();
        for_each_layer_records_go_into(
            &band.cuts,
            band.layer_below_all_cuts,
            stretch.record_span.begin,
            stretch.reach,
            |layer, _| layers.push(layer),
        );
        layers.sort_unstable();
        layers.dedup();
        layers
    }
}

fn text_of_corner_radii_if_any(radii: CornerRadii) -> String {
    if !radii.has_any_radius() {
        return String::new();
    }
    let corners = [radii.top_left, radii.top_right, radii.bottom_right, radii.bottom_left];
    let every_corner_is_circular = corners
        .iter()
        .all(|corner| corner.horizontal_radius == corner.vertical_radius);
    let corner_texts: Vec<String> = corners
        .iter()
        .map(|corner| {
            if every_corner_is_circular {
                corner.horizontal_radius.to_string()
            } else {
                format!("{}x{}", corner.horizontal_radius, corner.vertical_radius)
            }
        })
        .collect();
    format!(" radii=({})", corner_texts.join(","))
}

//! What placing a list reads of the raster spaces at a set of anchors: the clips that rasters of each visual context
//! leave to apply when they are composited, the effects that keep content out of a space, and the runs whose records
//! reach outside their visual context.

use super::raster_spaces_for_placing::{
    RasterSpaceGeometryForPlacing, RasterSpacesForPlacing, rect_swept_over_translations,
};
use crate::display_list::animated_transform_spaces::spatial_nodes_under_transform_animations;
use crate::display_list::chunks::ReachOutsideRunContext;
use crate::display_list::commands::{ClipMode, ContextRef, DisplayListCommandRun, EffectNodeIndex, SpatialNodeIndex};
use crate::display_list::effect_geometry::backdrop_filter_read_reach;
use crate::display_list::placement::{
    CompositeClip, EXTENT_LIMIT_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS, RasterSpace, RasterSpaceAnchorKind, RasterSpaceIndex,
    space_and_ancestors_below_viewport, space_is_ancestor_or_self, translation_if_only_translates,
};

use libgfx_rust::IntRect;

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::rc::Rc;

const COMPOSITE_CLIP_EDGE_TOLERANCE_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS: f32 = 1.0 / 64.0;

impl CompositeClip {
    /// Whether the clip leaves all of `rect` unclipped: it lies within the clip's rect and outside its corner boxes.
    fn leaves_all_of(&self, rect: IntRect) -> bool {
        if !self.rect.contains_rect(rect) {
            return false;
        }
        let radii = self.corner_radii;
        let (left, top, right, bottom) = (self.rect.x, self.rect.y, self.rect.right(), self.rect.bottom());
        [
            IntRect::new(
                left,
                top,
                radii.top_left.horizontal_radius,
                radii.top_left.vertical_radius,
            ),
            IntRect::new(
                right - radii.top_right.horizontal_radius,
                top,
                radii.top_right.horizontal_radius,
                radii.top_right.vertical_radius,
            ),
            IntRect::new(
                right - radii.bottom_right.horizontal_radius,
                bottom - radii.bottom_right.vertical_radius,
                radii.bottom_right.horizontal_radius,
                radii.bottom_right.vertical_radius,
            ),
            IntRect::new(
                left,
                bottom - radii.bottom_left.vertical_radius,
                radii.bottom_left.horizontal_radius,
                radii.bottom_left.vertical_radius,
            ),
        ]
        .iter()
        .all(|corner_box| corner_box.is_empty() || corner_box.intersected(rect).is_empty())
    }
}

pub(super) fn lowest_common_ancestor_space(
    spaces: &[RasterSpace],
    first: RasterSpaceIndex,
    second: RasterSpaceIndex,
) -> RasterSpaceIndex {
    let mut candidate = first;
    while !space_is_ancestor_or_self(spaces, candidate, second) {
        candidate = spaces[candidate.0].parent_index;
    }
    candidate
}

type CompositeClipsOfContextInSpace = Option<Rc<[CompositeClip]>>;

/// Where content is placed among the spaces at a set of anchors: the spaces, the clips that can be left to apply when
/// rasters are composited, and the effects whose content reads its backdrop. Where each context is placed is worked out
/// as it is first asked for.
pub(super) struct PlacementTables {
    spaces: RasterSpacesForPlacing,
    /// Per spatial node, whether a sample of the compositor's animations can move it within the deepest space it is
    /// in, as it is under a node whose transform the compositor animates that anchors no space. Empty where the tree
    /// has no transform animations.
    spatial_node_moves_with_animation_samples: Vec<bool>,
    composite_form_of_clips: Vec<Option<CompositeClip>>,
    placement_constraint_of_effects: Vec<EffectPlacementConstraint>,
    deepest_space_and_backdrop_filter_read_rect_by_effect: Vec<Option<(RasterSpaceIndex, IntRect)>>,
    animated_space_holding_every_run_of_effect: Vec<Option<RasterSpaceIndex>>,
    refused_animated_spaces: RefCell<Vec<bool>>,
    /// Per effect node, whether the compositor composites it around content it keeps in several spaces, so that it
    /// neither keeps its content out of spaces deeper than its own nor moves that content within a space. Empty where
    /// no effect is.
    effect_is_composited_around_content_of_several_spaces_by_effect_index: Vec<bool>,
    cached_composite_clips_of_contexts:
        RefCell<HashMap<(ContextRef, RasterSpaceIndex), CompositeClipsOfContextInSpace>>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum EffectPlacementConstraint {
    ConstrainsNothing,
    MustMoveWithSpace,
    MustMoveWithSpaceAndKeepBackdropReadUncut,
}

impl PlacementTables {
    pub fn new(
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        spaces: RasterSpacesForPlacing,
        geometries: &[RasterSpaceGeometryForPlacing],
    ) -> Self {
        let spaces_len = spaces.spaces().len();
        let spatial_node_moves_with_animation_samples = spatial_nodes_under_transform_animations(tree, |node| {
            spaces.spaces().iter().skip(1).all(|space| space.anchor != node)
        });
        let composite_form_of_clips = tree
            .clip_nodes
            .iter()
            .map(|node| {
                let ClipNodeData::Rect(data) = &node.data else {
                    return None;
                };
                if data.mode != ClipMode::Intersect || spaces.spatial_moves_on_its_own(node.spatial) {
                    return None;
                }
                let clip_space = spaces.deepest_space_of(node.spatial);
                let world = &geometries[clip_space.0].raster.world;
                translation_if_only_translates(&world.draw_matrix(node.spatial))?;
                let rect = world.map_rect_to_root(node.spatial, data.rect);
                // A clip of one axis alone clips as much at the extent limit as at its far edges on the other axis.
                let [left, top, right, bottom] = [rect.x, rect.y, rect.right(), rect.bottom()]
                    .map(|edge| edge.clamp(-EXTENT_LIMIT_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS, EXTENT_LIMIT_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS));
                let edges_are_on_whole_device_pixels = [left, top, right, bottom]
                    .iter()
                    .all(|edge| (edge - edge.round()).abs() <= COMPOSITE_CLIP_EDGE_TOLERANCE_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS);
                if !edges_are_on_whole_device_pixels {
                    return None;
                }
                Some(CompositeClip {
                    raster_space_index: clip_space,
                    rect: IntRect::new(
                        left.round() as i32,
                        top.round() as i32,
                        right.round() as i32 - left.round() as i32,
                        bottom.round() as i32 - top.round() as i32,
                    ),
                    corner_radii: data.corner_radii,
                })
            })
            .collect();
        let placement_constraint_of_effects = tree
            .effect_nodes
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(index, node)| {
                if tree.root_isolation_effect == Some(EffectNodeIndex(index as u32))
                    || matches!(node.data, EffectNodeData::BackgroundColorAnimation)
                {
                    return EffectPlacementConstraint::ConstrainsNothing;
                }
                let reads_backdrop = match &node.data {
                    EffectNodeData::Effects(effects) => effects.backdrop_filter.is_some(),
                    EffectNodeData::Mask(mask) => mask.masks_backdrop,
                    _ => false,
                };
                if reads_backdrop {
                    EffectPlacementConstraint::MustMoveWithSpaceAndKeepBackdropReadUncut
                } else {
                    EffectPlacementConstraint::MustMoveWithSpace
                }
            })
            .collect();
        let deepest_space_and_backdrop_filter_read_rect_by_effect = tree
            .effect_nodes
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(index, node)| {
                if spaces.spatial_moves_on_its_own(node.spatial) {
                    return None;
                }
                let space = spaces.deepest_space_of(node.spatial);
                match backdrop_filter_read_reach(tree, &geometries[space.0].raster, EffectNodeIndex(index as u32)) {
                    Reach::Within(read_rect) => Some((space, read_rect)),
                    _ => None,
                }
            })
            .collect();
        Self {
            spaces,
            spatial_node_moves_with_animation_samples,
            composite_form_of_clips,
            placement_constraint_of_effects,
            deepest_space_and_backdrop_filter_read_rect_by_effect,
            animated_space_holding_every_run_of_effect: Vec::new(),
            refused_animated_spaces: RefCell::new(vec![false; spaces_len]),
            effect_is_composited_around_content_of_several_spaces_by_effect_index: Vec::new(),
            cached_composite_clips_of_contexts: RefCell::new(HashMap::new()),
        }
    }

    /// Notes the effects the compositor composites around content it keeps in several spaces. Where content goes then
    /// changes, so this forgets what was worked out of it.
    pub fn note_effects_composited_around_content_of_several_spaces(&mut self, marks_by_effect_index: Vec<bool>) {
        self.effect_is_composited_around_content_of_several_spaces_by_effect_index = marks_by_effect_index;
        self.cached_composite_clips_of_contexts.borrow_mut().clear();
    }

    fn effect_is_composited_around_content_of_several_spaces(&self, effect: EffectNodeIndex) -> bool {
        self.effect_is_composited_around_content_of_several_spaces_by_effect_index
            .get(effect.0 as usize)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(false)
    }

    /// Notes, per effect node, the space whose anchor the compositor animates that holds every run of the list under
    /// the effect, if one does: content of that space can be placed in it under such an effect although the effect
    /// does not move with the space, as the compositor composites the effect around the space's rasters.
    pub fn note_animated_spaces_holding_every_run_of_effects(
        &mut self,
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        list: &DisplayListStorage,
    ) {
        #[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
        enum SpacesOfRuns {
            NoRun,
            All(RasterSpaceIndex),
            Several,
        }
        let mut spaces_of_runs_by_effect = vec![SpacesOfRuns::NoRun; tree.effect_nodes.len()];
        for run_index in 0..list.run_count() {
            let context = list.run(run_index).context;
            let space_of_run = self.deepest_space_of(context.spatial);
            let mut effect = context.effect;
            while !effect.is_none() {
                let spaces_of_runs = &mut spaces_of_runs_by_effect[effect.0 as usize];
                *spaces_of_runs = match *spaces_of_runs {
                    SpacesOfRuns::NoRun => SpacesOfRuns::All(space_of_run),
                    SpacesOfRuns::All(space) if space == space_of_run => SpacesOfRuns::All(space),
                    _ => SpacesOfRuns::Several,
                };
                effect = tree.effect_nodes[effect.0 as usize].parent;
            }
        }
        let spaces = self.spaces.spaces();
        self.animated_space_holding_every_run_of_effect = spaces_of_runs_by_effect
            .into_iter()
            .map(|spaces_of_runs| match spaces_of_runs {
                SpacesOfRuns::All(space)
                    if matches!(
                        spaces[space.0].anchor_kind,
                        RasterSpaceAnchorKind::AnimatedTransform { .. }
                    ) =>
                {
                    Some(space)
                }
                _ => None,
            })
            .collect();
    }

    pub fn animated_space_holding_every_run_of_effect(&self, effect: EffectNodeIndex) -> Option<RasterSpaceIndex> {
        self.animated_space_holding_every_run_of_effect
            .get(effect.0 as usize)
            .copied()
            .flatten()
    }

    /// Keeps content out of a space whose anchor the compositor animates, which then goes into the space around it.
    /// Called before anything is placed in the space.
    pub fn refuse_animated_space(&self, space: RasterSpaceIndex) {
        self.refused_animated_spaces.borrow_mut()[space.0] = true;
    }

    pub fn spaces(&self) -> &[RasterSpace] {
        self.spaces.spaces()
    }

    pub fn deepest_space_of(&self, spatial: SpatialNodeIndex) -> RasterSpaceIndex {
        self.spaces.deepest_space_of(spatial)
    }

    pub fn moves_with(&self, spatial: SpatialNodeIndex, space: RasterSpaceIndex) -> bool {
        self.spaces.moves_with(spatial, space)
    }

    /// The clips that rasters of `context` in `space` leave to be applied as they are composited, in the order its
    /// clip chain names them, or none where the context cannot be rastered in the space: it does not move with the
    /// space, an effect of it does not, or a clip that does not cannot be applied as a rect of whole device pixels.
    pub fn composite_clips_in(
        &self,
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        context: ContextRef,
        space: RasterSpaceIndex,
    ) -> Option<Rc<[CompositeClip]>> {
        if let Some(cached) = self.cached_composite_clips_of_contexts.borrow().get(&(context, space)) {
            return cached.clone();
        }
        let clips = self.compute_composite_clips_in(tree, context, space).map(Rc::from);
        self.cached_composite_clips_of_contexts
            .borrow_mut()
            .insert((context, space), clips.clone());
        clips
    }

    fn compute_composite_clips_in(
        &self,
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        context: ContextRef,
        space: RasterSpaceIndex,
    ) -> Option<Vec<CompositeClip>> {
        if !self.moves_with(context.spatial, space) || self.refused_animated_spaces.borrow()[space.0] {
            return None;
        }
        let mut composite_clips = Vec::new();
        let mut clip = context.clip;
        while !clip.is_none() {
            let node = &tree.clip_nodes[clip.0 as usize];
            let composite_form = self.composite_form_of_clips[clip.0 as usize];
            clip = node.parent;
            if self.moves_with(node.spatial, space) {
                continue;
            }
            let composite_clip = composite_form?;
            if composite_clips.contains(&composite_clip) {
                continue;
            }
            let rounded_clip_shares_space_with_another = composite_clips.iter().any(|other: &CompositeClip| {
                other.raster_space_index == composite_clip.raster_space_index
                    && (other.is_rounded() || composite_clip.is_rounded())
            });
            if rounded_clip_shares_space_with_another {
                return None;
            }
            composite_clips.push(composite_clip);
        }
        let mut effect = context.effect;
        while !effect.is_none() {
            let node = &tree.effect_nodes[effect.0 as usize];
            if self.effect_is_composited_around_content_of_several_spaces(effect) {
                effect = node.parent;
                continue;
            }
            match self.placement_constraint_of_effects[effect.0 as usize] {
                EffectPlacementConstraint::ConstrainsNothing => {}
                constraint => {
                    let composited_around_animated_space = constraint == EffectPlacementConstraint::MustMoveWithSpace
                        && self.animated_space_holding_every_run_of_effect(effect) == Some(space);
                    if !self.moves_with(node.spatial, space) && !composited_around_animated_space {
                        return None;
                    }
                    if constraint == EffectPlacementConstraint::MustMoveWithSpaceAndKeepBackdropReadUncut
                        && !self.composite_clips_cut_nothing_backdrop_filter_reads(effect, space, &composite_clips)
                    {
                        return None;
                    }
                }
            }
            effect = node.parent;
        }
        Some(composite_clips)
    }

    fn composite_clips_cut_nothing_backdrop_filter_reads(
        &self,
        effect: EffectNodeIndex,
        space: RasterSpaceIndex,
        composite_clips: &[CompositeClip],
    ) -> bool {
        if composite_clips.is_empty() {
            return true;
        }
        let Some((space_of_read_rect, read_rect)) =
            self.deepest_space_and_backdrop_filter_read_rect_by_effect[effect.0 as usize]
        else {
            return false;
        };
        if space_of_read_rect != space {
            return false;
        }
        let spaces = self.spaces.spaces();
        composite_clips.iter().all(|clip| {
            let mut read_rect_swept_over_anchor_translations = read_rect;
            let mut space_swept_through = space;
            while space_swept_through != clip.raster_space_index {
                if space_swept_through == RasterSpaceIndex::VIEWPORT {
                    return false;
                }
                read_rect_swept_over_anchor_translations = rect_swept_over_translations(
                    read_rect_swept_over_anchor_translations,
                    spaces[space_swept_through.0].lowest_anchor_translation,
                    spaces[space_swept_through.0].highest_anchor_translation,
                );
                space_swept_through = spaces[space_swept_through.0].parent_index;
            }
            clip.leaves_all_of(read_rect_swept_over_anchor_translations)
        })
    }

    /// Whether a sample of the compositor's animations can change how rasters of `space`, which `spatial` moves with,
    /// draw what is drawn in `spatial`, as a transform the compositor animates is between them.
    pub fn animation_samples_move_spatial_within_space(
        &self,
        spatial: SpatialNodeIndex,
        space: RasterSpaceIndex,
    ) -> bool {
        if self
            .spatial_node_moves_with_animation_samples
            .get(spatial.0 as usize)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(false)
        {
            return true;
        }
        let spaces = self.spaces.spaces();
        let mut space_of_spatial = self.deepest_space_of(spatial);
        while space_of_spatial != space && space_of_spatial != RasterSpaceIndex::VIEWPORT {
            if matches!(
                spaces[space_of_spatial.0].anchor_kind,
                RasterSpaceAnchorKind::AnimatedTransform { .. }
            ) {
                return true;
            }
            space_of_spatial = spaces[space_of_spatial.0].parent_index;
        }
        false
    }

    /// Whether what is drawn in `spatial` moves within rasters of `space`: it is in a space inside it, or moves on its
    /// own.
    pub fn spatial_moves_within_space(&self, spatial: SpatialNodeIndex, space: RasterSpaceIndex) -> bool {
        let deepest = self.deepest_space_of(spatial);
        (deepest != space && space_is_ancestor_or_self(self.spaces.spaces(), space, deepest))
            || self.spaces.spatial_moves_on_its_own(spatial)
    }

    /// Whether content of `context` rastered in `space` moves within it as an anchor of a space inside it scrolls, a
    /// sticky box sticks or the compositor animates a transform or a filter, so that where it lands holds at the
    /// current values only.
    pub fn context_moves_within_space(
        &self,
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        context: ContextRef,
        space: RasterSpaceIndex,
    ) -> bool {
        let moves_within_space = |spatial: SpatialNodeIndex| self.spatial_moves_within_space(spatial, space);
        if self.spaces.effect_spread_moves_on_its_own(context.effect) {
            return true;
        }
        if moves_within_space(context.spatial) {
            return true;
        }
        let mut clip = context.clip;
        while !clip.is_none() {
            let node = &tree.clip_nodes[clip.0 as usize];
            if moves_within_space(node.spatial) {
                return true;
            }
            clip = node.parent;
        }
        let mut effect = context.effect;
        while !effect.is_none() {
            let node = &tree.effect_nodes[effect.0 as usize];
            if tree.root_isolation_effect != Some(effect)
                && !self.effect_is_composited_around_content_of_several_spaces(effect)
                && moves_within_space(node.spatial)
            {
                return true;
            }
            effect = node.parent;
        }
        false
    }
}

/// The records of runs that a space whose anchor what they draw does not move with cannot raster: records with inline
/// clips in spaces of their own, and scroll bars, alone in their runs, whose thumbs follow a scroll offset, as the
/// chunks they are in know.
pub(super) struct RunsReachingOutsideTheirContext {
    inline_clip_spaces_of_runs: HashMap<usize, Vec<SpatialNodeIndex>>,
    scroll_nodes_moving_scroll_bar_thumbs_of_runs: HashMap<usize, Vec<SpatialNodeIndex>>,
}

impl RunsReachingOutsideTheirContext {
    pub fn new(list: &DisplayListStorage) -> Self {
        let mut inline_clip_spaces_of_runs: HashMap<usize, Vec<SpatialNodeIndex>> = HashMap::new();
        let mut scroll_nodes_moving_scroll_bar_thumbs_of_runs: HashMap<usize, Vec<SpatialNodeIndex>> = HashMap::new();
        for (chunk_index, chunk) in list.chunks().iter().enumerate() {
            let first_run_index_of_chunk = list.first_run_of_chunk(ChunkIndexInList(chunk_index as u32));
            for record in chunk.records_reaching_outside_run_context() {
                let run_index = first_run_index_of_chunk + record.run_index as usize;
                match record.reach_outside_run_context {
                    ReachOutsideRunContext::InlineClipInSpaceOf(space) => {
                        inline_clip_spaces_of_runs.entry(run_index).or_default().push(space);
                    }
                    ReachOutsideRunContext::ScrollbarThumbFollowsScrollOffsetOf(scroll_node_index) => {
                        scroll_nodes_moving_scroll_bar_thumbs_of_runs
                            .entry(run_index)
                            .or_default()
                            .push(scroll_node_index);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Self {
            inline_clip_spaces_of_runs,
            scroll_nodes_moving_scroll_bar_thumbs_of_runs,
        }
    }

    /// The spaces of the inline clips of the run's records that apply in spaces of their own, one per clip, which may
    /// name nodes the tree does not hold.
    pub fn inline_clip_spaces_of_run(&self, run_index: usize) -> &[SpatialNodeIndex] {
        self.inline_clip_spaces_of_runs
            .get(&run_index)
            .map_or(&[], |clip_spaces| clip_spaces.as_slice())
    }

    /// The clips rasters of the run in `space` leave to be composited, or none where the run cannot be rastered there.
    pub fn composite_clips_of_run_in(
        &self,
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        tables: &PlacementTables,
        run_index: usize,
        run: &DisplayListCommandRun,
        space: RasterSpaceIndex,
    ) -> Option<Rc<[CompositeClip]>> {
        let composite_clips = tables.composite_clips_in(tree, run.context, space)?;
        let has_inline_clip_not_moving_with_space =
            self.inline_clip_spaces_of_runs
                .get(&run_index)
                .is_some_and(|clip_spaces| {
                    clip_spaces.iter().any(|&clip_space| {
                        (clip_space.0 as usize) < tree.spatial_nodes.len() && !tables.moves_with(clip_space, space)
                    })
                });
        if has_inline_clip_not_moving_with_space {
            return None;
        }
        let has_scroll_bar_thumb_following_anchor_of_space = self
            .scroll_nodes_moving_scroll_bar_thumbs_of_runs
            .get(&run_index)
            .is_some_and(|scroll_nodes| {
                space_and_ancestors_below_viewport(tables.spaces(), space)
                    .any(|space_or_ancestor| scroll_nodes.contains(&tables.spaces()[space_or_ancestor.0].anchor))
            });
        if has_scroll_bar_thumb_following_anchor_of_space {
            return None;
        }
        Some(composite_clips)
    }

    /// Whether an inline clip of the run in a space of its own moves within rasters of `space`, which then read where
    /// the clip is.
    pub fn inline_clips_of_run_move_within_space(
        &self,
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        tables: &PlacementTables,
        run_index: usize,
        space: RasterSpaceIndex,
    ) -> bool {
        self.inline_clip_spaces_of_runs
            .get(&run_index)
            .is_some_and(|clip_spaces| {
                clip_spaces.iter().any(|&clip_space| {
                    (clip_space.0 as usize) < tree.spatial_nodes.len()
                        && tables.spatial_moves_within_space(clip_space, space)
                })
            })
    }

    /// The deepest space the run can be rastered in.
    pub fn deepest_space_of_run(
        &self,
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        tables: &PlacementTables,
        run_index: usize,
        run: &DisplayListCommandRun,
    ) -> RasterSpaceIndex {
        let mut space = tables.deepest_space_of(run.context.spatial);
        while space != RasterSpaceIndex::VIEWPORT
            && self
                .composite_clips_of_run_in(tree, tables, run_index, run, space)
                .is_none()
        {
            space = tables.spaces()[space.0].parent_index;
        }
        space
    }
}

//! The raster spaces that a plan places a list among, and the geometry of each, with what placing reads past what
//! rastering reads: the spatial nodes that move on their own relative to the spaces, the effects whose filters can
//! spread their content farther on their own, the bounds of the clip chains fixed in a space, and the extent of each
//! space.

use crate::display_list::commands::{ContextRef, EffectNodeIndex, SpatialNodeIndex};
use crate::display_list::effect_geometry::filter_may_spread_at_some_sample;
use crate::display_list::layers::anchors_of_layer_plans;
use crate::display_list::placement::{
    FiltersAndClipsOfList, RasterSpace, RasterSpaceAnchorKind, RasterSpaceGeometry, RasterSpaceIndex, RasterSpaces,
    WhatEverySpaceOfTreeShares, antialiased_reach_in_device_pixels, chain_bounds_of_clip, compositor_scroll_record_of,
    enclosing_int_rect_within_extent_limit, extent_limit_rect, intersect_bounds, is_finite_rect, raster_scroll_offsets,
    space_is_ancestor_or_self, spatial_nodes_that_move_on_their_own_relative_to_spaces_at,
    spatial_nodes_whose_scroll_offset_placement_leaves_out_of_nodes_moving, translation_if_only_translates,
};
use crate::display_list::reach::Reach;
use crate::host::FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind;
use crate::visual_context::{VisualContextTree, WorldTransforms};
use libgfx_rust::{FloatMatrix4x4, FloatPoint, FloatRect, IntRect};
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::Arc;

const ANCHOR_TRANSLATION_ROUNDING_OVERSHOOT_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS: i32 = 1;

/// The rect that content within `rect` covers wherever a translation between `lowest` and `highest` takes it, with the
/// rounding of that translation to whole device pixels.
pub(super) fn rect_swept_over_translations(rect: IntRect, lowest: FloatPoint, highest: FloatPoint) -> IntRect {
    if rect.is_empty() {
        return rect;
    }
    let swept = FloatRect::new(
        rect.x as f32 + lowest.x,
        rect.y as f32 + lowest.y,
        rect.width as f32 + highest.x - lowest.x,
        rect.height as f32 + highest.y - lowest.y,
    );
    if !is_finite_rect(swept) {
        return enclosing_int_rect_within_extent_limit(extent_limit_rect());
    }
    let margin = ANCHOR_TRANSLATION_ROUNDING_OVERSHOOT_IN_DEVICE_PIXELS;
    enclosing_int_rect_within_extent_limit(swept).inflated_edges(margin, margin, margin, margin)
}

/// Per effect node, whether how far its filters spread its content can change while the list and the tree's structure
/// stay, as the compositor animates the filter of it or of an effect above it, and the filter spreads at some sample.
fn effects_whose_spread_moves_on_its_own(tree: &VisualContextTree) -> Vec<bool> {
    let mut spread_moves = vec![false; tree.effect_nodes.len()];
    if !tree
        .visual_animations()
        .iter()
        .any(|animation| animation.target_kind == FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Filter)
    {
        return spread_moves;
    }
    tree.visit_effect_nodes_parents_first(|index| {
        let node = &tree.effect_nodes[index];
        let effect = EffectNodeIndex(index as u32);
        let spread_of_parent_moves = !node.parent.is_none() && spread_moves[node.parent.0 as usize];
        spread_moves[index] = spread_of_parent_moves
            || (tree.effect_filter_is_animated(effect) && filter_may_spread_at_some_sample(tree, effect));
    });
    spread_moves
}

fn extent_of_space(
    tree: &VisualContextTree,
    spaces: &[RasterSpace],
    space: RasterSpaceIndex,
    world_with_anchors_of_space_at_origin: &WorldTransforms,
    viewport_rect: IntRect,
) -> IntRect {
    let world = world_with_anchors_of_space_at_origin;
    let unbounded = enclosing_int_rect_within_extent_limit(extent_limit_rect());
    let space = &spaces[space.0];
    if let RasterSpaceAnchorKind::AnimatedTransform { .. } = space.anchor_kind {
        return unbounded;
    }
    if let RasterSpaceAnchorKind::StickyBox { .. } = space.anchor_kind {
        let extent_of_parent = if space.parent_index == RasterSpaceIndex::VIEWPORT {
            viewport_rect
        } else {
            extent_of_space(tree, spaces, space.parent_index, world, viewport_rect)
        };
        let negated = |point: FloatPoint| FloatPoint {
            x: -point.x,
            y: -point.y,
        };
        let extent_of_parent_translated_back_by_every_box_offset = rect_swept_over_translations(
            extent_of_parent,
            negated(space.highest_anchor_translation),
            negated(space.lowest_anchor_translation),
        );
        return extent_of_parent_translated_back_by_every_box_offset;
    }
    let Some(record) = compositor_scroll_record_of(tree, space.anchor) else {
        return unbounded;
    };
    let Some(scrollport_offset) =
        translation_if_only_translates(&world.draw_matrix(tree.spatial_nodes[space.anchor.0 as usize].parent))
    else {
        return unbounded;
    };
    let scrollport = record
        .scrollport_rect
        .to_float()
        .translated(scrollport_offset.x, scrollport_offset.y);
    let (minimum, maximum) = (record.min_scroll_offset, record.max_scroll_offset);
    let extent = FloatRect::new(
        scrollport.x + minimum.x.min(0.0),
        scrollport.y + minimum.y.min(0.0),
        scrollport.width + (maximum.x.max(0.0) - minimum.x.min(0.0)),
        scrollport.height + (maximum.y.max(0.0) - minimum.y.min(0.0)),
    );
    if !is_finite_rect(extent) {
        return unbounded;
    }
    enclosing_int_rect_within_extent_limit(extent)
}

/// What plans of layers work out of a tree alone, once for every plan under the tree: the anchors of the raster spaces
/// it offers, and per spatial node, whether the node moves on its own relative to those spaces, and whether a plan
/// leaves out the scroll offset of the node.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub(super) struct RasterSpaceAnchorsOfTree {
    pub(super) anchors: Vec<SpatialNodeIndex>,
    spatial_node_moves_on_its_own: Arc<[bool]>,
    pub(super) leaves_out_scroll_offset_of_node: Vec<bool>,
}

impl RasterSpaceAnchorsOfTree {
    pub(super) fn of(tree: &VisualContextTree) -> Self {
        let anchors = anchors_of_layer_plans(tree);
        let spatial_node_moves_on_its_own =
            spatial_nodes_that_move_on_their_own_relative_to_spaces_at(tree, Some(&anchors));
        Self {
            leaves_out_scroll_offset_of_node: spatial_nodes_whose_scroll_offset_placement_leaves_out_of_nodes_moving(
                tree,
                &anchors,
                spatial_node_moves_on_its_own.clone(),
            ),
            anchors,
            spatial_node_moves_on_its_own: spatial_node_moves_on_its_own.into(),
        }
    }
}

/// The raster spaces of a tree at a set of anchors, with what placing a list among them reads past what rastering
/// reads: per spatial node, whether it moves on its own relative to the spaces, and per effect node, whether how far
/// its filters spread its content moves on its own.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub(super) struct RasterSpacesForPlacing {
    raster_spaces: RasterSpaces,
    spatial_node_moves_on_its_own: Arc<[bool]>,
    effect_node_spread_moves_on_its_own: Vec<bool>,
}

impl RasterSpacesForPlacing {
    /// The spaces at the anchors of `tree`, without the extent of each but the viewport's, which placing reads of the
    /// geometry of each space.
    fn at_anchors(
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        anchors_of_tree: &RasterSpaceAnchorsOfTree,
        viewport_rect: IntRect,
    ) -> Self {
        let raster_spaces = RasterSpaces::of_spaces(
            tree,
            RasterSpaces::spaces_at_anchors(tree, &anchors_of_tree.anchors, viewport_rect),
        );
        debug_assert!(
            raster_spaces
                .spaces()
                .iter()
                .skip(1)
                .map(|space| space.anchor)
                .eq(anchors_of_tree.anchors.iter().copied()),
            "every anchor of a tree has a space"
        );
        Self {
            spatial_node_moves_on_its_own: anchors_of_tree.spatial_node_moves_on_its_own.clone(),
            effect_node_spread_moves_on_its_own: effects_whose_spread_moves_on_its_own(tree),
            raster_spaces,
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn spaces(&self) -> &[RasterSpace] {
        self.raster_spaces.spaces()
    }

    pub(super) fn deepest_space_of(&self, spatial: SpatialNodeIndex) -> RasterSpaceIndex {
        self.raster_spaces.deepest_space_of(spatial)
    }

    pub(super) fn moves_with(&self, spatial: SpatialNodeIndex, space: RasterSpaceIndex) -> bool {
        space_is_ancestor_or_self(self.spaces(), space, self.deepest_space_of(spatial))
    }

    pub(super) fn spatial_moves_on_its_own(&self, spatial: SpatialNodeIndex) -> bool {
        self.spatial_node_moves_on_its_own
            .get(spatial.0 as usize)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(false)
    }

    pub(super) fn effect_spread_moves_on_its_own(&self, effect: EffectNodeIndex) -> bool {
        !effect.is_none()
            && self
                .effect_node_spread_moves_on_its_own
                .get(effect.0 as usize)
                .copied()
                .unwrap_or(false)
    }
}

/// The geometry of one raster space, with what placing a list in it reads past what rastering reads: the bounds of
/// the clip chains fixed in the space, and the extent of the space.
pub(super) struct RasterSpaceGeometryForPlacing {
    pub(super) raster: RasterSpaceGeometry,
    clip_chain_bounds_fixed_in_space_by_clip: Vec<Option<FloatRect>>,
    pub(super) extent: IntRect,
}

impl RasterSpaceGeometryForPlacing {
    fn new(
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        spaces: &RasterSpacesForPlacing,
        space: RasterSpaceIndex,
        scroll_offsets: &[FloatPoint],
        viewport_rect: IntRect,
        what_every_space_of_tree_shares: &Rc<WhatEverySpaceOfTreeShares>,
        world_of_viewport_space: Option<&Rc<WorldTransforms>>,
    ) -> Self {
        let raster = match world_of_viewport_space {
            Some(world) if spaces.spaces()[space.0].raster_root().is_none() => RasterSpaceGeometry::with_world(
                tree,
                &spaces.raster_spaces,
                space,
                raster_scroll_offsets(spaces.spaces(), space, scroll_offsets),
                world.clone(),
                what_every_space_of_tree_shares,
            ),
            _ => RasterSpaceGeometry::new(
                tree,
                &spaces.raster_spaces,
                space,
                scroll_offsets,
                FloatMatrix4x4::identity(),
                what_every_space_of_tree_shares,
            ),
        };
        let mut clip_chain_bounds_fixed_in_space_by_clip: Vec<Option<FloatRect>> = vec![None; tree.clip_nodes.len()];
        tree.visit_clip_nodes_parents_first(|index| {
            let node = &tree.clip_nodes[index];
            let own_bounds_if_fixed_in_space = raster.rastered_affine_own_clip_bounds_by_clip[index].filter(|_| {
                spaces.deepest_space_of(node.spatial) == space && !spaces.spatial_moves_on_its_own(node.spatial)
            });
            clip_chain_bounds_fixed_in_space_by_clip[index] = intersect_bounds(
                own_bounds_if_fixed_in_space,
                chain_bounds_of_clip(node.parent, &clip_chain_bounds_fixed_in_space_by_clip),
            );
        });
        let extent = if space == RasterSpaceIndex::VIEWPORT {
            viewport_rect
        } else {
            extent_of_space(tree, spaces.spaces(), space, &raster.world, viewport_rect)
        };
        Self {
            raster,
            clip_chain_bounds_fixed_in_space_by_clip,
            extent,
        }
    }

    /// As `RasterSpaceGeometry::reach_of_content`, or without `drawn_within`, where content of `context` can show
    /// anywhere it can move: within the clips fixed in the space, which are some of those that rasters of the space
    /// apply.
    pub(super) fn reach_of_content(
        &self,
        list: &FiltersAndClipsOfList<'_>,
        drawn_within: Option<FloatRect>,
        context: ContextRef,
    ) -> Reach<IntRect> {
        match drawn_within {
            Some(drawn_within) => self.raster.reach_of_content(list, drawn_within, context),
            None => antialiased_reach_in_device_pixels(chain_bounds_of_clip(
                list.clip_bounding_filter_spread(context),
                &self.clip_chain_bounds_fixed_in_space_by_clip,
            )),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn part_of_extent_reached_by(&self, reach: Reach<IntRect>) -> IntRect {
        reach.part_of(self.extent)
    }
}

/// The spaces at the anchors of `tree` and the geometry of each, in the device pixels of the viewport.
pub(super) fn spaces_with_geometries(
    tree: &VisualContextTree,
    anchors_of_tree: &RasterSpaceAnchorsOfTree,
    scroll_offsets: &[FloatPoint],
    viewport_rect: IntRect,
) -> (RasterSpacesForPlacing, Vec<RasterSpaceGeometryForPlacing>) {
    let spaces = RasterSpacesForPlacing::at_anchors(tree, anchors_of_tree, viewport_rect);
    let what_every_space_of_tree_shares = WhatEverySpaceOfTreeShares::of(tree);
    let geometry_of_viewport_space = RasterSpaceGeometryForPlacing::new(
        tree,
        &spaces,
        RasterSpaceIndex::VIEWPORT,
        scroll_offsets,
        viewport_rect,
        &what_every_space_of_tree_shares,
        None,
    );
    // The scroll offsets a plan reads leave out that of every anchor, so every space whose anchor the compositor does
    // not animate has the world transforms of the viewport's space.
    let world_of_viewport_space = geometry_of_viewport_space.raster.world.clone();
    let geometries: Vec<RasterSpaceGeometryForPlacing> = std::iter::once(geometry_of_viewport_space)
        .chain((1..spaces.spaces().len()).map(|space| {
            RasterSpaceGeometryForPlacing::new(
                tree,
                &spaces,
                RasterSpaceIndex(space),
                scroll_offsets,
                viewport_rect,
                &what_every_space_of_tree_shares,
                Some(&world_of_viewport_space),
            )
        }))
        .collect();
    (spaces, geometries)
}
