//! Mutable compositor-side copy of AsyncScrollingState. Current scroll offsets live in ScrollStateSnapshot; this tree owns scroll node geometry and derived hit-test targets.

use super::*;
use crate::css_pixels::{CssPixelPoint, CssPixels};
use crate::visual_context::RectMapping;
use libgfx_rust::{CornerRadii, FloatPoint, FloatRect, FloatSize, IntPoint, IntRect};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum WheelHitTestOutcome {
    FoundScrollTarget,
    #[default]
    NoScrollTarget,
    BlockedByMainThreadRegion,
    BlockedByWheelEventRegion,
    HitTestTargetsOfAnotherVisualContextTree,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct WheelHitTestResult {
    pub outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome,
    // Set exactly when the outcome is FoundScrollTarget.
    pub scroll_node_index: Option<SpatialNodeIndex>,
    // The scroller the wheel is over, which is where the search for `scroll_node_index` started. It is set even if
    // neither it nor any scroller around it can scroll by the delta.
    pub innermost_scroll_node_index: Option<SpatialNodeIndex>,
    // The scroller that keeps the delta from the scrollers around it, when the outcome is NoScrollTarget for that
    // reason rather than because no scroller is left to offer it to.
    pub scroll_node_index_keeping_the_scroll: Option<SpatialNodeIndex>,
}

impl WheelHitTestResult {
    pub fn is_blocked_by_a_region(&self) -> bool {
        self.outcome == WheelHitTestOutcome::BlockedByMainThreadRegion
            || self.outcome == WheelHitTestOutcome::BlockedByWheelEventRegion
    }
}

// Where the first step of a wheel gesture over a position goes, as far as the admission and the hit test decide it.
pub struct FirstWheelStepRoute {
    pub decision: InputRoutingDecision,
    pub scroller: Option<AsyncScrollNodeStableID>,
}

pub struct FirstWheelStepRouteForTesting {
    pub route: FirstWheelStepRoute,
    // The document whose scrolling state decided the route.
    pub document_id: Option<UniqueNodeId>,
}

// What the wheel hit test does where a nested context's content is painted.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum NestedContextRegions {
    // The step is left to the page, which hands it to the nested navigable.
    LeaveToMainThread,
    // The step is handed to the nested context under it, which only gets here if there is none.
    HandToNestedContext,
    // The nested context passed the step on, so it goes to whatever is under the nested context.
    Ignore,
}

// Where a wheel or the pointer over the content of a nested context lands in it.
pub struct NestedContextHit {
    pub child_context_id: CompositorContextId,
    // Relative to the origin of the nested context's content box, in the device pixels of the containing context.
    pub position_in_content_box: FloatPoint,
    pub content_box_size: FloatSize,
    // Where the nested context's content is painted among the other things in the containing context that take
    // pointer input.
    pub paint_order_index: u32,
}

pub struct WheelScrollTarget {
    pub stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
    pub current_offset: FloatPoint,
    pub start_offset: FloatPoint,
    pub destination_offset: FloatPoint,
}

pub struct CachedWheelHitTestTarget {
    pub target_scroll_node_index: Option<SpatialNodeIndex>,
    pub context: ContextRef,
    pub rect: FloatRect,
    pub corner_radii: CornerRadii,
    pub viewport_rect: Option<FloatRect>,
    pub paint_order_index: u32,
}

pub struct CachedMainThreadWheelEventTarget {
    pub context: ContextRef,
    pub rect: FloatRect,
    pub viewport_rect: Option<FloatRect>,
}

pub struct CachedNestedContextWheelRegion {
    pub region: NestedContextWheelRegion,
    pub viewport_rect: Option<FloatRect>,
}

pub struct CachedBlockingWheelEventTarget {
    pub context: ContextRef,
    pub rect: FloatRect,
    pub viewport_rect: Option<FloatRect>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum ScrollChaining {
    ToScrollableAncestors,
    None,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct AsyncScrollTree {
    state: AsyncScrollingState,
    cached_wheel_hit_test_targets: Vec<CachedWheelHitTestTarget>,
    cached_main_thread_wheel_event_targets: Vec<CachedMainThreadWheelEventTarget>,
    cached_nested_context_wheel_regions: Vec<CachedNestedContextWheelRegion>,
    cached_blocking_wheel_event_targets: Vec<CachedBlockingWheelEventTarget>,
    visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: Option<u64>,
    cached_viewport_rects_are_stale: bool,
}

struct NestedContextWheelRegionHit<'a> {
    region: &'a NestedContextWheelRegion,
    position_in_context: FloatPoint,
}

impl AsyncScrollTree {
    pub fn document_id(&self) -> Option<UniqueNodeId> {
        self.state.document_id
    }
    pub fn scroll_nodes(&self) -> &[AsyncScrollNode] {
        &self.state.scroll_nodes
    }

    // Scroll offsets are held in the device pixels of the display list; snap geometry is in the CSS pixels it was
    // recorded from, at the scale the display list carries.
    pub fn device_pixels_per_css_pixel(&self) -> f64 {
        self.state.device_pixels_per_css_pixel
    }
    pub fn has_nested_contexts(&self) -> bool {
        !self.state.nested_context_wheel_regions.is_empty()
    }
    pub fn has_wheel_hit_test_targets_for(&self, visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree) -> bool {
        self.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch == Some(visual_context_tree.structural_epoch())
    }
    pub fn mark_cached_viewport_rects_stale(&mut self) {
        self.cached_viewport_rects_are_stale = true;
    }
    pub fn cached_viewport_rects_are_stale(&self) -> bool {
        self.cached_viewport_rects_are_stale
    }

    pub fn set_state(&mut self, state: AsyncScrollingState) {
        self.state = state;
        self.cached_wheel_hit_test_targets.clear();
        self.cached_main_thread_wheel_event_targets.clear();
        self.cached_nested_context_wheel_regions.clear();
        self.cached_blocking_wheel_event_targets.clear();
        self.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch = None;
        self.cached_viewport_rects_are_stale = false;
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> &AsyncScrollingState {
        &self.state
    }
}

// A first step of a wheel gesture is latched to the scroller the hit test found, and is otherwise left to the page for
// the outcome's reason.
pub fn input_routing_decision_for_first_wheel_step(outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome) -> InputRoutingDecision {
    match outcome {
        WheelHitTestOutcome::FoundScrollTarget => InputRoutingDecision::Latched,
        WheelHitTestOutcome::NoScrollTarget => InputRoutingDecision::NoScrollTarget,
        WheelHitTestOutcome::BlockedByMainThreadRegion => InputRoutingDecision::BlockedByMainThreadRegion,
        WheelHitTestOutcome::BlockedByWheelEventRegion => InputRoutingDecision::BlockedByWheelEventRegion,
        WheelHitTestOutcome::HitTestTargetsOfAnotherVisualContextTree => {
            InputRoutingDecision::HitTestTargetsOfAnotherVisualContextTree
        }
    }
}

impl AsyncScrollTree {
    pub fn scroll_node_for_index(&self, scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex) -> Option<&AsyncScrollNode> {
        self.state
            .scroll_nodes
            .iter()
            .find(|node| node.scroll_node_index == scroll_node_index)
    }
}

fn delta_is_mainly_vertical(delta: FloatPoint) -> bool {
    delta.y.abs() >= delta.x.abs()
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-overscroll-1/#overscroll-behavior-properties
// A step is taken by one scroller, and a touchpad rarely moves along one axis exactly, so the main axis of the step
// decides whether a scroller that cannot take it passes it on.
fn node_chains_scroll_to_ancestors(node: &AsyncScrollNode, delta: FloatPoint) -> bool {
    if delta_is_mainly_vertical(delta) {
        node.chains_scroll_to_ancestors_vertically
    } else {
        node.chains_scroll_to_ancestors_horizontally
    }
}

impl AsyncScrollTree {
    // The scroller, of the given one and those it passes a scroll by the delta on to, that takes a wheel step by it, as
    // the hit test finds one for a step over the given scroller.
    pub fn hit_test_result_for_scroll_node(
        &self,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        delta: FloatPoint,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        in_flight_destination_for: &dyn Fn(AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> Option<FloatPoint>,
    ) -> WheelHitTestResult {
        let can_take_step = |node: &AsyncScrollNode| {
            let in_flight_destination = in_flight_destination_for(node.stable_node_id);
            Self::can_scroll_node_from_offset_by_delta(
                node,
                in_flight_destination.unwrap_or(Self::scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, scroll_state_snapshot)),
                delta,
            )
        };
        let mut node = self.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index);
        while let Some(current) = node {
            if can_take_step(current) {
                return WheelHitTestResult {
                    outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::FoundScrollTarget,
                    scroll_node_index: Some(current.scroll_node_index),
                    innermost_scroll_node_index: Some(scroll_node_index),
                    ..Default::default()
                };
            }
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-overscroll-1/#scroll-chaining-and-boundary-default-actions
            // If a scroll container has no potential to scroll, because it does not overflow in the direction of the
            // scroll, the element is always considered to be at the scroll boundary.
            // NB: A scroll container that keeps its scrolls has a scroll node even when it has nothing to scroll.
            if !node_chains_scroll_to_ancestors(current, delta) {
                return WheelHitTestResult {
                    outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::NoScrollTarget,
                    innermost_scroll_node_index: Some(scroll_node_index),
                    scroll_node_index_keeping_the_scroll: Some(current.scroll_node_index),
                    ..Default::default()
                };
            }
            let Some(parent) = current.parent_scroll_node_index else {
                break;
            };
            node = self.scroll_node_for_index(parent);
        }
        WheelHitTestResult {
            outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::NoScrollTarget,
            innermost_scroll_node_index: Some(scroll_node_index),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    // Of the scroller and the scrollers around it that a scroll by the delta may be passed on to, the outermost one a
    // wheel can scroll along the main axis of the delta at all, wherever it is scrolled to.
    pub fn outermost_scroll_node_wheel_scrollable_along_main_axis_of(
        &self,
        innermost_scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        delta: FloatPoint,
    ) -> Option<SpatialNodeIndex> {
        let mut outermost_scroll_node_index = None;
        let mut scroll_node_index = innermost_scroll_node_index;
        for _ in 0..self.state.scroll_nodes.len() {
            let Some(node) = self.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index) else {
                break;
            };
            if if delta_is_mainly_vertical(delta) {
                node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_vertically
            } else {
                node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_horizontally
            } {
                outermost_scroll_node_index = Some(node.scroll_node_index);
            }
            if !node_chains_scroll_to_ancestors(node, delta) {
                break;
            }
            let Some(parent) = node.parent_scroll_node_index else {
                break;
            };
            scroll_node_index = parent;
        }
        outermost_scroll_node_index
    }

    pub fn snap_container_for_node(&self, scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex) -> Option<&AsyncSnapContainer> {
        self.state
            .snap_containers
            .iter()
            .find(|snap_container| snap_container.scroll_node_index == scroll_node_index)
    }

    fn scroll_node_for_stable_id(&self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> Option<&AsyncScrollNode> {
        self.state
            .scroll_nodes
            .iter()
            .find(|node| node.stable_node_id == stable_node_id)
    }

    fn clamp_scroll_offset_to_node(node: &AsyncScrollNode, mut scroll_offset: FloatPoint) -> FloatPoint {
        scroll_offset.x = max(node.min_scroll_offset.x, min(scroll_offset.x, node.max_scroll_offset.x));
        scroll_offset.y = max(node.min_scroll_offset.y, min(scroll_offset.y, node.max_scroll_offset.y));
        scroll_offset
    }

    pub fn scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(
        node: &AsyncScrollNode,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> FloatPoint {
        let device_offset = scroll_state_snapshot.device_offset_for_index(node.scroll_node_index);
        FloatPoint {
            x: -device_offset.x,
            y: -device_offset.y,
        }
    }

    fn can_scroll_node_by_delta(
        node: &AsyncScrollNode,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        delta: FloatPoint,
    ) -> bool {
        Self::can_scroll_node_from_offset_by_delta(
            node,
            Self::scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, scroll_state_snapshot),
            delta,
        )
    }

    fn can_scroll_node_from_offset_by_delta(
        node: &AsyncScrollNode,
        scroll_offset: FloatPoint,
        delta: FloatPoint,
    ) -> bool {
        if node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_horizontally && delta.x < 0.0 && scroll_offset.x > node.min_scroll_offset.x {
            return true;
        }
        if node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_horizontally && delta.x > 0.0 && scroll_offset.x < node.max_scroll_offset.x {
            return true;
        }
        if node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_vertically && delta.y < 0.0 && scroll_offset.y > node.min_scroll_offset.y {
            return true;
        }
        if node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_vertically && delta.y > 0.0 && scroll_offset.y < node.max_scroll_offset.y {
            return true;
        }
        false
    }

    fn scrollable_ancestor_for_node(
        &self,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        delta: FloatPoint,
    ) -> Option<SpatialNodeIndex> {
        let mut node = self.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index)?;
        while node_chains_scroll_to_ancestors(node, delta) && node.parent_scroll_node_index.is_some() {
            node = self.scroll_node_for_index(node.parent_scroll_node_index?)?;
            if Self::can_scroll_node_by_delta(node, scroll_state_snapshot, delta) {
                return Some(node.scroll_node_index);
            }
        }
        None
    }

    fn scroll_offset_of_node_moved_by_delta(
        node: &AsyncScrollNode,
        delta: FloatPoint,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> FloatPoint {
        let old_scroll_offset = Self::scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, scroll_state_snapshot);
        let wheel_scrollable_delta = FloatPoint {
            x: if node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_horizontally {
                delta.x
            } else {
                0.0
            },
            y: if node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_vertically {
                delta.y
            } else {
                0.0
            },
        };
        Self::clamp_scroll_offset_to_node(node, old_scroll_offset + wheel_scrollable_delta)
    }

    // The scroller a delta moves, of the given one and those it passes the delta on to, and where it moves it.
    pub fn scroll_destination_for_delta(
        &self,
        mut scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        delta: FloatPoint,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        scroll_chaining: ScrollChaining,
    ) -> Option<(SpatialNodeIndex, FloatPoint)> {
        // The compositor can advance only the scroll offsets it owns in this snapshot. Hit testing already selects an
        // ancestor when the target cannot scroll in the wheel direction at all, so once a node moves it consumes the event.
        for _ in 0..self.state.scroll_nodes.len() {
            if delta.is_zero() {
                break;
            }
            let Some(node) = self.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index) else {
                break;
            };
            let destination = Self::scroll_offset_of_node_moved_by_delta(node, delta, scroll_state_snapshot);
            if destination != Self::scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, scroll_state_snapshot) {
                return Some((scroll_node_index, destination));
            }
            if scroll_chaining == ScrollChaining::None {
                break;
            }
            let Some(ancestor_scroll_node_index) =
                self.scrollable_ancestor_for_node(scroll_node_index, scroll_state_snapshot, delta)
            else {
                break;
            };
            scroll_node_index = ancestor_scroll_node_index;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn select_wheel_scroll_target(
        &self,
        mut scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        delta: FloatPoint,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        in_flight_destination_for: &dyn Fn(AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> Option<FloatPoint>,
        scroll_chaining: ScrollChaining,
    ) -> Option<WheelScrollTarget> {
        // Each box is measured from where its scroll in flight is headed, so a box already headed for its extent passes the
        // first step of a gesture on to an ancestor.
        for _ in 0..self.state.scroll_nodes.len() {
            let node = self.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index)?;
            let start_offset = in_flight_destination_for(node.stable_node_id)
                .unwrap_or(Self::scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, scroll_state_snapshot));
            let wheel_scrollable_delta = FloatPoint {
                x: if node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_horizontally {
                    delta.x
                } else {
                    0.0
                },
                y: if node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_vertically {
                    delta.y
                } else {
                    0.0
                },
            };
            let destination_offset = Self::clamp_scroll_offset_to_node(node, start_offset + wheel_scrollable_delta);
            if destination_offset != start_offset {
                return Some(WheelScrollTarget {
                    stable_node_id: node.stable_node_id,
                    current_offset: Self::scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, scroll_state_snapshot),
                    start_offset,
                    destination_offset,
                });
            }
            if scroll_chaining == ScrollChaining::None || !node_chains_scroll_to_ancestors(node, delta) {
                return None;
            }
            scroll_node_index = node.parent_scroll_node_index?;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn rebuild_wheel_hit_test_targets(
        &mut self,
        display_list: Option<&DisplayList>,
        visual_context_tree: Option<&AccumulatedVisualContextTree>,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) {
        self.cached_wheel_hit_test_targets.clear();
        self.cached_main_thread_wheel_event_targets.clear();
        self.cached_nested_context_wheel_regions.clear();
        self.cached_blocking_wheel_event_targets.clear();
        self.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch = None;
        self.cached_viewport_rects_are_stale = false;
        let (Some(display_list), Some(visual_context_tree)) = (display_list, visual_context_tree) else {
            return;
        };
        assert_eq!(
            display_list.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch(),
            visual_context_tree.structural_epoch()
        );
        self.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch = Some(visual_context_tree.structural_epoch());
        let context_is_valid = |context| visual_context_tree.context_is_valid(context);
        let spatial_context_has_visual_animation =
            visual_context_tree.spatial_nodes_in_subtrees_of_transform_animations();
        let world = scroll_state_snapshot.world_transforms(visual_context_tree);
        // Targets come in paint order, so most of them share the spatial node of the target before them.
        let mut last_mapping: Option<(SpatialNodeIndex, RectMapping)> = None;
        let mut viewport_rect_for_context = |context: ContextRef, rect| {
            if *spatial_context_has_visual_animation.get(context.spatial.0 as usize)? {
                return None;
            }
            let mapping = match last_mapping {
                Some((spatial, mapping)) if spatial == context.spatial => mapping,
                _ => {
                    let mapping = world.viewport_rect_mapping(context.spatial, IncludeVisualViewportTransform::Yes);
                    last_mapping = Some((context.spatial, mapping));
                    mapping
                }
            };
            Some(mapping.map_rect(rect))
        };
        self.cached_wheel_hit_test_targets
            .reserve(self.state.wheel_hit_test_targets.len());
        for target in &self.state.wheel_hit_test_targets {
            if !context_is_valid(target.context) {
                continue;
            }
            self.cached_wheel_hit_test_targets.push(CachedWheelHitTestTarget {
                target_scroll_node_index: target.target_scroll_node_index,
                context: target.context,
                rect: target.rect,
                corner_radii: target.corner_radii,
                viewport_rect: viewport_rect_for_context(target.context, target.rect),
                paint_order_index: target.paint_order_index,
            });
        }
        self.cached_main_thread_wheel_event_targets
            .reserve(self.state.main_thread_wheel_event_regions.len());
        for region in &self.state.main_thread_wheel_event_regions {
            if !context_is_valid(region.context) {
                continue;
            }
            self.cached_main_thread_wheel_event_targets
                .push(CachedMainThreadWheelEventTarget {
                    context: region.context,
                    rect: region.rect,
                    viewport_rect: viewport_rect_for_context(region.context, region.rect),
                });
        }
        self.cached_nested_context_wheel_regions
            .reserve(self.state.nested_context_wheel_regions.len());
        for region in &self.state.nested_context_wheel_regions {
            if !context_is_valid(region.context) {
                continue;
            }
            self.cached_nested_context_wheel_regions
                .push(CachedNestedContextWheelRegion {
                    region: *region,
                    viewport_rect: viewport_rect_for_context(region.context, region.rect),
                });
        }
        for region in &self.state.blocking_wheel_event_regions {
            // Keep invalid blockers so hit testing fails closed when their extent cannot be determined.
            self.cached_blocking_wheel_event_targets
                .push(CachedBlockingWheelEventTarget {
                    context: region.context,
                    rect: region.rect,
                    viewport_rect: if context_is_valid(region.context) {
                        viewport_rect_for_context(region.context, region.rect)
                    } else {
                        None
                    },
                });
        }
    }
}

fn rounded_rect_contains_point(rect: FloatRect, corner_radii: CornerRadii, position_in_context: FloatPoint) -> bool {
    if !rect.contains_point(position_in_context) {
        return false;
    }
    if !corner_radii.has_any_radius() {
        return true;
    }
    corner_radii.contains_int_point(
        IntPoint {
            x: position_in_context.x as i32,
            y: position_in_context.y as i32,
        },
        IntRect::new(rect.x as i32, rect.y as i32, rect.width as i32, rect.height as i32),
    )
}

fn wheel_hit_test_target_contains_point(target: &CachedWheelHitTestTarget, position_in_context: FloatPoint) -> bool {
    rounded_rect_contains_point(target.rect, target.corner_radii, position_in_context)
}

impl AsyncScrollTree {
    pub fn scroll_offset_for_node(
        &self,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
        if let Some(node) = self.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index) {
            return Some(Self::scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, scroll_state_snapshot));
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn css_pixels_from_device_offset(&self, device_offset: FloatPoint) -> CssPixelPoint {
        CssPixelPoint {
            x: CssPixels::nearest_value_for(device_offset.x as f64 / self.state.device_pixels_per_css_pixel),
            y: CssPixels::nearest_value_for(device_offset.y as f64 / self.state.device_pixels_per_css_pixel),
        }
    }

    pub fn device_offset_from_css_pixels(&self, offset: CssPixelPoint) -> FloatPoint {
        FloatPoint {
            x: (offset.x.to_double() * self.state.device_pixels_per_css_pixel) as f32,
            y: (offset.y.to_double() * self.state.device_pixels_per_css_pixel) as f32,
        }
    }

    pub fn css_scroll_offset_for_node(
        &self,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> Option<CssPixelPoint> {
        self.scroll_offset_for_node(scroll_node_index, scroll_state_snapshot)
            .map(|device_offset| self.css_pixels_from_device_offset(device_offset))
    }

    pub fn css_scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(
        &self,
        node: &AsyncScrollNode,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> CssPixelPoint {
        self.css_pixels_from_device_offset(Self::scroll_offset_for_scroll_node(node, scroll_state_snapshot))
    }

    pub fn viewport_scroll_node_index(&self) -> Option<SpatialNodeIndex> {
        for node in &self.state.scroll_nodes {
            if node.is_viewport {
                return Some(node.scroll_node_index);
            }
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn scroll_node_index_for_stable_id(&self, stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> Option<SpatialNodeIndex> {
        if let Some(node) = self.scroll_node_for_stable_id(stable_node_id) {
            return Some(node.scroll_node_index);
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn blocks_wheel_event_at_position(
        &self,
        visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        position: FloatPoint,
    ) -> bool {
        assert!(!self.cached_viewport_rects_are_stale);
        if self.state.has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport
            || !self.has_wheel_hit_test_targets_for(visual_context_tree)
        {
            return true;
        }
        for target in &self.cached_blocking_wheel_event_targets {
            if !visual_context_tree.context_is_valid(target.context) {
                return true;
            }
            if target.viewport_rect.is_some_and(|rect| !rect.contains_point(position)) {
                continue;
            }
            let position_in_context = visual_context_tree.transform_point_for_hit_test(
                target.context,
                position,
                scroll_state_snapshot,
                ClipBehavior::Respect,
            );
            if position_in_context.is_some_and(|point| target.rect.contains_point(point)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        false
    }

    pub fn main_thread_wheel_event_region_contains(
        &self,
        visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        position: FloatPoint,
    ) -> bool {
        assert!(!self.cached_viewport_rects_are_stale);
        for target in &self.cached_main_thread_wheel_event_targets {
            if target.viewport_rect.is_some_and(|rect| !rect.contains_point(position)) {
                continue;
            }
            if !visual_context_tree.context_is_valid(target.context) {
                continue;
            }
            let position_in_context = visual_context_tree.transform_point_for_hit_test(
                target.context,
                position,
                scroll_state_snapshot,
                ClipBehavior::Respect,
            );
            if position_in_context.is_some_and(|point| target.rect.contains_point(point)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        false
    }

    fn topmost_nested_context_wheel_region_at(
        &self,
        visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        position: FloatPoint,
    ) -> Option<NestedContextWheelRegionHit<'_>> {
        assert!(!self.cached_viewport_rects_are_stale);
        for cached_region in self.cached_nested_context_wheel_regions.iter().rev() {
            let region = &cached_region.region;
            if cached_region
                .viewport_rect
                .is_some_and(|rect| !rect.contains_point(position))
            {
                continue;
            }
            if !visual_context_tree.context_is_valid(region.context) {
                continue;
            }
            let position_in_context = visual_context_tree.transform_point_for_hit_test(
                region.context,
                position,
                scroll_state_snapshot,
                ClipBehavior::Respect,
            );
            if let Some(point) = position_in_context
                && rounded_rect_contains_point(region.rect, region.corner_radii, point)
            {
                return Some(NestedContextWheelRegionHit {
                    region,
                    position_in_context: point,
                });
            }
        }
        None
    }
}

fn nested_context_hit_in_region(
    region: &NestedContextWheelRegion,
    position_in_context: FloatPoint,
) -> NestedContextHit {
    NestedContextHit {
        child_context_id: region.child_context_id,
        position_in_content_box: position_in_context
            - FloatPoint {
                x: region.rect.x,
                y: region.rect.y,
            },
        content_box_size: FloatSize {
            width: region.rect.width,
            height: region.rect.height,
        },
        paint_order_index: region.paint_order_index,
    }
}

impl AsyncScrollTree {
    // The nested context whose content is the topmost thing taking pointer input at the position, if any.
    pub fn nested_context_at(
        &self,
        visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        position: FloatPoint,
    ) -> Option<NestedContextHit> {
        if self.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch != Some(visual_context_tree.structural_epoch()) {
            return None;
        }
        let hit = self.topmost_nested_context_wheel_region_at(visual_context_tree, scroll_state_snapshot, position)?;
        if self.is_covered_by_hit_test_target_painted_after(
            hit.region.paint_order_index,
            visual_context_tree,
            scroll_state_snapshot,
            position,
        ) {
            return None;
        }
        Some(nested_context_hit_in_region(hit.region, hit.position_in_context))
    }

    // As above, unless the main thread takes the wheel events at the position.
    pub fn nested_context_for_wheel_at(
        &self,
        visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        position: FloatPoint,
    ) -> Option<NestedContextHit> {
        if self.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch != Some(visual_context_tree.structural_epoch()) {
            return None;
        }
        if self.main_thread_wheel_event_region_contains(visual_context_tree, scroll_state_snapshot, position) {
            return None;
        }
        self.nested_context_at(visual_context_tree, scroll_state_snapshot, position)
    }

    // Where the position lands in the content of the nested context, even outside of that content and its clips, as
    // the pointer of a drag that began in there moves on.
    pub fn position_in_content_of_nested_context(
        &self,
        child_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        position: FloatPoint,
    ) -> Option<NestedContextHit> {
        if self.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch != Some(visual_context_tree.structural_epoch()) {
            return None;
        }
        for cached_region in self.cached_nested_context_wheel_regions.iter().rev() {
            let region = &cached_region.region;
            if region.child_context_id != child_context_id {
                continue;
            }
            if !visual_context_tree.context_is_valid(region.context) {
                return None;
            }
            let position_in_context = visual_context_tree.transform_point_for_hit_test(
                region.context,
                position,
                scroll_state_snapshot,
                ClipBehavior::Ignore,
            )?;
            return Some(nested_context_hit_in_region(region, position_in_context));
        }
        None
    }

    // Where a position in the viewport of the nested context lies in this context's viewport.
    pub fn position_of_nested_context_position(
        &self,
        child_context_id: CompositorContextId,
        position_in_nested_context: FloatPoint,
        nested_context_viewport_size: FloatSize,
        visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
        if self.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch != Some(visual_context_tree.structural_epoch())
            || nested_context_viewport_size.is_empty()
        {
            return None;
        }
        for cached_region in self.cached_nested_context_wheel_regions.iter().rev() {
            let region = &cached_region.region;
            if region.child_context_id != child_context_id {
                continue;
            }
            if !visual_context_tree.context_is_valid(region.context) {
                return None;
            }
            // The content box of a nested context is drawn scaled to the size of its viewport.
            let position_in_content_box = FloatPoint {
                x: position_in_nested_context.x * region.rect.width / nested_context_viewport_size.width,
                y: position_in_nested_context.y * region.rect.height / nested_context_viewport_size.height,
            };
            let location = FloatPoint {
                x: region.rect.x,
                y: region.rect.y,
            } + position_in_content_box;
            let point_in_context = FloatRect::new(location.x, location.y, 0.0, 0.0);
            let result = visual_context_tree.transform_rect_to_viewport(
                region.context.spatial,
                point_in_context,
                scroll_state_snapshot,
                IncludeVisualViewportTransform::Yes,
            );
            return Some(FloatPoint {
                x: result.x,
                y: result.y,
            });
        }
        None
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn hit_test_scroll_node_for_wheel(
        &self,
        visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        position: FloatPoint,
        delta: FloatPoint,
        in_flight_destination_for: &dyn Fn(AsyncScrollNodeStableID) -> Option<FloatPoint>,
        wheel_step_dispatch: WheelStepDispatch,
        nested_context_regions: NestedContextRegions,
    ) -> WheelHitTestResult {
        assert!(!self.cached_viewport_rects_are_stale);
        if self.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch != Some(visual_context_tree.structural_epoch()) {
            return WheelHitTestResult {
                outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::HitTestTargetsOfAnotherVisualContextTree,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        let context_is_valid = |context| visual_context_tree.context_is_valid(context);
        // Neither the listeners nor the main thread have anything left to say about a step the page let through.
        let page_has_yet_to_see_the_step = wheel_step_dispatch == WheelStepDispatch::NotYetDispatched;
        if page_has_yet_to_see_the_step && self.state.has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport {
            return WheelHitTestResult {
                outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::BlockedByWheelEventRegion,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        if page_has_yet_to_see_the_step
            && self.main_thread_wheel_event_region_contains(visual_context_tree, scroll_state_snapshot, position)
        {
            return WheelHitTestResult {
                outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::BlockedByMainThreadRegion,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        if nested_context_regions == NestedContextRegions::LeaveToMainThread
            && self
                .topmost_nested_context_wheel_region_at(visual_context_tree, scroll_state_snapshot, position)
                .is_some()
        {
            return WheelHitTestResult {
                outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::BlockedByMainThreadRegion,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        if page_has_yet_to_see_the_step
            && self.blocks_wheel_event_at_position(visual_context_tree, scroll_state_snapshot, position)
        {
            return WheelHitTestResult {
                outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::BlockedByWheelEventRegion,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        for target in self.cached_wheel_hit_test_targets.iter().rev() {
            if target.viewport_rect.is_some_and(|rect| !rect.contains_point(position)) {
                continue;
            }
            if !context_is_valid(target.context) {
                continue;
            }
            let position_in_context = visual_context_tree.transform_point_for_hit_test(
                target.context,
                position,
                scroll_state_snapshot,
                ClipBehavior::Respect,
            );
            if !position_in_context.is_some_and(|point| wheel_hit_test_target_contains_point(target, point)) {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(index) = target.target_scroll_node_index else {
                return WheelHitTestResult {
                    outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::NoScrollTarget,
                    ..Default::default()
                };
            };
            return self.hit_test_result_for_scroll_node(
                index,
                delta,
                scroll_state_snapshot,
                in_flight_destination_for,
            );
        }
        let Some(index_of_viewport_scroll_node) = self.viewport_scroll_node_index() else {
            return WheelHitTestResult {
                outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::NoScrollTarget,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        };
        let viewport_node = self.scroll_node_for_index(index_of_viewport_scroll_node);
        if !viewport_node.is_some_and(|node| node.scrollport_rect.to_float().contains_point(position)) {
            return WheelHitTestResult {
                outcome: WheelHitTestOutcome::NoScrollTarget,
                ..Default::default()
            };
        }
        self.hit_test_result_for_scroll_node(
            index_of_viewport_scroll_node,
            delta,
            scroll_state_snapshot,
            in_flight_destination_for,
        )
    }

    // Leaves out what only a compositor holding a gesture decides: whether a step continues a latched gesture, which
    // scroller fingers at its edge stretch, and whether a zoomed page pans its visual viewport.
    pub fn route_first_wheel_step(
        &self,
        admission: WheelRoutingAdmission,
        visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        position: FloatPoint,
        delta: FloatPoint,
        nested_context_regions: NestedContextRegions,
    ) -> FirstWheelStepRoute {
        if admission != WheelRoutingAdmission::Accepted {
            return FirstWheelStepRoute {
                decision: input_routing_decision_for_wheel_step_not_admitted_by(admission),
                scroller: None,
            };
        }
        let scroll_target = self.hit_test_scroll_node_for_wheel(
            visual_context_tree,
            scroll_state_snapshot,
            position,
            delta,
            &|_| None,
            WheelStepDispatch::NotYetDispatched,
            nested_context_regions,
        );
        let mut route = FirstWheelStepRoute {
            decision: input_routing_decision_for_first_wheel_step(scroll_target.outcome),
            scroller: None,
        };
        if let Some(index) = scroll_target.scroll_node_index
            && let Some(node) = self.scroll_node_for_index(index)
        {
            route.scroller = Some(node.stable_node_id);
        }
        route
    }

    // Whether something painted above the given place in paint order takes pointer input at the position. It is taken
    // to be covered whenever that cannot be told.
    pub fn is_covered_by_hit_test_target_painted_after(
        &self,
        paint_order_index: u32,
        visual_context_tree: &AccumulatedVisualContextTree,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
        position: FloatPoint,
    ) -> bool {
        assert!(!self.cached_viewport_rects_are_stale);
        if self.visual_context_tree_structural_epoch != Some(visual_context_tree.structural_epoch()) {
            return true;
        }
        for target in self.cached_wheel_hit_test_targets.iter().rev() {
            if target.paint_order_index < paint_order_index {
                break;
            }
            if target.viewport_rect.is_some_and(|rect| !rect.contains_point(position)) {
                continue;
            }
            if !visual_context_tree.context_is_valid(target.context) {
                continue;
            }
            let position_in_context = visual_context_tree.transform_point_for_hit_test(
                target.context,
                position,
                scroll_state_snapshot,
                ClipBehavior::Respect,
            );
            if position_in_context.is_some_and(|point| wheel_hit_test_target_contains_point(target, point)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        false
    }

    pub fn scroll_node_for_keyboard_scroll(
        &self,
        stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
        delta: FloatPoint,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> Option<SpatialNodeIndex> {
        let node = self.scroll_node_for_stable_id(stable_node_id)?;
        // Keyboard routing does not depend on pointer or wheel-listener regions.
        if Self::can_scroll_node_by_delta(node, scroll_state_snapshot, delta) {
            return Some(node.scroll_node_index);
        }
        self.scrollable_ancestor_for_node(node.scroll_node_index, scroll_state_snapshot, delta)
    }

    pub fn clamped_scroll_offset_for_node(
        &self,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        scroll_offset: FloatPoint,
    ) -> FloatPoint {
        let Some(node) = self.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index) else {
            return scroll_offset;
        };
        Self::clamp_scroll_offset_to_node(node, scroll_offset)
    }

    pub fn scroll_node_is_viewport(&self, scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex) -> bool {
        self.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index)
            .is_some_and(|node| node.is_viewport)
    }

    // Whether the viewport keeps a scroll by the delta from the document it is nested in, whether or not it has a
    // scroll node.
    pub fn viewport_keeps_scrolls_along_main_axis_of(&self, delta: FloatPoint) -> bool {
        if delta_is_mainly_vertical(delta) {
            self.state.viewport_keeps_vertical_scrolls
        } else {
            self.state.viewport_keeps_horizontal_scrolls
        }
    }

    pub fn set_scroll_offset(
        &self,
        scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
        scroll_offset: FloatPoint,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &mut ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> Option<FloatPoint> {
        let node = self.scroll_node_for_index(scroll_node_index)?;
        Some(self.set_scroll_offset_of_node(node, scroll_offset, scroll_state_snapshot))
    }

    pub fn set_scroll_offset_of_node(
        &self,
        node: &AsyncScrollNode,
        scroll_offset: FloatPoint,
        scroll_state_snapshot: &mut ScrollStateSnapshot,
    ) -> FloatPoint {
        let new_scroll_offset = Self::clamp_scroll_offset_to_node(node, scroll_offset);
        scroll_state_snapshot.set_device_offset_for_index(
            node.scroll_node_index,
            FloatPoint {
                x: -new_scroll_offset.x,
                y: -new_scroll_offset.y,
            },
        );
        new_scroll_offset
    }
}

//! The scrolling state a display list carries for the compositor: scroll nodes, snap containers, wheel regions and
//! scrollbars.

use super::scroll_snap_selection::{SnapAlign, SnapAreaGeometry, SnapAxes, SnapContainerGeometry, SnapStrictness};
use super::{
    AsyncScrollNodeKind, AsyncScrollNodeStableID, AsyncScrollOffset, CompositorContextId, CompositorScrollNodeKind,
    ContextRef, DisplayList, InputRoutingDecision, SnapAreaIdentity, SpatialNodeIndex, UniqueNodeId,
};
use crate::css_pixels::{CssPixelPoint, CssPixelRect};
use crate::display_list::builder::read_command;
use crate::display_list::commands::*;
use crate::visual_context::{
    CompositorScrollNodeRecord, CompositorSnapAreaRecord, CompositorSnapContainerRecord, VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
    VisualContextTree,
};
use libgfx_rust::{CornerRadii, FloatPoint, FloatRect, IntRect};

pub type AsyncScrollOperationID = u64;

impl AsyncScrollOffset {
    pub fn merge_later_scroll(&mut self, later: &Self) {
        self.compositor_scroll_offset = later.compositor_scroll_offset;
        // The last of the main thread's scroll requests for the box that the compositor applied before it reported this.
        self.applied_scroll_request_id = later.applied_scroll_request_id;
        // How many times the compositor had scrolled the box for user input of its own when it reported this.
        self.user_input_scroll_count = later.user_input_scroll_count;
        // The scale the visual viewport was zoomed to, which only its scroll node reports.
        if later.visual_viewport_scale.is_some() {
            self.visual_viewport_scale = later.visual_viewport_scale;
        }
        // The most recent nonzero delta of a relative scroll in each axis, such as a wheel or panning scroll. Absolute
        // scrolls, such as dragging a scrollbar thumb, leave it as it is.
        if later.last_relative_scroll_delta.x != 0.0 {
            self.last_relative_scroll_delta.x = later.last_relative_scroll_delta.x;
        }
        if later.last_relative_scroll_delta.y != 0.0 {
            self.last_relative_scroll_delta.y = later.last_relative_scroll_delta.y;
        }
    }
}

// One scrollable area from the paint snapshot, or a scroll container with nothing to scroll that keeps its scrolls.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct AsyncScrollNode {
    pub scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
    pub stable_node_id: AsyncScrollNodeStableID,
    pub parent_scroll_node_index: Option<SpatialNodeIndex>,
    pub scrollport_rect: IntRect,
    pub min_scroll_offset: FloatPoint,
    pub max_scroll_offset: FloatPoint,
    pub is_viewport: bool,
    pub can_be_wheel_scrolled_horizontally: bool,
    pub can_be_wheel_scrolled_vertically: bool,
    // Whether a scroll the scroller cannot scroll by is passed on to the scrollers around it.
    pub chains_scroll_to_ancestors_horizontally: bool,
    pub chains_scroll_to_ancestors_vertically: bool,
    // Whether a touchpad may pull the scroller past the edges of its scroll range.
    pub shows_overscroll_effect_horizontally: bool,
    pub shows_overscroll_effect_vertically: bool,
}

// A region with a non-passive wheel listener. Wheels inside it must stay on the main thread because script may cancel.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub struct BlockingWheelEventRegion {
    pub context: ContextRef,
    pub rect: FloatRect,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub struct WheelHitTestTarget {
    pub context: ContextRef,
    pub rect: FloatRect,
    pub corner_radii: CornerRadii,
    pub target_scroll_node_index: Option<SpatialNodeIndex>,
    // Position among the wheel hit test targets and scrollbars of the display list, which are recorded in paint order.
    pub paint_order_index: u32,
}

// A region that must always use main-thread wheel routing even without a blocking listener, such as a nested navigable.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub struct MainThreadWheelEventRegion {
    pub context: ContextRef,
    pub rect: FloatRect,
}

// Where a nested context's content is painted. A wheel inside it that no wheel hit test target painted later covers
// can be handed to the nested context.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub struct NestedContextWheelRegion {
    pub context: ContextRef,
    pub rect: FloatRect,
    pub corner_radii: CornerRadii,
    pub child_context_id: CompositorContextId,
    pub paint_order_index: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
pub struct AsyncScrollbar {
    pub scroller_stable_node_id: Option<AsyncScrollNodeStableID>,
    pub scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
    // The rects of a scrollbar the display list paints are in the space of this context.
    pub context: ContextRef,
    pub paint_order_index: u32,
    pub thumb_rect: IntRect,
    pub track_rect: IntRect,
    pub expanded_gutter_rect: IntRect,
    pub expanded_thumb_rect: IntRect,
    pub scroll_size: f64,
    pub expanded_scroll_size: f64,
    pub min_scroll_offset: f32,
    pub max_scroll_offset: f32,
    pub vertical: bool,
    // The page takes no pointer input on a scrollbar of the viewport, which the compositor drags by itself.
    pub scrolls_viewport: bool,
}

// A scroll node that is a snap container, with the geometry snap positions are selected from.
pub struct AsyncSnapContainer {
    pub scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex,
    pub geometry: SnapContainerGeometry,
    pub areas: Vec<SnapAreaGeometry>,
}

pub struct AsyncScrollingState {
    pub document_id: Option<UniqueNodeId>,
    pub scroll_nodes: Vec<AsyncScrollNode>,
    pub snap_containers: Vec<AsyncSnapContainer>,
    pub wheel_hit_test_targets: Vec<WheelHitTestTarget>,
    pub main_thread_wheel_event_regions: Vec<MainThreadWheelEventRegion>,
    pub nested_context_wheel_regions: Vec<NestedContextWheelRegion>,
    pub scrollbars: Vec<AsyncScrollbar>,

    // Non-passive wheel listeners can cancel scrolling, so async scrolling must treat them as hard barriers.
    // Viewport-wide barriers cover listeners on the root targets; element regions let input hit-testing accept
    // async scrolling elsewhere.
    pub blocking_wheel_event_regions: Vec<BlockingWheelEventRegion>,
    pub viewport_rect: IntRect,

    // Bumped whenever wheel listener state changes so queued compositor snapshots
    // cannot re-enable async wheel routing after a non-passive listener has been
    // added.
    pub wheel_event_listener_state_generation: u64,
    pub has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners: bool,
    pub has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport: bool,
    pub viewport_keeps_horizontal_scrolls: bool,
    pub viewport_keeps_vertical_scrolls: bool,
    pub device_pixels_per_css_pixel: f64,
}

impl Default for AsyncScrollingState {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            document_id: Default::default(),
            scroll_nodes: Default::default(),
            snap_containers: Default::default(),
            wheel_hit_test_targets: Default::default(),
            main_thread_wheel_event_regions: Default::default(),
            nested_context_wheel_regions: Default::default(),
            scrollbars: Default::default(),
            blocking_wheel_event_regions: Default::default(),
            viewport_rect: Default::default(),
            wheel_event_listener_state_generation: Default::default(),
            has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners: false,
            has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport: false,
            viewport_keeps_horizontal_scrolls: false,
            viewport_keeps_vertical_scrolls: false,
            device_pixels_per_css_pixel: 1.0,
        }
    }
}

impl AsyncScrollingState {
    // Scroll offsets and the durations of scroll animations are calculated from these, and a number that is not finite,
    // or a scale that is not positive, leaves them with no value.
    pub fn has_only_numbers_scrolls_can_be_calculated_with(&self) -> bool {
        let is_finite = |point: FloatPoint| point.x.is_finite() && point.y.is_finite();
        self.device_pixels_per_css_pixel.is_finite()
            && self.device_pixels_per_css_pixel > 0.0
            && self
                .scroll_nodes
                .iter()
                .all(|node| is_finite(node.min_scroll_offset) && is_finite(node.max_scroll_offset))
            && self.scrollbars.iter().all(|scrollbar| {
                scrollbar.scroll_size.is_finite()
                    && scrollbar.expanded_scroll_size.is_finite()
                    && scrollbar.min_scroll_offset.is_finite()
                    && scrollbar.max_scroll_offset.is_finite()
            })
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum WheelRoutingAdmission {
    Accepted,
    NoAsyncScrollingState,
    BlockingWheelEventListeners,
    NoScrollNode,
    StaleWheelEventListeners,
}

pub fn async_scroll_node_kind_for(kind: CompositorScrollNodeKind) -> AsyncScrollNodeKind {
    match kind {
        CompositorScrollNodeKind::Viewport => AsyncScrollNodeKind::Viewport,
        CompositorScrollNodeKind::Element => AsyncScrollNodeKind::Element,
        CompositorScrollNodeKind::PseudoElement => AsyncScrollNodeKind::PseudoElement,
    }
}

fn stable_scroll_node_id_for(
    scrollable_node_id: UniqueNodeId,
    kind: CompositorScrollNodeKind,
    pseudo_element_type: u8,
) -> AsyncScrollNodeStableID {
    AsyncScrollNodeStableID {
        node_id: scrollable_node_id,
        kind: async_scroll_node_kind_for(kind),
        pseudo_element_type,
    }
}

fn async_scroll_node_from(node: &CompositorScrollNodeRecord) -> AsyncScrollNode {
    let parent_scroll_node_index =
        (node.parent_scroll_node_index != VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX).then_some(node.parent_scroll_node_index);
    AsyncScrollNode {
        scroll_node_index: node.scroll_node_index,
        stable_node_id: stable_scroll_node_id_for(
            node.scrollable_node_id,
            node.scroll_node_kind,
            node.pseudo_element_type,
        ),
        parent_scroll_node_index,
        scrollport_rect: node.scrollport_rect,
        min_scroll_offset: node.min_scroll_offset,
        max_scroll_offset: node.max_scroll_offset,
        is_viewport: node.is_viewport,
        can_be_wheel_scrolled_horizontally: node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_horizontally,
        can_be_wheel_scrolled_vertically: node.can_be_wheel_scrolled_vertically,
        chains_scroll_to_ancestors_horizontally: node.chains_scroll_to_ancestors_horizontally,
        chains_scroll_to_ancestors_vertically: node.chains_scroll_to_ancestors_vertically,
        shows_overscroll_effect_horizontally: node.shows_overscroll_effect_horizontally,
        shows_overscroll_effect_vertically: node.shows_overscroll_effect_vertically,
    }
}

fn snap_strictness_from(value: u8) -> Option<SnapStrictness> {
    match value {
        0 => Some(SnapStrictness::None),
        1 => Some(SnapStrictness::Proximity),
        2 => Some(SnapStrictness::Mandatory),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn snap_align_from(value: u8) -> Option<SnapAlign> {
    match value {
        0 => Some(SnapAlign::None),
        1 => Some(SnapAlign::Start),
        2 => Some(SnapAlign::End),
        3 => Some(SnapAlign::Center),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn async_snap_container_from(container: &CompositorSnapContainerRecord) -> Option<AsyncSnapContainer> {
    Some(AsyncSnapContainer {
        scroll_node_index: container.scroll_node_index,
        geometry: SnapContainerGeometry {
            snapport: container.snapport.into(),
            min_scroll_offset: container.min_scroll_offset.into(),
            max_scroll_offset: container.max_scroll_offset.into(),
            strictness: snap_strictness_from(container.strictness)?,
            axes: SnapAxes {
                x: container.snaps_x,
                y: container.snaps_y,
            },
            horizontal_writing_mode: container.horizontal_writing_mode,
        },
        areas: Vec::new(),
    })
}

fn snap_area_geometry_from(area: &CompositorSnapAreaRecord) -> Option<SnapAreaGeometry> {
    Some(SnapAreaGeometry {
        identity: SnapAreaIdentity {
            node_id: area.area_node_id,
            pseudo_element_type: area.pseudo_element_type,
        },
        rect: area.rect.into(),
        align_x: snap_align_from(area.align_x)?,
        align_y: snap_align_from(area.align_y)?,
        always_stop: area.always_stop,
    })
}

pub fn async_scrolling_state_from(
    display_list: &DisplayList,
    visual_context_tree: &VisualContextTree,
) -> AsyncScrollingState {
    let mut async_scrolling_state = AsyncScrollingState::default();
    let mut next_paint_order_index = 0u32;
    if let Some(metadata) = display_list.async_scrolling_metadata() {
        async_scrolling_state.document_id = metadata.document_id;
        async_scrolling_state.viewport_rect = metadata.viewport_rect;
        async_scrolling_state.wheel_event_listener_state_generation = metadata.wheel_event_listener_state_generation;
        async_scrolling_state.has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners = metadata.has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners;
        async_scrolling_state.has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport =
            metadata.has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport;
        async_scrolling_state.viewport_keeps_horizontal_scrolls = metadata.viewport_keeps_horizontal_scrolls;
        async_scrolling_state.viewport_keeps_vertical_scrolls = metadata.viewport_keeps_vertical_scrolls;
        async_scrolling_state.device_pixels_per_css_pixel = metadata.device_pixels_per_css_pixel;
    }
    let scroll_table = visual_context_tree.compositor_scroll_table();
    async_scrolling_state
        .scroll_nodes
        .extend(scroll_table.nodes.iter().map(async_scroll_node_from));
    for container in scroll_table.snap_containers.iter() {
        let Some(mut snap_container) = async_snap_container_from(container) else {
            continue;
        };
        let first_area_index = container.first_area_index as usize;
        let areas = &scroll_table.snap_areas[first_area_index..first_area_index + container.area_count as usize];
        snap_container
            .areas
            .extend(areas.iter().filter_map(snap_area_geometry_from));
        async_scrolling_state.snap_containers.push(snap_container);
    }
    display_list.for_each_compositor_metadata(|context, command_type, payload| {
        let mut append_wheel_hit_test_target = |target_scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex, rect, corner_radii| {
            let target_scroll_node_index = if target_scroll_node_index.0 != 0 {
                Some(target_scroll_node_index)
            } else {
                None
            };
            async_scrolling_state.wheel_hit_test_targets.push(WheelHitTestTarget {
                context,
                rect,
                corner_radii,
                target_scroll_node_index,
                paint_order_index: next_paint_order_index,
            });
            next_paint_order_index = next_paint_order_index.wrapping_add(1);
        };
        match command_type {
            DisplayListCommandType::CompositorBlockingWheelEventRegion => {
                let command = read_command::<CompositorBlockingWheelEventRegion>(payload);
                async_scrolling_state.has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners = true;
                async_scrolling_state
                    .blocking_wheel_event_regions
                    .push(BlockingWheelEventRegion {
                        context,
                        rect: command.rect,
                    });
            }
            DisplayListCommandType::CompositorWheelHitTestTarget => {
                let command = read_command::<CompositorWheelHitTestTarget>(payload);
                append_wheel_hit_test_target(command.target_scroll_node_index, command.rect, CornerRadii::default());
            }
            DisplayListCommandType::CompositorWheelHitTestTargetWithCornerRadii => {
                let command = read_command::<CompositorWheelHitTestTargetWithCornerRadii>(payload);
                append_wheel_hit_test_target(command.target_scroll_node_index, command.rect, command.corner_radii);
            }
            DisplayListCommandType::CompositorMainThreadWheelEventRegion => {
                let command = read_command::<CompositorMainThreadWheelEventRegion>(payload);
                async_scrolling_state
                    .main_thread_wheel_event_regions
                    .push(MainThreadWheelEventRegion {
                        context,
                        rect: command.rect,
                    });
            }
            DisplayListCommandType::CompositorNestedContextWheelRegion => {
                let command = read_command::<CompositorNestedContextWheelRegion>(payload);
                async_scrolling_state
                    .nested_context_wheel_regions
                    .push(NestedContextWheelRegion {
                        context,
                        rect: command.rect,
                        corner_radii: command.corner_radii,
                        child_context_id: command.child_context_id,
                        paint_order_index: next_paint_order_index,
                    });
                next_paint_order_index = next_paint_order_index.wrapping_add(1);
            }
            DisplayListCommandType::CompositorScrollbar => {
                let command = read_command::<CompositorScrollbar>(payload);
                async_scrolling_state.scrollbars.push(AsyncScrollbar {
                    scroller_stable_node_id: None,
                    scroll_node_index: command.scroll_node_index,
                    context,
                    paint_order_index: next_paint_order_index,
                    thumb_rect: command.thumb_rect,
                    track_rect: command.track_rect,
                    expanded_gutter_rect: command.expanded_gutter_rect,
                    expanded_thumb_rect: command.expanded_thumb_rect,
                    scroll_size: command.scroll_size,
                    expanded_scroll_size: command.expanded_scroll_size,
                    min_scroll_offset: command.min_scroll_offset,
                    max_scroll_offset: command.max_scroll_offset,
                    vertical: command.vertical,
                    scrolls_viewport: false,
                });
                next_paint_order_index = next_paint_order_index.wrapping_add(1);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    });
    for scrollbar in &mut async_scrolling_state.scrollbars {
        for scroll_node in &async_scrolling_state.scroll_nodes {
            if scroll_node.scroll_node_index == scrollbar.scroll_node_index {
                scrollbar.scroller_stable_node_id = Some(scroll_node.stable_node_id);
                scrollbar.scrolls_viewport = scroll_node.is_viewport;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    async_scrolling_state
}

fn snap_strictness_name(strictness: SnapStrictness) -> &'static str {
    match strictness {
        SnapStrictness::None => "none",
        SnapStrictness::Proximity => "proximity",
        SnapStrictness::Mandatory => "mandatory",
    }
}

fn snap_align_name(align: SnapAlign) -> &'static str {
    match align {
        SnapAlign::None => "none",
        SnapAlign::Start => "start",
        SnapAlign::End => "end",
        SnapAlign::Center => "center",
    }
}

fn rect_to_json(rect: CssPixelRect) -> String {
    format!(
        r#"{{"x":{},"y":{},"width":{},"height":{}}}"#,
        rect.x.to_double(),
        rect.y.to_double(),
        rect.width.to_double(),
        rect.height.to_double()
    )
}

fn point_to_json(point: CssPixelPoint) -> String {
    format!(r#"{{"x":{},"y":{}}}"#, point.x.to_double(), point.y.to_double())
}

fn int_rect_to_json(rect: IntRect) -> String {
    format!(
        r#"{{"x":{},"y":{},"width":{},"height":{}}}"#,
        rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height
    )
}

fn float_point_to_json(point: FloatPoint) -> String {
    format!(r#"{{"x":{},"y":{}}}"#, point.x, point.y)
}

pub fn async_scrolling_state_to_json(state: &AsyncScrollingState) -> String {
    let mut scroll_nodes = Vec::new();
    for scroll_node in &state.scroll_nodes {
        scroll_nodes.push(format!(
            r#"{{"scrollNodeIndex":{},"parentScrollNodeIndex":{},"isViewport":{},"scrollportRect":{},"minScrollOffset":{},"maxScrollOffset":{}}}"#,
            scroll_node.scroll_node_index.0,
            scroll_node.parent_scroll_node_index.map_or(0, |index| index.0),
            scroll_node.is_viewport,
            int_rect_to_json(scroll_node.scrollport_rect),
            float_point_to_json(scroll_node.min_scroll_offset),
            float_point_to_json(scroll_node.max_scroll_offset)
        ));
    }
    let mut snap_containers = Vec::new();
    for snap_container in &state.snap_containers {
        let mut areas = Vec::new();
        for snap_area in &snap_container.areas {
            areas.push(format!(
                r#"{{"nodeID":{},"pseudoElementType":{},"rect":{},"alignX":"{}","alignY":"{}","alwaysStop":{}}}"#,
                snap_area.identity.node_id.0,
                snap_area.identity.pseudo_element_type,
                rect_to_json(snap_area.rect),
                snap_align_name(snap_area.align_x),
                snap_align_name(snap_area.align_y),
                snap_area.always_stop
            ));
        }
        snap_containers.push(format!(r#"{{"scrollNodeIndex":{},"snapport":{},"minScrollOffset":{},"maxScrollOffset":{},"strictness":"{}","snapsX":{},"snapsY":{},"horizontalWritingMode":{},"areas":[{}]}}"#,
            snap_container.scroll_node_index.0, rect_to_json(snap_container.geometry.snapport), point_to_json(snap_container.geometry.min_scroll_offset),
            point_to_json(snap_container.geometry.max_scroll_offset), snap_strictness_name(snap_container.geometry.strictness), snap_container.geometry.axes.x,
            snap_container.geometry.axes.y, snap_container.geometry.horizontal_writing_mode, areas.join(",")));
    }
    format!(
        r#"{{"documentID":{},"scrollNodeCount":{},"scrollNodes":[{}],"snapContainers":[{}],"devicePixelsPerCssPixel":{},"hasBlockingWheelEventListeners":{},"blockingWheelEventRegionCount":{},"mainThreadWheelEventRegionCount":{},"nestedContextWheelRegionCount":{},"wheelEventListenerStateGeneration":{},"hasBlockingWheelEventRegionCoveringViewport":{}}}"#,
        state
            .document_id
            .map_or_else(|| "null".to_owned(), |id| id.0.to_string()),
        state.scroll_nodes.len(),
        scroll_nodes.join(","),
        snap_containers.join(","),
        if state.device_pixels_per_css_pixel.is_finite() {
            state.device_pixels_per_css_pixel.to_string()
        } else {
            "null".to_owned()
        },
        state.has_blocking_wheel_event_listeners,
        state.blocking_wheel_event_regions.len(),
        state.main_thread_wheel_event_regions.len(),
        state.nested_context_wheel_regions.len(),
        state.wheel_event_listener_state_generation,
        state.has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport
    )
}

pub fn wheel_routing_admission_for(state: &AsyncScrollingState) -> WheelRoutingAdmission {
    if state.has_blocking_wheel_event_region_covering_viewport {
        return WheelRoutingAdmission::BlockingWheelEventListeners;
    }
    if state.scroll_nodes.is_empty() {
        return WheelRoutingAdmission::NoScrollNode;
    }
    WheelRoutingAdmission::Accepted
}

// Why a wheel step that the admission does not let the compositor scroll before the page dispatches it is left to the
// page.
pub fn input_routing_decision_for_wheel_step_not_admitted_by(admission: WheelRoutingAdmission) -> InputRoutingDecision {
    match admission {
        WheelRoutingAdmission::Accepted => unreachable!(),
        WheelRoutingAdmission::NoAsyncScrollingState => InputRoutingDecision::NoAsyncScrollingState,
        WheelRoutingAdmission::BlockingWheelEventListeners => InputRoutingDecision::BlockingWheelEventListeners,
        WheelRoutingAdmission::NoScrollNode => InputRoutingDecision::NoScrollNode,
        WheelRoutingAdmission::StaleWheelEventListeners => InputRoutingDecision::StaleWheelEventListeners,
    }
}

// The admission of a scrolling state recorded before the newest change to the page's blocking wheel event listeners is
// stale, as the state may not have the regions that change made.
pub fn wheel_routing_admission_for_with_generation(
    state: &AsyncScrollingState,
    newest_wheel_event_listener_state_generation: u64,
) -> WheelRoutingAdmission {
    if state.wheel_event_listener_state_generation < newest_wheel_event_listener_state_generation {
        return WheelRoutingAdmission::StaleWheelEventListeners;
    }
    wheel_routing_admission_for(state)
}

impl crate::ipc_types::Compositing_RequestedRelativeScroll {
    pub fn applied_to(&self, offset: FloatPoint) -> FloatPoint {
        let clamp = |value: f32, min: f32, max: f32| {
            if value > max {
                max
            } else if value < min {
                min
            } else {
                value
            }
        };
        FloatPoint {
            x: clamp(offset.x + self.delta.x, self.lower_bound.x, self.upper_bound.x),
            y: clamp(offset.y + self.delta.y, self.lower_bound.y, self.upper_bound.y),
        }
    }
}

impl crate::ipc_types::Compositing_RequestedSmoothScroll {
    pub fn relative_scroll(&self) -> crate::ipc_types::Compositing_RequestedRelativeScroll {
        assert!(self.destination_is_relative);
        crate::ipc_types::Compositing_RequestedRelativeScroll {
            delta: self.destination_offset,
            lower_bound: self.relative_lower_bound,
            upper_bound: self.relative_upper_bound,
        }
    }
}

//! Everything about a list that travels alongside its chunks when it is sent to the Compositor.

use super::ContextRef;
use crate::display_list::builder::read_command;
use crate::display_list::commands::{DisplayListCommandType, PaintCaret};
use crate::display_list::storage::DisplayListStorage;
use crate::display_list::summary::LiveContent;
use crate::display_list::window::RecordedWindow;
use libgfx_rust::Color;
use std::sync::Arc;

pub use crate::ipc_types::Compositing_AsyncScrollingMetadata as AsyncScrollingMetadata;

pub struct DisplayList {
    pub(crate) storage: Arc<DisplayListStorage>,
    id: u64,
    compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: u64,
    async_scrolling_metadata: Option<AsyncScrollingMetadata>,
    surface_clear_color: Option<Color>,
    root_group_color: Color,
    window: Option<RecordedWindow>,
}

impl DisplayList {
    pub fn new(
        storage: Arc<DisplayListStorage>,
        id: u64,
        compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch: u64,
        async_scrolling_metadata: Option<AsyncScrollingMetadata>,
        surface_clear_color: Option<Color>,
        root_group_color: Color,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            storage,
            id,
            compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch,
            async_scrolling_metadata,
            surface_clear_color,
            root_group_color,
            window: None,
        }
    }

    /// The list, which holds what shows in `window` rather than the whole document where it has one.
    pub fn with_window(self, window: Option<RecordedWindow>) -> Self {
        Self { window, ..self }
    }

    pub fn window(&self) -> Option<&RecordedWindow> {
        self.window.as_ref()
    }

    pub fn storage(&self) -> &Arc<DisplayListStorage> {
        &self.storage
    }

    // What the surface a frame of the list is painted into is cleared to first, none for transparent.
    pub fn surface_clear_color(&self) -> Option<Color> {
        self.surface_clear_color
    }

    // What the backdrop of an effect directly under the root group reads, outside every layer.
    pub fn root_group_color(&self) -> Color {
        self.root_group_color
    }

    pub fn compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch(&self) -> u64 {
        self.compatible_visual_context_tree_structural_epoch
    }

    pub fn id(&self) -> u64 {
        self.id
    }

    pub fn async_scrolling_metadata(&self) -> Option<&AsyncScrollingMetadata> {
        self.async_scrolling_metadata.as_ref()
    }

    // Visits the compositor metadata commands with the context of their run and their payload, in tape order.
    pub fn for_each_compositor_metadata(&self, visit: impl FnMut(ContextRef, DisplayListCommandType, &[u8])) {
        self.storage.for_each_compositor_metadata(visit);
    }

    // Visits the carets the list draws outside of any group.
    pub fn for_each_caret(&self, mut visit: impl FnMut(&PaintCaret)) {
        for live_content_record in &self.storage.summary().live_content_records {
            if live_content_record.content != LiveContent::Caret {
                continue;
            }
            let (header, payload) = self.storage.record_at(live_content_record.record.position);
            if header.command_type == DisplayListCommandType::PaintCaret {
                visit(&read_command::<PaintCaret>(payload));
            }
        }
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibCompositing/Rust/src/scrolling/elastic_overscroll.rs
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
