        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&bytes).is_err());
    }

    fn encode_tree(tree: &VisualContextTree) -> Vec<u8> {
        tree.to_bytes()
    }

    fn encoded_size<T: Encode>(value: &T) -> usize {
        let mut encoder = Encoder::new();
        encoder.encode(value).unwrap();
        encoder.finish().0.len()
    }

    fn hostile_tree() -> VisualContextTree {
        let mut tree = VisualContextTree::create(transform(FloatMatrix4x4::identity()));
        tree.append_spatial(
            SpatialData::Scroll(ScrollData {
                state_slot: NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT,
                owner_paintable: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            }),
            VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        );
        tree.append_spatial(
            SpatialData::Sticky(StickyData::unconstrained(
                SpatialNodeIndex(1),
                None,
                NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT,
                NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            )),
            SpatialNodeIndex(1),
        );
        // Clips: c0 at the root, c1 under it in s2. Effects: e0 at the root under no clip, e1 under
        // e0 begins under local clip c0.
        tree.append_clip(
            ClipNodeData::rect_clip(FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0)),
            ClipNodeIndex::NONE,
            VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        );
        tree.append_clip(
            ClipNodeData::Rect(ClipData {
                rect: FloatRect::default(),
                corner_radii: CornerRadii::default(),
                mode: ClipMode::Intersect,
            }),
            ClipNodeIndex(0),
            SpatialNodeIndex(2),
        );
        tree.append_effect(
            EffectNodeData::Effects(EffectsData {
                isolation: false,
                opacity: 1.0,
                blend_mode: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
                filter: None,
                backdrop_filter: None,
            }),
            EffectNodeIndex::NONE,
            VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
            ClipNodeIndex::NONE,
        );
        tree.append_effect(
            EffectNodeData::Effects(EffectsData {
                isolation: false,
                opacity: 0.5,
                blend_mode: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
                filter: None,
                backdrop_filter: None,
            }),
            EffectNodeIndex(0),
            SpatialNodeIndex(2),
            ClipNodeIndex(0),
        );
        tree
    }

    #[test]
    fn references_to_nodes_stored_after_the_node_are_accepted() {
        let mut child_stored_below_its_parent = hostile_tree();
        child_stored_below_its_parent.spatial_nodes[1].parent = SpatialNodeIndex(2);
        child_stored_below_its_parent.spatial_nodes[2] = SpatialNode {
            data: SpatialData::Transform(transform(translation_matrix(5.0, 5.0, 0.0))),
            parent: VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        };
        child_stored_below_its_parent.clip_nodes[0].parent = ClipNodeIndex(1);
        child_stored_below_its_parent.clip_nodes[1].parent = ClipNodeIndex::NONE;
        child_stored_below_its_parent.effect_nodes[0].parent = EffectNodeIndex(1);
        child_stored_below_its_parent.effect_nodes[1].parent = EffectNodeIndex::NONE;
        child_stored_below_its_parent.effect_nodes[1].local_clip = ClipNodeIndex::NONE;
        child_stored_below_its_parent.effect_nodes[0].local_clip = ClipNodeIndex(1);
        let decoded = VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&child_stored_below_its_parent))
            .expect("acyclic forward references decode");
        assert_eq!(decoded.spatial_dependency_order(), vec![0, 2, 1]);
        assert_eq!(decoded.clip_dependency_order(), vec![1, 0]);
        assert_eq!(decoded.effect_dependency_order(), vec![1, 0]);
        assert_eq!(
            super::super::WorldTransforms::new(&decoded, &[], None).transform_rect_to_viewport(
                SpatialNodeIndex(1),
                FloatRect::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0),
                super::super::IncludeVisualViewportTransform::Yes
            ),
            FloatRect::new(5.0, 5.0, 10.0, 10.0)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn reference_cycles_self_references_and_wrong_kinds_are_rejected() {
        let mut parent_cycle = hostile_tree();
        parent_cycle.spatial_nodes[1].parent = SpatialNodeIndex(2);
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&parent_cycle)).is_err());

        let mut self_parented = hostile_tree();
        self_parented.spatial_nodes[1].parent = SpatialNodeIndex(1);
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&self_parented)).is_err());

        let mut root_with_a_parent = hostile_tree();
        root_with_a_parent.spatial_nodes[0].parent = SpatialNodeIndex(1);
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&root_with_a_parent)).is_err());

        let mut sticky_parent_cycle = hostile_tree();
        sticky_parent_cycle.spatial_nodes[1] = SpatialNode {
            data: SpatialData::Sticky(StickyData::unconstrained(
                VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
                Some(SpatialNodeIndex(2)),
                NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT,
                NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            )),
            parent: VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        };
        sticky_parent_cycle.spatial_nodes[2] = SpatialNode {
            data: SpatialData::Sticky(StickyData::unconstrained(
                VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
                Some(SpatialNodeIndex(1)),
                NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT,
                NodeSlotId::INVALID,
            )),
            parent: VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        };
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&sticky_parent_cycle)).is_err());

        let mut parent_out_of_range = hostile_tree();
        parent_out_of_range.spatial_nodes[1].parent = SpatialNodeIndex(7);
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&parent_out_of_range)).is_err());

        let mut plane_root_out_of_range = hostile_tree();
        plane_root_out_of_range.spatial_nodes[1].data = SpatialData::BackfaceVisibility(BackfaceVisibilityData {
            plane_root_index: SpatialNodeIndex(9),
            flattens_inherited_transform: false,
        });
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&plane_root_out_of_range)).is_err());

        let mut root_is_not_a_transform = hostile_tree();
        root_is_not_a_transform.spatial_nodes[0].data = SpatialData::Scroll(ScrollData {
            state_slot: NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT,
            owner_paintable: NodeSlotId::INVALID,
        });
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&root_is_not_a_transform)).is_err());

        let mut sorting_root_cycle = hostile_tree();
        sorting_root_cycle.spatial_nodes[0].data = SpatialData::Transform(TransformData {
            sorting_context_root_index: Some(SpatialNodeIndex(1)),
            ..transform(FloatMatrix4x4::identity())
        });
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&sorting_root_cycle)).is_err());

        let mut sticky_scroller_is_not_a_scroll_node = hostile_tree();
        sticky_scroller_is_not_a_scroll_node.spatial_nodes[1].data = SpatialData::Perspective(PerspectiveData {
            matrix: FloatMatrix4x4::identity(),
            flattens_inherited_transform: false,
        });
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&sticky_scroller_is_not_a_scroll_node)).is_err());

        let mut sticky_parent_is_not_sticky = hostile_tree();
        sticky_parent_is_not_sticky.spatial_nodes[2].data = SpatialData::Sticky(StickyData::unconstrained(
            SpatialNodeIndex(1),
            Some(SpatialNodeIndex(1)),
            NO_SCROLL_STATE_SLOT,
            NodeSlotId::INVALID,
        ));
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&sticky_parent_is_not_sticky)).is_err());

        let mut plane_root_cycle = hostile_tree();
        plane_root_cycle.spatial_nodes[1].data = SpatialData::BackfaceVisibility(BackfaceVisibilityData {
            plane_root_index: SpatialNodeIndex(2),
            flattens_inherited_transform: false,
        });
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&plane_root_cycle)).is_err());

        let mut plane_root_on_another_branch = hostile_tree();
        plane_root_on_another_branch.spatial_nodes[2].parent = VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX;
        plane_root_on_another_branch.spatial_nodes[2].data = SpatialData::BackfaceVisibility(BackfaceVisibilityData {
            plane_root_index: SpatialNodeIndex(1),
            flattens_inherited_transform: false,
        });
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&plane_root_on_another_branch)).is_err());

        let mut plane_root_on_the_root_path = hostile_tree();
        plane_root_on_the_root_path.spatial_nodes[2].data = SpatialData::BackfaceVisibility(BackfaceVisibilityData {
            plane_root_index: SpatialNodeIndex(1),
            flattens_inherited_transform: false,
        });
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&plane_root_on_the_root_path)).is_ok());

        let mut anchor_node_names_itself = hostile_tree();
        anchor_node_names_itself.spatial_nodes[1].data = SpatialData::AnchorScrollShift(AnchorScrollShift {
            scroll_node_index: SpatialNodeIndex(1),
            negate: false,
            compensate_horizontal_scroll: true,
            compensate_vertical_scroll: true,
        });
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&anchor_node_names_itself)).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn clip_and_effect_reference_cycles_and_ranges_are_rejected() {
        let rejected = |tree: &VisualContextTree| assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(tree)).is_err());

        let mut clip_parent_cycle = hostile_tree();
        clip_parent_cycle.clip_nodes[0].parent = ClipNodeIndex(1);
        rejected(&clip_parent_cycle);

        let mut clip_parent_out_of_range = hostile_tree();
        clip_parent_out_of_range.clip_nodes[1].parent = ClipNodeIndex(4);
        rejected(&clip_parent_out_of_range);

        let mut clip_spatial_out_of_range = hostile_tree();
        clip_spatial_out_of_range.clip_nodes[1].spatial = SpatialNodeIndex(3);
        rejected(&clip_spatial_out_of_range);

        let mut effect_parent_cycle = hostile_tree();
        effect_parent_cycle.effect_nodes[0].parent = EffectNodeIndex(1);
        rejected(&effect_parent_cycle);

        let mut effect_parent_out_of_range = hostile_tree();
        effect_parent_out_of_range.effect_nodes[1].parent = EffectNodeIndex(4);
        rejected(&effect_parent_out_of_range);

        let mut effect_spatial_out_of_range = hostile_tree();
        effect_spatial_out_of_range.effect_nodes[1].spatial = SpatialNodeIndex(3);
        rejected(&effect_spatial_out_of_range);

        let mut local_clip_out_of_range = hostile_tree();
        local_clip_out_of_range.effect_nodes[1].local_clip = ClipNodeIndex(9);
        rejected(&local_clip_out_of_range);

        let mut isolation_effect_out_of_range = hostile_tree();
        isolation_effect_out_of_range.root_isolation_effect = Some(EffectNodeIndex(2));
        rejected(&isolation_effect_out_of_range);

        let mut isolation_effect_is_a_mask = hostile_tree();
        isolation_effect_is_a_mask.effect_nodes[0].data = EffectNodeData::Mask(MaskData {
            rect: IntRect::new(0, 0, 1, 1),
            kind: MaskKind::Alpha,
            origin: MaskLayerOrigin::CssMaskLayers,
            masks_backdrop: false,
        });
        isolation_effect_is_a_mask.root_isolation_effect = Some(EffectNodeIndex(0));
        rejected(&isolation_effect_is_a_mask);

        // The isolation layer must be a root effect.
        let mut isolation_effect_has_a_parent = hostile_tree();
        isolation_effect_has_a_parent.root_isolation_effect = Some(EffectNodeIndex(1));
        rejected(&isolation_effect_has_a_parent);

        let mut isolation_effect_at_the_root = hostile_tree();
        isolation_effect_at_the_root.root_isolation_effect = Some(EffectNodeIndex(0));
        assert!(VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&encode_tree(&isolation_effect_at_the_root)).is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn out_of_range_discriminants_and_absurd_counts_are_rejected() {
        let tree = hostile_tree();
        let bytes = tree.to_bytes();
        let count_size = size_of::<u32>();
        let index_size = size_of::<u32>();
        let spatial_count_offset = encoded_size(&tree.structural_epoch) + encoded_size(&tree.root_isolation_effect);
        let clip_count_offset = spatial_count_offset + encoded_size(&tree.spatial_nodes);
        let effect_count_offset = clip_count_offset + encoded_size(&tree.clip_nodes);

        let root_spatial_kind_offset = spatial_count_offset + count_size + index_size;
        let mut bad_spatial_kind = bytes.clone();
        bad_spatial_kind[root_spatial_kind_offset] = 200;
        assert_eq!(
            VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&bad_spatial_kind).err(),
            Some(DecodeError::InvalidValue("SpatialData"))
        );

        for count_offset in [spatial_count_offset, clip_count_offset, effect_count_offset] {
            let mut absurd_count = bytes.clone();
            absurd_count[count_offset..count_offset + count_size].copy_from_slice(&u32::MAX.to_ne_bytes());
            assert_eq!(
                VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&absurd_count).err(),
                Some(DecodeError::UnexpectedEnd),
                "an absurd count at byte {count_offset} decoded"
            );
        }

        // A clip node's kind follows its parent and spatial indices.
        let first_clip_kind_offset = clip_count_offset + count_size + 2 * index_size;
        let mut bad_clip_kind = bytes.clone();
        bad_clip_kind[first_clip_kind_offset] = 200;
        assert_eq!(
            VisualContextTree::from_bytes(&bad_clip_kind).err(),
            Some(DecodeError::InvalidValue("ClipNodeData"))
        );
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibCompositing/Rust/src/visual_context/visual_animations.rs
/*

//! The compositor animations a visual context tree carries, and the trees derived by sampling them.

use super::{
    ClipBehavior, ClipNodeIndex, ContextRef, EffectNodeData, EffectNodeIndex, EffectsData, SpatialData,
    SpatialNodeIndex, VisualContextTree, WorldTransforms,
};
use crate::filter_bytes::filter_functions_graph;
use crate::host::{FfiVisualAnimationSummary, FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind};
use crate::visual_animation::{VisualAnimation, VisualAnimationSample, VisualAnimationValue};
use libgfx_rust::FloatPoint;
use libgfx_rust::filter::Filter;

/// What the animations of a tree animate, per node, worked out once as they are set, so that the copies of the tree
/// that share the animations share it too.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct VisualAnimationTargets {
    effect_targets: Vec<AnimatedEffect>,
    transform_animation_leaves_plane_by_spatial_index: Vec<bool>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
struct AnimatedEffect {
    opacity_or_filter_is_animated: bool,
    filter_is_animated: bool,
    some_keyframe_filter_spreads: bool,
}

impl VisualAnimationTargets {
    fn of(animations: &[VisualAnimation]) -> Self {
        let mut targets = Self::default();
        for animation in animations {
            match animation.target_kind {
                FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Opacity | FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Filter => {
                    let is_filter = animation.target_kind == FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Filter;
                    let some_keyframe_filter_spreads = is_filter
                        && animation.keyframes.iter().any(|keyframe| {
                            matches!(&keyframe.value, VisualAnimationValue::Filter(functions)
                                if filter_functions_graph(functions.iter().copied().map(Filter::from))
                                    .is_some_and(|graph| graph.may_affect_output_bounds()))
                        });
                    for &node_index in &animation.node_indices {
                        let index = node_index as usize;
                        if targets.effect_targets.len() <= index {
                            targets.effect_targets.resize(index + 1, AnimatedEffect::default());
                        }
                        let target = &mut targets.effect_targets[index];
                        target.opacity_or_filter_is_animated = true;
                        target.filter_is_animated |= is_filter;
                        target.some_keyframe_filter_spreads |= some_keyframe_filter_spreads;
                    }
                }
                FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform => {
                    if crate::display_list::animated_transform_spaces::transform_animation_stays_in_plane(animation) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    for &node_index in &animation.node_indices {
                        let index = node_index as usize;
                        let leaves_plane = &mut targets.transform_animation_leaves_plane_by_spatial_index;
                        if leaves_plane.len() <= index {
                            leaves_plane.resize(index + 1, false);
                        }
                        leaves_plane[index] = true;
                    }
                }
                FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::BackgroundColor => {}
            }
        }
        targets
    }

    fn effect(&self, effect: EffectNodeIndex) -> AnimatedEffect {
        self.effect_targets.get(effect.0 as usize).copied().unwrap_or_default()
    }
}

impl VisualContextTree {
    pub fn visual_animations(&self) -> &[VisualAnimation] {
        &self.visual_animations
    }

    pub fn has_visual_animations(&self) -> bool {
        !self.visual_animations.is_empty()
    }

    pub fn set_visual_animations(&mut self, animations: Vec<VisualAnimation>) {
        self.visual_animation_targets = std::sync::Arc::new(VisualAnimationTargets::of(&animations));
        self.visual_animations = std::sync::Arc::from(animations);
    }

    pub fn clear_visual_animations(&mut self) {
        if self.has_visual_animations() {
            self.visual_animations = std::sync::Arc::from(Vec::new());
            self.visual_animation_targets = std::sync::Arc::default();
        }
    }

    /// Whether an opacity or filter animation of the tree animates the effect node.
    pub fn effect_opacity_or_filter_is_animated(&self, effect: EffectNodeIndex) -> bool {
        self.visual_animation_targets
            .effect(effect)
            .opacity_or_filter_is_animated
    }

    /// Whether a filter animation of the tree animates the effect node.
    pub fn effect_filter_is_animated(&self, effect: EffectNodeIndex) -> bool {
        self.visual_animation_targets.effect(effect).filter_is_animated
    }

    /// Whether the filter a keyframe of a filter animation of the effect node gives it can spread what it filters
    /// outside its bounds.
    pub fn some_keyframe_filter_of_effect_spreads(&self, effect: EffectNodeIndex) -> bool {
        self.visual_animation_targets
            .effect(effect)
            .some_keyframe_filter_spreads
    }

    /// Whether a transform animation of the tree that turns what it transforms out of the plane at some sample
    /// animates the spatial node.
    pub fn transform_animation_of_node_leaves_plane(&self, node: SpatialNodeIndex) -> bool {
        self.visual_animation_targets
            .transform_animation_leaves_plane_by_spatial_index
            .get(node.0 as usize)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(false)
    }

    /// Whether a transform animation of the tree animates a plane of a 3D sorting context, whose samples can hold the
    /// plane in the plane of its context where the tree turns it out of it, or the other way around.
    pub fn transform_animation_animates_plane_of_sorting_context(&self) -> bool {
        self.visual_animations
            .iter()
            .filter(|animation| animation.target_kind == FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform)
            .flat_map(|animation| animation.node_indices.iter())
            .any(|&node_index| {
                matches!(self.spatial_nodes.get(node_index as usize).map(|node| &node.data),
                    Some(SpatialData::Transform(transform)) if transform.sorting_context_root_index.is_some())
            })
    }

    pub fn shared_visual_animations(&self) -> std::sync::Arc<[VisualAnimation]> {
        self.visual_animations.clone()
    }

    fn effects_mut(&mut self, node_index: u32) -> Option<&mut EffectsData> {
        match self
            .effect_nodes
            .get_mut(node_index as usize)
            .map(|node| &mut node.data)
        {
            Some(EffectNodeData::Effects(effects)) => Some(effects),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    /// A copy of the tree whose nodes carry the values the animations take at `sample_time_ns`. An
    /// animation that has no value at that time, because it is dormant or its timing cannot be
    /// resolved, leaves its nodes as the main thread published them.
    pub fn with_visual_animation_samples(&self, sample_time_ns: i64) -> Self {
        let mut sampled = self.clone();
        sampled.animation_samples_taken_from_copy =
            super::AnimationSamplesTakenFromCopy(Some(self.copy_without_animation_samples()));
        sampled.sampled_background_color_by_effect_index.clear();
        for animation in self.visual_animations.iter() {
            let Some(sample) = animation.sample(animation.elapsed_since_anchor_ns(sample_time_ns)) else {
                continue;
            };
            for &node_index in &animation.node_indices {
                match &sample {
                    VisualAnimationSample::Opacity(opacity) => {
                        if let Some(effects) = sampled.effects_mut(node_index) {
                            effects.opacity = *opacity;
                        }
                    }
                    VisualAnimationSample::BackgroundColor(color) => {
                        sampled
                            .sampled_background_color_by_effect_index
                            .insert(node_index, *color);
                    }
                    VisualAnimationSample::Filter(filter) => {
                        if let Some(effects) = sampled.effects_mut(node_index) {
                            effects.filter = filter.clone();
                        }
                    }
                    VisualAnimationSample::Transform(matrix) => {
                        if let Some(SpatialData::Transform(transform)) = sampled
                            .spatial_nodes
                            .get_mut(node_index as usize)
                            .map(|node| &mut node.data)
                        {
                            transform.matrix = *matrix;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        sampled
    }

    pub fn has_active_visual_animation_at(&self, sample_time_ns: i64) -> bool {
        self.visual_animations
            .iter()
            .any(|animation| animation.is_active_at(sample_time_ns))
    }

    /// Whether `screen_point` lies in the bounds of a node that a transform animation running at `sample_time_ns`
    /// moves, through the values the nodes hold: those of this tree sampled at that time, where a frame shows it.
    pub fn running_transform_animation_covers_point(
        &self,
        sample_time_ns: i64,
        screen_point: FloatPoint,
        scroll_offsets: &[FloatPoint],
    ) -> bool {
        let world = std::cell::OnceCell::new();
        self.visual_animations.iter().any(|animation| {
            animation.target_kind == FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform
                && animation.is_active_at(sample_time_ns)
                && animation.node_indices.iter().any(|&node_index| {
                    let Some(SpatialData::Transform(transform)) =
                        self.spatial_nodes.get(node_index as usize).map(|node| &node.data)
                    else {
                        return false;
                    };
                    let context = ContextRef {
                        spatial: SpatialNodeIndex(node_index),
                        clip: ClipNodeIndex::NONE,
                        effect: EffectNodeIndex::NONE,
                    };
                    let world = world.get_or_init(|| WorldTransforms::new(self, scroll_offsets, None));
                    self.transform_point_for_hit_test(world, context, screen_point, ClipBehavior::Ignore)
                        .is_some_and(|local_point| transform.bounds.contains_point(local_point))
                })
        })
    }

    pub fn visual_animations_target_valid_nodes(&self) -> bool {
        self.visual_animations
            .iter()
            .all(|animation| self.visual_animation_targets_are_valid(animation.target_kind, &animation.node_indices))
    }

    pub fn visual_animation_summary(&self) -> FfiVisualAnimationSummary {
        let Some(first) = self.visual_animations.first() else {
            return FfiVisualAnimationSummary {
                count: 0,
                local_time_at_anchor_ms_of_first: 0.0,
                share_timing_anchor: true,
                targets_are_valid: true,
            };
        };
        FfiVisualAnimationSummary {
            count: self.visual_animations.len(),
            local_time_at_anchor_ms_of_first: first.local_time_at_anchor_ms,
            share_timing_anchor: self.visual_animations.iter().all(|animation| {
                animation.monotonic_time_at_anchor_ns == first.monotonic_time_at_anchor_ns
                    && animation.local_time_at_anchor_ms == first.local_time_at_anchor_ms
            }),
            targets_are_valid: self.visual_animations_target_valid_nodes(),
        }
    }

    /// One flag per spatial node: whether a transform animation moves the node or an ancestor.
    pub fn spatial_nodes_in_subtrees_of_transform_animations(&self) -> Vec<bool> {
        let roots: Vec<SpatialNodeIndex> = self
            .visual_animations
            .iter()
            .filter(|animation| animation.target_kind == FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform)
            .flat_map(|animation| animation.node_indices.iter().map(|&index| SpatialNodeIndex(index)))
            .collect();
        self.spatial_nodes_in_subtrees_of(&roots)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::animation_timing::{AnimationEffectTiming, TimeValue};
    use crate::easing::Easing;
    use crate::host::FfiVisualAnimationTransformOperationKind;
    use crate::visual_animation::{VisualAnimationKeyframe, VisualAnimationTransformOperation};
    use crate::visual_context::{
        ClipNodeIndex, EffectsData, TransformData, TransformDataRole, VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
    };
    use libgfx_rust::{CompositingAndBlendingOperator, FloatMatrix4x4, FloatPoint, translation_matrix};

    fn transform_data(matrix: FloatMatrix4x4) -> TransformData {
        TransformData {
            matrix,
            origin: FloatPoint { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 },
            sorting_context_root_index: None,
            flattens_inherited_transform: false,
            role: TransformDataRole::CssTransform,
            synthetic_plane: false,
            establishes_sorting_context: false,
            bounds: libgfx_rust::FloatRect::default(),
        }
    }

    fn opacity_effect() -> EffectNodeData {
        EffectNodeData::Effects(EffectsData {
            isolation: false,
            opacity: 1.0,
            blend_mode: CompositingAndBlendingOperator::Normal,
            filter: None,
            backdrop_filter: None,
        })
    }

    fn keyframe(offset: f64, value: VisualAnimationValue) -> VisualAnimationKeyframe {
        VisualAnimationKeyframe {
            offset,
            easing: Easing::default(),
            value,
        }
    }

    fn translate_x(pixels: f32) -> VisualAnimationValue {
        VisualAnimationValue::Transform(vec![
            VisualAnimationTransformOperation::new(FfiVisualAnimationTransformOperationKind::TranslateX, &[pixels])
                .unwrap(),
        ])
    }

    fn milliseconds(value: i64) -> i64 {
        value * 1_000_000
    }

    #[test]
    fn sampling_derives_a_tree_and_leaves_the_source_untouched() {
        let mut tree = VisualContextTree::create(transform_data(FloatMatrix4x4::identity()));
        let spatial = tree.append_spatial(
            SpatialData::Transform(transform_data(FloatMatrix4x4::identity())),
            VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        );
        let effect = tree.append_effect(opacity_effect(), EffectNodeIndex::NONE, spatial, ClipNodeIndex::NONE);
        tree.set_visual_animations(vec![
            VisualAnimation {
                target_kind: FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform,
                node_indices: vec![spatial.0],
                timing: AnimationEffectTiming {
                    iteration_duration: TimeValue::milliseconds(1000.0),
                    ..VisualAnimation::default().timing
                },
                keyframes: vec![keyframe(0.0, translate_x(0.0)), keyframe(1.0, translate_x(20.0))],
                ..VisualAnimation::default()
            },
            VisualAnimation {
                target_kind: FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Opacity,
                node_indices: vec![effect.0],
                timing: AnimationEffectTiming {
                    iteration_duration: TimeValue::milliseconds(1000.0),
                    ..VisualAnimation::default().timing
                },
                keyframes: vec![
                    keyframe(0.0, VisualAnimationValue::Opacity(0.0)),
                    keyframe(1.0, VisualAnimationValue::Opacity(1.0)),
                ],
                ..VisualAnimation::default()
            },
        ]);
        assert!(tree.has_visual_animations());
        assert!(tree.visual_animations_target_valid_nodes());

        let sampled = tree.with_visual_animation_samples(milliseconds(500));
        assert_eq!(sampled.structural_epoch, tree.structural_epoch);
        assert_eq!(sampled.visual_animations().len(), 2);
        let SpatialData::Transform(sampled_transform) = &sampled.spatial_nodes[spatial.0 as usize].data else {
            panic!("not a transform node");
        };
        assert_eq!(sampled_transform.matrix, translation_matrix(10.0, 0.0, 0.0));
        assert_eq!(sampled.effects_opacity(effect), Some(0.5));

        let SpatialData::Transform(source_transform) = &tree.spatial_nodes[spatial.0 as usize].data else {
            panic!("not a transform node");
        };
        assert_eq!(source_transform.matrix, FloatMatrix4x4::identity());
        assert_eq!(tree.effects_opacity(effect), Some(1.0));

        let flags = tree.spatial_nodes_in_subtrees_of_transform_animations();
        assert_eq!(flags, vec![false, true]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_dormant_animation_leaves_its_node_as_published() {
        let mut tree = VisualContextTree::create(transform_data(FloatMatrix4x4::identity()));
        let spatial = tree.append_spatial(
            SpatialData::Transform(transform_data(translation_matrix(5.0, 0.0, 0.0))),
            VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        );
        tree.set_visual_animations(vec![VisualAnimation {
            target_kind: FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform,
            node_indices: vec![spatial.0],
            timing: AnimationEffectTiming {
                start_delay: TimeValue::milliseconds(1000.0),
                iteration_duration: TimeValue::milliseconds(1000.0),
                ..VisualAnimation::default().timing
            },
            keyframes: vec![keyframe(0.0, translate_x(0.0)), keyframe(1.0, translate_x(20.0))],
            ..VisualAnimation::default()
        }]);

        assert!(!tree.has_active_visual_animation_at(milliseconds(500)));
        assert!(tree.has_active_visual_animation_at(milliseconds(1500)));
        let sampled = tree.with_visual_animation_samples(milliseconds(500));
        let SpatialData::Transform(sampled_transform) = &sampled.spatial_nodes[spatial.0 as usize].data else {
            panic!("not a transform node");
        };
        assert_eq!(sampled_transform.matrix, translation_matrix(5.0, 0.0, 0.0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_running_transform_animation_covers_a_point_in_the_bounds_it_moves() {
        let mut tree = VisualContextTree::create(transform_data(FloatMatrix4x4::identity()));
        // A box from x 150 to 1150 slides 150 pixels a second to the left: it covers x 50 from 2/3 s to 7 1/3 s in.
        let spatial = tree.append_spatial(
            SpatialData::Transform(TransformData {
                bounds: libgfx_rust::FloatRect::new(150.0, 0.0, 1000.0, 100.0),
                ..transform_data(FloatMatrix4x4::identity())
            }),
            VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        );
        tree.set_visual_animations(vec![VisualAnimation {
            target_kind: FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform,
            node_indices: vec![spatial.0],
            timing: AnimationEffectTiming {
                iteration_duration: TimeValue::milliseconds(10000.0),
                iteration_count: 1.0,
                ..VisualAnimation::default().timing
            },
            keyframes: vec![keyframe(0.0, translate_x(0.0)), keyframe(1.0, translate_x(-1500.0))],
            ..VisualAnimation::default()
        }]);
        let point = FloatPoint { x: 50.0, y: 50.0 };
        let covers_at = |time_ns: i64| {
            tree.with_visual_animation_samples(time_ns)
                .running_transform_animation_covers_point(time_ns, point, &[])
        };
        assert!(!covers_at(milliseconds(0)));
        assert!(covers_at(milliseconds(2000)));
        assert!(!covers_at(milliseconds(9000)));
        // The animation over, the node holds the value the main thread published, which has the box beside the point.
        assert!(!covers_at(milliseconds(11000)));
        // The tree answers for the values it holds: unsampled, the box is where the main thread published it.
        assert!(!tree.running_transform_animation_covers_point(milliseconds(2000), point, &[]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_summary_reports_the_shared_anchor_and_the_targets() {
        let mut tree = VisualContextTree::create(transform_data(FloatMatrix4x4::identity()));
        assert_eq!(tree.visual_animation_summary().count, 0);
        assert!(tree.visual_animation_summary().share_timing_anchor);
        assert!(tree.visual_animation_summary().targets_are_valid);

        let spatial = tree.append_spatial(
            SpatialData::Transform(transform_data(FloatMatrix4x4::identity())),
            VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
        );
        let animation = VisualAnimation {
            target_kind: FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Transform,
            node_indices: vec![spatial.0],
            monotonic_time_at_anchor_ns: 10,
            local_time_at_anchor_ms: 20.0,
            timing: AnimationEffectTiming {
                iteration_duration: TimeValue::milliseconds(1000.0),
                ..VisualAnimation::default().timing
            },
            keyframes: vec![keyframe(0.0, translate_x(0.0)), keyframe(1.0, translate_x(20.0))],
            ..VisualAnimation::default()
        };
        tree.set_visual_animations(vec![
            animation.clone(),
            VisualAnimation {
                local_time_at_anchor_ms: 30.0,
                ..animation.clone()
            },
        ]);
        let summary = tree.visual_animation_summary();
        assert_eq!(summary.count, 2);
        assert_eq!(summary.local_time_at_anchor_ms_of_first, 20.0);
        assert!(!summary.share_timing_anchor);
        assert!(summary.targets_are_valid);

        tree.set_visual_animations(vec![VisualAnimation {
            node_indices: vec![spatial.0],
            target_kind: FfiVisualAnimationTargetKind::Opacity,
            keyframes: vec![
                keyframe(0.0, VisualAnimationValue::Opacity(0.0)),
                keyframe(1.0, VisualAnimationValue::Opacity(1.0)),
            ],
            ..animation
        }]);
        assert!(!tree.visual_animation_summary().targets_are_valid);

        tree.clear_visual_animations();
        assert!(!tree.has_visual_animations());
    }
}

FILE: Libraries/LibCompositing/Rust/src/visual_context/world_transforms.rs
/*

use super::{
    IncludeVisualViewportTransform, LocalTransformKind, SpatialData, SpatialNodeIndex, VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX,
    VisualContextTree, should_cull_back_face,
};
use crate::display_list::placement::is_finite_rect;
use libgfx_rust::{
    AffineTransform, FloatMatrix4x4, FloatPoint, FloatRect, FloatSize, map_rect_through_matrix, multiply_affine,
    scale_matrix, translation_matrix,
};

/// A spatial node whose subtree a table maps into the node's own coordinates times `raster_scale`, under the root's
/// parent matrix, rather than through the node's transform, which the compositor animates: the subtree lands alike in
/// every sample of the animation.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct RasterRoot {
    pub anchor: SpatialNodeIndex,
    pub raster_scale: f32,
}

/// Homogeneous coordinates this close to the eye plane have no meaningful projection.
pub const MINIMUM_PROJECTION_W: f32 = 0.0001;

/// The to-root matrix of every spatial node under one set of scroll offsets, filled in dependency order so that any
/// node's space is entered with a single matrix. A backface marker's entry carries the flattened matrix that feeds its
/// cull test and its descendants, while content recorded directly under the marker belongs to its parent's plane, so
/// `draw_space` redirects the marker to the parent's entry. A table filled without a root parent matrix is in the
/// layout viewport's space, and the queries below add the visual viewport transform where asked.
///
/// Scroll, sticky and anchor scroll shift translations under no transform but identities round to whole device pixels
/// of the layout viewport, so scrolled content never lands on subpixel positions. Under a transform they stay exact.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct WorldTransforms {
    pub local: Vec<FloatMatrix4x4>,
    pub to_root: Vec<FloatMatrix4x4>,
    pub flattens_inherited_transform: Vec<bool>,
    pub backface_culled: Vec<bool>,
    pub draw_space: Vec<SpatialNodeIndex>,
    pub translations_snap_to_device_pixels: Vec<bool>,
}

/// The translation by `offset` of a scroll, sticky or anchor scroll shift node under no transform, on whole device
/// pixels. A sticky offset carries the fraction of the box's own position, which replay rounds the box by already, so
/// for a sticky box recorded at `sticky_box_origin` where the box lands is rounded, not the offset, or a box at a half
/// pixel would round twice.
pub fn translation_on_whole_device_pixels(offset: FloatPoint, sticky_box_origin: Option<FloatPoint>) -> FloatPoint {
    match sticky_box_origin {
        Some(origin) => FloatPoint {
            x: (origin.x + offset.x).round() - origin.x.round(),
            y: (origin.y + offset.y).round() - origin.y.round(),
        },
        None => FloatPoint {
            x: offset.x.round(),
            y: offset.y.round(),
        },
    }
}

fn backface_culled_at_element_establishing_sorting_context(
    tree: &VisualContextTree,
    backface_culled: &[bool],
    sorting_context_root: SpatialNodeIndex,
) -> bool {
    let mut index = sorting_context_root;
    loop {
        if tree.local_transform(index, &[]).establishes_sorting_context {
            return backface_culled[index.0 as usize];
        }
        if index.0 == 0 {
            return false;
        }
        index = tree.spatial_nodes[index.0 as usize].parent;
    }
}

impl WorldTransforms {
    pub fn new(
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        scroll_offsets: &[FloatPoint],
        root_parent_matrix: Option<FloatMatrix4x4>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self::with_raster_root(tree, scroll_offsets, root_parent_matrix, None)
    }

    pub fn with_raster_root(
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        scroll_offsets: &[FloatPoint],
        root_parent_matrix: Option<FloatMatrix4x4>,
        raster_root: Option<RasterRoot>,
    ) -> Self {
        let mut world = Self::default();
        world.fill(
            tree,
            &tree.spatial_dependency_order(),
            scroll_offsets,
            root_parent_matrix,
            raster_root,
        );
        world
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.local.clear();
        self.to_root.clear();
        self.flattens_inherited_transform.clear();
        self.backface_culled.clear();
        self.draw_space.clear();
        self.translations_snap_to_device_pixels.clear();
    }

    /// Fills the table, with `root_parent_matrix` as what the visual viewport node's transform applies on top of, or
    /// with that transform left out, and the subtree of `raster_root` mapped as it says.
    pub fn fill(
        &mut self,
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        spatial_dependency_order: &[u32],
        scroll_offsets: &[FloatPoint],
        root_parent_matrix: Option<FloatMatrix4x4>,
        raster_root: Option<RasterRoot>,
    ) {
        let node_count = tree.spatial_nodes.len();
        self.clear();
        self.local.resize(node_count, FloatMatrix4x4::identity());
        self.to_root.resize(node_count, FloatMatrix4x4::identity());
        self.flattens_inherited_transform.resize(node_count, false);
        self.backface_culled.resize(node_count, false);
        self.draw_space
            .extend((0..node_count).map(|index| SpatialNodeIndex(index as u32)));
        self.translations_snap_to_device_pixels.resize(node_count, false);
        for &index in spatial_dependency_order {
            let i = index as usize;
            let parent = tree.spatial_nodes[i].parent.0 as usize;
            let mut local = tree.local_transform(SpatialNodeIndex(index), scroll_offsets);
            let raster_root_here = raster_root.filter(|raster_root| raster_root.anchor.0 == index);
            if let Some(raster_root) = raster_root_here {
                let scale = scale_matrix(raster_root.raster_scale, raster_root.raster_scale, 1.0);
                local.matrix = scale;
                local.flattens_inherited_transform = false;
            }
            let has_non_identity_transform = raster_root_here.is_some()
                || (local.is_transform_or_perspective() && local.matrix != FloatMatrix4x4::identity());
            let translations_snap =
                i == 0 || (self.translations_snap_to_device_pixels[parent] && !has_non_identity_transform);
            self.translations_snap_to_device_pixels[i] = translations_snap;
            if let LocalTransformKind::Translation(offset) = local.kind
                && translations_snap
            {
                let sticky_box_origin = match &tree.spatial_nodes[i].data {
                    SpatialData::Sticky(sticky) => Some(sticky.border_box_origin),
                    _ => None,
                };
                let snapped_offset = translation_on_whole_device_pixels(offset, sticky_box_origin);
                local.matrix = translation_matrix(snapped_offset.x, snapped_offset.y, 0.0);
            }
            self.to_root[i] = match (i, root_parent_matrix) {
                (0, None) => FloatMatrix4x4::identity(),
                (0, Some(root_parent_matrix)) => local.applied_to(root_parent_matrix),
                _ if raster_root_here.is_some() => {
                    local.applied_to(root_parent_matrix.unwrap_or(FloatMatrix4x4::identity()))
                }
                _ => local.applied_to(self.to_root[parent]),
            };
            self.local[i] = local.matrix;
            self.flattens_inherited_transform[i] = local.flattens_inherited_transform;
            let mut culled = i != 0 && self.backface_culled[parent];
            // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-transforms-2/#3d-rendering-contexts
            // A participant in a 3D rendering context is its own plane, so the hidden backfaces of other planes in the
            // context don't cull it. But a context is part of the content flattened into the plane its establishing
            // element sits in, so whatever culls that plane culls the whole context: A participant starts from the
            // cull state of the element that establishes its context. The spec doesn't yet say if a hidden backface
            // culls the 3D rendering contexts nested in it:
            // https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/918
            if let Some(root) = local.sorting_context_root {
                culled = backface_culled_at_element_establishing_sorting_context(tree, &self.backface_culled, root);
            }
            if let Some(plane_root) = local.backface_plane_root {
                self.draw_space[i] = self.draw_space[parent];
                culled = culled || should_cull_back_face(self.to_root[i], self.to_root[plane_root.0 as usize]);
            }
            self.backface_culled[i] = culled;
        }
    }

    /// The matrix that content recorded in `space` is drawn with.
    pub fn draw_matrix(&self, space: SpatialNodeIndex) -> FloatMatrix4x4 {
        self.to_root[self.draw_space[space.0 as usize].0 as usize]
    }

    pub fn translations_snap_to_device_pixels(&self, node: SpatialNodeIndex) -> bool {
        self.translations_snap_to_device_pixels
            .get(node.0 as usize)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(false)
    }

    pub fn draw_matrix_if_known(&self, space: SpatialNodeIndex) -> Option<FloatMatrix4x4> {
        ((space.0 as usize) < self.draw_space.len()).then(|| self.draw_matrix(space))
    }

    /// Where content drawn within `rect` in `space` lands in the root's space.
    pub fn map_rect_to_root(&self, space: SpatialNodeIndex, rect: FloatRect) -> FloatRect {
        map_rect_through(self.draw_matrix(space), rect)
    }

    /// The matrix from `node`'s space to the viewport, in a table filled without a root parent matrix.
    pub fn to_viewport_matrix(
        &self,
        node: SpatialNodeIndex,
        include_visual_viewport_transform: IncludeVisualViewportTransform,
    ) -> FloatMatrix4x4 {
        debug_assert!(self.to_root[0] == FloatMatrix4x4::identity());
        let matrix = self.to_root[node.0 as usize];
        match include_visual_viewport_transform {
            IncludeVisualViewportTransform::No => matrix,
            IncludeVisualViewportTransform::Yes => self.local[0].multiplied(matrix),
        }
    }

    pub fn transform_rect_to_viewport(
        &self,
        node: SpatialNodeIndex,
        rect: FloatRect,
        include_visual_viewport_transform: IncludeVisualViewportTransform,
    ) -> FloatRect {
        map_rect_through(self.to_viewport_matrix(node, include_visual_viewport_transform), rect)
    }

    /// The mapping from `node`'s space to the viewport, for many rects of one node.
    pub fn viewport_rect_mapping(
        &self,
        node: SpatialNodeIndex,
        include_visual_viewport_transform: IncludeVisualViewportTransform,
    ) -> RectMapping {
        RectMapping::new(self.to_viewport_matrix(node, include_visual_viewport_transform))
    }

    pub fn accumulated_2d_scale(
        &self,
        node: SpatialNodeIndex,
        include_visual_viewport_transform: IncludeVisualViewportTransform,
    ) -> FloatSize {
        let affine = self
            .to_viewport_matrix(node, include_visual_viewport_transform)
            .extract_2d_affine();
        FloatSize {
            width: affine.x_scale(),
            height: affine.y_scale(),
        }
    }

    pub fn plane_depth_at_point_for_hit_test(&self, plane: SpatialNodeIndex, screen_point: FloatPoint) -> Option<f32> {
        let inverse = self
            .to_viewport_matrix(plane, IncludeVisualViewportTransform::Yes)
            .inverse()?;
        let matrix = &inverse.elements;
        let depth = -(screen_point.x * matrix[2][0] + screen_point.y * matrix[2][1] + matrix[2][3]) / matrix[2][2];
        depth.is_finite().then_some(depth)
    }

    /// How far the nodes on the spatial chain from `node` up to the viewport move a box when its transforms are left
    /// out, in device pixels.
    pub fn offset_to_viewport_ignoring_transforms(
        &self,
        tree: &VisualContextTree,
        node: SpatialNodeIndex,
    ) -> FloatPoint {
        let mut offset = FloatPoint::default();
        let mut current = node;
        while current != VISUAL_VIEWPORT_NODE_INDEX {
            if let LocalTransformKind::Translation(_) = tree.local_transform(current, &[]).kind {
                let local = &self.local[current.0 as usize].elements;
                offset.x += local[0][3];
                offset.y += local[1][3];
            }
            current = tree.spatial_nodes[current.0 as usize].parent;
        }
        offset
    }

    /// Maps `rect` from `from`'s space into `to`'s, or gives `None` when either space is not a two-dimensional
    /// transform of the root or `to`'s cannot be inverted.
    pub fn map_rect_between_spaces(
        &self,
        rect: FloatRect,
        from: SpatialNodeIndex,
        to: SpatialNodeIndex,
    ) -> Option<FloatRect> {
        if from == to {
            return Some(rect);
        }
        let from_matrix = self.draw_matrix(from);
        let to_matrix = self.draw_matrix(to);
        if !from_matrix.is_2d_affine() || !to_matrix.is_2d_affine() {
            return None;
        }
        let root_to_target = to_matrix.extract_2d_affine().inverse()?;
        Some(multiply_affine(root_to_target, from_matrix.extract_2d_affine()).map_rect(rect))
    }

    /// As `map_rect_between_spaces`, with spaces in perspective too, unless a corner of `rect` lies behind the eye or
    /// does not project back onto `to`'s plane in front of the eye.
    pub fn bounds_of_rect_mapped_between_spaces(
        &self,
        rect: FloatRect,
        from: SpatialNodeIndex,
        to: SpatialNodeIndex,
    ) -> Option<FloatRect> {
        if let Some(mapped) = self.map_rect_between_spaces(rect, from, to) {
            return Some(mapped);
        }
        let corners_in_root = corners_projected_if_in_front_of_eye(self.draw_matrix(from), corners_of(rect))?;
        let corners_in_to = corners_on_plane_projecting_onto(self.draw_matrix(to), corners_in_root)?;
        Some(bounds_of_corners(corners_in_to)).filter(|bounds| is_finite_rect(*bounds))
    }

    pub fn bounds_in_root_of_rect_drawn_in(&self, space: SpatialNodeIndex, rect: FloatRect) -> Option<FloatRect> {
        bounds_of_projected_rect_if_corners_in_front_of_eye(self.draw_matrix(space), rect)
            .filter(|bounds| is_finite_rect(*bounds))
    }

    pub fn bounds_in_space_of_root_rect(&self, space: SpatialNodeIndex, rect: FloatRect) -> Option<FloatRect> {
        let corners = corners_on_plane_projecting_onto(self.draw_matrix(space), corners_of(rect))?;
        Some(bounds_of_corners(corners)).filter(|bounds| is_finite_rect(*bounds))
    }
}

fn corners_of(rect: FloatRect) -> [(f32, f32); 4] {
    [
        (rect.x, rect.y),
        (rect.right(), rect.y),
        (rect.x, rect.bottom()),
        (rect.right(), rect.bottom()),
    ]
}

fn bounds_of_corners(corners: [(f32, f32); 4]) -> FloatRect {
    let (left, right) = corners
        .iter()
        .fold((f32::INFINITY, f32::NEG_INFINITY), |(left, right), &(x, _)| {
            (left.min(x), right.max(x))
        });
    let (top, bottom) = corners
        .iter()
        .fold((f32::INFINITY, f32::NEG_INFINITY), |(top, bottom), &(_, y)| {
            (top.min(y), bottom.max(y))
        });
    FloatRect::new(left, top, right - left, bottom - top)
}

fn corners_projected_if_in_front_of_eye(matrix: FloatMatrix4x4, corners: [(f32, f32); 4]) -> Option<[(f32, f32); 4]> {
    const SMALLEST_W_IN_FRONT_OF_EYE: f32 = 0.00001;
    let corners = corners.map(|(x, y)| matrix.map_vector4([x, y, 0.0, 1.0]));
    if corners.iter().any(|corner| corner[3] <= SMALLEST_W_IN_FRONT_OF_EYE) {
        return None;
    }
    Some(corners.map(|corner| (corner[0] / corner[3], corner[1] / corner[3])))
}

pub(crate) fn bounds_of_projected_rect_if_corners_in_front_of_eye(
    matrix: FloatMatrix4x4,
    rect: FloatRect,
) -> Option<FloatRect> {
    corners_projected_if_in_front_of_eye(matrix, corners_of(rect)).map(bounds_of_corners)
}

/// The points of the z = 0 plane that project through `matrix` onto `points`, if each is where a point in front of the
/// eye projects. The points of the plane then bound every point that projects into the quad of `points`.
fn corners_on_plane_projecting_onto(matrix: FloatMatrix4x4, points: [(f32, f32); 4]) -> Option<[(f32, f32); 4]> {
    let m = &matrix.elements;
    let plane_to_root = [0, 1, 3].map(|row| [0, 1, 3].map(|column| m[row][column] as f64));
    let root_to_plane = inverse_of_3x3(plane_to_root)?;
    let points = points.map(|(x, y)| root_to_plane.map(|row| row[0] * x as f64 + row[1] * y as f64 + row[2]));
    if points.iter().any(|point| point[2] <= 0.0) {
        return None;
    }
    Some(points.map(|point| ((point[0] / point[2]) as f32, (point[1] / point[2]) as f32)))
}

fn inverse_of_3x3(m: [[f64; 3]; 3]) -> Option<[[f64; 3]; 3]> {
    let cofactor = |row: usize, column: usize| {
        let (r0, r1) = ((row + 1) % 3, (row + 2) % 3);
        let (c0, c1) = ((column + 1) % 3, (column + 2) % 3);
        m[r0][c0] * m[r1][c1] - m[r0][c1] * m[r1][c0]
    };
    let determinant = m[0][0] * cofactor(0, 0) + m[0][1] * cofactor(0, 1) + m[0][2] * cofactor(0, 2);
    if determinant == 0.0 || !determinant.is_finite() {
        return None;
    }
    Some([0, 1, 2].map(|row| [0, 1, 2].map(|column| cofactor(column, row) / determinant)))
}

fn map_rect_through(matrix: FloatMatrix4x4, rect: FloatRect) -> FloatRect {
    RectMapping::new(matrix).map_rect(rect)
}

/// A matrix that maps rects, with the check for a 2D affine matrix done once.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub enum RectMapping {
    Affine(AffineTransform),
    Projective(FloatMatrix4x4),
}

impl RectMapping {
    pub fn new(matrix: FloatMatrix4x4) -> Self {
        if matrix.is_2d_affine() {
            return Self::Affine(matrix.extract_2d_affine());
        }
        Self::Projective(matrix)
    }

    pub fn map_rect(&self, rect: FloatRect) -> FloatRect {
        match self {
            Self::Affine(affine) => affine.map_rect(rect),
            Self::Projective(matrix) => map_rect_through_matrix(*matrix, rect, MINIMUM_PROJECTION_W),
        }
    }
}

//! The pixel formats that an image is converted to for a texture upload of a format and a type.

const GL_ALPHA: u32 = 0x1906;
const GL_RGB: u32 = 0x1907;
const GL_RGBA: u32 = 0x1908;
const GL_LUMINANCE: u32 = 0x1909;
const GL_LUMINANCE_ALPHA: u32 = 0x190A;
const GL_FLOAT: u32 = 0x1406;
const GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE: u32 = 0x1401;
const GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_4_4_4_4: u32 = 0x8033;
const GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_5_5_1: u32 = 0x8034;
const GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_6_5: u32 = 0x8363;

/// `Gfx::ExportFormat`.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum ExportFormat {
    Luminance8,
    LuminanceAlpha88,
    Alpha8,
    RGB565,
    RGBA5551,
    RGBA4444,
    RGB888,
    RGBA8888,
    Luminance32F,
    LuminanceAlpha32F,
    Alpha32F,
    RGB32F,
    RGBA32F,
}

pub fn texture_export_format(format: u32, r#type: u32) -> Option<ExportFormat> {
    Some(match (format, r#type) {
        (GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE) => ExportFormat::RGB888,
        (GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_6_5) => ExportFormat::RGB565,
        (GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE) => ExportFormat::RGBA8888,
        // FIXME: This is not exactly the same as RGBA.
        (GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_4_4_4_4) => ExportFormat::RGBA4444,
        (GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_5_5_1) => ExportFormat::RGBA5551,
        (GL_ALPHA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE) => ExportFormat::Alpha8,
        (GL_LUMINANCE, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE) => ExportFormat::Luminance8,
        (GL_LUMINANCE_ALPHA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE) => ExportFormat::LuminanceAlpha88,
        (GL_LUMINANCE, GL_FLOAT) => ExportFormat::Luminance32F,
        (GL_LUMINANCE_ALPHA, GL_FLOAT) => ExportFormat::LuminanceAlpha32F,
        (GL_ALPHA, GL_FLOAT) => ExportFormat::Alpha32F,
        (GL_RGB, GL_FLOAT) => ExportFormat::RGB32F,
        (GL_RGBA, GL_FLOAT) => ExportFormat::RGBA32F,
        _ => return None,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn only_the_formats_and_types_that_an_image_converts_to_have_an_export_format() {
        assert_eq!(
            texture_export_format(GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE),
            Some(ExportFormat::RGBA8888)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            texture_export_format(GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_6_5),
            Some(ExportFormat::RGB565)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            texture_export_format(GL_LUMINANCE_ALPHA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE),
            Some(ExportFormat::LuminanceAlpha88)
        );
        assert_eq!(texture_export_format(GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_4_4_4_4), None);
        assert_eq!(texture_export_format(GL_ALPHA, GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_6_5), None);
    }
}

//! The vocabulary of the command stream: the command types, the synchronous call types and the struct that each
//! serializes to. The build script writes it from GLFunctions.json (generate/webgl_wire.rs).

include!(concat!(env!("OUT_DIR"), "/webgl_wire.rs"));

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::webgl::wire::{DataSpan, WireStruct};

    #[test]
    fn a_struct_is_its_fields_in_the_byte_order_of_the_machine() {
        let command = commands::Viewport {
            x: 1,
            y: -2,
            width: 3,
            height: 4,
        };
        let mut expected = Vec::new();
        for field in [1i32, -2, 3, 4] {
            expected.extend_from_slice(&field.to_ne_bytes());
        }
        assert_eq!(command.as_bytes(), expected);
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_bytes_between_the_fields_of_a_struct_are_zero() {
        let command = commands::BufferData {
            target: u32::MAX,
            size: -1,
            has_data: true,
            data: DataSpan {
                offset: u32::MAX,
                size: u32::MAX,
            },
            usage: u32::MAX,
            ..commands::BufferData::ZEROED
        };
        let bytes = command.as_bytes();
        assert_eq!(bytes.len(), 32);
        assert_eq!(bytes[4..8], [0; 4]);
        assert_eq!(bytes[16], 1);
        assert_eq!(bytes[17..20], [0; 3]);
        assert!(bytes[20..32].iter().all(|&byte| byte == 0xFF));
        assert!(commands::BufferData::ZEROED.as_bytes().iter().all(|&byte| byte == 0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_struct_without_fields_is_one_byte() {
        assert_eq!(sync_calls::GetErrorRequest::ZEROED.as_bytes(), [0]);
        assert_eq!(commands::Flush::ZEROED.as_bytes(), [0]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_types_are_numbered_in_the_order_of_their_definition() {
        assert_eq!(CommandType::ActiveTexture as u16, 0);
        assert_eq!(CommandType::AttachShader as u16, 1);
        assert_eq!(SyncCallType::CheckFramebufferStatus as u16, 0);
        assert!((CommandType::Viewport as u16) < COMMAND_TYPE_COUNT);
        assert!((SyncCallType::GetError as u16) < SYNC_CALL_TYPE_COUNT);
    }
}
