#pragma once

#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <LibGfx/Forward.h>
#include <LibGfx/ShapeFeature.h>

namespace Gfx {

struct SystemFallbackFontKey {
    u32 code_point { 0 };
    u16 weight { 0 };
    u16 width { 0 };
    u8 slope { 0 };
    bool prefer_color_emoji { false };

    [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(SystemFallbackFontKey const&) const = default;
};

// The installed font that covers a code point at one style. The answer depends on the key and the
// font set alone, never on a document, so one memo serves every document in the process and the
// answer for a key never changes while the font set stands. The memo keeps one typeface per code
// point and style until the font set changes; the point size only picks a font from that typeface.
RefPtr<Font const> system_fallback_font(SystemFallbackFontKey const&, float point_size, ShapeFeatures const& = {});

// Drops every memoized answer. Call this whenever the installed font set changes.
void clear_system_fallback_font_cache();

[[nodiscard]] size_t system_fallback_font_cache_size();

}

FILE: Libraries/LibGfx/Font/SystemFontMatcher.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <LibCore/MappedFile.h>
#include <LibFileSystem/FileSystem.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/SystemFontMatcher.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/WOFF/Loader.h>

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
#    include <LibGfx/Font/TypefaceCoreText.h>
#endif

namespace Gfx::SystemFontMatcher {

namespace {

struct FileFace {
    ByteString path;
    u32 ttc_index { 0 };

    bool operator==(FileFace const&) const = default;
};

struct FileFaceTraits : public DefaultTraits<FileFace> {
    static unsigned hash(FileFace const& face) { return pair_int_hash(face.path.hash(), face.ttc_index); }
};

struct SystemFontFileTraits : public DefaultTraits<SystemFontFile> {
    static unsigned hash(SystemFontFile const& file) { return pair_int_hash(pair_int_hash(file.path.hash(), file.ttc_index), to_underlying(file.format)); }
};

// A fallback font covers many code points, and each code point that a page asks for matches the same face again. So
// each face is checked and loaded only once.
struct MatchCaches {
    Mutex mutex;
    HashMap<FileFace, Optional<SystemFontFile>, FileFaceTraits> loadable_files;
    HashMap<SystemFontFile, NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>, SystemFontFileTraits> typefaces;
    HashMap<String, NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> platform_typefaces;
};

MatchCaches& match_caches()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<MatchCaches> caches;
    return *caches;
}

}

static FontFileFormat format_of(ReadonlyBytes bytes)
{
    // https://www.w3.org/TR/WOFF/#WOFFHeader
    if (bytes.size() >= 4 && bytes[0] == 'w' && bytes[1] == 'O' && bytes[2] == 'F' && bytes[3] == 'F')
        return FontFileFormat::WOFF;
    return FontFileFormat::OpenType;
}

static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> load_mapped_file(NonnullOwnPtr<Core::MappedFile> mapped_file, u32 ttc_index, FontFileFormat format)
{
    if (format == FontFileFormat::WOFF)
        return WOFF::try_load_from_bytes(mapped_file->bytes(), ttc_index);
    return Typeface::try_load_from_mapped_file(move(mapped_file), ttc_index);
}

static Optional<SystemFontFile> find_loadable_file(StringView path, u32 ttc_index)
{
    auto canonical_path = FileSystem::real_path(path);
    if (canonical_path.is_error())
        return {};
    auto mapped_file = Core::MappedFile::map(canonical_path.value());
    if (mapped_file.is_error())
        return {};
    auto format = format_of(mapped_file.value()->bytes());
    auto typeface = load_mapped_file(mapped_file.release_value(), ttc_index, format);
    if (typeface.is_error())
        return {};
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    // The compositor draws the faces of installed fonts with CoreText, which does not load every face that HarfBuzz
    // reads, such as one with hvgl outlines.
    if (!core_text_accepts_font_data(*typeface.value()->font_data_backing(), ttc_index))
        return {};
#endif
    auto string_path = String::from_byte_string(canonical_path.release_value());
    if (string_path.is_error())
        return {};
    return SystemFontFile { .path = string_path.release_value(), .ttc_index = ttc_index, .format = format };
}

Optional<SystemFontFile> loadable_file(StringView path, u32 ttc_index)
{
    auto& caches = match_caches();
    FileFace face { path, ttc_index };
    {
        MutexLocker locker { caches.mutex };
        if (auto it = caches.loadable_files.find(face); it != caches.loadable_files.end())
            return it->value;
    }
    auto file = find_loadable_file(path, ttc_index);
    MutexLocker locker { caches.mutex };
    caches.loadable_files.set(move(face), file);
    return file;
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> load(SystemFontMatch const& match)
{
    auto& caches = match_caches();
    return match.visit(
        [&](SystemFontFile const& file) -> ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> {
            {
                MutexLocker locker { caches.mutex };
                if (auto it = caches.typefaces.find(file); it != caches.typefaces.end())
                    return it->value;
            }
            auto typeface = TRY(load_mapped_file(TRY(Core::MappedFile::map(file.path)), file.ttc_index, file.format));
            if (file.format == FontFileFormat::OpenType)
                typeface->set_file_path(file.path);
            MutexLocker locker { caches.mutex };
            return caches.typefaces.ensure(file, [&] { return move(typeface); });
        },
        [&](PlatformFontName const& name) -> ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> {
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
            {
                MutexLocker locker { caches.mutex };
                if (auto it = caches.platform_typefaces.find(name.postscript_name); it != caches.platform_typefaces.end())
                    return it->value;
            }
            NonnullRefPtr<Typeface> typeface = TRY(TypefaceCoreText::try_load_postscript_name(name.postscript_name));
            MutexLocker locker { caches.mutex };
            return caches.platform_typefaces.ensure(name.postscript_name, [&] { return move(typeface); });
#else
            (void)name;
            return Error::from_string_literal("Only CoreText opens fonts by name");
#endif
        });
}

}

// Releases a CoreFoundation object at the end of its scope.
template<typename T>
class CFOwned {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(CFOwned);

public:
    CFOwned() = default;

    explicit CFOwned(T object)
        : m_object(object)
    {
    }

    CFOwned(CFOwned&& other)
        : m_object(exchange(other.m_object, nullptr))
    {
    }

    CFOwned& operator=(CFOwned&& other)
    {
        if (this != &other) {
            release();
            m_object = exchange(other.m_object, nullptr);
        }
        return *this;
    }

    ~CFOwned() { release(); }

    T get() const { return m_object; }

private:
    void release()
    {
        if (m_object)
            CFRelease(m_object);
        m_object = nullptr;
    }

    T m_object { nullptr };
};

}

// https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appkit/nsfont/weight
// CoreText gives weights from -1 to 1. These are the weights of the AppKit constants from ultraLight to black, which
// stand for the CSS weights from 100 to 900.
static CGFloat core_text_weight(u16 css_weight)
{
    static constexpr Array<CGFloat, 9> weights { -0.8, -0.6, -0.4, 0, 0.23, 0.3, 0.4, 0.56, 0.62 };
    auto position = (clamp<CGFloat>(css_weight, 100, 900) - 100) / 100;
    auto index = min(static_cast<size_t>(position), weights.size() - 2);
    return weights[index] + (weights[index + 1] - weights[index]) * (position - index);
}

// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/os2#uswidthclass
// CoreText gives widths from -1 to 1, with 0 for the normal width. Use the change from the normal width, which the
// width classes give in percent.
static CGFloat core_text_width(u16 width_class)
{
    static constexpr Array<CGFloat, 9> percentages { 50, 62.5, 75, 87.5, 100, 112.5, 125, 150, 200 };
    return (percentages[clamp<u16>(width_class, 1, 9) - 1] - 100) / 100;
}

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#valdef-font-style-oblique-angle
// CoreText gives slants from -1 to 1, where 1 is 30 degrees. An italic or oblique style asks for the default angle of
// an oblique style, 14 degrees.
static constexpr CGFloat core_text_slant_of_slanted_styles = 14.0 / 30.0;

static CFOwned<CFStringRef> make_string(StringView string)
{
    return CFOwned<CFStringRef> { CFStringCreateWithBytes(kCFAllocatorDefault, reinterpret_cast<UInt8 const*>(string.characters_without_null_termination()), static_cast<CFIndex>(string.length()), kCFStringEncodingUTF8, false) };
}

static Optional<String> string_from(CFStringRef string)
{
    if (!string)
        return {};
    auto capacity = CFStringGetMaximumSizeForEncoding(CFStringGetLength(string), kCFStringEncodingUTF8) + 1;
    Vector<char> buffer;
    buffer.resize(capacity);
    if (!CFStringGetCString(string, buffer.data(), capacity, kCFStringEncodingUTF8))
        return {};
    auto result = String::from_utf8(StringView { buffer.data(), strlen(buffer.data()) });
    if (result.is_error())
        return {};
    return result.release_value();
}

static void set_number(CFMutableDictionaryRef dictionary, CFStringRef key, CGFloat value)
{
    CFOwned<CFNumberRef> number { CFNumberCreate(kCFAllocatorDefault, kCFNumberCGFloatType, &value) };
    if (number.get())
        CFDictionarySetValue(dictionary, key, number.get());
}

static CFOwned<CTFontDescriptorRef> create_descriptor(CFStringRef family, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope)
{
    CFOwned<CFMutableDictionaryRef> traits { CFDictionaryCreateMutable(kCFAllocatorDefault, 0, &kCFTypeDictionaryKeyCallBacks, &kCFTypeDictionaryValueCallBacks) };
    CFOwned<CFMutableDictionaryRef> attributes { CFDictionaryCreateMutable(kCFAllocatorDefault, 0, &kCFTypeDictionaryKeyCallBacks, &kCFTypeDictionaryValueCallBacks) };
    if (!traits.get() || !attributes.get())
        return {};

    set_number(traits.get(), kCTFontWeightTrait, core_text_weight(weight));
    set_number(traits.get(), kCTFontWidthTrait, core_text_width(width));
    set_number(traits.get(), kCTFontSlantTrait, slope == 0 ? 0 : core_text_slant_of_slanted_styles);
    CFDictionarySetValue(attributes.get(), kCTFontTraitsAttribute, traits.get());
    CFDictionarySetValue(attributes.get(), kCTFontFamilyNameAttribute, family);
    return CFOwned<CTFontDescriptorRef> { CTFontDescriptorCreateWithAttributes(attributes.get()) };
}

// The face of a family that has the style closest to the requested one, if the family is installed.
static CFOwned<CTFontRef> match_font_for_family(CFStringRef family, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope)
{
    auto descriptor = create_descriptor(family, weight, width, slope);
    if (!descriptor.get())
        return {};
    CFTypeRef required_attribute_values[] = { kCTFontFamilyNameAttribute };
    CFOwned<CFSetRef> required_attributes { CFSetCreate(kCFAllocatorDefault, required_attribute_values, 1, &kCFTypeSetCallBacks) };
    if (!required_attributes.get())
        return {};
    CFOwned<CTFontDescriptorRef> matched_descriptor { CTFontDescriptorCreateMatchingFontDescriptor(descriptor.get(), required_attributes.get()) };
    if (!matched_descriptor.get())
        return {};
    return CFOwned<CTFontRef> { CTFontCreateWithFontDescriptor(matched_descriptor.get(), 0, nullptr) };
}

static bool has_code_point(CTFontRef font, u32 code_point)
{
    UniChar code_units[2] = {};
    CGGlyph glyphs[2] = {};
    CFIndex length = 1;
    if (code_point < 0x10000) {
        code_units[0] = static_cast<UniChar>(code_point);
    } else {
        code_units[0] = static_cast<UniChar>(0xD800 + ((code_point - 0x10000) >> 10));
        code_units[1] = static_cast<UniChar>(0xDC00 + ((code_point - 0x10000) & 0x3FF));
        length = 2;
    }
    return CTFontGetGlyphsForCharacters(font, code_units, glyphs, length);
}

// The face index in a font file for a font that CoreText gives. This is the face with the same PostScript name, or
// else a face of the same family with a named instance at the variation of the font, or that face by itself if no
// named instance is at the variation. The upper 16 bits of the index select the named instance.
static Optional<u32> face_index_of(ReadonlyBytes bytes, CTFontRef font, String const& postscript_name, CFDictionaryRef variation)
{
    CFOwned<CFStringRef> core_text_family { CTFontCopyFamilyName(font) };
    auto family = string_from(core_text_family.get());

    auto* blob = hb_blob_create(reinterpret_cast<char const*>(bytes.data()), bytes.size(), HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY, nullptr, nullptr);
    auto face_count = hb_face_count(blob);
    Optional<u32> match;
    Optional<u32> instance_match;
    Optional<u32> family_match;
    for (u32 index = 0; index < face_count && !match.has_value(); ++index) {
        auto* face = hb_face_create(blob, index);
        if (face_name(face, HB_OT_NAME_ID_POSTSCRIPT_NAME) == postscript_name) {
            match = index;
        } else if (variation && CFDictionaryGetCount(variation) > 0 && family.has_value() && !instance_match.has_value()) {
            auto face_family = face_name(face, HB_OT_NAME_ID_TYPOGRAPHIC_FAMILY);
            if (!face_family.has_value())
                face_family = face_name(face, HB_OT_NAME_ID_FONT_FAMILY);
            if (face_family == family) {
                if (!family_match.has_value())
                    family_match = index;
                if (auto instance = named_instance_with_variation(face, variation); instance.has_value())
                    instance_match = index | ((*instance + 1) << 16);
            }
        }
        hb_face_destroy(face);
    }
    hb_blob_destroy(blob);
    if (match.has_value())
        return match;
    if (instance_match.has_value())
        return instance_match;
    return family_match;
}

// The face index of a font depends on its file, its PostScript name and its variation.
static ByteString file_face_key(StringView path, String const& postscript_name, CFDictionaryRef variation)
{
    struct Coordinate {
        i64 tag { 0 };
        double value { 0 };
    };
    Vector<Coordinate> coordinates;
    if (variation) {
        CFDictionaryApplyFunction(
            variation, [](void const* key, void const* value, void* context) {
                Coordinate coordinate;
                CFNumberGetValue(static_cast<CFNumberRef>(key), kCFNumberSInt64Type, &coordinate.tag);
                CFNumberGetValue(static_cast<CFNumberRef>(value), kCFNumberDoubleType, &coordinate.value);
                static_cast<Vector<Coordinate>*>(context)->append(coordinate);
            },
            &coordinates);
        quick_sort(coordinates, [](auto const& a, auto const& b) { return a.tag < b.tag; });
    }

    StringBuilder builder;
    builder.append(path);
    builder.append('\0');
    builder.append(postscript_name);
    for (auto const& coordinate : coordinates) {
        builder.append('\0');
        builder.appendff("{}={:x}", coordinate.tag, bit_cast<u64>(coordinate.value));
    }
    return builder.to_byte_string();
}

// The face of a font file that a CoreText font has, if Typeface loads it. A fallback font covers many code points, and
// each code point that a page asks for gives the same font again, so the answer is kept.
static Optional<SystemFontFile> file_face_of(CTFontRef font, StringView path, String const& postscript_name)
{
    static NeverDestroyed<Mutex> mutex;
    static NeverDestroyed<HashMap<ByteString, Optional<SystemFontFile>>> file_faces;

    CFOwned<CFDictionaryRef> variation { CTFontCopyVariation(font) };
    auto key = file_face_key(path, postscript_name, variation.get());
    {
        MutexLocker locker { *mutex };
        if (auto it = file_faces->find(key); it != file_faces->end())
            return it->value;
    }

    Optional<SystemFontFile> file;
    if (auto mapped_file = Core::MappedFile::map(path); !mapped_file.is_error()) {
        if (auto ttc_index = face_index_of(mapped_file.value()->bytes(), font, postscript_name, variation.get()); ttc_index.has_value())
            file = loadable_file(path, *ttc_index);
    }
    MutexLocker locker { *mutex };
    file_faces->set(move(key), file);
    return file;
}

// The file of a font that CoreText gives, if Typeface loads its face, or else the PostScript name to open it by.
static Optional<SystemFontMatch> match_of(CTFontRef font)
{
    CFOwned<CFStringRef> core_text_postscript_name { CTFontCopyPostScriptName(font) };
    auto postscript_name = string_from(core_text_postscript_name.get());
    if (!postscript_name.has_value())
        return {};

    CFOwned<CFURLRef> url { static_cast<CFURLRef>(CTFontCopyAttribute(font, kCTFontURLAttribute)) };
    char path[MAXPATHLEN];
    if (url.get() && CFURLGetFileSystemRepresentation(url.get(), true, reinterpret_cast<UInt8*>(path), sizeof(path))) {
        if (auto file = file_face_of(font, { path, strlen(path) }, *postscript_name); file.has_value())
            return SystemFontMatch { file.release_value() };
    }

    return SystemFontMatch { PlatformFontName { postscript_name.release_value() } };
}

Optional<SystemFontMatch> match_family_style(StringView family, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope)
{
    auto family_name = make_string(family);
    if (!family_name.get())
        return {};
    auto font = match_font_for_family(family_name.get(), weight, width, slope);
    if (!font.get())
        return {};
    return match_of(font.get());
}

Optional<SystemFontMatch> match_code_point(u32 code_point, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope, bool prefer_color_emoji)
{
    // A code point that is a surrogate or that is past the last code point gives no string, and no font has it.
    CFOwned<CFStringRef> string { CFStringCreateWithBytes(kCFAllocatorDefault, reinterpret_cast<UInt8 const*>(&code_point), sizeof(code_point), kCFStringEncodingUTF32LE, false) };
    if (!string.get())
        return {};

    // The cascade list of the font that the user reads documents in gives the font for the code point.
    CFOwned<CTFontRef> document_font { CTFontCreateUIFontForLanguage(kCTFontUIFontUser, 0, nullptr) };
    if (!document_font.get())
        return {};

    // https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr51/#Emoji_Script
    // The script subtag Zsye asks for emoji presentation, which CoreText gives with a color emoji font.
    CFOwned<CFStringRef> language;
    if (prefer_color_emoji)
        language = make_string("und-Zsye"sv);
    CFOwned<CTFontRef> fallback_font { CTFontCreateForStringWithLanguage(document_font.get(), string.get(), CFRangeMake(0, CFStringGetLength(string.get())), language.get()) };
    if (!fallback_font.get() || !has_code_point(fallback_font.get(), code_point))
        return {};

    // The fallback font has the style of the document font, so look for a face of its family with the requested style
    // that also has the code point. A family whose name starts with '.' is hidden, and no name matches it.
    CFOwned<CFStringRef> fallback_family { CTFontCopyFamilyName(fallback_font.get()) };
    if (fallback_family.get() && CFStringGetLength(fallback_family.get()) > 0 && CFStringGetCharacterAtIndex(fallback_family.get(), 0) != '.') {
        if (auto styled_font = match_font_for_family(fallback_family.get(), weight, width, slope); styled_font.get() && has_code_point(styled_font.get(), code_point))
            fallback_font = move(styled_font);
    }

    return match_of(fallback_font.get());
}

Optional<FlyString> resolve_generic_family(StringView family, u16 weight, u8 slope)
{
    auto family_name = make_string(family);
    if (!family_name.get())
        return {};
    auto font = match_font_for_family(family_name.get(), weight, FontWidth::Normal, slope);
    if (!font.get())
        return {};
    CFOwned<CFStringRef> resolved_family { CTFontCopyFamilyName(font.get()) };
    auto name = string_from(resolved_family.get());
    if (!name.has_value())
        return {};
    return FlyString { name.release_value() };
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibGfx/Font/SystemFontMatcherDirectWrite.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <AK/Windows.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/Font.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/SystemFontMatcher.h>

#include <dwrite.h>
#include <dwrite_2.h>
// NB: WRL instead of WinRT, because WinRT reports errors with exceptions.
#include <wrl/client.h>

namespace Gfx::SystemFontMatcher {

using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;

namespace {

struct DirectWrite {
    ComPtr<IDWriteFactory2> factory;
    ComPtr<IDWriteFontCollection> system_fonts;
    ComPtr<IDWriteFontFallback> system_fallback;
    // The locale of the user, which picks among the fonts of a script, ending with a null character.
    Vector<wchar_t> user_locale;
};

// The text of one code point, which the font fallback of DirectWrite reads. It lives on the stack for one call, so it
// does not count references.
class CodePointText final : public IDWriteTextAnalysisSource {
public:
    CodePointText(u32 code_point, wchar_t const* locale)
        : m_locale(locale)
    {
        if (code_point < 0x10000) {
            m_code_units[0] = static_cast<wchar_t>(code_point);
            m_length = 1;
        } else {
            m_code_units[0] = static_cast<wchar_t>(0xD800 + ((code_point - 0x10000) >> 10));
            m_code_units[1] = static_cast<wchar_t>(0xDC00 + ((code_point - 0x10000) & 0x3FF));
            m_length = 2;
        }
    }

    UINT32 length() const { return m_length; }

    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE QueryInterface(REFIID interface_id, void** object) override
    {
        if (interface_id != __uuidof(IUnknown) && interface_id != __uuidof(IDWriteTextAnalysisSource)) {
            *object = nullptr;
            return E_NOINTERFACE;
        }
        *object = this;
        return S_OK;
    }

    ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE AddRef() override { return 1; }
    ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE Release() override { return 1; }

    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE GetTextAtPosition(UINT32 position, WCHAR const** text, UINT32* length) override
    {
        *text = position < m_length ? m_code_units + position : nullptr;
        *length = position < m_length ? m_length - position : 0;
        return S_OK;
    }

    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE GetTextBeforePosition(UINT32 position, WCHAR const** text, UINT32* length) override
    {
        *text = position > 0 && position <= m_length ? m_code_units : nullptr;
        *length = position > 0 && position <= m_length ? position : 0;
        return S_OK;
    }

    DWRITE_READING_DIRECTION STDMETHODCALLTYPE GetParagraphReadingDirection() override
    {
        return DWRITE_READING_DIRECTION_LEFT_TO_RIGHT;
    }

    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE GetLocaleName(UINT32 position, UINT32* length, WCHAR const** locale) override
    {
        *length = position < m_length ? m_length - position : 0;
        *locale = m_locale;
        return S_OK;
    }

    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE GetNumberSubstitution(UINT32 position, UINT32* length, IDWriteNumberSubstitution** number_substitution) override
    {
        // The text has no digits to substitute.
        *length = position < m_length ? m_length - position : 0;
        *number_substitution = nullptr;
        return S_OK;
    }

private:
    wchar_t m_code_units[2] {};
    UINT32 m_length { 0 };
    wchar_t const* m_locale { nullptr };
};

}

static DirectWrite const* direct_write()
{
    static DirectWrite const* const instance = []() -> DirectWrite const* {
        auto* direct_write = new DirectWrite;
        // IDWriteFactory2 and its system font fallback need Windows 8.1 or later.
        if (FAILED(DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, __uuidof(IDWriteFactory2), reinterpret_cast<IUnknown**>(direct_write->factory.GetAddressOf())))
            || FAILED(direct_write->factory->GetSystemFontCollection(&direct_write->system_fonts, FALSE))
            || FAILED(direct_write->factory->GetSystemFontFallback(&direct_write->system_fallback))) {
            delete direct_write;
            return nullptr;
        }

        wchar_t locale[LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH] {};
        auto locale_length = GetUserDefaultLocaleName(locale, LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH);
        for (int index = 0; index < locale_length && locale[index] != 0; ++index)
            direct_write->user_locale.append(locale[index]);
        direct_write->user_locale.append(0);
        return direct_write;
    }();
    return instance;
}

static Vector<wchar_t> to_wide_string(StringView string)
{
    Vector<wchar_t> wide_string;
    if (!string.is_empty()) {
        auto length = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, string.characters_without_null_termination(), static_cast<int>(string.length()), nullptr, 0);
        if (length > 0) {
            wide_string.resize(length);
            MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, string.characters_without_null_termination(), static_cast<int>(string.length()), wide_string.data(), length);
        }
    }
    wide_string.append(0);
    return wide_string;
}

static Optional<String> from_wide_string(wchar_t const* wide_string, UINT32 length)
{
    if (length == 0)
        return String {};
    auto size = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wide_string, static_cast<int>(length), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    if (size <= 0)
        return {};
    Vector<char> buffer;
    buffer.resize(size);
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wide_string, static_cast<int>(length), buffer.data(), size, nullptr, nullptr);
    auto string = String::from_utf8(StringView { buffer.data(), buffer.size() });
    if (string.is_error())
        return {};
    return string.release_value();
}

// DirectWrite uses the CSS weights and the width classes of the OS/2 table.
static DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT direct_write_weight(u16 weight)
{
    return static_cast<DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT>(clamp<u16>(weight, 1, 999));
}

static DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH direct_write_stretch(u16 width)
{
    return static_cast<DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH>(clamp<u16>(width, FontWidth::UltraCondensed, FontWidth::UltraExpanded));
}

static DWRITE_FONT_STYLE direct_write_style(u8 slope)
{
    if (slope == 1)
        return DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC;
    if (slope == 2)
        return DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_OBLIQUE;
    return DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL;
}

// The face of a font that DirectWrite gives, if it is in a local file that Typeface loads. DirectWrite gives a named
// instance of a variable font as the face at its default coordinates.
static Optional<SystemFontMatch> match_of(IDWriteFont* font)
{
    ComPtr<IDWriteFontFace> face;
    if (FAILED(font->CreateFontFace(&face)))
        return {};

    // A face whose data is in several files cannot be loaded from one of them.
    UINT32 file_count = 0;
    if (FAILED(face->GetFiles(&file_count, nullptr)) || file_count != 1)
        return {};
    ComPtr<IDWriteFontFile> file;
    if (FAILED(face->GetFiles(&file_count, file.GetAddressOf())))
        return {};

    void const* reference_key = nullptr;
    UINT32 reference_key_size = 0;
    ComPtr<IDWriteFontFileLoader> loader;
    ComPtr<IDWriteLocalFontFileLoader> local_loader;
    if (FAILED(file->GetReferenceKey(&reference_key, &reference_key_size)) || FAILED(file->GetLoader(&loader)) || FAILED(loader.As(&local_loader)))
        return {};

    UINT32 path_length = 0;
    if (FAILED(local_loader->GetFilePathLengthFromKey(reference_key, reference_key_size, &path_length)))
        return {};
    Vector<wchar_t> path;
    path.resize(path_length + 1);
    if (FAILED(local_loader->GetFilePathFromKey(reference_key, reference_key_size, path.data(), path_length + 1)))
        return {};
    auto utf8_path = from_wide_string(path.data(), path_length);
    if (!utf8_path.has_value())
        return {};

    auto loadable = loadable_file(*utf8_path, face->GetIndex());
    if (!loadable.has_value())
        return {};
    return SystemFontMatch { loadable.release_value() };
}

static ComPtr<IDWriteFont> match_font_for_family(StringView family, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope)
{
    auto const* direct_write = SystemFontMatcher::direct_write();
    if (!direct_write)
        return {};

    auto family_name = to_wide_string(family);
    UINT32 family_index = 0;
    BOOL exists = FALSE;
    ComPtr<IDWriteFontFamily> font_family;
    if (FAILED(direct_write->system_fonts->FindFamilyName(family_name.data(), &family_index, &exists)) || !exists
        || FAILED(direct_write->system_fonts->GetFontFamily(family_index, &font_family)))
        return {};

    ComPtr<IDWriteFont> font;
    if (FAILED(font_family->GetFirstMatchingFont(direct_write_weight(weight), direct_write_stretch(width), direct_write_style(slope), &font)))
        return {};
    return font;
}

Optional<SystemFontMatch> match_family_style(StringView family, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope)
{
    auto font = match_font_for_family(family, weight, width, slope);
    if (!font)
        return {};
    return match_of(font.Get());
}

Optional<SystemFontMatch> match_code_point(u32 code_point, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope, bool prefer_color_emoji)
{
    auto const* direct_write = SystemFontMatcher::direct_write();
    if (!direct_write || code_point > 0x10FFFF)
        return {};

    // https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr51/#Emoji_Script
    // The script subtag Zsye asks for emoji presentation, which DirectWrite gives with a color emoji font.
    CodePointText text { code_point, prefer_color_emoji ? L"und-Zsye" : direct_write->user_locale.data() };
    UINT32 mapped_length = 0;
    ComPtr<IDWriteFont> font;
    FLOAT scale = 1;
    if (FAILED(direct_write->system_fallback->MapCharacters(&text, 0, text.length(), direct_write->system_fonts.Get(), nullptr, direct_write_weight(weight), direct_write_style(slope), direct_write_stretch(width), &mapped_length, &font, &scale)))
        return {};
    if (!font)
        return {};
    return match_of(font.Get());
}

// The family for a generic family, such as 'monospace'. DirectWrite has no families for the generic families, unlike
// fontconfig, so this names the fonts that come with Windows for each of them.
static StringView windows_family_for_generic_family(StringView family)
{
    if (family == "serif"sv)
        return "Times New Roman"sv;
    if (family == "sans-serif"sv)
        return "Arial"sv;
    if (family == "monospace"sv)
        return "Consolas"sv;
    if (family == "cursive"sv)
        return "Comic Sans MS"sv;
    if (family == "fantasy"sv)
        return "Impact"sv;
    if (family == "math"sv)
        return "Cambria Math"sv;
    return family;
}

Optional<FlyString> resolve_generic_family(StringView family, u16 weight, u8 slope)
{
    auto font = match_font_for_family(windows_family_for_generic_family(family), weight, FontWidth::Normal, slope);
    if (!font)
        return {};

    ComPtr<IDWriteFontFamily> font_family;
    ComPtr<IDWriteLocalizedStrings> family_names;
    if (FAILED(font->GetFontFamily(&font_family)) || FAILED(font_family->GetFamilyNames(&family_names)))
        return {};

    // The US English name, or else the first name.
    UINT32 name_index = 0;
    BOOL exists = FALSE;
    if (FAILED(family_names->FindLocaleName(L"en-us", &name_index, &exists)) || !exists)
        name_index = 0;

    UINT32 name_length = 0;
    if (FAILED(family_names->GetStringLength(name_index, &name_length)))
        return {};
    Vector<wchar_t> name;
    name.resize(name_length + 1);
    if (FAILED(family_names->GetString(name_index, name.data(), name_length + 1)))
        return {};
    auto resolved_family = from_wide_string(name.data(), name_length);
    if (!resolved_family.has_value())
        return {};
    return FlyString { resolved_family.release_value() };
}

}

/*

#include <AK/Array.h>
#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/Font.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/GlobalFontConfig.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/SystemFontMatcher.h>
#include <LibUnicode/CharacterTypes.h>

#include <fontconfig/fontconfig.h>

namespace Gfx::SystemFontMatcher {

namespace {

// Destroys a fontconfig object at the end of its scope.
template<typename T, void (*destroy)(T*)>
class Owned {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(Owned);

public:
    explicit Owned(T* object)
        : m_object(object)
    {
    }

    Owned(Owned&& other)
        : m_object(exchange(other.m_object, nullptr))
    {
    }

    ~Owned()
    {
        if (m_object)
            destroy(m_object);
    }

    T* get() const { return m_object; }

private:
    T* m_object { nullptr };
};

using OwnedFontSet = Owned<FcFontSet, FcFontSetDestroy>;
using OwnedPattern = Owned<FcPattern, FcPatternDestroy>;
using OwnedCharSet = Owned<FcCharSet, FcCharSetDestroy>;
using OwnedLangSet = Owned<FcLangSet, FcLangSetDestroy>;

// The file and the face index of a matched font. The face is loaded after the lock is released.
struct MatchedFile {
    ByteString path;
    u32 ttc_index { 0 };
};

}

// The configuration is shared by all threads, so one match runs at a time.
static Mutex& fontconfig_mutex()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<Mutex> mutex;
    return *mutex;
}

static FcChar8 const* fontconfig_string(char const* string)
{
    return reinterpret_cast<FcChar8 const*>(string);
}

// Calls the callback with each string value of an object of a pattern.
template<typename Callback>
static void for_each_string(FcPattern* pattern, char const* object, Callback callback)
{
    FcChar8* value = nullptr;
    for (int id = 0; FcPatternGetString(pattern, object, id, &value) == FcResultMatch; ++id)
        callback(value, id);
}

static void add_style(FcPattern* pattern, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope)
{
    // https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/os2#uswidthclass
    // Fontconfig gives a width in percent of the normal width, as the width classes of the OS/2 table do.
    static constexpr Array<int, 9> widths {
        FC_WIDTH_ULTRACONDENSED,
        FC_WIDTH_EXTRACONDENSED,
        FC_WIDTH_CONDENSED,
        FC_WIDTH_SEMICONDENSED,
        FC_WIDTH_NORMAL,
        FC_WIDTH_SEMIEXPANDED,
        FC_WIDTH_EXPANDED,
        FC_WIDTH_EXTRAEXPANDED,
        FC_WIDTH_ULTRAEXPANDED,
    };
    FcPatternAddInteger(pattern, FC_WEIGHT, FcWeightFromOpenType(clamp<int>(weight, 1, 1000)));
    FcPatternAddInteger(pattern, FC_WIDTH, widths[clamp<u16>(width, FontWidth::UltraCondensed, FontWidth::UltraExpanded) - 1]);
    FcPatternAddInteger(pattern, FC_SLANT, fontconfig_slant(slope));
}

// A family name that no font has. Put after the requested family, it splits the families of a pattern after
// substitution: the configuration puts the families that it substitutes for the requested family, such as the fonts
// that an alias stands for, before it, and the families that it adds to every pattern as defaults after it.
static constexpr char const* end_of_substitutes = "ladybird-end-of-family-substitutes";

static Optional<MatchedFile> matched_file(FcPattern* font)
{
    FcChar8* path = nullptr;
    if (FcPatternGetString(font, FC_FILE, 0, &path) != FcResultMatch)
        return {};
    // The upper 16 bits of the index select a named instance of a variable face.
    int index = 0;
    FcPatternGetInteger(font, FC_INDEX, 0, &index);
    return MatchedFile { reinterpret_cast<char const*>(path), static_cast<u32>(index) };
}

// The font for a family and a style, if it has the family or one that the configuration substitutes for it.
static OwnedPattern match_font_for_family(StringView family, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope)
{
    auto* config = GlobalFontConfig::the().get();

    OwnedPattern pattern { FcPatternCreate() };
    auto family_name = family.to_byte_string();
    FcPatternAddString(pattern.get(), FC_FAMILY, fontconfig_string(family_name.characters()));
    FcPatternAddString(pattern.get(), FC_FAMILY, fontconfig_string(end_of_substitutes));
    add_style(pattern.get(), weight, width, slope);
    FcConfigSubstitute(config, pattern.get(), FcMatchPattern);

    // A rule can replace the requested family itself, so it is accepted whatever the configuration does with it.
    Vector<ByteString> accepted_families { family_name };
    Optional<int> end_id;
    for_each_string(pattern.get(), FC_FAMILY, [&](FcChar8 const* name, int id) {
        if (end_id.has_value())
            return;
        if (FcStrCmp(name, fontconfig_string(end_of_substitutes)) == 0)
            end_id = id;
        else
            accepted_families.append(reinterpret_cast<char const*>(name));
    });
    if (end_id.has_value())
        FcPatternRemove(pattern.get(), FC_FAMILY, *end_id);

    FcDefaultSubstitute(pattern.get());
    FcResult result;
    OwnedPattern font { FcFontMatch(config, pattern.get(), &result) };
    if (!font.get())
        return font;

    bool has_accepted_family = false;
    for_each_string(font.get(), FC_FAMILY, [&](FcChar8 const* name, int) {
        for (auto const& accepted_family : accepted_families) {
            if (FcStrCmpIgnoreCase(name, fontconfig_string(accepted_family.characters())) == 0)
                has_accepted_family = true;
        }
    });
    if (!has_accepted_family)
        return OwnedPattern { nullptr };
    return font;
}

static void prepare_code_point_pattern(FcConfig* config, FcPattern* pattern, u32 code_point, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope, bool prefer_color_emoji)
{
    add_style(pattern, weight, width, slope);
    OwnedCharSet char_set { FcCharSetCreate() };
    FcCharSetAddChar(char_set.get(), code_point);
    FcPatternAddCharSet(pattern, FC_CHARSET, char_set.get());

    // https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr51/#Emoji_Script
    // The script subtag Zsye asks for emoji presentation, which fontconfig gives to the color emoji fonts.
    if (prefer_color_emoji) {
        OwnedLangSet lang_set { FcLangSetCreate() };
        FcLangSetAdd(lang_set.get(), fontconfig_string("und-zsye"));
        FcPatternAddLangSet(pattern, FC_LANG, lang_set.get());
    } else if (auto language = Unicode::likely_language_for_script_of(code_point); language.has_value()) {
        // NB: Without a language, fontconfig ranks every font that has the code point alike, and can pick one that
        //     covers every script only crudely (GNU Unifont, e.g.) over one made for the code point's script.
        OwnedLangSet lang_set { FcLangSetCreate() };
        FcLangSetAdd(lang_set.get(), fontconfig_string(language->to_byte_string().characters()));
        FcPatternAddLangSet(pattern, FC_LANG, lang_set.get());
    }

    FcConfigSubstitute(config, pattern, FcMatchPattern);
    FcDefaultSubstitute(pattern);
}

static Optional<SystemFontMatch> loadable_match(Optional<MatchedFile> const& file)
{
    if (!file.has_value())
        return {};
    auto loadable = loadable_file(file->path, file->ttc_index);
    if (!loadable.has_value())
        return {};
    return SystemFontMatch { loadable.release_value() };
}

Optional<SystemFontMatch> match_family_style(StringView family, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope)
{
    Optional<MatchedFile> file;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(fontconfig_mutex());
        if (auto font = match_font_for_family(family, weight, width, slope); font.get())
            file = matched_file(font.get());
    }
    return loadable_match(file);
}

Optional<SystemFontMatch> match_code_point(u32 code_point, u16 weight, u16 width, u8 slope, bool prefer_color_emoji)
{
    auto covers_code_point = [code_point](FcPattern* font) {
        FcCharSet* char_set = nullptr;
        return FcPatternGetCharSet(font, FC_CHARSET, 0, &char_set) == FcResultMatch && FcCharSetHasChar(char_set, code_point);
    };

    auto* config = GlobalFontConfig::the().get();
    OwnedPattern pattern { FcPatternCreate() };
    Optional<MatchedFile> first_file;
    FcResult result;

    // Trying the preferred face first avoids sorting the full font set when that face is usable.
    {
        MutexLocker locker(fontconfig_mutex());
        prepare_code_point_pattern(config, pattern.get(), code_point, weight, width, slope, prefer_color_emoji);
        OwnedPattern first { FcFontMatch(config, pattern.get(), &result) };
        if (first.get() && covers_code_point(first.get()))
            first_file = matched_file(first.get());
    }
    if (auto match = loadable_match(first_file); match.has_value())
        return match;

    // Ask Fontconfig for the untrimmed list so we can try later faces with the same coverage.
    auto fonts = [&] {
        MutexLocker locker(fontconfig_mutex());
        return OwnedFontSet { FcFontSort(config, pattern.get(), FcFalse, nullptr, &result) };
    }();
    if (!fonts.get())
        return {};
    for (int i = 0; i < fonts.get()->nfont; ++i) {
        Optional<MatchedFile> file;
        {
            MutexLocker locker(fontconfig_mutex());
            auto* candidate = fonts.get()->fonts[i];
            if (!covers_code_point(candidate))
                continue;
            OwnedPattern prepared { FcFontRenderPrepare(config, pattern.get(), candidate) };
            if (!prepared.get() || !covers_code_point(prepared.get()))
                continue;
            file = matched_file(prepared.get());
        }
        if (auto match = loadable_match(file); match.has_value())
            return match;
    }
    return {};
}

Optional<FlyString> resolve_generic_family(StringView family, u16 weight, u8 slope)
{
    ByteString family_name;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(fontconfig_mutex());
        auto font = match_font_for_family(family, weight, FontWidth::Normal, slope);
        if (!font.get())
            return {};
        FcChar8* name = nullptr;
        if (FcPatternGetString(font.get(), FC_FAMILY, 0, &name) != FcResultMatch)
            return {};
        family_name = reinterpret_cast<char const*>(name);
    }
    auto resolved_family = FlyString::from_utf8(family_name.view());
    if (resolved_family.is_error())
        return {};
    return resolved_family.release_value();
}

}

#include <harfbuzz/hb-ot.h>

ErrorOr<Vector<String>> Typeface::local_font_names() const
{
    // https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#local-font-fallback
    // NB: local() identifies a face by its full name or PostScript name, never by its family.
    Vector<String> names;
    for (auto name_id : { HB_OT_NAME_ID_FULL_NAME, HB_OT_NAME_ID_POSTSCRIPT_NAME }) {
        if (auto name = face_name(harfbuzz_typeface(), name_id); name.has_value())
            TRY(names.try_append(name.release_value()));
    }
    return names;
}

Optional<String> Typeface::postscript_name() const
{
    return face_name(harfbuzz_typeface(), HB_OT_NAME_ID_POSTSCRIPT_NAME);
}

FlyString const& Typeface::family() const
{
    return description().family();
}

u16 Typeface::weight() const
{
    return fixed_style().value_or(description().style()).weight;
}

u16 Typeface::width() const
{
    return fixed_style().value_or(description().style()).width;
}

u8 Typeface::slope() const
{
    return fixed_style().value_or(description().style()).slope;
}

ReadonlyBytes Typeface::FontDataBacking::bytes() const
{
    return storage.visit(
        [](Core::AnonymousBuffer const& anonymous_buffer) { return anonymous_buffer.bytes(); },
        [](NonnullOwnPtr<Core::MappedFile> const& mapped_file) { return mapped_file->bytes(); });
}

static constexpr FourCC truetype_tag { "true" };

static bool is_sfnt_version(u32 tag)
{
    // https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/otff#table-directory
    return tag == 0x00010000 || tag == FourCC { "OTTO" }.to_u32() || tag == truetype_tag.to_u32();
}

// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/otff#table-directory
// The rules of FreeType for a table directory. A table that starts after the end of the data does not count, and
// neither does one that ends after it, except for the metrics tables, which FreeType cuts off.
static bool is_valid_table_directory(FontDataReader const& data, size_t offset, u32 version)
{
    if (!data.contains(offset, 12))
        return false;
    size_t table_count = data.u16_at(offset + 4);
    if (table_count == 0)
        return false;
    // FreeType checks the directory of a face with CFF outlines no further.
    if (version == FourCC { "OTTO" }.to_u32())
        return data.contains(offset + 12, table_count * 16);

    size_t valid_tables = 0;
    bool has_head = false;
    bool has_sing = false;
    bool has_meta = false;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < table_count && data.contains(offset + 12 + index * 16, 16); ++index) {
        auto record = offset + 12 + index * 16;
        auto tag = data.u32_at(record);
        size_t table_offset = data.u32_at(record + 8);
        size_t table_length = data.u32_at(record + 12);
        if (table_offset > data.bytes().size())
            continue;
        if (table_length > data.bytes().size() - table_offset && tag != FourCC { "hmtx" }.to_u32() && tag != FourCC { "vmtx" }.to_u32())
            continue;
        ++valid_tables;
        if (tag == FourCC { "head" }.to_u32() || tag == FourCC { "bhed" }.to_u32()) {
            // Each font header must have its full size, whichever of them FreeType reads.
            if (table_length < 54)
                return false;
            has_head = true;
        } else if (tag == FourCC { "SING" }.to_u32()) {
            has_sing = true;
        } else if (tag == FourCC { "META" }.to_u32()) {
            has_meta = true;
        }
    }
    // A face with SING and META tables, which Adobe fonts of single glyphs have, does not need a font header.
    return valid_tables > 0 && (has_head || (has_sing && has_meta));
}

// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/fvar#instancerecord
// The number of named instances that the upper 16 bits of a face index can select. If no instance of a face has the
// default coordinates, FreeType adds an instance with them after the others. It gives a face with only CFF outlines
// no named instances.
static u32 named_instance_count(hb_face_t* face)
{
    if (face_has_table(face, FourCC { "CFF " }) && !face_has_table(face, FourCC { "glyf" }) && !face_has_table(face, FourCC { "CFF2" }))
        return 0;
    auto axis_count = hb_ot_var_get_axis_count(face);
    if (axis_count == 0)
        return 0;

    Vector<hb_ot_var_axis_info_t> axes;
    axes.resize(axis_count);
    hb_ot_var_get_axis_infos(face, 0, &axis_count, axes.data());

    auto instance_count = hb_ot_var_get_named_instance_count(face);
    Vector<float> coordinates;
    coordinates.resize(axis_count);
    for (unsigned instance = 0; instance < instance_count; ++instance) {
        auto coordinate_count = axis_count;
        hb_ot_var_named_instance_get_design_coords(face, instance, &coordinate_count, coordinates.data());
        bool has_default_coordinates = coordinate_count == axis_count;
        for (unsigned index = 0; has_default_coordinates && index < axis_count; ++index)
            has_default_coordinates = coordinates[index] == axes[index].default_value;
        if (has_default_coordinates)
            return instance_count;
    }
    return instance_count + 1;
}

// Font data must have a face that FreeType loads as an SFNT font and that HarfBuzz reads. These are the rules by which
// FreeType loads the tables of a face.
static ErrorOr<void> validate_face(ReadonlyBytes bytes, u32 ttc_index)
{
    // Skia does not load font data of more than 1 GiB.
    if (bytes.size() > 1 * GiB)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Font data is too large");

    auto face_index = ttc_index & 0xFFFF;
    FontDataReader data { bytes };
    auto directory_offset = table_directory_offset(data, face_index);
    if (!directory_offset.has_value() || !data.contains(*directory_offset, 4))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Font data has no face in the SFNT format");
    auto version = data.u32_at(*directory_offset);
    if (!is_sfnt_version(version) || !is_valid_table_directory(data, *directory_offset, version))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Font data has no face in the SFNT format");

    auto* blob = hb_blob_create(reinterpret_cast<char const*>(bytes.data()), bytes.size(), HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY, nullptr, nullptr);
    ScopeGuard destroy_blob = [&] { hb_blob_destroy(blob); };
    if (face_index >= hb_face_count(blob))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Font data has no face that HarfBuzz can read");
    auto* face = hb_face_create(blob, ttc_index);
    ScopeGuard destroy_face = [&] { hb_face_destroy(face); };

    auto has_table = [&](char const* tag) { return face_has_table(face, FourCC { tag }); };
    // A header of a table that FreeType reads with its fixed size, from the following data if the table is shorter.
    auto read_header = [&](char const* tag, size_t size) -> Optional<FontDataReader> {
        FontTable table { face, FourCC { tag } };
        if (table.is_empty() || !table.with_following_data().contains(0, size))
            return {};
        return table.with_following_data();
    };

    // https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/head
    // A face without outlines can be an Apple bitmap font, which has a bhed table instead of a head table.
    bool has_outlines = has_table("glyf") || has_table("CFF ") || has_table("CFF2");
    auto bitmap_header = has_outlines ? Optional<FontDataReader> {} : read_header("bhed", 54);
    bool is_apple_bitmap_font = bitmap_header.has_value();
    auto header = bitmap_header;
    if (!is_apple_bitmap_font || has_table("sbix")) {
        header = read_header("head", 54);
        if (!header.has_value())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Font face has no head table");
    }
    auto units_per_em = header->u16_at(18);
    if (units_per_em < 16 || units_per_em > 16384)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Font face has an invalid number of units per em");

    // https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/maxp
    if (!has_table("maxp"))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Font face has no maxp table");

    // https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/hhea
    // A TrueType font for macOS does not need horizontal metrics.
    if (!is_apple_bitmap_font) {
        if (read_header("hhea", 36).has_value()) {
            if (!has_table("hmtx"))
                return Error::from_string_literal("Font face has no hmtx table");
        } else if (version != truetype_tag.to_u32()) {
            return Error::from_string_literal("Font face has no hhea table");
        }
    }

    if (version == FourCC { "OTTO" }.to_u32()) {
        // https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/otff#organization-of-an-opentype-font
        if (!has_table("CFF ") && !has_table("CFF2"))
            return Error::from_string_literal("Font face with CFF outlines has no CFF table");
    } else {
        // https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/loca
        // FreeType needs a loca table for every TrueType face that it does not draw from bitmap strikes alone. It
        // draws a face without outlines or strikes as a face with empty outlines, and color bitmaps replace outlines.
        bool has_scalable_outlines = has_outlines && !has_table("CBLC") && !has_table("CBDT");
        bool has_bitmap_strikes = has_table("EBLC") || has_table("CBLC") || has_table("bloc") || has_table("sbix");
        if ((has_scalable_outlines || !has_bitmap_strikes) && !has_table("loca"))
            return Error::from_string_literal("Font face has no loca table");
    }

    if ((ttc_index >> 16) > named_instance_count(face))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Font face has no such named instance");
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> Typeface::try_load_from_font_data(NonnullRefPtr<FontDataBacking> font_data, u32 ttc_index)
{
    TRY(validate_face(font_data->bytes(), ttc_index));
    return adopt_ref(*new Typeface(move(font_data), ttc_index));
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> Typeface::try_load_from_mapped_file(NonnullOwnPtr<Core::MappedFile> mapped_file, u32 ttc_index)
{
    return try_load_from_font_data(make_ref_counted<FontDataBacking>(move(mapped_file)), ttc_index);
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> Typeface::try_load_from_anonymous_buffer(Core::AnonymousBuffer anonymous_buffer, u32 ttc_index)
{
    return try_load_from_font_data(make_ref_counted<FontDataBacking>(move(anonymous_buffer)), ttc_index);
}

ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> Typeface::try_load_from_temporary_memory(ReadonlyBytes bytes, u32 ttc_index)
{
    auto anonymous_buffer = TRY(Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_with_size(bytes.size()));
    if (!bytes.is_empty())
        memcpy(anonymous_buffer.data<void>(), bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    return try_load_from_anonymous_buffer(move(anonymous_buffer), ttc_index);
}

static Atomic<u64> s_next_typeface_id { 1 };
static Atomic<Typeface::DestructionObserver> s_destruction_observer { nullptr };

void Typeface::set_destruction_observer(DestructionObserver observer)
{
    s_destruction_observer.store(observer, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_release);
}

Typeface::Typeface()
    : m_id(s_next_typeface_id.fetch_add(1, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_relaxed))
{
    VERIFY(m_id != 0);
}

Typeface::Typeface(NonnullRefPtr<FontDataBacking> font_data, u32 ttc_index)
    : Typeface()
{
    m_font_data = move(font_data);
    m_ttc_index = ttc_index;
}

Typeface::~Typeface()
{
    if (auto observer = s_destruction_observer.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_acquire))
        observer(m_id);
    if (m_cmap_font)
        hb_font_destroy(m_cmap_font);
    if (m_harfbuzz_face)
        hb_face_destroy(m_harfbuzz_face);
    if (m_harfbuzz_blob)
        hb_blob_destroy(m_harfbuzz_blob);
}

namespace {

// The fonts that were made last. Text asks for the same fonts again and again, so a font stays alive for a while after
// its last holder drops it, and keeps its id and the data of its rasterizer when it comes back.
struct RecentFonts {
    static constexpr size_t capacity = 256;

    Mutex mutex;
    Array<RefPtr<Font const>, capacity> fonts;
    size_t next_index { 0 };
};

void keep_recent_font(NonnullRefPtr<Font const> font)
{
    static NeverDestroyed<RecentFonts> recent_fonts;
    RefPtr<Font const> oldest_font;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { recent_fonts->mutex };
        oldest_font = exchange(recent_fonts->fonts[recent_fonts->next_index], move(font));
        recent_fonts->next_index = (recent_fonts->next_index + 1) % RecentFonts::capacity;
    }
    // NB: The oldest font is released after the lock, because releasing it can destroy the font and its typeface.
}

}

NonnullRefPtr<Font> Typeface::font(float point_size, FontVariationSettings const& variations, Gfx::ShapeFeatures const& shape_features, FontSynthesis synthesis) const
{
    RefPtr<Font> font;
    {
        MutexLocker locker { m_fonts_mutex };
        FontCacheKey key { point_size, variations.to_sorted_list(), shape_features, synthesis };

        // A font that another thread is destroying cannot be referenced any more, and a new font replaces it.
        if (auto it = m_fonts.find(key); it != m_fonts.end() && it->value->try_ref())
            return adopt_ref(*it->value);

        font = adopt_ref(*new Font(*this, point_size, point_size, variations, shape_features, synthesis));
        m_fonts.set(move(key), font.ptr());
    }
    keep_recent_font(*font);
    return font.release_nonnull();
}

NonnullRefPtr<Font> Typeface::invisible_font(float point_size, FontVariationSettings const& variations, Gfx::ShapeFeatures const& shape_features, FontSynthesis synthesis) const
{
    auto font = adopt_ref(*new Font(*this, point_size, point_size, variations, shape_features, synthesis));
    font->m_is_invisible = true;
    return font;
}

void Typeface::forget_font(Font const& font) const
{
    MutexLocker locker { m_fonts_mutex };
    FontCacheKey key { font.point_size(), font.variation_settings().to_sorted_list(), font.features(), font.synthesis() };
    // Invisible variants are not in the cache, and a newer font may have replaced this one.
    if (auto it = m_fonts.find(key); it != m_fonts.end() && it->value == &font)
        m_fonts.remove(it);
}

hb_face_t* Typeface::harfbuzz_typeface() const
{
    call_once(m_harfbuzz_face_once, [&] {
        m_harfbuzz_face = create_harfbuzz_face();
        hb_face_make_immutable(m_harfbuzz_face);
    });
    return m_harfbuzz_face;
}

u32 Typeface::glyph_count() const
{
    return hb_face_get_glyph_count(harfbuzz_typeface());
}

u16 Typeface::units_per_em() const
{
    return hb_face_get_upem(harfbuzz_typeface());
}

u32 Typeface::glyph_id_for_code_point(u32 code_point) const
{
    return glyph_page(code_point / GlyphPage::glyphs_per_page).glyph_ids[code_point % GlyphPage::glyphs_per_page];
}

Typeface::GlyphPage const& Typeface::glyph_page(size_t page_index) const
{
    struct GlyphPageCache {
        AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

        u64 last_use { 0 };
        OwnPtr<GlyphPage> page_zero;
        HashMap<size_t, NonnullOwnPtr<GlyphPage>> pages;
    };
    struct ThreadGlyphPageCaches {
        u64 last_typeface_id { 0 };
        GlyphPageCache* last_cache { nullptr };
        u64 use_clock { 0 };
        HashMap<u64, NonnullOwnPtr<GlyphPageCache>> caches;
    };
    // NB: -Wexit-time-destructors is a Clang-only warning, and GCC rejects the
    //     unknown option name in the pragma.
#ifdef AK_COMPILER_CLANG
    AK_IGNORE_DIAGNOSTIC("-Wexit-time-destructors", static thread_local ThreadGlyphPageCaches thread_caches)
#else
    static thread_local ThreadGlyphPageCaches thread_caches;
#endif

    auto& caches = thread_caches.caches;
    auto* cache = thread_caches.last_cache;
    if (thread_caches.last_typeface_id != m_id) {
        if (auto it = caches.find(m_id); it != caches.end()) {
            cache = it->value.ptr();
        } else {
            constexpr size_t maximum_cached_typefaces = 128;
            if (caches.size() >= maximum_cached_typefaces) {
                // NB: Evict the cache this thread used least recently. The caches of typefaces that are gone go first,
                //     and the ones a text run alternates between stay: evicting any other would have them evict each
                //     other at every switch once the caches of a long session filled up.
                auto least_recently_used = caches.begin();
                for (auto it = caches.begin(); it != caches.end(); ++it) {
                    if (it->value->last_use < least_recently_used->value->last_use)
                        least_recently_used = it;
                }
                caches.remove(least_recently_used);
            }
            auto new_cache = make<GlyphPageCache>();
            cache = new_cache.ptr();
            caches.set(m_id, move(new_cache));
        }
        cache->last_use = ++thread_caches.use_clock;
        thread_caches.last_typeface_id = m_id;
        thread_caches.last_cache = cache;
    }

    if (page_index == 0) {
        if (!cache->page_zero) {
            cache->page_zero = make<GlyphPage>();
            populate_glyph_page(*cache->page_zero, 0);
        }
        return *cache->page_zero;
    }
    if (auto it = cache->pages.find(page_index); it != cache->pages.end()) {
        return *it->value;
    }

    auto glyph_page = make<GlyphPage>();
    populate_glyph_page(*glyph_page, page_index);
    auto const* glyph_page_ptr = glyph_page.ptr();
    cache->pages.set(page_index, move(glyph_page));
    return *glyph_page_ptr;
}

static thread_local u64 s_glyph_pages_populated_on_this_thread = 0;

u64 Typeface::glyph_pages_populated_on_this_thread()
{
    return s_glyph_pages_populated_on_this_thread;
}

void Typeface::populate_glyph_page(GlyphPage& glyph_page, size_t page_index) const
{
    ++s_glyph_pages_populated_on_this_thread;
    u32 first_code_point = page_index * GlyphPage::glyphs_per_page;
    auto* font = cmap_font();
    auto glyph_count = this->glyph_count();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < GlyphPage::glyphs_per_page; ++i) {
        u32 code_point = first_code_point + i;
        hb_codepoint_t glyph_id = 0;
        // A cmap can name a glyph that the face does not have. Such a code point has no glyph.
        if (!hb_font_get_nominal_glyph(font, code_point, &glyph_id) || glyph_id >= glyph_count)
            glyph_id = 0;
        glyph_page.glyph_ids[i] = static_cast<u16>(glyph_id);
    }
}

// An unscaled font for code point lookups. The face's cmap gives the same glyphs at every size.
hb_font_t* Typeface::cmap_font() const
{
    call_once(m_cmap_font_once, [&] {
        m_cmap_font = hb_font_create(harfbuzz_typeface());
        hb_font_make_immutable(m_cmap_font);
    });
    return m_cmap_font;
}

FaceDescription const& Typeface::description() const
{
    call_once(m_description_once, [&] {
        m_description = FaceDescription::read(harfbuzz_typeface());
    });
    return *m_description;
}

// NB: A slant of 90 degrees has an infinite skew, so a synthetic oblique stops just short of it.
static constexpr float max_synthetic_oblique_angle = 89;

FontSynthesis Typeface::synthesis_for(FontSynthesisRequest const& request, FontVariationSettings const& variations) const
{
    auto style = style_for_variations(variations.to_sorted_list());
    FontSynthesis synthesis;
    // A face that is lighter than bold is drawn bolder for a bold request. A variable face whose weight axis stops
    // short of the weight asked for is drawn at the end of its axis instead, as its designer made it.
    if (request.allows_weight && request.weight >= 600 && style.weight < 600 && !description().has_axis(FourCC("wght").to_u32()))
        synthesis.bold = true;
    // An upright face is slanted for an italic or oblique request, unless its axes give it a slant of its own.
    if (request.allows_style && request.slope != 0 && style.slope == 0
        && !description().has_axis(FourCC("ital").to_u32()) && !description().has_axis(FourCC("slnt").to_u32()))
        synthesis.oblique_angle = clamp(request.oblique_angle, -max_synthetic_oblique_angle, max_synthetic_oblique_angle);
    return synthesis;
}

FaceStyle Typeface::style_for_variations(ReadonlySpan<FontVariationAxis> variations) const
{
    if (auto style = fixed_style(); style.has_value())
        return *style;
    return description().style_for_variations(variations);
}

// Recording asks for this while the document thread may ask the same typeface for it, so the
// read of a half-written memo has to be impossible. The same `call_once` the HarfBuzz face uses
// above publishes it.
Typeface::BoundingBoxInFontUnits Typeface::bounding_box_in_font_units() const
{
    call_once(m_bounding_box_once, [&] {
        auto* face = harfbuzz_typeface();
        auto* head_table = hb_face_reference_table(face, HB_TAG('h', 'e', 'a', 'd'));
        unsigned head_table_length = 0;
        auto const* head_table_data = reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(hb_blob_get_data(head_table, &head_table_length));

        // https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/head
        // xMin, yMin, xMax and yMax are big-endian int16 values at byte offsets 36, 38, 40 and 42 of a 54-byte table.
        constexpr unsigned head_table_size = 54;
        if (head_table_data && head_table_length >= head_table_size) {
            auto read_i16 = [&](unsigned offset) {
                return static_cast<i16>((head_table_data[offset] << 8) | head_table_data[offset + 1]);
            };
            m_bounding_box_in_font_units.x_min = read_i16(36);
            m_bounding_box_in_font_units.y_min = read_i16(38);
            m_bounding_box_in_font_units.x_max = read_i16(40);
            m_bounding_box_in_font_units.y_max = read_i16(42);
            m_bounding_box_in_font_units.units_per_em = hb_face_get_upem(face);
        }
        hb_blob_destroy(head_table);
    });
    return m_bounding_box_in_font_units;
}

hb_face_t* Typeface::create_harfbuzz_face() const
{
    if (!m_harfbuzz_blob)
        m_harfbuzz_blob = hb_blob_create(reinterpret_cast<char const*>(font_data().data()), font_data().size(), HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY, nullptr, [](void*) { });
    return hb_face_create(m_harfbuzz_blob, m_ttc_index);
}

void Typeface::encode_font_data_for_ipc(IPC::Encoder& encoder) const
{
    if (m_system_font_identifier.has_value()) {
        MUST(encoder.encode(FontDataFormat::SystemFontId));
        MUST(encoder.encode(m_system_font_identifier->generation));
        MUST(encoder.encode(m_system_font_identifier->face_id));
        return;
    }

    if (m_file_path.has_value()) {
        MUST(encoder.encode(FontDataFormat::MappedFile));
        MUST(encoder.encode(*m_file_path));
        MUST(encoder.encode(m_ttc_index));
        return;
    }

    VERIFY(m_font_data);

    m_font_data->storage.visit(
        [&](Core::AnonymousBuffer const& anonymous_buffer) {
            MUST(encoder.encode(FontDataFormat::RawFontData));
            MUST(encoder.encode(anonymous_buffer));
            MUST(encoder.encode(m_ttc_index));
        },
        [&](NonnullOwnPtr<Core::MappedFile> const&) {
            // NB: SharedMappedFile backing should have an associated m_system_font_identifier or m_file_path and
            //     therefore have already been handled above.
            VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
        });
}

}

namespace IPC {

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Gfx::Typeface const& typeface)
{
    typeface.encode_font_data_for_ipc(encoder);
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Gfx::Typeface const>> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto format = TRY(decoder.decode<Gfx::Typeface::FontDataFormat>());

    switch (format) {
    case Gfx::Typeface::FontDataFormat::RawFontData: {
        auto font_data = TRY(decoder.decode<Core::AnonymousBuffer>());
        auto ttc_index = TRY(decoder.decode<u32>());
        if (!font_data.is_valid())
            return Error::from_string_literal("Typeface IPC data contained invalid font data");
        return TRY(Gfx::Typeface::try_load_from_anonymous_buffer(move(font_data), ttc_index));
    }
    case Gfx::Typeface::FontDataFormat::MappedFile: {
        auto file_path = TRY(decoder.decode<String>());
        auto ttc_index = TRY(decoder.decode<u32>());

        auto typeface = TRY(Gfx::Typeface::try_load_from_mapped_file(TRY(Core::MappedFile::map(file_path)), ttc_index));
        typeface->set_file_path(move(file_path));
        return typeface;
    }
    case Gfx::Typeface::FontDataFormat::SystemUIFont: {
        auto style = TRY(decoder.decode<Gfx::SystemUIFontStyle>());
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
        if (auto typeface = Gfx::TypefaceCoreText::system_ui(style))
            return typeface.release_nonnull();
#else
        (void)style;
#endif
        return Error::from_string_literal("Typeface IPC data referred to an unavailable system UI font");
    }
    case Gfx::Typeface::FontDataFormat::PlatformFontName: {
        auto postscript_name = TRY(decoder.decode<String>());
#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
        return TRY(Gfx::TypefaceCoreText::try_load_postscript_name(postscript_name));
#else
        (void)postscript_name;
        return Error::from_string_literal("Typeface IPC data referred to a platform font, which this platform does not have");
#endif
    }
    case Gfx::Typeface::FontDataFormat::SystemFontId: {
        auto generation = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
        auto face_id = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
        auto matched_typeface = Gfx::FontDatabase::the().get_typeface_by_id(generation, face_id);
        if (!matched_typeface)
            return Error::from_string_literal("Typeface IPC data referred to an unavailable system font");
        return matched_typeface.release_nonnull();
    }
    }

    return Error::from_string_literal("Typeface IPC data contained invalid font data format");
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Gfx::SystemUIFontStyle const& style)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(style.kind));
    TRY(encoder.encode(style.weight));
    TRY(encoder.encode(style.width));
    TRY(encoder.encode(style.slope));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Gfx::SystemUIFontStyle> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto kind = TRY(decoder.decode<Gfx::SystemUIFontKind>());
    auto weight = TRY(decoder.decode<u16>());
    auto width = TRY(decoder.decode<u16>());
    auto slope = TRY(decoder.decode<u8>());
    return Gfx::SystemUIFontStyle { kind, weight, width, slope };
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/Once.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/QuickSort.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <LibCore/AnonymousBuffer.h>
#include <LibCore/MappedFile.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/FaceDescription.h>
#include <LibGfx/Font/FontVariationSettings.h>
#include <LibGfx/Forward.h>
#include <LibGfx/RasterizerData.h>
#include <LibGfx/ShapeFeature.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>

#define POINTS_PER_INCH 72.0f
#define DEFAULT_DPI 96

struct hb_blob_t;
struct hb_face_t;
struct hb_font_t;

namespace Gfx {

class Font;
struct TypefaceRasterizerData;

struct SystemFontIdentifier {
    u64 generation { 0 };
    u64 face_id { 0 };

    bool operator==(SystemFontIdentifier const&) const = default;
};

// The designs of the system UI font that CSS can name.
enum class SystemUIFontKind : u8 {
    System,
    Serif,
    Monospace,
    Rounded,
};

struct SystemUIFontStyle {
    SystemUIFontKind kind;
    u16 weight;
    u16 width;
    u8 slope;
};

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#font-synthesis-intro
// How a font is drawn bolder or slanted than its face, where the face lacks the weight or style asked for.
struct FontSynthesis {
    bool bold { false };
    // The angle of a synthetic oblique, in degrees; positive slants the glyphs' tops toward the end of the line.
    float oblique_angle { 0 };

    bool operator==(FontSynthesis const&) const = default;
};

// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#font-synthesis-weight
// https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts-4/#font-synthesis-style
// What a request for text at this weight and slope (0 normal, 1 italic, 2 oblique) asks to be synthesized of a font
// made of the typeface with these variations, where the request allows synthesis of weight and of style.
struct FontSynthesisRequest {
    int weight { 400 };
    int slope { 0 };
    // The angle of the oblique style the request asks for, in degrees.
    float oblique_angle { 14 };
    bool allows_weight { true };
    bool allows_style { true };
};

struct FontCacheKey {
    float point_size;
    Vector<FontVariationAxis> axes;
    Gfx::ShapeFeatures shape_features;
    FontSynthesis synthesis;

    // Sizes and values compare by their bits, as the hash reads them, so that a key with NaN finds itself.
    bool operator==(FontCacheKey const& other) const
    {
        if (bit_cast<u32>(point_size) != bit_cast<u32>(other.point_size) || axes.size() != other.axes.size() || shape_features != other.shape_features
            || synthesis.bold != other.synthesis.bold || bit_cast<u32>(synthesis.oblique_angle) != bit_cast<u32>(other.synthesis.oblique_angle))
            return false;
        for (size_t index = 0; index < axes.size(); ++index) {
            if (axes[index].tag != other.axes[index].tag || bit_cast<u32>(axes[index].value) != bit_cast<u32>(other.axes[index].value))
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    unsigned hash() const
    {
        auto h = pair_int_hash(bit_cast<u32>(point_size), axes.size());
        for (auto const& axis : axes)
            h = pair_int_hash(h, pair_int_hash(axis.tag.to_u32(), bit_cast<u32>(axis.value)));
        h = pair_int_hash(h, Traits<Gfx::ShapeFeatures>::hash(shape_features));
        h = pair_int_hash(h, pair_int_hash(synthesis.bold, bit_cast<u32>(synthesis.oblique_angle)));
        return h;
    }
};

class Typeface : public AtomicRefCounted<Typeface> {
public:
    struct FontDataBacking final : AtomicRefCounted<FontDataBacking> {
        using Storage = Variant<Core::AnonymousBuffer, NonnullOwnPtr<Core::MappedFile>>;

        explicit FontDataBacking(Storage storage)
            : storage(move(storage))
        {
        }

        ReadonlyBytes bytes() const;

        Storage storage;
    };

    // The face of font data that FreeType loads as an SFNT font and that HarfBuzz reads, so that both shaping and every
    // rasterizer have the face. The upper 16 bits of the index select a named instance of a variable face, from 1.
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> try_load_from_font_data(NonnullRefPtr<FontDataBacking>, u32 ttc_index = 0);
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> try_load_from_mapped_file(NonnullOwnPtr<Core::MappedFile>, u32 ttc_index = 0);
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> try_load_from_anonymous_buffer(Core::AnonymousBuffer, u32 ttc_index = 0);
    static ErrorOr<NonnullRefPtr<Typeface>> try_load_from_temporary_memory(ReadonlyBytes bytes, u32 ttc_index = 0);

    virtual ~Typeface();

    u64 id() const { return m_id; }

    using DestructionObserver = void (*)(u64 typeface_id);
    static void set_destruction_observer(DestructionObserver);

    u32 glyph_count() const;
    u16 units_per_em() const;
    u32 glyph_id_for_code_point(u32 code_point) const;
    FlyString const& family() const;
    u16 weight() const;
    u16 width() const;
    u8 slope() const;

    ReadonlyBytes font_data() const LIFETIME_BOUND { return m_font_data ? m_font_data->bytes() : ReadonlyBytes {}; }
    // What keeps the font data alive. Null for a typeface without font data of its own.
    RefPtr<FontDataBacking> font_data_backing() const { return m_font_data; }
    u32 collection_index() const { return m_ttc_index; }

    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<Font> font(float point_size, FontVariationSettings const& variations = {}, Gfx::ShapeFeatures const& shape_features = {}, FontSynthesis synthesis = {}) const;
    // A font that measures and shapes text like font() but draws nothing. Each call makes a new font.
    [[nodiscard]] NonnullRefPtr<Font> invisible_font(float point_size, FontVariationSettings const& variations = {}, Gfx::ShapeFeatures const& shape_features = {}, FontSynthesis synthesis = {}) const;

    void set_system_font_identifier(SystemFontIdentifier identifier) { m_system_font_identifier = identifier; }
    Optional<SystemFontIdentifier> system_font_identifier() const { return m_system_font_identifier; }

    void set_file_path(String file_path) { m_file_path = move(file_path); }

    hb_face_t* harfbuzz_typeface() const;
    FaceDescription const& description() const;

    // How a font of this typeface, with these variations, has to be synthesized to show the weight and the slope that
    // the request asks for.
    FontSynthesis synthesis_for(FontSynthesisRequest const&, FontVariationSettings const&) const;

    // The style of a font of this typeface with these variations.
    FaceStyle style_for_variations(ReadonlySpan<FontVariationAxis>) const;
    ErrorOr<Vector<String>> local_font_names() const;
    Optional<String> postscript_name() const;

    // What a rasterizer keeps with this typeface. The first call makes it.
    template<typename Callback>
    TypefaceRasterizerData& rasterizer_data(Callback make) const { return m_rasterizer_data.get(make); }

    // Union of all glyph bounding boxes as recorded in the `head` table, in font units with y pointing up.
    // is_empty() when the face has no usable `head` table (e.g. bitmap-only fonts).
    struct BoundingBoxInFontUnits {
        i16 x_min { 0 };
        i16 y_min { 0 };
        i16 x_max { 0 };
        i16 y_max { 0 };
        u16 units_per_em { 0 };

        bool is_empty() const { return x_min >= x_max || y_min >= y_max || units_per_em == 0; }
    };
    BoundingBoxInFontUnits bounding_box_in_font_units() const;

    template<typename T>
    bool fast_is() const = delete;

    virtual bool is_core_text() const { return false; }

    // How many glyph pages the calling thread has filled in, for tests of its glyph page caches.
    static u64 glyph_pages_populated_on_this_thread();

protected:
    enum class FontDataFormat : u8 {
        RawFontData,
        MappedFile,
        SystemUIFont,
        SystemFontId,
        PlatformFontName,
    };

    // A typeface without font data of its own.
    Typeface();

    virtual void encode_font_data_for_ipc(IPC::Encoder&) const;
    virtual hb_face_t* create_harfbuzz_face() const;
    // A typeface that the platform picked for a style answers with that style, whatever its tables say.
    virtual Optional<FaceStyle> fixed_style() const { return {}; }

private:
    Typeface(NonnullRefPtr<FontDataBacking>, u32 ttc_index);

    friend class Font;

    template<typename T>
    friend ErrorOr<void> IPC::encode(IPC::Encoder&, T const&);

    template<typename T>
    friend ErrorOr<T> IPC::decode(IPC::Decoder&);

    RefPtr<FontDataBacking> m_font_data;
    u32 m_ttc_index { 0 };
    Optional<SystemFontIdentifier> m_system_font_identifier;
    Optional<String> m_file_path;

    // A font that is being destroyed leaves the cache of its typeface.
    void forget_font(Font const&) const;

    // This cache stores information per code point.
    // It's segmented into pages with data about 256 code points each.
    struct GlyphPage {
        AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

        static constexpr size_t glyphs_per_page = 256;
        u16 glyph_ids[glyphs_per_page];
    };

    [[nodiscard]] GlyphPage const& glyph_page(size_t page_index) const;
    void populate_glyph_page(GlyphPage&, size_t page_index) const;
    hb_font_t* cmap_font() const;

    // Addresses can be reused after destruction, so per-thread caches and other processes name a typeface by a
    // monotonic identity.
    u64 m_id { 0 };

    mutable Mutex m_fonts_mutex;
    // The fonts that are alive. A font does not keep itself here, so it holds its typeface without a reference cycle.
    mutable HashMap<FontCacheKey, Font*> m_fonts;
    mutable OnceFlag m_harfbuzz_face_once;
    mutable hb_blob_t* m_harfbuzz_blob { nullptr };
    mutable hb_face_t* m_harfbuzz_face { nullptr };
    mutable OnceFlag m_cmap_font_once;
    mutable hb_font_t* m_cmap_font { nullptr };
    mutable OnceFlag m_description_once;
    mutable Optional<FaceDescription> m_description;
    mutable OnceFlag m_bounding_box_once;
    mutable BoundingBoxInFontUnits m_bounding_box_in_font_units;
    RasterizerDataSlot<TypefaceRasterizerData> m_rasterizer_data;
};

}

template<>
struct AK::Traits<Gfx::FontCacheKey> : public AK::DefaultTraits<Gfx::FontCacheKey> {
    static unsigned hash(Gfx::FontCacheKey const& key)
    {
        return key.hash();
    }
};
