// NB: Drop each thread's reference when that thread exits.
#ifdef AK_COMPILER_CLANG
AK_IGNORE_DIAGNOSTIC("-Wexit-time-destructors", static thread_local RefPtr<SyncRequestCanceller> s_sync_request_canceller)
#else
static thread_local RefPtr<SyncRequestCanceller> s_sync_request_canceller;
#endif

void SyncRequestCanceller::install_on_this_thread()
{
    s_sync_request_canceller = *this;
}

bool SyncRequestCanceller::is_installed_on_this_thread()
{
    return s_sync_request_canceller;
}

void SyncRequestCanceller::cancel()
{
    m_cancelled.store(true, AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_release);

    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    if (m_transport_waited_on)
        m_transport_waited_on->interrupt_wait_until_readable();
}

void SyncRequestCanceller::set_transport_waited_on(Transport* transport)
{
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    m_transport_waited_on = transport;
}

ConnectionBase::ConnectionBase(IPC::Stub& local_stub, NonnullOwnPtr<Transport> transport, u32 local_endpoint_magic)
    : m_local_stub(local_stub)
    , m_transport(move(transport))
    , m_local_endpoint_magic(local_endpoint_magic)
{
    m_transport->set_up_read_hook([this] {
        NonnullRefPtr protect = *this;
        drain_messages_from_peer();
        handle_messages();
    });
}

ConnectionBase::~ConnectionBase() = default;

bool ConnectionBase::is_open() const
{
    return m_transport->is_open();
}

ErrorOr<void> ConnectionBase::post_message(Message const& message)
{
    auto buffer = TRY(message.encode());
    return post_message(buffer);
}

ErrorOr<void> ConnectionBase::post_message(MessageBuffer& buffer)
{
    // NOTE: If this connection is being shut down, but has not yet been destroyed,
    //       the socket will be closed. Don't try to send more messages.
    if (!m_transport->is_open())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Trying to post_message during IPC shutdown");

    TRY(buffer.transfer_message(*m_transport));

    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> ConnectionBase::post_sync_request(Message const& request)
{
    auto buffer = TRY(request.encode());
    return post_sync_request(buffer);
}

ErrorOr<void> ConnectionBase::post_sync_request(MessageBuffer& request)
{
    auto result = post_message(request);
    // NB: No response can come if the peer has closed the connection, which is the peer going away just as when a wait
    // for the response finds it gone. So, the connection learns of that, rather than hand the failure to a caller that
    // may have no way to carry on.
    if (result.is_error() && !is_open())
        did_find_transport_closed_during_sync_request();
    return result;
}

void ConnectionBase::did_find_transport_closed_during_sync_request()
{
    if (m_peer_owns_this_process) {
        did_lose_peer_during_sync_request();
        return;
    }
    // NB: The caller of the request that failed may still use the connection, which dying could let go of. The event
    // loop keeps it alive until then.
    if (!m_died)
        deferred_invoke([this] { did_lose_peer_during_sync_request(); });
}

bool ConnectionBase::send_raw_sync_request(MessageBuffer& request, u32 response_endpoint_magic, i32 response_message_id, Function<void(FfiRawMessage)> const& hand_over_response)
{
    if (post_sync_request(request).is_error())
        return false;
    auto response = wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(response_endpoint_magic, response_message_id, MayCancel::Yes);
    if (!response)
        return false;
    auto outcome = static_cast<RawMessage&>(*response).hand_to_rust(hand_over_response);
    if (outcome.misbehavior.has_value()) {
        dbgln("IPC::ConnectionBase ({:p}) got a response it cannot use ({}), disconnecting.", this, *outcome.misbehavior);
        shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool ConnectionBase::send_sync_request_from_rust(void* connection, ReadonlyBytes bytes, ReadonlySpan<RawAttachment> attachments, u32 response_endpoint_magic, i32 response_message_id, void* response_sink, void (*take_response)(void* response_sink, FfiRawMessage))
{
    auto& self = *static_cast<ConnectionBase*>(connection);
    VERIFY(self.m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    auto request = adopt_encoded_message(bytes, attachments);
    return self.send_raw_sync_request(request, response_endpoint_magic, response_message_id, [&](FfiRawMessage response) {
        take_response(response_sink, response);
    });
}

void ConnectionBase::ref_from_rust(void* connection)
{
    auto& self = *static_cast<ConnectionBase*>(connection);
    VERIFY(self.m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    self.ref();
}

void ConnectionBase::unref_from_rust(void* connection)
{
    auto& self = *static_cast<ConnectionBase*>(connection);
    VERIFY(self.m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    self.unref();
}

FfiConnection ConnectionBase::to_ffi_with_one_reference()
{
    VERIFY(m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    ref();
    return {
        .connection_with_one_reference = this,
        .send_sync_request = send_sync_request_from_rust,
        .ref = ref_from_rust,
        .unref = unref_from_rust,
    };
}

void ConnectionBase::shutdown()
{
    VERIFY(m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    if (m_died)
        return;
    m_died = true;
    m_transport->close();

    m_unprocessed_messages.clear();
    for (auto batch : m_dispatching_message_batches) {
        for (auto& message : batch)
            message.clear();
    }

    die();
}

void ConnectionBase::shutdown_with_error(Error const& error)
{
    dbgln("IPC::ConnectionBase ({:p}) had an error ({}), disconnecting.", this, error);
    shutdown();
}

Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<Message>> ConnectionBase::take_unprocessed_messages(u32 endpoint_magic, i32 message_id)
{
    VERIFY(m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<Message>> taken;
    // A handler can make a synchronous request while older messages still await dispatch
    // in its batch. Take those first, including batches suspended by nested event loops.
    for (auto batch : m_dispatching_message_batches) {
        for (auto& message : batch) {
            if (message && message->endpoint_magic() == endpoint_magic && message->message_id() == message_id)
                taken.append(message.release_nonnull());
        }
    }
    m_unprocessed_messages.remove_all_matching([&](auto& message) {
        if (message->endpoint_magic() != endpoint_magic || message->message_id() != message_id)
            return false;
        taken.append(message.release_nonnull());
        return true;
    });
    return taken;
}

void ConnectionBase::dispatch_pending_messages()
{
    VERIFY(m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    m_transport->wait_until_incoming_is_current();
    drain_messages_from_peer();
    handle_messages();
}

void ConnectionBase::handle_messages()
{
    VERIFY(m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    if (m_died)
        return;
    auto messages = move(m_unprocessed_messages);
    m_dispatching_message_batches.append(messages.span());
    ScopeGuard remove_batch = [&] { m_dispatching_message_batches.take_last(); };
    for (auto& message : messages) {
        if (!message)
            continue;
        auto current_message = message.release_nonnull();
        if (current_message->endpoint_magic() != m_local_endpoint_magic)
            continue;

        if (!is_open()) {
            // NB: A peer that owns this process has closed the connection, so there's nothing left to do here but shut
            // down; see set_peer_owns_this_process().
            if (m_peer_owns_this_process) {
                shutdown();
                return;
            }
            dbgln("Handling message while connection closed: {}", current_message->message_name());
        }

        auto handler_result = m_local_stub.handle(move(current_message));
        if (handler_result.is_error()) {
            dbgln("IPC::ConnectionBase::handle_messages: {}", handler_result.error());
            continue;
        }

        if (!is_open())
            continue;

        if (auto response = handler_result.release_value()) {
            if (auto post_result = post_message(*response); post_result.is_error())
                dbgln("IPC::ConnectionBase::handle_messages: {}", post_result.error());
        }
    }
}

void ConnectionBase::wait_for_transport_to_become_readable(Optional<MonotonicTime> deadline)
{
    m_transport->wait_until_readable(deadline);
}

ConnectionBase::PeerEOF ConnectionBase::drain_messages_from_peer()
{
    VERIFY(m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    if (m_died)
        return PeerEOF::Yes;
    bool parse_error = false;
    auto schedule_shutdown = m_transport->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& raw_message) {
        auto bytes = raw_message.bytes.bytes();
        if (auto message = try_parse_message(raw_message.bytes, raw_message.attachments)) {
            m_unprocessed_messages.append(message.release_nonnull());
        } else {
            dbgln("Failed to parse IPC message {:hex-dump}", bytes);
            parse_error = true;
        }
    });

    if (parse_error) {
        dbgln("IPC::ConnectionBase ({:p}): Disconnecting peer after failing to parse a message", this);
        schedule_shutdown = Transport::ShouldShutdown::Yes;
    }

    // NB: Once a peer that owns this process has closed the connection, whatever it sent before closing is moot — and
    // dispatching that would run handlers on a connection that's closed under them. So, drop it all and shut down now,
    // rather than after one last dispatch; see set_peer_owns_this_process().
    if (schedule_shutdown == Transport::ShouldShutdown::Yes && m_peer_owns_this_process) {
        // NB: A wait for a sync response acts on this once it sees that no response came, and shuts down then.
        if (m_is_waiting_for_sync_response)
            m_unprocessed_messages.clear();
        else
            shutdown();
        return PeerEOF::Yes;
    }

    if (!m_unprocessed_messages.is_empty()) {
        deferred_invoke([this] {
            handle_messages();
        });
    }

    if (schedule_shutdown == Transport::ShouldShutdown::Yes) {
        deferred_invoke([this] {
            shutdown();
        });
        return PeerEOF::Yes;
    }

    return PeerEOF::No;
}

OwnPtr<IPC::Message> ConnectionBase::wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(u32 endpoint_magic, int message_id, MayCancel may_cancel, Optional<MonotonicTime> deadline)
{
    VERIFY(m_owner_thread_id.is_current_thread());
    TemporaryChange waiting_for_sync_response { m_is_waiting_for_sync_response, true };
    bool peer_disconnected_during_wait = false;

    // NB: The canceller knows the transport before this thread looks at its flag, so it cannot slip in between that look
    //     and the wait: if it does not find the transport, this thread sees the flag.
    auto canceller = may_cancel == MayCancel::Yes ? s_sync_request_canceller : nullptr;
    if (canceller)
        canceller->set_transport_waited_on(m_transport.ptr());
    ScopeGuard forget_transport = [&] {
        if (canceller)
            canceller->set_transport_waited_on(nullptr);
    };

    auto take_matching_message = [&]() -> OwnPtr<IPC::Message> {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m_unprocessed_messages.size(); ++i) {
            auto& message = m_unprocessed_messages[i];
            if (message->endpoint_magic() != endpoint_magic)
                continue;
            if (message->message_id() == message_id)
                return m_unprocessed_messages.take(i);
        }
        return {};
    };

    for (;;) {
        // NB: Responses have no ID, so one that a cancelled wait left behind would pass for the response to the next
        //     request of that type. A canceller stays cancelled, so nothing takes that response after this point. It
        //     is not dispatched either, as it is not for this endpoint.
        if (canceller && canceller->is_cancelled())
            return {};

        // Double check we don't already have the event waiting for us.
        // Otherwise we might end up blocked for a while for no reason.
        if (auto message = take_matching_message())
            return message;

        // NB: A transport no longer counts as open once its peer is gone or a send has failed, which can be before it has
        //     taken in everything the peer sent, the response among it.
        if (!is_open()) {
            m_transport->wait_until_incoming_is_current();
            if (drain_messages_from_peer() == PeerEOF::Yes)
                peer_disconnected_during_wait = true;
            if (canceller && canceller->is_cancelled())
                return {};
            if (auto message = take_matching_message())
                return message;
            break;
        }
        if (deadline.has_value() && MonotonicTime::now() >= *deadline)
            return {};

        wait_for_transport_to_become_readable(deadline);
        if (drain_messages_from_peer() == PeerEOF::Yes) {
            peer_disconnected_during_wait = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    // The EOF-reporting drain can deliver the awaited response in the same batch. A peer replying then exiting produces
    // that. Take the response instead of failing; the drain-scheduled deferred handle_messages/shutdown still run after-
    // wards. So, other messages from that final batch are dispatched in order before the connection close is acted on.
    if (peer_disconnected_during_wait) {
        if (auto message = take_matching_message())
            return message;
    }

    dbgln("Failed to receive message_id: {}", message_id);

    if (!m_unprocessed_messages.is_empty()) {
        dbgln("Transport shutdown with unprocessed messages left: {}", m_unprocessed_messages.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m_unprocessed_messages.size(); ++i) {
            auto& message = m_unprocessed_messages[i];
            dbgln(" Message {:03} is: {:2}-{}", i, message->message_id(), message->message_name());
        }
    }

    if (peer_disconnected_during_wait) {
        // shutdown() discards any remaining queued messages. wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl can be entered
        // from any sync IPC call — including from inside a constructor whose members are still being initialized. (See
        // issue #9582. PageHost's constructor issues a sync IPC before ConnectionFromClient::m_page_host has been
        // assigned.) Re-entering arbitrary handlers from here can hit uninitialized state and crash. shutdown() closes
        // the transport and calls die(). That exits processes cleanly — the same as queued close_server message would.
        did_lose_peer_during_sync_request();
    } else if (!is_open()) {
        // NB: The peer may also have been found gone before the wait began — e.g. by the transport's IO thread, right
        // after the request was posted; see set_peer_owns_this_process(). A transport whose send failed is closed as
        // well, even while the peer keeps writing, and no response can come then either.
        did_find_transport_closed_during_sync_request();
    }

    return {};
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Atomic.h>
#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/Forward.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Queue.h>
#include <AK/ThreadID.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <LibCore/EventReceiver.h>
#include <LibIPC/Attachment.h>
#include <LibIPC/FfiConnection.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibIPC/Message.h>
#include <LibIPC/RawMessage.h>
#include <LibIPC/ReceivedMessageBytes.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>

namespace IPC {

// Lets any thread end the sync requests of the thread this is installed on, on whichever connection they are. A request
// that may fail then fails, now and from then on, rather than wait for a peer that may never answer. This is for a thread
// that shares its process with others, so that it cannot just exit. Such a thread has no use for a request that cannot
// fail, which would take the whole process along, so it may not make one; see send_sync().
class SyncRequestCanceller final : public AtomicRefCounted<SyncRequestCanceller> {
public:
    static NonnullRefPtr<SyncRequestCanceller> create() { return adopt_ref(*new SyncRequestCanceller); }

    // This stays the canceller of the current thread until the thread ends.
    void install_on_this_thread();
    static bool is_installed_on_this_thread();

    void cancel();
    bool is_cancelled() const { return m_cancelled.load(AK::MemoryOrder::memory_order_acquire); }

private:
    friend class ConnectionBase;

    SyncRequestCanceller() = default;

    void set_transport_waited_on(Transport*);

    Atomic<bool> m_cancelled { false };
    Mutex m_mutex;
    Transport* m_transport_waited_on { nullptr };
};

class ConnectionBase : public Core::EventReceiver {
    C_OBJECT_ABSTRACT(ConnectionBase);

public:
    virtual ~ConnectionBase() override;

    [[nodiscard]] bool is_open() const;
    ErrorOr<void> post_message(Message const&);
    ErrorOr<void> post_message(MessageBuffer&);

    void shutdown();
    virtual void die() { }

    // Tells the connection that its peer owns this process — i.e. that the process exists only to serve that peer, and
    // that die() ends it, right away or once its event loop unwinds. Such a process has nothing left to do once that
    // peer has closed the connection. So, the connection then shuts down rather than be used any further: It drops
    // whatever the peer sent before closing, rather than dispatch that to handlers that'd find the connection closed
    // under them. And it shuts down on a sync request, rather than fail one whose caller may have no way to carry on
    // without the response.
    // Gecko/WebKit/Blink do the same for a child process's connection to its parent, each exiting the process right
    // there: Gecko SetAbortOnError, Blink TerminateSelfOnDisconnect, WebKit
    // setDidCloseOnConnectionWorkQueueCallback/setShouldExitOnSyncMessageSendFailure.
    // NB: Those all exit from their IO thread, which also ends a process whose main thread is stuck in script. This
    // acts on the connection's own thread only — so it doesn't.
    void set_peer_owns_this_process(bool value) { m_peer_owns_this_process = value; }

    Transport& transport() const { return *m_transport; }

    // Messages of one kind that have arrived and have not been dispatched yet, in
    // arrival order. A caller that asked the peer for state synchronously reads what the peer sent ahead of
    // its answer this way, without dispatching anything else out of turn.
    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<Message>> take_unprocessed_messages(u32 endpoint_magic, i32 message_id);

    // A sync request cannot get a response, as a peer that owns this process has closed the connection. The caller of
    // send_sync() has no way to carry on, so a connection whose die() returns has to end the process here.
    virtual void did_lose_peer_during_sync_request() { shutdown(); }

    // Dispatch every message the peer has already sent on this connection, without waiting for new ones.
    void dispatch_pending_messages();

    FfiConnection to_ffi_with_one_reference();

    template<typename RequestType, typename... Args>
    NonnullOwnPtr<typename RequestType::ResponseType> send_sync(Args&&... args)
    {
        // NB: A peer that dies here ends this process, and nothing can stop this wait. A thread with a canceller has to
        //     fail on its own, so all it asks for goes through send_sync_but_allow_failure().
        VERIFY(!SyncRequestCanceller::is_installed_on_this_thread());
        MUST(post_sync_request(RequestType(forward<Args>(args)...)));
        auto response = wait_for_specific_endpoint_message<typename RequestType::ResponseType>();
        VERIFY(response);
        return response.release_nonnull();
    }

    template<typename RequestType, typename... Args>
    OwnPtr<typename RequestType::ResponseType> send_sync_but_allow_failure(Args&&... args)
    {
        if (post_sync_request(RequestType(forward<Args>(args)...)).is_error())
            return nullptr;
        return wait_for_specific_endpoint_message<typename RequestType::ResponseType>(MayCancel::Yes);
    }

    // NB: Responses have no ID, so the response to a request that missed its deadline would pass for the response to
    //     the next request of that type. A caller that gets none while the connection is open must not use the
    //     connection again.
    template<typename RequestType, typename... Args>
    OwnPtr<typename RequestType::ResponseType> send_sync_until(MonotonicTime deadline, Args&&... args)
    {
        if (post_sync_request(RequestType(forward<Args>(args)...)).is_error())
            return nullptr;
        if (auto message = wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(RequestType::ResponseType::ENDPOINT_MAGIC, RequestType::ResponseType::static_message_id(), MayCancel::Yes, deadline))
            return message.template release_nonnull<typename RequestType::ResponseType>();
        return nullptr;
    }

    // Waits for a message from the peer and handles none of the others meanwhile, which stay queued in order. None if
    // the deadline passes first, or the peer goes away.
    template<typename MessageType>
    OwnPtr<MessageType> wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_until(MonotonicTime deadline)
    {
        if (auto message = wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(MessageType::ENDPOINT_MAGIC, MessageType::static_message_id(), MayCancel::No, deadline))
            return message.template release_nonnull<MessageType>();
        return {};
    }

protected:
    enum class MayCancel {
        No,
        Yes,
    };

    template<typename MessageType>
    OwnPtr<MessageType> wait_for_specific_endpoint_message(MayCancel may_cancel = MayCancel::No)
    {
        if (auto message = wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(MessageType::ENDPOINT_MAGIC, MessageType::static_message_id(), may_cancel))
            return message.template release_nonnull<MessageType>();
        return {};
    }

    explicit ConnectionBase(IPC::Stub&, NonnullOwnPtr<Transport>, u32 local_endpoint_magic);

    virtual void shutdown_with_error(Error const&);
    virtual OwnPtr<Message> try_parse_message(ReceivedMessageBytes const&, Queue<Attachment>&) = 0;

    ErrorOr<void> post_sync_request(Message const&);
    ErrorOr<void> post_sync_request(MessageBuffer&);
    OwnPtr<IPC::Message> wait_for_specific_endpoint_message_impl(u32 endpoint_magic, int message_id, MayCancel = MayCancel::No, Optional<MonotonicTime> deadline = {});
    void wait_for_transport_to_become_readable(Optional<MonotonicTime> deadline = {});
    enum class PeerEOF {
        No,
        Yes
    };
    PeerEOF drain_messages_from_peer();
    void did_find_transport_closed_during_sync_request();

    void handle_messages();

    bool send_raw_sync_request(MessageBuffer&, u32 response_endpoint_magic, i32 response_message_id, Function<void(FfiRawMessage)> const& hand_over_response);
    static bool send_sync_request_from_rust(void* connection, ReadonlyBytes, ReadonlySpan<RawAttachment>, u32 response_endpoint_magic, i32 response_message_id, void* response_sink, void (*take_response)(void* response_sink, FfiRawMessage));
    static void ref_from_rust(void* connection);
    static void unref_from_rust(void* connection);

    AK::ThreadID m_owner_thread_id { AK::ThreadID::current() };

    IPC::Stub& m_local_stub;

    NonnullOwnPtr<Transport> m_transport;

    Vector<OwnPtr<Message>> m_unprocessed_messages;
    Vector<Span<OwnPtr<Message>>> m_dispatching_message_batches;

    u32 m_local_endpoint_magic { 0 };

    bool m_peer_owns_this_process { false };
    bool m_is_waiting_for_sync_response { false };
    bool m_died { false };
};

template<typename LocalEndpoint, typename PeerEndpoint>
class Connection : public ConnectionBase {
public:
    Connection(IPC::Stub& local_stub, NonnullOwnPtr<Transport> transport)
        : ConnectionBase(local_stub, move(transport), LocalEndpoint::static_magic())
    {
    }

protected:
    virtual OwnPtr<Message> try_parse_message(ReceivedMessageBytes const& received_bytes, Queue<Attachment>& attachments) override
    {
        auto bytes = received_bytes.bytes();
        if (auto header = RawMessage::read_header(bytes); header.has_value()) {
            Optional<StringView> message_name;
            if (header->endpoint_magic == LocalEndpoint::static_magic())
                message_name = LocalEndpoint::name_of_request_that_arrives_raw(header->message_id);
            else if (header->endpoint_magic == PeerEndpoint::static_magic())
                message_name = PeerEndpoint::name_of_response_that_arrives_raw(header->message_id);
            if (message_name.has_value()) {
                Vector<Attachment> attachments_of_message;
                while (!attachments.is_empty())
                    attachments_of_message.append(attachments.dequeue());
                return make<RawMessage>(*header, *message_name, received_bytes, move(attachments_of_message));
            }
        }

        auto local_message = LocalEndpoint::decode_message(bytes, attachments);
        if (!local_message.is_error())
            return local_message.release_value();

        auto peer_message = PeerEndpoint::decode_message(bytes, attachments);
        if (!peer_message.is_error())
            return peer_message.release_value();

        dbgln("Failed to parse IPC message:");
        dbgln("  Local endpoint error: {}", local_message.error());
        dbgln("  Peer endpoint error: {}", peer_message.error());

        return nullptr;
    }
};

}

#pragma once

#include <LibIPC/Connection.h>
#include <LibIPC/Stub.h>

namespace IPC {

template<typename T, class... Args>
NonnullRefPtr<T> new_client_connection(Args&&... args)
{
    return T::construct(forward<Args>(args)...) /* arghs */;
}

template<typename ClientEndpoint, typename ServerEndpoint>
class ConnectionFromClient : public Connection<ServerEndpoint, ClientEndpoint>
    , public ServerEndpoint::Stub
    , public ClientEndpoint::Proxy {
public:
    using ServerStub = typename ServerEndpoint::Stub;
    using IPCProxy = typename ClientEndpoint::Proxy;

    ConnectionFromClient(ServerStub& stub, NonnullOwnPtr<Transport> transport, int client_id)
        : IPC::Connection<ServerEndpoint, ClientEndpoint>(stub, move(transport))
        , ClientEndpoint::Proxy(*this, {})
        , m_client_id(client_id)
    {
    }

    virtual ~ConnectionFromClient() override = default;

    using ServerStub::did_misbehave;

    void did_misbehave()
    {
        dbgln("{} (id={}) misbehaved, disconnecting.", *this, m_client_id);
        this->shutdown();
    }

    void did_misbehave(char const* message)
    {
        dbgln("{} (id={}) misbehaved ({}), disconnecting.", *this, m_client_id, message);
        this->shutdown();
    }

    virtual void shutdown_with_error(Error const& error) override
    {
        dbgln("{} (id={}) had an error ({}), disconnecting.", *this, m_client_id, error);
        this->shutdown();
    }

    int client_id() const { return m_client_id; }

    virtual void die() override = 0;

private:
    int m_client_id { -1 };
};

}

template<typename ClientEndpoint, typename ServerEndpoint>
struct AK::Formatter<IPC::ConnectionFromClient<ClientEndpoint, ServerEndpoint>> : Formatter<Core::EventReceiver> {
};

#pragma once

#include <LibIPC/Connection.h>

namespace IPC {

template<typename ClientEndpoint, typename ServerEndpoint, typename LocalStub = typename ClientEndpoint::Stub>
class ConnectionToServer : public IPC::Connection<ClientEndpoint, ServerEndpoint>
    , public LocalStub
    , public ServerEndpoint::Proxy {
public:
    using IPCProxy = typename ServerEndpoint::Proxy;

    ConnectionToServer(LocalStub& local_endpoint, NonnullOwnPtr<Transport> transport)
        : Connection<ClientEndpoint, ServerEndpoint>(local_endpoint, move(transport))
        , ServerEndpoint::Proxy(*this, {})
    {
    }

    virtual void die() override
    {
        // Override this function if you don't want your app to exit if it loses the connection.
        exit(0);
    }
};

FILE: Libraries/LibIPC/Decoder.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2020, Andreas Kling <andreas@ladybird.org>
 * Copyright (c) 2023-2025, Tim Flynn <trflynn89@ladybird.org>

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <AK/Checked.h>
#include <AK/IPv4Address.h>
#include <AK/IPv6Address.h>
#include <AK/JsonValue.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <AK/Utf16FlyString.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <LibCore/AnonymousBuffer.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/File.h>
#include <LibURL/Parser.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>

namespace IPC {

ErrorOr<size_t> Decoder::decode_size()
{
    auto max_size = exchange(m_max_size_of_next_value, NumericLimits<size_t>::max());
    auto size = static_cast<size_t>(TRY(decode<u32>()));
    if (size > max_size)
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC decode: Size exceeds the maximum");

    // Every element of a string or container takes at least one byte or one attachment of the message.
    if (size > m_stream.remaining() + m_attachments.size())
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC decode: Size exceeds the rest of the message");
    return size;
}

template<>
ErrorOr<String> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto length = TRY(decoder.decode_size());
    return String::from_stream(decoder.stream(), length);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Utf16String> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto has_latin1_storage = TRY(decoder.decode<bool>());
    auto length_in_code_units = TRY(decoder.decode_size());

    return Utf16String::from_ipc_stream(decoder.stream(), length_in_code_units, has_latin1_storage);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Utf16FlyString> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto string = TRY(decoder.decode<Utf16String>());
    return Utf16FlyString::from_utf16(string.utf16_view());
}

template<>
ErrorOr<ByteString> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto length = TRY(decoder.decode_size());
    if (length == 0)
        return ByteString::empty();

    return ByteString::create_and_overwrite(length, [&](Bytes bytes) -> ErrorOr<void> {
        TRY(decoder.decode_into(bytes));
        return {};
    });
}

template<>
ErrorOr<ByteBuffer> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto length = TRY(decoder.decode_size());
    if (length == 0)
        return ByteBuffer {};

    auto buffer = TRY(ByteBuffer::create_uninitialized(length));
    auto bytes = buffer.bytes();

    TRY(decoder.decode_into(bytes));
    return buffer;
}

template<>
ErrorOr<JsonValue> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto json = TRY(decoder.decode<ByteString>());
    return JsonValue::from_string(json);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<AK::Duration> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto seconds = TRY(decoder.decode<i64>());
    auto nanoseconds = TRY(decoder.decode<u32>());
    auto duration = AK::Duration::maybe_from_seconds_and_nanoseconds(seconds, nanoseconds);
    if (!duration.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC: Invalid duration");
    return duration.release_value();
}

template<>
ErrorOr<UnixDateTime> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto nanoseconds = TRY(decoder.decode<i64>());
    return AK::UnixDateTime::from_nanoseconds_since_epoch(nanoseconds);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<IPv4Address> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto ipv4 = TRY(decoder.decode<u32>());
    return IPv4Address(ipv4);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<IPv6Address> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto ipv6 = TRY(decoder.decode<Array<u8, 16>>());
    return IPv6Address(ipv6);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<URL::URL> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto url_string = TRY(decoder.decode<ByteString>());
    auto url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(url_string);
    if (!url.has_value())
        return Error::from_string_view("Failed to parse URL in IPC Decode"sv);

    url->set_blob_url_entry(TRY(decoder.decode<Optional<URL::BlobURLEntry>>()));
    return url.release_value();
}

template<>
ErrorOr<URL::BlobURLEntry> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    URL::BlobURLEntry::Object object = URL::BlobURLEntry::MediaSource {};
    if (TRY(decoder.decode<bool>()))
        object = URL::BlobURLEntry::Blob { .token = TRY(decoder.decode<URL::BlobURLEntry::Token>()), .object = nullptr };
    auto origin = TRY(decoder.decode<URL::Origin>());
    return URL::BlobURLEntry { .object = move(object), .environment { .origin = move(origin) } };
}

template<>
ErrorOr<URL::Origin> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto is_opaque = TRY(decoder.decode<bool>());
    if (is_opaque) {
        auto nonce = TRY(decoder.decode<URL::Origin::OpaqueData::Nonce>());
        auto type = TRY(decoder.decode<URL::Origin::OpaqueData::Type>());
        return URL::Origin { URL::Origin::OpaqueData { nonce, type } };
    }

    auto scheme = TRY(decoder.decode<Optional<String>>());
    auto host = TRY(decoder.decode<URL::Host>());
    auto port = TRY(decoder.decode<Optional<u16>>());
    auto domain = TRY(decoder.decode<Optional<URL::Host>>());

    return URL::Origin { move(scheme), move(host), port, move(domain) };
}

template<>
ErrorOr<URL::Host> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto value = TRY(decoder.decode<URL::Host::VariantType>());
    return URL::Host { move(value) };
}

template<>
ErrorOr<URL::OpaqueHost> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto value = TRY(decoder.decode<String>());
    return URL::OpaqueHost { move(value) };
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Empty> decode(Decoder&)
{
    return Empty {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<Core::AnonymousBuffer> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    if (auto valid = TRY(decoder.decode<bool>()); !valid)
        return Core::AnonymousBuffer {};

    // We don't use decode_size() here since AnonymousBuffer is backed by shared memory, not heap allocation. Its
    // contents are not part of the message.
    auto encoded_size = TRY(decoder.decode<u64>());
    if (!AK::is_within_range<size_t>(encoded_size))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Anonymous buffer size does not fit on this platform");

    auto size = static_cast<size_t>(encoded_size);
    auto anon_file = TRY(decoder.decode<IPC::File>());

    // The size is the sender's claim. Touching a mapping past the end of the file it maps raises SIGBUS, so a sender that
    // claims more than it sent could crash us whenever we got to that part of the buffer.
    auto buffer = TRY(Core::AnonymousBuffer::create_from_anon_fd(anon_file.take_fd(), size));
    TRY(buffer.validate_backing_size());
    return buffer;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Concepts.h>
#include <AK/Forward.h>
#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <AK/NumericLimits.h>
#include <AK/Queue.h>
#include <AK/ScopeGuard.h>
#include <AK/StdLibExtras.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Try.h>
#include <AK/TypeList.h>
#include <AK/Utf16FlyString.h>
#include <AK/Variant.h>
#include <LibCore/Forward.h>
#include <LibIPC/Attachment.h>
#include <LibIPC/Concepts.h>
#include <LibIPC/File.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibURL/Origin.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>

namespace IPC {

template<typename T>
inline ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder&)
{
    static_assert(DependentFalse<T>, "Base IPC::decoder() instantiated");
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

class Decoder {
public:
    Decoder(FixedMemoryStream& stream, Queue<Attachment>& attachments)
        : m_stream(stream)
        , m_attachments(attachments)
    {
    }

    template<typename T>
    ErrorOr<T> decode();

    // Decodes a string, byte buffer or vector, which goes as its size and then its contents, refusing one larger than
    // max_size before decoding its contents.
    template<typename T>
    ErrorOr<T> decode_with_max_size(size_t max_size);

    template<typename T>
    ErrorOr<void> decode_into(T& value)
    {
        value = TRY(m_stream.read_value<T>());
        return {};
    }

    ErrorOr<void> decode_into(Bytes bytes)
    {
        TRY(m_stream.read_until_filled(bytes));
        return {};
    }

    ErrorOr<size_t> decode_size();

    FixedMemoryStream& stream() { return m_stream; }
    Queue<Attachment>& attachments() { return m_attachments; }

private:
    FixedMemoryStream& m_stream;
    Queue<Attachment>& m_attachments;
    size_t m_max_size_of_next_value { NumericLimits<size_t>::max() };
};

template<Arithmetic T>
requires(!IsSame<T, bool>)
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    T value { 0 };
    TRY(decoder.decode_into(value));
    return value;
}

template<SameAs<bool> T>
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    // Only 0 and 1 are valid representations of a bool, so read the byte as an integer first.
    u8 byte { 0 };
    TRY(decoder.decode_into(byte));
    if (byte > 1)
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC decode: Invalid bool value");
    return byte == 1;
}

template<Enum T>
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto value = TRY(decoder.decode<UnderlyingType<T>>());
    return static_cast<T>(value);
}

template<Concepts::DistinctNumeric T>
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    return T { TRY(decoder.decode<typename T::Type>()) };
}

template<>
ErrorOr<String> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<Utf16String> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<Utf16FlyString> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<ByteString> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<ByteBuffer> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<JsonValue> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<AK::Duration> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<UnixDateTime> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<IPv4Address> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<IPv6Address> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<URL::URL> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<URL::Origin> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<URL::Host> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<URL::OpaqueHost> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<File> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<TransportHandle> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<Empty> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<Core::AnonymousBuffer> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<URL::BlobURLEntry> decode(Decoder&);

template<Concepts::Array T>
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    T array {};
    auto size = TRY(decoder.decode_size());
    if (size != array.size())
        return Error::from_string_literal("Array size mismatch");
    for (size_t i = 0; i < array.size(); ++i)
        array[i] = TRY(decoder.decode<typename T::ValueType>());
    return array;
}

template<Concepts::Vector T>
requires(!IsArithmetic<typename T::ValueType>)
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    T vector;

    auto size = TRY(decoder.decode_size());
    TRY(vector.try_ensure_capacity(size));

    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
        auto value = TRY(decoder.decode<typename T::ValueType>());
        vector.unchecked_append(move(value));
    }

    return vector;
}

template<Concepts::Vector T>
requires(IsArithmetic<typename T::ValueType>)
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    T vector;
    auto size = TRY(decoder.decode_size());
    if (Checked<size_t>::multiplication_would_overflow(size, sizeof(typename T::ValueType)))
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC decode: Vector size would overflow");
    TRY(vector.try_resize(size));
    TRY(decoder.decode_into({ reinterpret_cast<u8*>(vector.data()), size * sizeof(typename T::ValueType) }));
    if constexpr (IsSame<typename T::ValueType, bool>) {
        for (auto byte : ReadonlyBytes { reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(vector.data()), size }) {
            if (byte > 1)
                return Error::from_string_literal("IPC decode: Invalid bool value");
        }
    }
    return vector;
}

template<Concepts::HashMap T>
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    T hashmap;

    auto size = TRY(decoder.decode_size());
    TRY(hashmap.try_ensure_capacity(size));

    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
        auto key = TRY(decoder.decode<typename T::KeyType>());
        auto value = TRY(decoder.decode<typename T::ValueType>());
        TRY(hashmap.try_set(move(key), move(value)));
    }

    return hashmap;
}

template<Concepts::Optional T>
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    if (auto has_value = TRY(decoder.decode<bool>()); !has_value)
        return T {};
    return T { TRY(decoder.decode<typename T::ValueType>()) };
}

namespace Detail {

template<Concepts::Variant T, size_t Index = 0>
ErrorOr<T> decode_variant(Decoder& decoder, size_t index)
{
    using ElementList = TypeList<T>;

    if constexpr (Index < ElementList::size) {
        if (index == Index) {
            using ElementType = typename ElementList::template Type<Index>;
            return T { TRY(decoder.decode<ElementType>()) };
        }

        return decode_variant<T, Index + 1>(decoder, index);
    } else {
        // Index was validated before calling decode_variant
        VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
    }
}

}

template<Concepts::Variant T>
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto index = TRY(decoder.decode<typename T::IndexType>());
    if (index >= TypeList<T>::size)
        return Error::from_string_literal("IPC decode: Invalid variant index");
    return Detail::decode_variant<T>(decoder, index);
}

template<Concepts::Encoded T>
ErrorOr<T> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    return T::from_bytes(TRY(decoder.decode<ByteBuffer>()));
}

// This must be last so that it knows about the above specializations.
template<typename T>
ErrorOr<T> Decoder::decode()
{
    return IPC::decode<T>(*this);
}

template<typename T>
ErrorOr<T> Decoder::decode_with_max_size(size_t max_size)
{
    // NB: Decoding a string, byte buffer or vector starts with decode_size(), which checks the size against this. The
    //     bound ends with the value, so it never applies to anything decoded after it.
    m_max_size_of_next_value = max_size;
    ScopeGuard reset_max_size = [&] { m_max_size_of_next_value = NumericLimits<size_t>::max(); };
    return decode<T>();
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibIPC/Encoded.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#pragma once

#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/Span.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Message.h>

namespace IPC {

// A value of C++ that Rust takes: C++ encodes it and never decodes it. As an argument of a message that C++ receives,
// it reaches the handler still encoded, for the handler to hand to Rust as its bytes, which are a
// `libipc_rust::cpp_connection::EncodedValue` there.
template<typename T>
class Encoded {
public:
    using ValueType = T;

    Encoded() = default;

    explicit Encoded(T const& value)
    {
        MessageBuffer buffer;
        Encoder encoder { buffer };
        MUST(encoder.encode(value));
        VERIFY(buffer.attachments().is_empty());
        m_bytes = MUST(ByteBuffer::copy(buffer.data().span()));
    }

    static Encoded from_bytes(ByteBuffer bytes)
    {
        Encoded encoded;
        encoded.m_bytes = move(bytes);
        return encoded;
    }

    ReadonlyBytes bytes() const { return m_bytes.bytes(); }

private:
    ByteBuffer m_bytes;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibIPC/Encoder.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2020, Andreas Kling <andreas@ladybird.org>
 * Copyright (c) 2021, kleines Filmröllchen <filmroellchen@serenityos.org>
 * Copyright (c) 2023-2025, Tim Flynn <trflynn89@ladybird.org>
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/BitCast.h>
#include <AK/ByteBuffer.h>
#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/Checked.h>
#include <AK/JsonValue.h>
#include <AK/NumericLimits.h>
#include <AK/String.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Utf16FlyString.h>
#include <AK/Utf16String.h>
#include <AK/Utf16View.h>
#include <LibCore/AnonymousBuffer.h>
#include <LibIPC/Attachment.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/File.h>
#include <LibURL/Origin.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>

namespace IPC {

ErrorOr<void> Encoder::encode_size(size_t size)
{
    VERIFY(size <= NumericLimits<u32>::max());
    return encode(static_cast<u32>(size));
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, float const& value)
{
    return encoder.encode(bit_cast<u32>(value));
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, double const& value)
{
    return encoder.encode(bit_cast<u64>(value));
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, String const& value)
{
    return encoder.encode(value.bytes_as_string_view());
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, StringView const& value)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode_size(value.length()));
    TRY(encoder.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(value.characters_without_null_termination()), value.length()));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Utf16String const& value)
{
    return encoder.encode(value.utf16_view());
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Utf16FlyString const& value)
{
    return encoder.encode(value.view());
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Utf16View const& value)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(value.has_latin1_storage()));
    TRY(encoder.encode_size(value.length_in_code_units()));

    if (value.has_latin1_storage()) {
        TRY(encoder.append(value.latin1_span().data(), value.length_in_code_units()));
    } else {
        VERIFY(!Checked<size_t>::multiplication_would_overflow(value.length_in_code_units(), sizeof(char16_t)));
        TRY(encoder.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(value.utf16_span().data()), value.length_in_code_units() * sizeof(char16_t)));
    }

    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, ByteString const& value)
{
    return encoder.encode(value.view());
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, ByteBuffer const& value)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode_size(value.size()));
    TRY(encoder.append(value.data(), value.size()));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, JsonValue const& value)
{
    return encoder.encode(value.serialized());
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, AK::Duration const& value)
{
    auto seconds = value.to_floored_seconds();
    auto nanoseconds = (value - AK::Duration::from_seconds(seconds)).to_nanoseconds();
    TRY(encoder.encode(seconds));
    TRY(encoder.encode(static_cast<u32>(nanoseconds)));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, UnixDateTime const& value)
{
    return encoder.encode(value.nanoseconds_since_epoch());
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, IPv4Address const& ipv4)
{
    return encoder.encode(ipv4.to_u32());
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, IPv6Address const& ipv6)
{
    auto const& data = ipv6.to_in6_addr_t();
    return encoder.encode(ReadonlySpan<u8>(data));
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, URL::URL const& value)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(value.serialize()));
    TRY(encoder.encode(value.blob_url_entry()));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, URL::BlobURLEntry const& entry)
{
    // NB: The entry's object stays in this process. Only the origin and the token are sent, and the receiver asks the
    //     user agent's blob URL store for the object by token.
    auto const* blob = entry.object.get_pointer<URL::BlobURLEntry::Blob>();
    TRY(encoder.encode(blob != nullptr));
    if (blob)
        TRY(encoder.encode(blob->token));
    TRY(encoder.encode(entry.environment.origin));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, URL::Origin const& origin)
{
    if (origin.is_opaque()) {
        TRY(encoder.encode(true));
        TRY(encoder.encode(origin.opaque_data().nonce));
        TRY(encoder.encode(origin.opaque_data().type));
    } else {
        TRY(encoder.encode(false));
        TRY(encoder.encode(origin.scheme()));
        TRY(encoder.encode(origin.host()));
        TRY(encoder.encode(origin.port()));
        TRY(encoder.encode(origin.domain()));
    }

    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, URL::Host const& host)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(host.value()));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, URL::OpaqueHost const& opaque_host)
{
    return encoder.encode(opaque_host.value);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, File const& file)
{
    int fd = file.take_fd();
    VERIFY(fd >= 0);

    TRY(encoder.append_attachment(Attachment::from_fd(fd)));
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, Empty const&)
{
    return {};
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Core::AnonymousBuffer const& buffer)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(buffer.is_valid()));

    if (buffer.is_valid()) {
        TRY(encoder.encode(static_cast<u64>(buffer.size())));
        TRY(encoder.encode(TRY(IPC::File::clone_fd(buffer.fd()))));
    }

    return {};
}

}

namespace IPC {

template<typename T>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, T const&)
{
    static_assert(DependentFalse<T>, "Base IPC::encode() was instantiated");
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

class Encoder {
public:
    explicit Encoder(MessageBuffer& buffer)
        : m_buffer(buffer)
    {
    }

    template<typename T>
    ErrorOr<void> encode(T const& value);

    ErrorOr<void> extend_capacity(size_t capacity)
    {
        TRY(m_buffer.extend_data_capacity(capacity));
        return {};
    }

    ErrorOr<void> append(u8 const* values, size_t count)
    {
        TRY(m_buffer.append_data(values, count));
        return {};
    }

    ErrorOr<void> append_attachment(Attachment attachment)
    {
        TRY(m_buffer.append_attachment(move(attachment)));
        return {};
    }

    ErrorOr<void> encode_size(size_t size);

private:
    MessageBuffer& m_buffer;
};

template<Arithmetic T>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, T const& value)
{
    TRY(encoder.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(&value), sizeof(value)));
    return {};
}

template<Enum T>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, T const& value)
{
    return encoder.encode(to_underlying(value));
}

template<Concepts::DistinctNumeric T>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, T const& value)
{
    return encoder.encode(value.value());
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, float const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, double const&);

ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, String const&);

ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, Utf16String const&);

ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, Utf16FlyString const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, ByteString const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, ByteBuffer const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, JsonValue const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, AK::Duration const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, UnixDateTime const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, IPv4Address const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, IPv6Address const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, URL::URL const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, URL::Origin const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, URL::Host const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, URL::OpaqueHost const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, File const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, TransportHandle const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, Empty const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, Core::AnonymousBuffer const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, URL::BlobURLEntry const&);

template<Concepts::Span T>
requires(!IsArithmetic<typename T::ElementType>)
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, T const& span)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode_size(span.size()));

    for (auto const& value : span)
        TRY(encoder.encode(value));

    return {};
}

template<Concepts::Span T>
requires(IsArithmetic<typename T::ElementType>)
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, T const& span)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode_size(span.size()));

    VERIFY(!Checked<size_t>::multiplication_would_overflow(span.size(), sizeof(typename T::ElementType)));
    TRY(encoder.append(reinterpret_cast<u8 const*>(span.data()), span.size() * sizeof(typename T::ElementType)));

    return {};
}

template<typename T, size_t N>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, Array<T, N> const& array)
{
    return encoder.encode(array.span());
}

template<Concepts::Vector T>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, T const& vector)
{
    return encoder.encode(vector.span());
}

template<Concepts::HashMap T>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, T const& hashmap)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode_size(hashmap.size()));

    for (auto it : hashmap) {
        TRY(encoder.encode(it.key));
        TRY(encoder.encode(it.value));
    }

    return {};
}

template<Concepts::Optional T>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, T const& optional)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(optional.has_value()));

    if (optional.has_value())
        TRY(encoder.encode(optional.value()));

    return {};
}

template<Concepts::Variant T>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, T const& variant)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(variant.index()));

    return variant.visit([&](auto const& value) {
        return encoder.encode(value);
    });
}

template<Concepts::Encoded T>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, T const& value)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode_size(value.bytes().size()));
    return encoder.append(value.bytes().data(), value.bytes().size());
}

// This must be last so that it knows about the above specializations.
template<typename T>
ErrorOr<void> Encoder::encode(T const& value)
{
    return IPC::encode(*this, value);
}

}

#include <LibCore/File.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibIPC/Attachment.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/File.h>

namespace IPC {

File File::adopt_file(NonnullOwnPtr<Core::File> file)
{
    return File(file->leak_fd());
}

File File::adopt_fd(int fd)
{
    return File(fd);
}

ErrorOr<File> File::clone_fd(int fd)
{
    int new_fd = TRY(Core::System::dup(fd));
    return File(new_fd);
}

File::File(int fd)
    : m_fd(fd)
{
}

File::File(File&& other)
    : m_fd(exchange(other.m_fd, -1))
{
}

File& File::operator=(File&& other)
{
    if (this != &other) {
        if (m_fd != -1)
            (void)Core::System::close(m_fd);
        m_fd = exchange(other.m_fd, -1);
    }
    return *this;
}

File::~File()
{
    if (m_fd != -1)
        (void)Core::System::close(m_fd);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<File> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto attachment = TRY(decoder.attachments().try_dequeue());
    int fd = attachment.to_fd();
    if (fd < 0)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Failed to obtain fd from attachment");
#ifndef AK_OS_WINDOWS
    TRY(Core::System::set_close_on_exec(fd, true));
#endif
    return File::adopt_fd(fd);
}

}

#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <AK/NeverDestroyed.h>
#include <AK/Random.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/HandleBroker.h>
#include <LibIPC/HandleBrokerMessages.h>
#include <LibIPC/Limits.h>
#include <LibIPC/Message.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>

namespace IPC {

static NeverDestroyed<Mutex> s_installed_broker_mutex;
static NeverDestroyed<OwnPtr<HandleBroker>> s_installed_broker;

static constexpr size_t MAX_HANDLE_BROKER_MESSAGE_SIZE = sizeof(HandleBrokerOperation) + sizeof(HandleBrokerToken) + sizeof(HandleBrokerChannel) + sizeof(u32) + MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT_WITH_SHARED_MEMORY * sizeof(u64);
static_assert(MAX_HANDLE_BROKER_MESSAGE_SIZE <= TransportWindows::MAX_INLINE_PAYLOAD_SIZE);

HandleBroker& HandleBroker::the()
{
    MutexLocker locker(*s_installed_broker_mutex);
    if (!*s_installed_broker)
        *s_installed_broker = make<LocalHandleBroker>();
    return **s_installed_broker;
}

void HandleBroker::install(NonnullOwnPtr<HandleBroker> broker)
{
    MutexLocker locker(*s_installed_broker_mutex);
    VERIFY(!*s_installed_broker);
    *s_installed_broker = move(broker);
}

static ErrorOr<void> encode_handle_values(Encoder& encoder, Vector<u64> const& handle_values)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(static_cast<u32>(handle_values.size())));
    for (auto value : handle_values)
        TRY(encoder.encode(value));
    return {};
}

static ErrorOr<Vector<u64>> decode_handle_values(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto count = TRY(decoder.decode<u32>());
    if (count > MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT_WITH_SHARED_MEMORY)
        return Error::from_string_literal("Handle broker message names too many handles");

    Vector<u64> handle_values;
    TRY(handle_values.try_ensure_capacity(count));
    for (u32 i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        handle_values.unchecked_append(TRY(decoder.decode<u64>()));
    return handle_values;
}

static ErrorOr<HandleBrokerOperation> decode_operation(Decoder& decoder)
{
    auto operation = TRY(decoder.decode<u8>());
    if (operation > to_underlying(HandleBrokerOperation::ForgetChannel))
        return Error::from_string_literal("Unknown handle broker operation");
    return static_cast<HandleBrokerOperation>(operation);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, HandleBrokerRequest const& request)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(to_underlying(request.operation)));
    TRY(encoder.encode(request.token));
    TRY(encoder.encode(request.channel));
    return encode_handle_values(encoder, request.handle_values);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<HandleBrokerRequest> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    HandleBrokerRequest request;
    request.operation = TRY(decode_operation(decoder));
    request.token = TRY(decoder.decode<HandleBrokerToken>());
    request.channel = TRY(decoder.decode<HandleBrokerChannel>());
    request.handle_values = TRY(decode_handle_values(decoder));
    return request;
}

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder& encoder, HandleBrokerResponse const& response)
{
    TRY(encoder.encode(to_underlying(response.operation)));
    TRY(encoder.encode(response.error));
    TRY(encoder.encode(response.token));
    return encode_handle_values(encoder, response.handle_values);
}

template<>
ErrorOr<HandleBrokerResponse> decode(Decoder& decoder)
{
    HandleBrokerResponse response;
    response.operation = TRY(decode_operation(decoder));
    response.error = TRY(decoder.decode<i32>());
    response.token = TRY(decoder.decode<HandleBrokerToken>());
    response.handle_values = TRY(decode_handle_values(decoder));
    return response;
}

ErrorOr<HandleBrokerToken> LocalHandleBroker::park(HandleBrokerChannel channel, Vector<Attachment> attachments)
{
    return park_on_behalf_of(Core::System::getpid(), channel, move(attachments));
}

ErrorOr<HandleBrokerToken> LocalHandleBroker::park_on_behalf_of(pid_t owner, HandleBrokerChannel channel, Vector<Attachment> attachments)
{
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);

    // Whoever holds a token may redeem it, so it must not be guessable. Zero stands for no token.
    HandleBrokerToken token = 0;
    while (token == 0 || m_parked_attachments.contains(token))
        token = get_random<HandleBrokerToken>();

    TRY(m_parked_attachments.try_set(token, ParkedAttachments { owner, channel, move(attachments) }));
    return token;
}

ErrorOr<Vector<Attachment>> LocalHandleBroker::redeem(HandleBrokerToken token)
{
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    auto parked_attachments = m_parked_attachments.take(token);
    if (!parked_attachments.has_value())
        return Error::from_errno(ENOENT);
    return move(parked_attachments->attachments);
}

void LocalHandleBroker::forget_channel(HandleBrokerChannel channel)
{
    forget_channel_of(Core::System::getpid(), channel);
}

void LocalHandleBroker::forget_channel_of(pid_t owner, HandleBrokerChannel channel)
{
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    m_parked_attachments.remove_all_matching([&](auto const&, auto const& parked_attachments) {
        return parked_attachments.owner == owner && parked_attachments.channel == channel;
    });
}

HandleBrokerClient::HandleBrokerClient(NonnullOwnPtr<Transport> transport)
    : m_transport(move(transport))
{
}

HandleBrokerClient::~HandleBrokerClient() = default;

ErrorOr<HandleBrokerToken> HandleBrokerClient::park(HandleBrokerChannel channel, Vector<Attachment> attachments)
{
    HandleBrokerRequest request;
    request.operation = HandleBrokerOperation::Park;
    request.channel = channel;
    TRY(request.handle_values.try_ensure_capacity(attachments.size()));
    for (auto const& attachment : attachments)
        request.handle_values.unchecked_append(static_cast<u64>(attachment.fd()));

    // The attachments stay open until the response confirms that the Browser holds copies of them.
    auto response = TRY(exchange(request));
    return response.token;
}

ErrorOr<Vector<Attachment>> HandleBrokerClient::redeem(HandleBrokerToken token)
{
    HandleBrokerRequest request;
    request.operation = HandleBrokerOperation::Redeem;
    request.token = token;
    auto response = TRY(exchange(request));

    Vector<Attachment> attachments;
    TRY(attachments.try_ensure_capacity(response.handle_values.size()));
    for (auto value : response.handle_values)
        attachments.unchecked_append(Attachment::from_fd(static_cast<int>(value)));
    return attachments;
}

void HandleBrokerClient::forget_channel(HandleBrokerChannel channel)
{
    HandleBrokerRequest request;
    request.operation = HandleBrokerOperation::ForgetChannel;
    request.channel = channel;
    if (auto result = exchange(request); result.is_error())
        dbgln("HandleBrokerClient: Could not forget channel {}: {}", channel, result.error());
}

ErrorOr<HandleBrokerResponse> HandleBrokerClient::exchange(HandleBrokerRequest const& request)
{
    MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
    if (!m_transport->is_open())
        return Error::from_string_literal("The handle broker is gone");

    MessageBuffer buffer;
    Encoder encoder(buffer);
    TRY(encoder.encode(request));
    TRY(buffer.transfer_message(*m_transport));

    // Requests take turns, so the next message to arrive answers this one.
    Optional<ErrorOr<HandleBrokerResponse>> response;
    while (!response.has_value()) {
        if (!m_transport->is_open())
            return Error::from_string_literal("The handle broker is gone");
        m_transport->wait_until_readable();

        auto should_shutdown = m_transport->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            if (response.has_value()) {
                response = ErrorOr<HandleBrokerResponse> { Error::from_string_literal("The handle broker answered a request more than once") };
                return;
            }
            FixedMemoryStream stream { message.bytes.bytes() };
            Decoder decoder { stream, message.attachments };
            response = decoder.decode<HandleBrokerResponse>();
        });

        if (should_shutdown == Transport::ShouldShutdown::Yes) {
            m_transport->close();
            if (!response.has_value())
                return Error::from_string_literal("The handle broker closed the connection");
        }
    }

    auto decoded_response = TRY(response.release_value());
    if (decoded_response.error != 0)
        return Error::from_errno(decoded_response.error);
    if (decoded_response.operation != request.operation)
        return Error::from_string_literal("The handle broker answered a different request");
    return decoded_response;
}

}

FILE: Libraries/LibIPC/HandleBroker.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/Platform.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibIPC/Attachment.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>

#if !defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
#    error "The handle broker is only needed on Windows, where a socket cannot carry a handle"
#endif

namespace IPC {

using HandleBrokerToken = u64;
using HandleBrokerChannel = u64;

// Holds the handles of a message while it sits in a socket: the sender parks them and writes the token it gets, and the
// reader redeems that token for them. The Browser holds the broker, so it alone ever places a handle into another
// process, and a token can only name handles that the process parking them owned.
class HandleBroker {
public:
    virtual ~HandleBroker() = default;

    // A process that was not given a client, such as the Browser or a test, serves itself with a LocalHandleBroker.
    static HandleBroker& the();
    static void install(NonnullOwnPtr<HandleBroker>);

    virtual bool is_local() const { return false; }

    // The channel is the transport end that writes the token, so that what it parked can be forgotten once nobody
    // can read from it anymore.
    virtual ErrorOr<HandleBrokerToken> park(HandleBrokerChannel, Vector<Attachment>) = 0;
    virtual ErrorOr<Vector<Attachment>> redeem(HandleBrokerToken) = 0;
    virtual void forget_channel(HandleBrokerChannel) = 0;
};

class LocalHandleBroker final : public HandleBroker {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    virtual bool is_local() const override { return true; }

    virtual ErrorOr<HandleBrokerToken> park(HandleBrokerChannel, Vector<Attachment>) override;
    virtual ErrorOr<Vector<Attachment>> redeem(HandleBrokerToken) override;
    virtual void forget_channel(HandleBrokerChannel) override;

    ErrorOr<HandleBrokerToken> park_on_behalf_of(pid_t owner, HandleBrokerChannel, Vector<Attachment>);
    void forget_channel_of(pid_t owner, HandleBrokerChannel);

private:
    struct ParkedAttachments {
        pid_t owner { -1 };
        HandleBrokerChannel channel { 0 };
        Vector<Attachment> attachments;
    };

    Mutex m_mutex;
    HashMap<HandleBrokerToken, ParkedAttachments> m_parked_attachments;
};

// Asks the Browser's broker over a transport that carries nothing else. Any thread may ask; the requests take turns.
class HandleBrokerClient final : public HandleBroker {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    explicit HandleBrokerClient(NonnullOwnPtr<Transport>);
    virtual ~HandleBrokerClient() override;

    virtual ErrorOr<HandleBrokerToken> park(HandleBrokerChannel, Vector<Attachment>) override;
    virtual ErrorOr<Vector<Attachment>> redeem(HandleBrokerToken) override;
    virtual void forget_channel(HandleBrokerChannel) override;

private:
    ErrorOr<HandleBrokerResponse> exchange(HandleBrokerRequest const&);

    Mutex m_mutex;
    NonnullOwnPtr<Transport> m_transport;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibIPC/HandleBrokerMessages.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibIPC/HandleBroker.h>

namespace IPC {

enum class HandleBrokerOperation : u8 {
    Park,
    Redeem,
    ForgetChannel,
};

// A handle is named by its value in the requester's process; the Browser copies it out of or into that process.
struct HandleBrokerRequest {
    HandleBrokerOperation operation { HandleBrokerOperation::Park };
    HandleBrokerToken token { 0 };
    HandleBrokerChannel channel { 0 };
    Vector<u64> handle_values;
};

struct HandleBrokerResponse {
    HandleBrokerOperation operation { HandleBrokerOperation::Park };
    // An errno value, or zero.
    i32 error { 0 };
    HandleBrokerToken token { 0 };
    Vector<u64> handle_values;
};

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, HandleBrokerRequest const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<HandleBrokerRequest> decode(Decoder&);

template<>
ErrorOr<void> encode(Encoder&, HandleBrokerResponse const&);

template<>
ErrorOr<HandleBrokerResponse> decode(Decoder&);

}

FILE: Libraries/LibIPC/HandleBrokerServer.cpp
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/MemoryStream.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibIPC/Decoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/Encoder.h>
#include <LibIPC/HandleBrokerMessages.h>
#include <LibIPC/HandleBrokerServer.h>
#include <LibIPC/Message.h>
#include <LibIPC/Transport.h>
#include <LibThreading/Thread.h>

#include <AK/Windows.h>

namespace IPC {

class HandleBrokerChildConnection {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(HandleBrokerChildConnection);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(HandleBrokerChildConnection);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    HandleBrokerChildConnection(HandleBrokerServer& server, pid_t pid, NonnullOwnPtr<Transport> transport, HANDLE process_handle)
        : m_server(server)
        , m_pid(pid)
        , m_transport(move(transport))
        , m_process_handle(process_handle)
    {
    }

    ~HandleBrokerChildConnection()
    {
        CloseHandle(m_process_handle);
    }

    void start()
    {
        m_transport->set_up_read_hook([this] {
            serve_requests();
        });
    }

    pid_t pid() const { return m_pid; }

private:
    void serve_requests()
    {
        if (m_is_closing)
            return;

        bool misbehaved = false;
        auto should_shutdown = m_transport->read_as_many_messages_as_possible_without_blocking([&](auto&& message) {
            if (misbehaved)
                return;
            FixedMemoryStream stream { message.bytes.bytes() };
            Decoder decoder { stream, message.attachments };
            auto request = decoder.decode<HandleBrokerRequest>();
            if (request.is_error()) {
                dbgln("HandleBrokerServer: Rejecting a malformed request from process {}: {}", m_pid, request.error());
                misbehaved = true;
                return;
            }
            if (respond(serve(request.value())).is_error())
                misbehaved = true;
        });

        if (should_shutdown == Transport::ShouldShutdown::Yes || misbehaved)
            close();
    }

    // The transport is read from within its own read hook, so it can only go away once that hook has returned.
    void close()
    {
        m_is_closing = true;
        m_transport->close();
        Core::deferred_invoke([this] {
            m_server.remove_child(*this);
        });
    }

    HandleBrokerResponse serve(HandleBrokerRequest const& request)
    {
        HandleBrokerResponse response;
        response.operation = request.operation;

        auto result = [&]() -> ErrorOr<void> {
            switch (request.operation) {
            case HandleBrokerOperation::Park: {
                auto attachments = TRY(copy_handles_out_of_child(request.handle_values));
                response.token = TRY(m_server.m_broker.park_on_behalf_of(m_pid, request.channel, move(attachments)));
                return {};
            }
            case HandleBrokerOperation::Redeem: {
                auto attachments = TRY(m_server.m_broker.redeem(request.token));
                response.handle_values = TRY(copy_handles_into_child(attachments));
                return {};
            }
            case HandleBrokerOperation::ForgetChannel:
                m_server.m_broker.forget_channel_of(m_pid, request.channel);
                return {};
            }
            VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
        }();

        if (result.is_error()) {
            auto error = result.release_error();
            response.error = error.is_errno() ? error.code() : EINVAL;
        }
        return response;
    }

    // Winsock documents WSADuplicateSocket for sockets, which needs the target process to be known in advance. A socket
    // of a base provider is a plain kernel handle that Winsock takes up on first use, as it does for the inherited
    // socket every helper starts with, and this process never uses the copies it holds.
    ErrorOr<Vector<Attachment>> copy_handles_out_of_child(Vector<u64> const& handle_values)
    {
        Vector<Attachment> attachments;
        TRY(attachments.try_ensure_capacity(handle_values.size()));
        for (auto value : handle_values) {
            HANDLE copied_handle = nullptr;
            if (!DuplicateHandle(m_process_handle, to_handle(static_cast<int>(value)), GetCurrentProcess(), &copied_handle, 0, FALSE, DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS))
                return Error::from_errno(EBADF);
            attachments.unchecked_append(Attachment::from_fd(to_fd(copied_handle)));
        }
        return attachments;
    }

    ErrorOr<Vector<u64>> copy_handles_into_child(Vector<Attachment> const& attachments)
    {
        Vector<u64> handle_values;
        TRY(handle_values.try_ensure_capacity(attachments.size()));
        for (auto const& attachment : attachments) {
            HANDLE copied_handle = nullptr;
            if (!DuplicateHandle(GetCurrentProcess(), to_handle(attachment.fd()), m_process_handle, &copied_handle, 0, FALSE, DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS))
                return Error::from_windows_error();
            handle_values.unchecked_append(static_cast<u64>(to_fd(copied_handle)));
        }
        return handle_values;
    }

    ErrorOr<void> respond(HandleBrokerResponse const& response)
    {
        MessageBuffer buffer;
        Encoder encoder(buffer);
        TRY(encoder.encode(response));
        return buffer.transfer_message(*m_transport);
    }

    HandleBrokerServer& m_server;
    pid_t m_pid { -1 };
    NonnullOwnPtr<Transport> m_transport;
    HANDLE m_process_handle { nullptr };
    bool m_is_closing { false };
};

NonnullOwnPtr<HandleBrokerServer> HandleBrokerServer::create()
{
    auto& broker = HandleBroker::the();
    VERIFY(broker.is_local());
    auto server = adopt_own(*new HandleBrokerServer(static_cast<LocalHandleBroker&>(broker)));

    MutexLocker locker(server->m_mutex);
    server->m_condition.wait_while([&] { return !server->m_event_loop; });
    return server;
}

HandleBrokerServer::HandleBrokerServer(LocalHandleBroker& broker)
    : m_broker(broker)
    , m_thread(Threading::Thread::construct("Handle broker"sv, [this] {
        return thread_main();
    }))
{
    m_thread->start();
}

HandleBrokerServer::~HandleBrokerServer()
{
    if (auto event_loop = m_event_loop->take()) {
        event_loop->quit(0);
        event_loop->wake();
    }
    (void)m_thread->join();
}

intptr_t HandleBrokerServer::thread_main()
{
    Core::EventLoop event_loop;
    {
        MutexLocker locker(m_mutex);
        m_event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak();
        m_condition.broadcast();
    }

    auto result = event_loop.exec();
    m_children.clear();
    return result;
}

// What the child parked stays: a message it wrote before it went may still be unread in a live socket, and the reader
// of a channel whose writer is gone redeems what it reads, as a descriptor in flight outlives its sender elsewhere.
void HandleBrokerServer::remove_child(HandleBrokerChildConnection& child)
{
    m_children.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& entry) { return entry.ptr() == &child; });
}

void HandleBrokerServer::add_child(pid_t pid, int channel_handle)
{
    HANDLE process_handle = OpenProcess(PROCESS_DUP_HANDLE, FALSE, pid);
    if (!process_handle) {
        dbgln("HandleBrokerServer: Could not open process {} to serve it handles: {}", pid, Error::from_windows_error());
        (void)Core::System::close(channel_handle);
        return;
    }

    auto event_loop = m_event_loop->take();
    VERIFY(event_loop);

    // A transport is read on the thread that constructs it, so the broker thread constructs this one.
    event_loop->deferred_invoke([=, this] {
        auto transport_or_error = Transport::adopt_fd(channel_handle);
        if (transport_or_error.is_error()) {
            dbgln("HandleBrokerServer: Could not adopt the handle broker channel of process {}: {}", pid, transport_or_error.error());
            (void)Core::System::close(channel_handle);
            CloseHandle(process_handle);
            return;
        }

        auto transport = transport_or_error.release_value();
        // Every other process waits on this thread, so one that stops reading its answers is dropped, not waited for.
        transport->set_disconnects_when_peer_stops_reading(true);
        auto child = make<HandleBrokerChildConnection>(*this, pid, move(transport), process_handle);
        child->start();
        m_children.append(move(child));
    });
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/ConditionVariable.h>
#include <AK/Mutex.h>
#include <AK/Noncopyable.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/NonnullRefPtr.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <LibCore/Forward.h>
#include <LibIPC/Forward.h>
#include <LibIPC/HandleBroker.h>
#include <LibThreading/Forward.h>

namespace IPC {

class HandleBrokerChildConnection;

// Serves this process's broker to the processes it spawned, each over a channel of its own. The channels are answered
// on a thread that waits on nothing else, so no process is kept waiting for a handle while this process is busy, or
// while this process is itself waiting on that one.
class HandleBrokerServer {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(HandleBrokerServer);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(HandleBrokerServer);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static NonnullOwnPtr<HandleBrokerServer> create();
    ~HandleBrokerServer();

    // The caller keeps the child's process alive until this returns, so its process ID cannot name another by then.
    void add_child(pid_t, int channel_handle);

private:
    friend class HandleBrokerChildConnection;

    explicit HandleBrokerServer(LocalHandleBroker&);
    intptr_t thread_main();
    void remove_child(HandleBrokerChildConnection&);

    LocalHandleBroker& m_broker;
    Mutex m_mutex;
    ConditionVariable m_condition { m_mutex };
    RefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> m_event_loop;
    NonnullRefPtr<Threading::Thread> m_thread;

    // Only the broker thread touches this.
    Vector<NonnullOwnPtr<HandleBrokerChildConnection>> m_children;
};

}

FILE: Libraries/LibIPC/Limits.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026, Andreas Kling <andreas@ladybird.org>
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <AK/NumericLimits.h>
#include <AK/Types.h>

namespace IPC {

// Maximum size of an IPC message payload
static constexpr size_t MAX_MESSAGE_PAYLOAD_SIZE = NumericLimits<u32>::max();

// Maximum number of file descriptors per message. Transports carry any number up to this, however few fit in one
// system call. It stays below the 16383 port rights that XNU accepts in one Mach message, so that a message is never
// split there, and far below the descriptor limit LibMain raises every process to.
static constexpr size_t MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT = 16000;

// A transport that sends a payload in shared memory attaches one more descriptor to its message.
static constexpr size_t MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT_WITH_SHARED_MEMORY = MAX_MESSAGE_FD_COUNT + 1;

}

#include <AK/Format.h>
#include <LibIPC/MachBootstrapListener.h>
#include <LibIPC/RustFFI.h>

namespace IPC {

MachBootstrapListener::MachBootstrapListener(ByteString server_port_name)
    : m_server_port_name(move(server_port_name))
{
    auto handle_request = [](void* listener, i32 pid, u32 task_name_port, u32 reply_port) {
        auto& self = *static_cast<MachBootstrapListener*>(listener);
        VERIFY(self.on_bootstrap_request);
        self.on_bootstrap_request({
            .pid = pid,
            .task_name_port = Core::MachPort::adopt_right(task_name_port, Core::MachPort::PortRight::Send),
            .reply_port = Core::MachPort::adopt_right(reply_port, Core::MachPort::PortRight::SendOnce),
        });
    };
    m_listener = FFI::ipc_mach_bootstrap_listener_create(m_server_port_name.bytes(), this, handle_request);
    if (!m_listener)
        dbgln("Failed to allocate server port");
}

MachBootstrapListener::~MachBootstrapListener()
{
    if (!m_listener)
        return;
    // NB: Destroying the listener stops it, after which nothing reaches this object.
    FFI::ipc_mach_bootstrap_listener_destroy(m_listener);
}

void MachBootstrapListener::stop()
{
    if (m_listener)
        FFI::ipc_mach_bootstrap_listener_stop(m_listener);
}

bool MachBootstrapListener::is_initialized()
{
    return m_listener;
}

}
