inline fn current_vm() -> VM {
    load_vm()
}

inline fn primitive_storage_cage_base() -> u64 {
    let vm = current_vm();
    vm.primitive_storage_cage_base
}

inline fn normalize_completion_value(initial_value: Value) -> (Value, Value) {
    let mut value = initial_value;
    let empty_tag: Value = Value<Empty>;
    # FIXME: Use an immutable value-producing if once its result can coalesce
    #        with an inline function output on AArch64.
    if value is Value<Empty> {
        value = Value<Undefined>;
    }
    (value, empty_tag)
}

# Switches to the dispatch table of the executable whose frame the interpreter
# continues in. Only the profiling build switches: the plain build's handlers
# run every frame while the JIT is off, and while it is on, the plain
# handlers' frames keep the table they run with until the next profiling
# handler switches frames (see the executable's interpreter tier).
inline fn switch_dispatch_table(executable: Executable) @profiling {
    let dispatch_table_index: u32 = alias(executable.dispatch_table_index);
    let vm = current_vm();
    let dispatch_table = vm.dispatch_tables[dispatch_table_index & DISPATCH_TABLE_INDEX_MASK];
    dispatch = dispatch_table;
}

inline fn return_to_caller(
    return_value: Value,
    else top_level: Label
) {
    let caller_frame = exec_ctx.caller_frame;
    guard caller_frame != 0 else top_level;
    let mut result = return_value;
    # NB: The frame of a derived constructor returns its this value only for undefined.
    if exec_ctx.caller_is_construct {
        if result is not Value<Object> {
            if exec_ctx.caller_is_derived_construct {
                if result is Value<Undefined> {
                    result = exec_ctx.this_value;
                }
            } else {
                result = exec_ctx.this_value;
            }
        }
    }
    let return_pc = exec_ctx.caller_return_pc;
    let destination_index = exec_ctx.caller_dst_raw;
    let returns_to_native_caller = exec_ctx.returns_to_native_caller;
    caller_frame.program_counter = return_pc;
    caller_frame.slots[destination_index] = result;
    let vm = current_vm();
    vm.running_execution_context = caller_frame;
    vm.interpreter_stack_top = alias(exec_ctx);
    inc32_mem([vm, VM_EXECUTION_GENERATION]);
    # A caller waiting in native code (JIT code) continues there.
    if returns_to_native_caller {
        exit;
    }
    exec_ctx = caller_frame;
    let executable = exec_ctx.executable;
    assert(executable != 0);
    pb = executable.bytecode_data;
    switch_dispatch_table(executable);
    assert(pb != 0);
    values = exec_ctx.slots;
    pc = return_pc;
    goto_handler(pc);
}

inline fn return_value(initial_value: Value) {
    let [value, empty_tag] = normalize_completion_value(initial_value);
    return_to_caller(value) else {
        values[3] = value;
        values[1] = empty_tag;
        exit;
    };
}

inline fn update_operand(
    operand: inout Operand,
    integer_operation: CheckedBinaryOperation<i32>,
    float_operation: BinaryOperation<f64>,
    slow_path: SlowPath,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex
) {
    let value = load(operand);
    guard let mut Value<i32>(integer) = value else slow;
    integer_operation(integer, 1) else overflow;
    record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
    store(operand, box_i32(integer));
    dispatch_next;

    let overflow = || @cold {
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
        let overflowed_integer = unbox_i32(load(operand));
        let mut result = to_f64(overflowed_integer);
        let one = unbox_f64(DOUBLE_ONE);
        float_operation(result, one);
        store(operand, box_f64(result));
        dispatch_next;
    };
    let slow = || @cold {
        record_arith_operand_feedback(feedback, value);
        call_slow_path(slow_path);
    };
}

inline fn post_update_operand(
    dst: out Operand,
    operand: inout Operand,
    integer_operation: CheckedBinaryOperation<i32>,
    float_operation: BinaryOperation<f64>,
    slow_path: SlowPath,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex
) {
    let old = load(operand);
    guard let mut Value<i32>(integer) = old else slow;
    store(dst, old);
    integer_operation(integer, 1) else overflow;
    record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
    store(operand, box_i32(integer));
    dispatch_next;

    let overflow = || @cold {
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
        let overflowed_integer = unbox_i32(load(operand));
        let mut result = to_f64(overflowed_integer);
        let one = unbox_f64(DOUBLE_ONE);
        float_operation(result, one);
        store(operand, box_f64(result));
        dispatch_next;
    };
    let slow = || @cold {
        record_arith_operand_feedback(feedback, old);
        call_slow_path(slow_path);
    };
}

inline fn numeric_value_to_i32(value: Value, else failure: Label) -> i32 {
    match value {
        Value<i32>(integer) => {
            integer
        },

        Value<bool>(boolean) => {
            i32(boolean)
        },

        Value<f64>(number) => @cold {
            guard let result = js_to_int32(number) else failure;
            result
        },

        _ => failure,
    }
}

inline fn bitwise_binary(
    dst: out Operand,
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    operation: BinaryOperation<i32>,
    slow_path: SlowPath,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_binary_slow_path(slow_path, dst, lhs, rhs);
    };

    let non_int32 = || @cold {
        record_arith_operands_feedback(feedback, lhs, rhs);
        guard let mut lhs_integer = numeric_value_to_i32(lhs) else slow;
        guard let rhs_integer = numeric_value_to_i32(rhs) else slow;
        operation(lhs_integer, rhs_integer);
        store(dst, box_i32(lhs_integer));
        dispatch_next;
    };
    guard let mut Value<i32>(lhs_integer) = lhs else non_int32;
    guard let Value<i32>(rhs_integer) = rhs else non_int32;

    record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
    operation(lhs_integer, rhs_integer);
    store(dst, box_i32(lhs_integer));
    dispatch_next;
}

inline fn signed_shift(
    dst: out Operand,
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    operation: BinaryOperation<i32>,
    slow_path: SlowPath,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        record_arith_operands_feedback(feedback, lhs, rhs);
        call_binary_slow_path(slow_path, dst, lhs, rhs);
    };

    guard let mut Value<i32>(integer) = lhs else slow;
    guard let mut Value<i32>(count) = rhs else slow;
    record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
    count = count & 31;
    operation(integer, count);
    store(dst, box_i32(integer));
    dispatch_next;
}

inline fn store_relational_result(
    dst: out Operand,
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    integer_condition: IntegerCondition,
    float_condition: FloatCondition,
    slow_path: SlowPath,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex
) {
    let store_true = || {
        store(dst, Value<True>);
        dispatch_next;
    };
    let store_false = || {
        store(dst, Value<False>);
        dispatch_next;
    };
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_binary_slow_path(slow_path, dst, lhs, rhs);
    };

    compare_numeric_values(
        lhs,
        rhs,
        integer_condition,
        float_condition,
        store_true,
        store_false,
        feedback
    ) else slow;
}

inline fn equality_same_tag(
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    lhs_tag: inout ValueTag,
    equal: Label,
    not_equal: Label,
    compare_f64: Label,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    else slow: Label
) {
    match lhs_tag {
        INT32_TAG | BOOLEAN_TAG => other_compare,
        OBJECT_TAG | SYMBOL_TAG => other_compare,
        STRING_TAG => string_compare,
        BIGINT_TAG => bigint_compare,
        _ => check_nullish,
    }

    let check_nullish = || {
        lhs_tag = lhs_tag & 0xfffe;
        branch_eq(lhs_tag, UNDEFINED_TAG, other_compare);
        goto compare_f64;
    };

    let string_compare = || {
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_STRING);
        guard lhs is not rhs else equal;
        goto different_strings;
    };

    let different_strings = || @cold {
        # Two different interned strings never have the same contents.
        guard let Value<PrimitiveString>(lhs_string) = lhs else slow;
        guard let Value<PrimitiveString>(rhs_string) = rhs else slow;
        guard lhs_string.deferred_kind_and_flags has PRIMITIVE_STRING_INTERNED_FLAG else slow;
        guard rhs_string.deferred_kind_and_flags has PRIMITIVE_STRING_INTERNED_FLAG else slow;
        goto not_equal;
    };

    let bigint_compare = || {
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_BIGINT);
        goto slow;
    };

    let other_compare = || {
        record_identity_equality_feedback(feedback, lhs_tag);
        guard lhs is not rhs else equal;
        goto not_equal;
    };
}

inline fn compare_f64_equality(
    lhs: f64,
    rhs: f64,
    equal: Label,
    not_equal: Label
) {
    branch_fp_unordered(lhs, rhs, not_equal);
    branch_fp_equal(lhs, rhs, equal);
    goto not_equal;
}

inline fn strict_equality(
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    equal: Label,
    not_equal: Label,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    else slow: Label
) {
    let mut rhs_tag = extract_tag(rhs);
    branch_eq(rhs_tag, INT32_TAG, rhs_i32);
    let mut lhs_tag = extract_tag(lhs);
    guard lhs_tag == rhs_tag else different_tags;
    equality_same_tag(lhs, rhs, lhs_tag, equal, not_equal, compare_f64, feedback) else slow;

    let compare_f64 = || {
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_DOUBLE);
        let lhs_number = unbox_f64(lhs);
        let rhs_number = unbox_f64(rhs);
        compare_f64_equality(lhs_number, rhs_number, equal, not_equal);
    };

    let other_not_equal = || {
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_OTHER);
        goto not_equal;
    };

    let different_tags = || {
        branch_eq(lhs_tag, INT32_TAG, lhs_i32);
        check_tag_is_double(lhs_tag) else other_not_equal;
        check_tag_is_double(rhs_tag) else other_not_equal;
        goto compare_f64;
    };

    let int32_and_other_not_equal = || {
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_OTHER);
        goto not_equal;
    };

    let lhs_i32 = || {
        check_tag_is_double(rhs_tag) else int32_and_other_not_equal;
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
        let integer = unbox_i32(lhs);
        let lhs_number = to_f64(integer);
        let rhs_number = unbox_f64(rhs);
        branch_fp_equal(lhs_number, rhs_number, equal);
        goto not_equal;
    };

    let rhs_i32 = || {
        let rhs_integer = unbox_i32(rhs);
        match lhs {
            Value<i32>(lhs_integer) => {
                record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
                branch_eq(lhs_integer, rhs_integer, equal);
                goto not_equal;
            },
            Value<f64>(lhs_double) => @cold {
                record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
                compare_f64_equality(lhs_double, to_f64(rhs_integer), equal, not_equal);
            },
            _ => int32_and_other_not_equal,
        }
    };
}

inline fn loose_equality(
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    equal: Label,
    not_equal: Label,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    else slow: Label
) {
    let mut rhs_tag = extract_tag(rhs);
    branch_eq(rhs_tag, INT32_TAG, rhs_i32);
    let mut lhs_tag = extract_tag(lhs);
    guard lhs_tag == rhs_tag else different_tags;
    equality_same_tag(lhs, rhs, lhs_tag, equal, not_equal, compare_f64, feedback) else slow;

    let compare_f64 = || {
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_DOUBLE);
        let lhs_number = unbox_f64(lhs);
        let rhs_number = unbox_f64(rhs);
        compare_f64_equality(lhs_number, rhs_number, equal, not_equal);
    };

    let other_slow = || {
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_OTHER);
        goto slow;
    };

    let different_tags = || {
        lhs_tag = lhs_tag & 0xfffe;
        guard lhs_tag == UNDEFINED_TAG else try_f64;
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_OTHER);
        rhs_tag = rhs_tag & 0xfffe;
        guard rhs_tag != UNDEFINED_TAG else equal;
        goto slow;
    };

    let try_f64 = || {
        guard lhs is Value<f64> else other_slow;
        guard rhs is Value<f64> else other_slow;
        goto compare_f64;
    };

    let int32_and_other_slow = || {
        record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_OTHER);
        goto slow;
    };

    let rhs_i32 = || {
        let rhs_integer = unbox_i32(rhs);
        match lhs {
            Value<i32>(lhs_integer) => {
                record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
                branch_eq(lhs_integer, rhs_integer, equal);
                goto not_equal;
            },
            Value<f64>(lhs_double) => @cold {
                record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
                compare_f64_equality(lhs_double, to_f64(rhs_integer), equal, not_equal);
            },
            _ => int32_and_other_slow,
        }
    };
}

inline fn strict_inequality(
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    not_equal: Label,
    equal: Label,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    else slow: Label
) {
    strict_equality(lhs, rhs, equal, not_equal, feedback) else slow;
}

inline fn loose_inequality(
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    not_equal: Label,
    equal: Label,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    else slow: Label
) {
    loose_equality(lhs, rhs, equal, not_equal, feedback) else slow;
}

inline fn store_equality_result(
    dst: out Operand,
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    operation: EqualityOperation,
    slow: SlowPath,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex
) {
    let failure = || @cold {
        call_binary_slow_path(slow, dst, lhs, rhs);
    };
    let store_true = || {
        store(dst, Value<True>);
        dispatch_next;
    };
    let store_false = || {
        store(dst, Value<False>);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    operation(lhs, rhs, store_true, store_false, feedback) else failure;
}

inline fn jump_equality(
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    true_target: BytecodeOffset,
    false_target: BytecodeOffset,
    operation: EqualityOperation,
    slow: SlowPath,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex
) {
    let failure = || @cold {
        call_jump_slow_path(slow, lhs, rhs, true_target, false_target);
    };
    let take_true = || {
        jump(true_target);
    };
    let take_false = || {
        jump(false_target);
    };

    operation(lhs, rhs, take_true, take_false, feedback) else failure;
}

inline fn compare_numeric_values(
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    integer_condition: IntegerCondition,
    float_condition: FloatCondition,
    true_result: Label,
    false_result: Label,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    else slow: Label
) {
    let compare_double = |lhs: f64, rhs: f64| @cold {
        branch_fp_unordered(lhs, rhs, false_result);
        float_condition(lhs, rhs, true_result);
        goto false_result;
    };

    match lhs {
        Value<i32>(lhs_integer) => {
            match rhs {
                Value<i32>(rhs_integer) => {
                    record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
                    integer_condition(lhs_integer, rhs_integer, true_result);
                    goto false_result;
                },
                Value<f64>(rhs_double) => @cold {
                    record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
                    goto compare_double(to_f64(lhs_integer), rhs_double);
                },
                _ => @cold {
                    record_arith_operands_feedback(feedback, lhs, rhs);
                    goto slow;
                },
            }
        },
        Value<f64>(lhs_double) => @cold {
            match rhs {
                Value<i32>(rhs_integer) => {
                    record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
                    goto compare_double(lhs_double, to_f64(rhs_integer));
                },
                Value<f64>(rhs_double) => {
                    record_arith_feedback(feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_DOUBLE);
                    goto compare_double(lhs_double, rhs_double);
                },
                _ => @cold {
                    record_arith_operands_feedback(feedback, lhs, rhs);
                    goto slow;
                },
            }
        },
        _ => @cold {
            record_arith_operands_feedback(feedback, lhs, rhs);
            goto slow;
        },
    }
}

inline fn jump_relational(
    lhs: Value,
    rhs: Value,
    true_target: BytecodeOffset,
    false_target: BytecodeOffset,
    integer_condition: IntegerCondition,
    float_condition: FloatCondition,
    slow: SlowPath,
    feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex
) {
    let failure = || @cold {
        call_jump_slow_path(slow, lhs, rhs, true_target, false_target);
    };
    let take_true = || {
        jump(true_target);
    };
    let take_false = || {
        jump(false_target);
    };

    compare_numeric_values(
        lhs,
        rhs,
        integer_condition,
        float_condition,
        take_true,
        take_false,
        feedback
    ) else failure;
}

inline fn runtime_truthiness(value: Value) -> u64 {
    let result: u64 = call_helper(asm_helper_to_boolean, value);
    assert(result < 2);
    result
}

inline fn box_boolean(value: u64) -> Value {
    let bits = value | BOOLEAN_FALSE;
    reinterpret_u64_as_value(bits)
}

inline fn load_primitive_string_utf16_code_unit(
    string: PrimitiveString,
    index: u32,
    out_of_bounds: Label,
    else failure: Label
) -> u32 {
    let deferred_kind_and_flags: u32 = alias(string.deferred_kind_and_flags);
    let deferred_kind = deferred_kind_and_flags & PRIMITIVE_STRING_DEFERRED_KIND_MASK;
    if deferred_kind == PRIMITIVE_STRING_DEFERRED_KIND_INLINE {
        let length = string.length_in_utf16_code_units;
        guard length > index else out_of_bounds;
        let code_unit: u32 = alias(string.inline_string_storage[index]);
        code_unit
    } else {
        guard deferred_kind == PRIMITIVE_STRING_DEFERRED_KIND_NONE else failure;
        let utf16_data = string.utf16_data;
        guard utf16_data != 0 else failure;
        assert(utf16_data != 0);

        let short_string_info = string.utf16_short_string_byte_count_and_flag;
        if short_string_info lacks UTF16_SHORT_STRING_FLAG {
            let length = utf16_data.length_in_code_units;
            guard length > index else out_of_bounds;
            if utf16_data.flags has UTF16_STRING_DATA_HAS_UTF16_STORAGE {
                let utf16_storage: Sequence<u16> = alias(utf16_data.string_storage);
                let code_unit: u32 = alias(utf16_storage[index]);
                code_unit
            } else {
                let code_unit: u32 = alias(utf16_data.string_storage[index]);
                code_unit
            }
        } else {
            let wide_short_string_info: u32 = alias(short_string_info);
            let byte_count = wide_short_string_info >> UTF16_SHORT_STRING_BYTE_COUNT_SHIFT_COUNT;
            guard index < byte_count else out_of_bounds;
            let code_unit: u32 = alias(string.utf16_short_string_storage[index]);
            code_unit
        }
    }
}

# All feedback recording goes through this helper, so the feedback base can
# later move into the frame without touching every handler.
inline fn feedback_base() -> ExecutableFeedback {
    let executable = exec_ctx.executable;
    executable.feedback
}

# The address of the element `index` of `size` bytes of the feedback array at
# `array` (an offset into the primitive storage cage), masked into the cage.
# Shifting the bits outside PRIMITIVE_STORAGE_CAGE_OFFSET_MASK out masks them
# without a 64-bit immediate, which takes another register on x86-64.
inline fn feedback_address(cage_base: u64, array: u64, index: u32, size: u8) -> u64 {
    let unmasked: u64 = array + alias(index) * alias(size);
    cage_base + ((unmasked << PRIMITIVE_STORAGE_CAGE_OFFSET_SHIFT) >> PRIMITIVE_STORAGE_CAGE_OFFSET_SHIFT)
}

inline fn record_arith_feedback(slot: ArithFeedbackIndex, bits: i32) @profiling {
    let feedback = feedback_base();
    let arith = feedback_address(primitive_storage_cage_base(), feedback.arith, load(slot), 1);
    or8_mem([arith, 0], bits);
}

inline fn record_identity_equality_feedback(slot: ArithFeedbackIndex, tag: ValueTag) @profiling {
    let mut bits: i32 = ARITH_FEEDBACK_OTHER;
    if tag == OBJECT_TAG {
        bits = ARITH_FEEDBACK_OBJECT_PAIR;
    }
    record_arith_feedback(slot, bits);
}

inline fn arith_feedback_bits(value: Value) -> i32 {
    let tag = extract_tag(value);
    let mut bits: i32 = ARITH_FEEDBACK_OTHER;
    if tag == INT32_TAG {
        bits = ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32;
    } else if value is Value<f64> {
        bits = ARITH_FEEDBACK_DOUBLE;
    } else if tag == STRING_TAG {
        bits = ARITH_FEEDBACK_STRING;
    } else if tag == BIGINT_TAG {
        bits = ARITH_FEEDBACK_BIGINT;
    } else if tag == BOOLEAN_TAG {
        bits = ARITH_FEEDBACK_BOOLEAN;
    }
    bits
}

inline fn record_arith_operand_feedback(slot: ArithFeedbackIndex, value: Value) @profiling {
    record_arith_feedback(slot, arith_feedback_bits(value));
}

inline fn record_arith_operands_feedback(slot: ArithFeedbackIndex, lhs: Value, rhs: Value) @profiling {
    let lhs_bits = arith_feedback_bits(lhs);
    let rhs_bits = arith_feedback_bits(rhs);
    let bits = lhs_bits | rhs_bits;
    record_arith_feedback(slot, bits);
}

# Value feedback stores the bits of the produced value in the instruction's
# bucket. The runtime classifies buckets into ValueFeedback bits later.
inline fn record_value_feedback(slot: ValueFeedbackIndex, value: Value) @profiling {
    let feedback = feedback_base();
    let buckets: Sequence<Value> = alias(
        feedback_address(primitive_storage_cage_base(), feedback.value_buckets, load(slot), 8)
    );
    buckets[0] = value;
}

# The value buckets of the sites of property lookup caches lie before the
# others, in reverse order: the bucket of cache 0 is the last of them.
inline fn record_cache_value_feedback(cache: ProfiledPropertyLookupCacheIndex, value: Value) @profiling {
    let feedback = feedback_base();
    let index: u64 = alias(load(cache));
    let unmasked: u64 = feedback.value_buckets - (index << 3) - 8;
    let cage_base = primitive_storage_cage_base();
    let buckets: Sequence<Value> = alias(
        cage_base + ((unmasked << PRIMITIVE_STORAGE_CAGE_OFFSET_SHIFT) >> PRIMITIVE_STORAGE_CAGE_OFFSET_SHIFT)
    );
    buckets[0] = value;
}

# A call site keeps the tag of the value a call returned in its call feedback,
# which holds its value bucket.
inline fn record_call_value_feedback(slot: CallFeedbackIndex, value: Value) @profiling {
    let feedback = feedback_base();
    let call_feedback: CallFeedback = alias(
        feedback_address(primitive_storage_cage_base(), feedback.call, load(slot), CALL_FEEDBACK_SIZE)
    );
    call_feedback.value_bucket = truncate_u16(i32(extract_tag(value)));
}

# Call feedback only does work when the callee differs from the first one
# recorded at the site.
# Records `function` as a target of the call site, and gives the site's call
# feedback flags in `site_flags`.
inline fn record_call_target(slot: CallFeedbackIndex, function: Object, site_flags: inout i32) @profiling {
    let feedback = feedback_base();
    let call_feedback: CallFeedback = alias(
        feedback_address(primitive_storage_cage_base(), feedback.call, load(slot), CALL_FEEDBACK_SIZE)
    );
    let function_pointer: u64 = alias(function);
    let mut flags: i32 = alias(call_feedback.flags);
    if call_feedback.target != function_pointer {
        if call_feedback.target == 0 {
            call_feedback.target = function_pointer;
        } else {
            flags = flags | CALL_FEEDBACK_POLYMORPHIC;
            # A closure of the first callee's function has its shared data.
            # Without native callees, the first callee is an ECMAScript
            # function too.
            if function.flags lacks OBJECT_FLAG_IS_ECMASCRIPT_FUNCTION_OBJECT {
                flags = flags | CALL_FEEDBACK_OTHER_FUNCTIONS;
            } else if flags lacks CALL_FEEDBACK_SAW_NATIVE {
                # The first callee is a weak reference in the feedback, which is
                # decoded into the heap region like a cell value.
                let first_bits = call_feedback.target;
                let mut first_value: Value;
                mov(first_value, first_bits);
                let first_object: Object = unbox_object(first_value);
                let first: ECMAScriptFunctionObject = alias(first_object);
                let closure: ECMAScriptFunctionObject = alias(function);
                if first.shared_data != closure.shared_data {
                    flags = flags | CALL_FEEDBACK_OTHER_FUNCTIONS;
                }
            }
        }
        if function.flags lacks OBJECT_FLAG_IS_ECMASCRIPT_FUNCTION_OBJECT {
            flags = flags | CALL_FEEDBACK_SAW_NATIVE;
        }
        call_feedback.flags = truncate_u8(flags);
    }
    site_flags = flags;
}

inline fn record_keyed_feedback(slot: KeyedFeedbackIndex, bits: u32) @profiling {
    record_keyed_feedback_with_cage_base(primitive_storage_cage_base(), slot, bits);
}

# For handlers that have the primitive storage cage base at hand already.
inline fn record_keyed_feedback_with_cage_base(cage_base: u64, slot: KeyedFeedbackIndex, bits: u32) @profiling {
    let feedback = feedback_base();
    let keyed_feedback = feedback_address(cage_base, feedback.keyed, load(slot), KEYED_FEEDBACK_SIZE);
    or32_mem([keyed_feedback, KEYED_FEEDBACK_BITS], bits);
}

inline fn record_typed_array_keyed_feedback(cage_base: u64, slot: KeyedFeedbackIndex, kind: u8) @profiling {
    let mut bits: u32 = 1;
    let shift: u32 = alias(kind);
    let mut count = shift + KEYED_FEEDBACK_TYPED_ARRAY_SHIFT;
    shl(bits, count);
    bits = bits | KEYED_FEEDBACK_INT32_INDEX;
    record_keyed_feedback_with_cage_base(cage_base, slot, bits);
}

# Runs the frame that just became the running execution context in its
# executable's JIT code, if it has some. Only the profiling build checks:
# JIT code exists only while the JIT is enabled, which selects that build.
inline fn enter_jit_code_if_any(executable: Executable) @profiling {
    if executable.jit_compile_state == JIT_COMPILE_STATE_INSTALLED {
        let control: i32 = call_helper(asm_helper_enter_jit_code, current_vm());
        guard control >= 0 else @cold {
            exit;
        };
        if control > 0 {
            # The code returned: its frame is still the running execution context, and the return value is in the
            # frame's return value register.
            let returned_vm = current_vm();
            exec_ctx = returned_vm.running_execution_context;
            values = exec_ctx.slots;
            return_value(values[3]);
        }
        continue_running_execution_context();
    }
}

# Continues interpreting the running execution context at its program
# counter, after JIT code ran.
inline fn continue_running_execution_context() @profiling {
    let resumed_vm = current_vm();
    exec_ctx = resumed_vm.running_execution_context;
    assert(exec_ctx != 0);
    values = exec_ctx.slots;
    let resumed_executable = exec_ctx.executable;
    assert(resumed_executable != 0);
    pb = resumed_executable.bytecode_data;
    switch_dispatch_table(resumed_executable);
    pc = exec_ctx.program_counter;
    goto_handler(pc);
}

# Continues the running frame in its executable's JIT code after the Catch
# that just ran, if the code has an entry there. Like at loop back edges, an
# exit from that code resumes after the Catch, so the frame always makes
# progress.
inline fn enter_jit_code_after_catch() @profiling {
    let executable = exec_ctx.executable;
    if executable.jit_compile_state == JIT_COMPILE_STATE_INSTALLED {
        let control: i32 = call_helper_with_two_arguments(asm_helper_enter_jit_code_after_catch, current_vm(), pc);
        if control != 0 {
            guard control > 0 else @cold {
                exit;
            };
            continue_running_execution_context();
        }
    }
}

# Starts running the frame that just became the running execution context,
# at its entry: in its executable's JIT code if it has some, and in the
# interpreter otherwise.
inline fn enter_new_frame(executable: Executable) {
    enter_jit_code_if_any(executable);
    pc = 0;
    goto_handler(pc);
}

# Counts the executable's tier-up budget down by cost and runs the tier-up
# policy once it is used up.
inline fn consume_tier_up_budget(cost: i32, target_pc: u32, is_loop: u32) @profiling {
    let executable = exec_ctx.executable;
    sub32_mem([executable, EXECUTABLE_TIER_UP_BUDGET], cost);
    if executable.tier_up_budget <= 0 {
        let shifted_pc = target_pc << 1;
        let encoded_pc = shifted_pc | is_loop;
        # NB: When the policy moves the executable to other handlers at a
        #     function entry, the running frame keeps its handlers until the
        #     interpreter enters another frame. At a loop back edge, the frame
        #     switches to them, or continues in JIT code (on-stack
        #     replacement).
        let control: i32 = call_helper_with_two_arguments(asm_helper_tier_up_check, current_vm(), encoded_pc);
        if control != 0 {
            guard control > 0 else @cold {
                exit;
            };
            continue_running_execution_context();
        }
    }
}

# Loop back edges consume tier-up budget each time they run.
inline fn count_loop_iteration() {
    consume_tier_up_budget(TIER_UP_LOOP_ITERATION_COST, pc, 1);
}

# Handlers whose complete semantics live in their slow path.

# Bytecode handlers are kept in native layout order.

inline fn enter_frame() {
    consume_tier_up_budget(TIER_UP_FUNCTION_ENTRY_COST, pc, 0);
    let executable = exec_ctx.executable;
    assert(executable != 0);
    # NB: Only a collection makes the count nonzero, so the store is rare.
    if executable.idle_collection_count != 0 {
        executable.idle_collection_count = 0;
    }
    let registers_and_locals_count = executable.registers_and_locals_count;
    let empty_tag: Value = Value<Empty>;
    let mut slot_index: u64 = RESERVED_REGISTER_COUNT;
    while slot_index + 1 < alias(registers_and_locals_count) {
        let next_slot_index = slot_index + 1;
        values[slot_index] = empty_tag;
        values[next_slot_index] = empty_tag;
        slot_index = slot_index + 2;
    }
    if slot_index < alias(registers_and_locals_count) {
        values[slot_index] = empty_tag;
    }
    let constant_count: u32 = executable.registers_and_locals_and_constants_count - registers_and_locals_count;
    let constant_data = executable.constants_data;
    let mut write_index: u64 = alias(registers_and_locals_count);
    let mut constant_index: u64 = 0;
    while constant_index < alias(constant_count) {
        assert(constant_data != 0);
        values[write_index] = constant_data[constant_index];
        constant_index = constant_index + 1;
        write_index = write_index + 1;
    }
    exec_ctx.frame_initialized = true;
}

handler Enter() {
    enter_frame();
    dispatch_next;
}

# NB: Callers pass the this value as it is, and the runtime binds it for a sloppy function that uses it: to an object,
#     or the global this value for null and undefined.
inline fn coerce_this() {
    let _: i32 = call_helper(asm_helper_coerce_this, current_vm());
}

# NB: Sloppy functions that use their this value start with this. Null and undefined become the global this value of
#     the current realm, which is the function's, as a call of an ECMAScript function of another realm goes through
#     the runtime.
handler EnterCoercingThis() {
    let this_value = exec_ctx.this_value_register;
    if this_value is not Value<Object> {
        if this_value is Value<Nullish> {
            let realm_vm = current_vm();
            let global_this: Value = alias(box_object(realm_vm.current_realm.global_environment.global_this_value));
            exec_ctx.this_value_register = global_this;
            exec_ctx.this_value = global_this;
        } else {
            coerce_this();
        }
    }
    enter_frame();
    dispatch_next;
}

# NB: Code that makes private or variable environments starts with this, and its frames keep their running private
#     and variable environments from here on. Others read them from their function.
handler EnterWithOwnEnvironments() {
    if exec_ctx.this_value_register is not Value<Object> {
        let this_function = exec_ctx.function;
        if this_function != 0 {
            let this_ecmascript_function: ECMAScriptFunctionObject = alias(this_function);
            let metadata = this_ecmascript_function.shared_data.asm_call_metadata;
            if metadata has SHARED_FUNCTION_INSTANCE_DATA_ASM_CALL_METADATA_USES_THIS {
                if metadata lacks SHARED_FUNCTION_INSTANCE_DATA_ASM_CALL_METADATA_STRICT {
                    coerce_this();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let function = exec_ctx.function;
    if function != 0 {
        let ecmascript_function: ECMAScriptFunctionObject = alias(function);
        exec_ctx.private_environment = null;
        if function.class_bits has ECMASCRIPT_FUNCTION_FLAG_HAS_RARE_DATA {
            exec_ctx.private_environment = ecmascript_function.private_environment;
        }
        # NB: The variable environment of a frame starts out as its lexical environment.
        exec_ctx.variable_environment = exec_ctx.lexical_environment;
    }
    enter_frame();
    dispatch_next;
}

handler Mov(
    dst: out Operand,
    src: in Operand
) {
    store(dst, load(src));
    dispatch_next;
}

specialize Mov(src: Undefined);

# NB: The only way to reach the frame slots that no other instruction can name.
handler MovWide(
    dst_slot: u32,
    src_slot: u32
) {
    values[load(dst_slot)] = values[load(src_slot)];
    dispatch_next;
}

    second: u32
) {
    dispatch_next;
}

handler Add(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    lhs: in Operand,
    rhs: in Operand
) {
    let lhs_value = load(lhs);
    let rhs_value = load(rhs);
    let slow = || @cold {
        record_arith_operands_feedback(arith_feedback, lhs_value, rhs_value);
        call_binary_slow_path(add_values, dst, lhs_value, rhs_value);
    };
    let add_double = |lhs: f64, rhs: f64| @cold {
        store(dst, box_number(lhs + rhs));
        dispatch_next;
    };
    match lhs_value {
        Value<i32>(lhs_integer) => {
            match rhs_value {
                Value<i32>(rhs_integer) => {
                    guard let sum = checked_add(lhs_integer, rhs_integer) else @cold {
                        record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
                        store(dst, box_f64(to_f64(lhs_integer) + to_f64(rhs_integer)));
                        dispatch_next;
                    };
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
                    store(dst, box_i32(sum));
                    dispatch_next;
                },
                Value<f64>(rhs_double) => @cold {
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
                    goto add_double(to_f64(lhs_integer), rhs_double);
                },
                _ => slow,
            }
        },
        Value<f64>(lhs_double) => @cold {
            match rhs_value {
                Value<i32>(rhs_integer) => {
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
                    goto add_double(lhs_double, to_f64(rhs_integer));
                },
                Value<f64>(rhs_double) => {
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_DOUBLE);
                    goto add_double(lhs_double, rhs_double);
                },
                _ => slow,
            }
        },
        _ => slow,
    }
}

handler Sub(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    lhs: in Operand,
    rhs: in Operand
) {
    let lhs_value = load(lhs);
    let rhs_value = load(rhs);
    let slow = || @cold {
        record_arith_operands_feedback(arith_feedback, lhs_value, rhs_value);
        call_binary_slow_path(sub_values, dst, lhs_value, rhs_value);
    };
    let subtract_double = |lhs: f64, rhs: f64| @cold {
        store(dst, box_number(lhs - rhs));
        dispatch_next;
    };
    match lhs_value {
        Value<i32>(lhs_integer) => {
            match rhs_value {
                Value<i32>(rhs_integer) => {
                    guard let difference = checked_sub(lhs_integer, rhs_integer) else @cold {
                        record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
                        store(dst, box_f64(to_f64(lhs_integer) - to_f64(rhs_integer)));
                        dispatch_next;
                    };
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
                    store(dst, box_i32(difference));
                    dispatch_next;
                },
                Value<f64>(rhs_double) => @cold {
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
                    goto subtract_double(to_f64(lhs_integer), rhs_double);
                },
                _ => slow,
            }
        },
        Value<f64>(lhs_double) => @cold {
            match rhs_value {
                Value<i32>(rhs_integer) => {
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
                    goto subtract_double(lhs_double, to_f64(rhs_integer));
                },
                Value<f64>(rhs_double) => {
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_DOUBLE);
                    goto subtract_double(lhs_double, rhs_double);
                },
                _ => slow,
            }
        },
        _ => slow,
    }
}

handler Mul(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    lhs: in Operand,
    rhs: in Operand
) {
    let lhs_value = load(lhs);
    let rhs_value = load(rhs);
    let slow = || @cold {
        record_arith_operands_feedback(arith_feedback, lhs_value, rhs_value);
        call_binary_slow_path(mul_values, dst, lhs_value, rhs_value);
    };
    let multiply_double = |lhs: f64, rhs: f64| @cold {
        store(dst, box_number(lhs * rhs));
        dispatch_next;
    };
    match lhs_value {
        Value<i32>(lhs_integer) => {
            match rhs_value {
                Value<i32>(rhs_integer) => {
                    let negative_zero = || @cold {
                        record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
                        store(dst, Value<NegativeZero>);
                        dispatch_next;
                    };
                    guard let product = checked_mul(lhs_integer, rhs_integer) else @cold {
                        record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
                        store(dst, box_f64(to_f64(lhs_integer) * to_f64(rhs_integer)));
                        dispatch_next;
                    };
                    if product == 0 {
                        let sign_check = lhs_integer | rhs_integer;
                        guard sign_check >= 0 else negative_zero;
                    }

                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
                    store(dst, box_i32(product));
                    dispatch_next;
                },
                Value<f64>(rhs_double) => @cold {
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
                    goto multiply_double(to_f64(lhs_integer), rhs_double);
                },
                _ => slow,
            }
        },
        Value<f64>(lhs_double) => @cold {
            match rhs_value {
                Value<i32>(rhs_integer) => {
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_AND_DOUBLE);
                    goto multiply_double(lhs_double, to_f64(rhs_integer));
                },
                Value<f64>(rhs_double) => {
                    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_DOUBLE);
                    goto multiply_double(lhs_double, rhs_double);
                },
                _ => slow,
            }
        },
        _ => slow,
    }
}

}

handler Jump(
    target: BytecodeOffset
) @terminator = jump(target);

inline fn jump_if(
    condition: in Operand,
    true_target: BytecodeOffset,
    false_target: BytecodeOffset
) {
    let value = load(condition);
    let take_false = || {
        jump(false_target);
    };
    let take_true = || {
        jump(true_target);
    };

    match value {
        Value<bool> => {
            branch_bits_set(value, 1, take_true);
            goto take_false;
        },

        Value<i32> => {
            branch_nonzero32(value, take_true);
            goto take_false;
        },

        _ => {
            let runtime = || {
                guard runtime_truthiness(value) == 0 else take_true;
                goto take_false;
            };
            guard let Value<Object>(object) = value else runtime;
            guard object.flags lacks OBJECT_FLAG_IS_HTMLDDA else take_false;
            goto take_true;
        },
    }
}

handler JumpIf(
    condition: in Operand,
    true_target: BytecodeOffset,
    false_target: BytecodeOffset
) @terminator = jump_if(condition, true_target, false_target);

inline fn jump_true(
    condition: in Operand,
    target: BytecodeOffset
) {
    let value = load(condition);
    let take = || {
        jump(target);
    };

    match value {
        Value<bool> => {
            branch_bits_set(value, 1, take);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        Value<i32> => {
            branch_nonzero32(value, take);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        _ => {
            let runtime = || {
                guard runtime_truthiness(value) == 0 else take;
                dispatch_next;
            };
            guard let Value<Object>(object) = value else runtime;
            guard object.flags has OBJECT_FLAG_IS_HTMLDDA else take;
            dispatch_next;
        },
    }
}

handler JumpTrue(
    condition: in Operand,
    target: BytecodeOffset
) @terminator @fallthrough = jump_true(condition, target);

inline fn jump_false(
    condition: in Operand,
    target: BytecodeOffset
) {
    let value = load(condition);
    let take = || {
        jump(target);
    };

    match value {
        Value<bool> => {
            branch_bits_clear(value, 1, take);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        Value<i32> => {
            branch_zero32(value, take);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        _ => {
            let runtime = || {
                guard runtime_truthiness(value) != 0 else take;
                dispatch_next;
            };
            guard let Value<Object>(object) = value else runtime;
            guard object.flags lacks OBJECT_FLAG_IS_HTMLDDA else take;
            dispatch_next;
        },
    }
}

handler JumpFalse(
    condition: in Operand,
    target: BytecodeOffset
) @terminator @fallthrough = jump_false(condition, target);

handler JumpNullish(
    condition: in Operand,
    true_target: BytecodeOffset,
    false_target: BytecodeOffset
) @terminator {
    if load(condition) is Value<Nullish> {
        jump(true_target);
    }
    jump(false_target);
}

handler JumpUndefined(
    condition: in Operand,
    true_target: BytecodeOffset,
    false_target: BytecodeOffset
) @terminator {
    if load(condition) is Value<Undefined> {
        jump(true_target);
    }
    jump(false_target);
}

# Loop back edges. The bytecode generator emits these variants for jumps to
# an earlier block, and they consume tier-up budget each time they run.

handler JumpLoop(
    target: BytecodeOffset
) @terminator {
    count_loop_iteration();
    jump(target);
}

handler JumpIfLoop(
    condition: in Operand,
    true_target: BytecodeOffset,
    false_target: BytecodeOffset
) @terminator {
    count_loop_iteration();
    jump_if(condition, true_target, false_target);
}

handler JumpTrueLoop(
    condition: in Operand,
    target: BytecodeOffset

}

handler JumpFalseLoop(

handler Increment(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: inout Operand
) = update_operand(dst, checked_add, add_f64, increment, arith_feedback);

handler Decrement(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: inout Operand
) = update_operand(dst, checked_sub, sub_f64, decrement, arith_feedback);

handler Not(
    dst: out Operand,
    src: in Operand
) {
    let value = load(src);
    let store_true = || {
        store(dst, Value<True>);
        dispatch_next;
    };
    let store_false = || {
        store(dst, Value<False>);
        dispatch_next;
    };
    # FIXME: Branch through a distinct continuation to retain the Boolean-first
    #        layout until value-match placement uses profile information.
    let store_false_from_boolean = || {
        goto store_false;
    };

    match value {
        Value<bool> => {
            # FIXME: Toggle bit 0 and store boolean inputs directly once result
            #        sinks can preserve that strictly better fast-path layout.
            branch_bits_clear(value, 1, store_true);
            goto store_false_from_boolean;
        },

        Value<i32> => {
            branch_zero32(value, store_true);
            goto store_false;
        },

        _ => {
            let runtime = || {
                guard runtime_truthiness(value) != 0 else store_true;
                goto store_false;
            };
            guard value is not Value<Nullish> else store_true;
            guard let Value<Object>(object) = value else runtime;
            guard object.flags lacks OBJECT_FLAG_IS_HTMLDDA else store_true;
            goto store_false;
        },
    }
}

handler ToBoolean(
    dst: out Operand,
    value: in Operand
) {
    store(dst, box_boolean(runtime_truthiness(load(value))));
    dispatch_next;
}

handler Catch(
    value_feedback: ValueFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand
) {
    let exception = exec_ctx.exception;
    record_value_feedback(value_feedback, exception);
    store(dst, exception);
    exec_ctx.exception = Value<Empty>;
    enter_jit_code_after_catch();
    dispatch_next;
}

handler Return(
    value: in Operand
) @terminator = return_value(load(value));

handler End(
    value: in Operand
) @terminator {
    let value = load(value);
    assert(extract_tag(value) != extract_tag(Value<Empty>));
    return_to_caller(value) else {
        values[3] = value;
        exit;
    };
}

handler GetLexicalEnvironment(
    dst: out Operand
) {
    let environment = exec_ctx.lexical_environment;
    assert(environment != 0);
    store(dst, box_cell(environment));
    dispatch_next;
}

}

handler GetBinding(
    value_feedback: ValueFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    identifier: IdentifierTableIndex,
    cache: EnvironmentCoordinate
) {
    let [environment, binding_index] =
        walk_environment_chain(exec_ctx.lexical_environment, cache);
    guard let value = load_initialized_binding(environment.binding_values, binding_index) else @cold {
        call_slow_path(get_binding);
    };
    record_value_feedback(value_feedback, value);
    store(dst, value);
    dispatch_next;
}

handler Div(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    lhs: in Operand,
    rhs: in Operand
) {
    let lhs = load(lhs);
    let rhs = load(rhs);
    record_arith_operands_feedback(arith_feedback, lhs, rhs);

    guard let [lhs_number, rhs_number] = numeric_pair_to_f64(lhs, rhs) else @cold {
        call_binary_slow_path(div_values, dst, lhs, rhs);
    };

    let quotient = lhs_number / rhs_number;
    guard let integer = double_to_int32(quotient) else store_f64;
    guard integer != 0 else check_negative_zero;
    goto store_i32(integer);

    let check_negative_zero = || {
        let bits = box_f64(quotient);
        branch_value_bits_negative(bits, store_f64);
        goto store_i32(integer);
    };

    let store_i32 = |integer: i32| @hot {
        store(dst, box_i32(integer));
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let store_f64 = || {
        record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
        store(dst, canonicalize_nan(quotient));
        dispatch_next;
    };
}

handler UnaryPlus(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    src: in Operand
) {
    let value = load(src);
    match value {
        Value<i32> => {
            record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
            store(dst, value);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        Value<f64> => @cold {
            record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_DOUBLE);
            store(dst, value);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        _ => @cold {
            record_arith_operand_feedback(arith_feedback, value);
            call_slow_path(unary_plus);
        },
    }
}

# `arguments[index]` of a function that has no arguments object, which reads the passed argument from the frame.
handler GetArgument(
    dst: out Operand,
    index: in Operand,
    kind: ArgumentsKind
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(get_argument);
    };
    let key = load(index);
    guard extract_tag(key) == INT32_TAG else slow;
    let signed_index = unbox_i32(key);
    guard signed_index >= 0 else slow;
    let argument_index = assume_u32(signed_index);
    guard argument_index < exec_ctx.passed_argument_count else slow;
    let first_argument: u32 = exec_ctx.slot_count - exec_ctx.argument_count;
    store(dst, values[first_argument + argument_index]);
    dispatch_next;
}

handler UnsignedRightShift(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    lhs: in Operand,
    rhs: in Operand
) {
    let lhs = load(lhs);
    let rhs = load(rhs);

    let slow = || @cold {
        record_arith_operands_feedback(arith_feedback, lhs, rhs);
        call_binary_slow_path(unsigned_right_shift_values, dst, lhs, rhs);
    };

    guard let Value<i32>(integer) = lhs else slow;
    guard let mut Value<i32>(count) = rhs else slow;
    let mut value = u32(integer);
    let as_double = || @cold {
        record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
        store(dst, box_f64(u32_to_f64(value)));
        dispatch_next;
    };
    count = count & 31;
    value = value >> u32(count);
    branch_bit_set(value, 31, as_double);
    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
    store(dst, box_i32(assume_i32(value)));
    dispatch_next;

}

handler Mod(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    lhs: in Operand,
    rhs: in Operand
) {
    let lhs = load(lhs);

    let slow = || @cold {
        let rhs_value = load(rhs);
        record_arith_operands_feedback(arith_feedback, lhs, rhs_value);
        call_binary_slow_path(mod_values, dst, lhs, rhs_value);
    };

    let try_int64 = || @cold {
        let rhs_value = load(rhs);
        record_arith_operands_feedback(arith_feedback, lhs, rhs_value);
        guard let lhs_integer = integer_value_to_i64(lhs) else slow;
        guard let rhs_integer = integer_value_to_i64(load(rhs)) else slow;
        guard rhs_integer != 0 else slow;

        let zero = || @cold {
            let negative_zero = || @cold {
                record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
                store(dst, Value<NegativeZero>);
                dispatch_next;
            };
            guard lhs_integer >= 0 else negative_zero;
            branch_value_bits_negative(lhs, negative_zero);
            let zero_value: Value = INT32_TAG_SHIFTED;
            store(dst, zero_value);
            dispatch_next;
        };

        # NB: Avoid signed division overflow for INT64_MIN % -1.
        let zero_integer: i64 = 0;
        let negative_one = zero_integer - 1;
        guard rhs_integer != negative_one else zero;
        let remainder = mod_i64(lhs_integer, rhs_integer);
        guard remainder != 0 else zero;
        let remainder_int32 = i32(remainder);
        let widened_remainder = i64(remainder_int32);
        guard widened_remainder == remainder else @cold {
            store(dst, box_f64(i64_to_f64(remainder)));
            dispatch_next;
        };
        store(dst, box_i32(remainder_int32));
        dispatch_next;
    };

    guard let Value<i32>(lhs_int) = lhs else try_int64;
    guard let Value<i32>(rhs_int) = load(rhs) else try_int64;
    guard rhs_int != 0 else slow;
    guard lhs_int >= 0 else try_int64;
    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
    let [_, remainder] = divmod(lhs_int, rhs_int);
    store(dst, box_i32(remainder));
    dispatch_next;
}
