handler UnaryMinus(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    src: in Operand
) {
    let mut value = load(src);

    match value {
        Value<i32>(mut integer) => {
            let negative_zero = || @cold {
                record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
                store(dst, Value<NegativeZero>);
                dispatch_next;
            };

            let overflow = || @cold {
                record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32_OVERFLOW);
                neg(integer);
                let unsigned_integer: u32 = alias(integer);
                store(dst, box_f64(u32_to_f64(unsigned_integer)));
                dispatch_next;
            };

            guard integer != 0 else negative_zero;
            neg32_overflow(integer) else overflow;
            record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
            store(dst, box_i32(integer));
            dispatch_next;
        },

        Value<f64> => @cold {
            record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_DOUBLE);
            toggle_bit(value, 63);
            store(dst, value);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        _ => @cold {
            record_arith_operand_feedback(arith_feedback, value);
            call_slow_path(unary_minus);
        },
    }
}

handler PostfixDecrement(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    src: inout Operand
) = post_update_operand(dst, src, checked_sub, sub_f64, postfix_decrement, arith_feedback);

handler ToInt32(
    arith_feedback: ArithFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    value: in Operand
) {
    let loaded_value = load(value);
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(to_int32);
    };

    let tag = extract_tag(loaded_value);
    guard tag == INT32_TAG else @cold {
        record_arith_operand_feedback(arith_feedback, loaded_value);
        guard let integer = numeric_value_to_i32(load(value)) else slow;
        store(dst, box_i32(integer));
        dispatch_next;
    };

    record_arith_feedback(arith_feedback, ARITH_FEEDBACK_INT32);
    store(dst, loaded_value);
    dispatch_next;
}

handler PutByValue(
    keyed_feedback: KeyedFeedbackIndex,
    base: in Operand,
    property: in Operand,
    src: in Operand,
    kind: PutKind,
    cache: PropertyLookupCacheIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(put_by_value);
    };

    let slow_without_cache = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(put_by_value_uncached);
    };

    let try_cache = || @cold {
        guard call_interp(asm_try_put_by_value_cache) == 0 else slow;
        dispatch_next;
    };

    guard load(kind) == PUT_KIND_NORMAL else slow;
    let key = load(property);
    guard extract_tag(key) == INT32_TAG else {
        # Keys that are not array indices: the property lookup cache remembers the shapes and keys it has
        # seen, and matches string and symbol keys by identity.
        guard let property_cache = load_keyed_property_lookup_cache(cache, slow_without_cache) else slow;
        guard let Value<Object>(object) = load(base) else slow;
        guard property_cache.key is key else try_cache;
        let shape = object.shape;
        guard property_cache.shape == shape else try_cache;
        guard property_cache.prototype == 0 else try_cache;
        guard property_cache.shape_dictionary_generation == shape.dictionary_generation else try_cache;
        # NB: Addition entries have no slot at their offset.
        guard property_cache.writes_data_property != 0 else try_cache;
        guard object.named_properties[property_cache.property_offset] is not Value<Accessor> else try_cache;
        object.named_properties[property_cache.property_offset] = load(src);
        dispatch_next;
    };
    guard let Value<Object>(object) = load(base) else slow;
    let index = u32(unbox_i32(key));
    let flags = object.flags;
    if flags lacks OBJECT_FLAG_IS_TYPED_ARRAY {
        let try_holey_array_slow = || @cold {
            guard call_interp(asm_try_put_by_value_holey_array) == 0 else slow;
            dispatch_next;
        };

        guard flags lacks OBJECT_FLAG_MAY_INTERFERE else slow;
        match object.indexed_storage_kind {
            INDEXED_STORAGE_KIND_PACKED => @hot {
                guard index < object.indexed_array_like_size else slow;
                let indexed_elements = object.indexed_elements;
                assert(indexed_elements != 0);
                # The size above lives on the object while the capacity lives with the buffer, so
                # bound the access by the buffer that is really being addressed.
                guard index < indexed_elements.capacity else slow;
                record_keyed_feedback(keyed_feedback, KEYED_FEEDBACK_INT32_INDEX_PACKED);
                indexed_elements[index] = load(src);
                dispatch_next;
            },

            INDEXED_STORAGE_KIND_HOLEY => {
                guard index < object.indexed_array_like_size else slow;
                let indexed_elements = object.indexed_elements;
                guard indexed_elements != 0 else try_holey_array_slow;
                guard index < indexed_elements.capacity else try_holey_array_slow;
                guard indexed_elements[index] is not Value<Empty> else try_holey_array_slow;
                record_keyed_feedback(keyed_feedback, KEYED_FEEDBACK_INT32_INDEX_HOLEY);
                indexed_elements[index] = load(src);
                dispatch_next;
            },

            _ => slow,
        }
    }

    let try_typed_array_slow = || @cold {
        guard call_interp(asm_try_put_by_value_typed_array) == 0 else slow;
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let cached_offset = object.typed_array_cached_data_offset;
    guard cached_offset != TYPED_ARRAY_CACHED_DATA_OFFSET_INVALID else try_typed_array_slow;
    let elements = primitive_storage_cage_base();
    # NB: A negative key wraps to an index below a length of 2^32.
    let signed_index = unbox_i32(key);
    guard signed_index >= 0 else slow;
    let element_index: u64 = alias(index);
    guard element_index < object.typed_array_array_length else slow;
    let typed_array_kind = object.typed_array_kind;
    record_typed_array_keyed_feedback(elements, keyed_feedback, typed_array_kind);
    let source = load(src);
    let store_non_integer = || {
        match typed_array_kind {
            TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_FLOAT32 => @hot {
                guard let Value<f64>(source_f64) = source else try_typed_array_slow;
                # FIXME: Sink this conversion into the store once lowering
                #        still schedules it ahead of caged address formation.
                let source_f32 = to_f32(source_f64);
                let values: Sequence<f32> = alias(
                    caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 4)
                );
                values[0] = source_f32;
                dispatch_next;
            },

            TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_FLOAT64 => {
                guard source is Value<f64> else try_typed_array_slow;
                let values: Sequence<Value> = alias(
                    caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 8)
                );
                values[0] = source;
                dispatch_next;
            },

            TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT8 | TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_INT8 => {
                guard let converted = numeric_value_to_i32(source) else try_typed_array_slow;
                let values: Sequence<u8> = alias(
                    caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 1)
                );
                values[0] = truncate_u8(converted);
                dispatch_next;
            },

            TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT16 | TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_INT16 => {
                guard let converted = numeric_value_to_i32(source) else try_typed_array_slow;
                let values: Sequence<u16> = alias(
                    caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 2)
                );
                values[0] = truncate_u16(converted);
                dispatch_next;
            },

            # Uint8Clamped is deliberately not handled here: it rounds half to even and clamps rather than truncating,
            # so it keeps using the general path.

            TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_INT32 | TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT32 => {
                guard let converted = numeric_value_to_i32(source) else try_typed_array_slow;
                let values: Sequence<i32> = alias(
                    caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 4)
                );
                values[0] = converted;
                dispatch_next;
            },

            _ => try_typed_array_slow,
        }
    };

    guard let mut Value<i32>(source_i32) = source else store_non_integer;
    match typed_array_kind {
        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT8 | TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_INT8 => {
            let values: Sequence<u8> = alias(
                caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 1)
            );
            values[0] = truncate_u8(source_i32);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT16 | TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_INT16 => {
            let values: Sequence<u16> = alias(
                caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 2)
            );
            values[0] = truncate_u16(source_i32);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT8_CLAMPED => {
            let values: Sequence<u8> = alias(
                caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 1)
            );
            if source_i32 < 0 {
                source_i32 = 0;
            } else if source_i32 >= 255 {
                source_i32 = 255;
            }
            values[0] = truncate_u8(source_i32);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_INT32 | TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT32 => {
            let values: Sequence<i32> = alias(
                caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 4)
            );
            values[0] = source_i32;
            dispatch_next;
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_FLOAT32 => {
            # FIXME: Sink these conversions into the store once lowering
            #        still schedules them ahead of caged address formation.
            let source_f64 = to_f64(source_i32);
            let source_f32 = to_f32(source_f64);
            let values: Sequence<f32> = alias(
                caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 4)
            );
            values[0] = source_f32;
            dispatch_next;
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_FLOAT64 => {
            let source_f64 = to_f64(source_i32);
            let values: Sequence<Value> = alias(
                caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 8)
            );
            values[0] = box_f64(source_f64);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        _ => try_typed_array_slow,
    }
}

handler GetById(
    dst: out Operand,
    base: in Operand,
    property: PropertyKeyTableIndex,
    cache: ProfiledPropertyLookupCacheIndex
) {
    let try_cache = || @cold {
        let executable = exec_ctx.executable;
        let caches: u64 = alias(executable.property_lookup_caches);
        let cache_index: u64 = alias(load(cache));
        let cache_pointer = caches + cache_index * PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_SIZE;
        let result: Value = call_helper_with_two_arguments(asm_try_get_by_id_cache, load(base), cache_pointer);
        guard result is not Value<Empty> else slow;
        store(dst, result);
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, result);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(get_by_id);
    };

    let invoke_accessor_slow = || @cold {
        guard call_interp(asm_try_inline_get_by_id_accessor) == 0 else {
            call_slow_path(get_by_id_cached_accessor);
        };
        let inline_vm = current_vm();
        exec_ctx = inline_vm.running_execution_context;
        assert(exec_ctx != 0);
        values = exec_ctx.slots;
        let inline_executable = exec_ctx.executable;
        assert(inline_executable != 0);
        pb = inline_executable.bytecode_data;
        switch_dispatch_table(inline_executable);
        pc = 0;
        goto_handler(pc);
    };

    let invoke_accessor = |accessor_value: Value, receiver_object: Object, property_cache: PropertyLookupCache| @cold {
        let accessor: Accessor = unbox_object(accessor_value);
        let getter = accessor.getter;
        guard getter != 0 else {
            let produced: Value = Value<Undefined>;
            record_cache_value_feedback(cache, produced);
            store(dst, produced);
            dispatch_next;
        };
        let function: Object = alias(getter);
        let flags = function.flags;
        guard flags has OBJECT_FLAG_IS_RAW_NATIVE_FUNCTION else invoke_accessor_slow;

        if flags has OBJECT_FLAG_IS_DIRECT_GETTER_FUNCTION {
            if property_cache.getter == getter {
                guard let result = load_direct_getter_value(function, receiver_object) else invoke_accessor_slow;
                record_cache_value_feedback(cache, result);
                store(dst, result);
                dispatch_next;
            }
            goto invoke_accessor_slow();
        }

        let raw_native_function: RawNativeFunction = alias(function);
        let native_function_index = raw_native_function.native_function_index;
        let native_table_vm = current_vm();
        let native_function_entry = &native_table_vm.native_function_table[native_function_index & NATIVE_FUNCTION_TABLE_INDEX_MASK];
        let native_function_type = native_function_entry.type;
        assert(native_function_type < NATIVE_FUNCTION_TYPE_COUNT);

        # Construct the lightweight zero-argument frame used by raw native getters.
        let native_stack_vm = current_vm();
        let frame_base = native_stack_vm.interpreter_stack_top;
        let native_stack_limit = native_stack_vm.interpreter_stack_limit;
        let native_frame: ExecutionContext = alias(frame_base);
        let native_frame_end: u64 = frame_base + SIZEOF_EXECUTION_CONTEXT;
        assert(native_frame_end >= frame_base);
        guard native_frame_end <= native_stack_limit else invoke_accessor_slow;
        let native_limit_vm = current_vm();
        let machine_stack_limit: u64 = native_limit_vm.stack_base + VM_STACK_SPACE_LIMIT;
        assert(machine_stack_limit >= native_limit_vm.stack_base);
        guard machine_stack_limit <= fp else invoke_accessor_slow;
        let native_stack_update_vm = current_vm();
        native_stack_update_vm.interpreter_stack_top = native_frame_end;
        # RawNativeFunction is the zero-valued native function table type.
        native_frame.slot_count = native_function_type;
        native_frame.argument_count = native_function_type;
        native_frame.passed_argument_count = 0;
        native_frame.function = function;
        let lexical_environment = exec_ctx.lexical_environment;
        assert(lexical_environment != 0);
        native_frame.lexical_environment = lexical_environment;
        let receiver: Value = alias(box_object(receiver_object));
        native_frame.this_value = receiver;
        native_frame.executable = null;
        native_frame.program_counter = 0;
        native_frame.frame_id = 0;
        native_frame.caller_is_construct = false;
        native_frame.frame_initialized = false;
        native_frame.returns_to_native_caller = false;
        native_frame.runs_jit_code = false;
        native_frame.caller_is_derived_construct = false;
        let undefined_new_target_1: Value = Value<Undefined>;
        native_frame.new_target = undefined_new_target_1;
        let native_pc: u32 = pc;
        let mut destination_offset: u32;
        load8(destination_offset, [pb, pc, dst]);
        exec_ctx.program_counter = native_pc;
        native_frame.caller_frame = exec_ctx;
        # The exception helper only needs a PC within the current instruction.
        native_frame.caller_return_pc = native_pc + 1;
        native_frame.caller_dst_raw = destination_offset;
        let native_running_vm = current_vm();
        native_running_vm.running_execution_context = native_frame;
        # The getter runs in its own realm, as in call_raw_native_function().
        native_frame.realm_without_function = native_running_vm.current_realm;
        native_running_vm.current_realm = function.shape.realm;
        exec_ctx = native_frame;
        values = exec_ctx.slots;
        let native_function = native_function_entry.function;
        let mut [native_return, variant] = call_raw_native(native_function);
        let native_payload = native_return;
        variant = variant & 255;
        assert(variant < 2);
        guard variant == 0 else @cold {
            let helper_argument = native_payload;
            let exception_pc: i32 = call_helper_with_two_arguments(
                asm_helper_handle_raw_native_exception,
                current_vm(),
                helper_argument
            );
            guard exception_pc >= 0 else @cold {
                exit;
            };
            let exception_vm = current_vm();
            exec_ctx = exception_vm.running_execution_context;
            assert(exec_ctx != 0);
            values = exec_ctx.slots;
            let exception_executable = exec_ctx.executable;
            assert(exception_executable != 0);
            pb = exception_executable.bytecode_data;
            switch_dispatch_table(exception_executable);
            pc = exec_ctx.program_counter;
            goto_handler(pc);
        };
        let caller_frame = exec_ctx.caller_frame;
        assert(caller_frame != 0);
        let return_vm = current_vm();
        return_vm.running_execution_context = caller_frame;
        return_vm.current_realm = exec_ctx.realm_without_function;
        return_vm.interpreter_stack_top = alias(exec_ctx);
        exec_ctx = caller_frame;
        values = exec_ctx.slots;
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, native_payload);
        store(dst, native_payload);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    # The other entries of a polymorphic cache (the first one did not match). Accessors and missing
    # properties are left to the runtime's probe.
    let try_polymorphic_entries = |object: Object, shape: Shape| {
        let polymorphic_executable = exec_ctx.executable;
        let tagged_cache: u64 = alias(polymorphic_executable.property_lookup_caches[load(cache)]);
        let cache_tag = tagged_cache & PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_DATA_TAG_MASK;
        guard cache_tag == PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_POLYMORPHIC_DATA_TAG else try_cache;
        let first_entry: u64 = tagged_cache & PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_DATA_POINTER_MASK;
        let second_entry_address: u64 = first_entry + PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_ENTRY_SIZE;
        let second_entry: PropertyLookupCache = alias(second_entry_address);
        guard second_entry.shape != shape else use_polymorphic_entry(object, second_entry, shape);
        let third_entry_address: u64 = second_entry_address + PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_ENTRY_SIZE;
        let third_entry: PropertyLookupCache = alias(third_entry_address);
        guard third_entry.shape != shape else use_polymorphic_entry(object, third_entry, shape);
        let fourth_entry_address: u64 = third_entry_address + PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_ENTRY_SIZE;
        let fourth_entry: PropertyLookupCache = alias(fourth_entry_address);
        guard fourth_entry.shape != shape else use_polymorphic_entry(object, fourth_entry, shape);
        goto try_cache;
    };

    let use_polymorphic_entry = |object: Object, entry: PropertyLookupCache, shape: Shape| {
        guard entry.entry_type != PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_ENTRY_TYPE_GET_MISSING_PROPERTY else try_cache;
        guard entry.shape_dictionary_generation == shape.dictionary_generation else try_cache;
        let entry_prototype = entry.prototype;
        guard entry_prototype == 0 else @cold {
            let entry_prototype_chain_validity = entry.prototype_chain_validity;
            guard entry_prototype_chain_validity != 0 else try_cache;
            guard entry_prototype_chain_validity.valid != 0 else try_cache;
            goto load_polymorphic_value(entry_prototype, entry);
        };
        goto load_polymorphic_value(object, entry);
    };

    let load_polymorphic_value = |holder: Object, entry: PropertyLookupCache| {
        let polymorphic_value = holder.named_properties[entry.property_offset];
        guard polymorphic_value is not Value<Accessor> else try_cache;
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, polymorphic_value);
        store(dst, polymorphic_value);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    # Primitive bases find their properties through the prototype of their kind, which the cache remembers.
    let try_primitive = || @cold {
        guard call_interp(asm_try_get_by_id_cache_on_primitive) == 0 else slow;
        dispatch_next;
    };

    guard let Value<Object>(object) = load(base) else try_primitive;
    let shape = object.shape;
    guard let property_cache = load_property_lookup_cache(cache) else try_cache;
    guard property_cache.shape == shape else try_polymorphic_entries(object, shape);
    guard property_cache.entry_type != PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_ENTRY_TYPE_GET_MISSING_PROPERTY else try_cache;
    let load_cached_value = |holder: Object, object: Object, property_cache: PropertyLookupCache, shape: Shape| {
        guard property_cache.shape_dictionary_generation == shape.dictionary_generation else try_cache;
        let value = holder.named_properties[property_cache.property_offset];
        guard value is not Value<Accessor> else invoke_accessor(value, object, property_cache);
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, value);
        store(dst, value);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let cached_prototype = property_cache.prototype;
    guard cached_prototype == 0 else @cold {
        let prototype_chain_validity = property_cache.prototype_chain_validity;
        guard prototype_chain_validity != 0 else try_cache;
        guard prototype_chain_validity.valid != 0 else try_cache;
        goto load_cached_value(cached_prototype, object, property_cache, shape);
    };
    goto load_cached_value(object, object, property_cache, shape);
}

handler GetByIdWithThis(
    dst: out Operand,
    base: in Operand,
    property: PropertyKeyTableIndex,
    this_value: Operand,
    cache: ProfiledPropertyLookupCacheIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(get_by_id_with_this);
    };

    # Data properties found through the cache of the base, whose value does not depend on the receiver. Getters run in
    # the slow path with the this value.
    let load_cached_value = |holder: Object, property_cache: PropertyLookupCache| {
        let value = holder.named_properties[property_cache.property_offset];
        guard value is not Value<Accessor> else slow;
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, value);
        store(dst, value);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    guard let Value<Object>(object) = load(base) else slow;
    let shape = object.shape;
    guard let property_cache = load_property_lookup_cache(cache) else slow;
    guard property_cache.shape == shape else slow;
    guard property_cache.entry_type != PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_ENTRY_TYPE_GET_MISSING_PROPERTY else slow;
    guard property_cache.shape_dictionary_generation == shape.dictionary_generation else slow;
    let cached_prototype = property_cache.prototype;
    guard cached_prototype == 0 else @cold {
        let prototype_chain_validity = property_cache.prototype_chain_validity;
        guard prototype_chain_validity != 0 else slow;
        guard prototype_chain_validity.valid != 0 else slow;
        goto load_cached_value(cached_prototype, property_cache);
    };
    goto load_cached_value(object, property_cache);
}

handler PutById(
    base: in Operand,
    property: PropertyKeyTableIndex,
    src: in Operand,
    kind: PutKind,
    cache: PropertyLookupCacheIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(put_by_id);
    };

    let try_cache = || @cold {
        guard call_interp(asm_try_put_by_id_cache) == 0 else slow;
        dispatch_next;
    };

    guard let Value<Object>(object) = load(base) else try_cache;
    let shape = object.shape;
    guard let property_cache = load_property_lookup_cache(cache) else try_cache;
    guard property_cache.shape == shape else try_cache;
    guard property_cache.prototype == 0 else try_cache;
    guard property_cache.shape_dictionary_generation == shape.dictionary_generation else try_cache;
    # NB: Addition entries have no slot at their offset.
    guard property_cache.writes_data_property != 0 else try_cache;
    guard object.named_properties[property_cache.property_offset] is not Value<Accessor> else try_cache;
    object.named_properties[property_cache.property_offset] = load(src);
    dispatch_next;
}

handler PutByIdWithThis(
    base: Operand,
    this_value: Operand,
    property: PropertyKeyTableIndex,
    src: Operand,
    kind: PutKind,
    cache: PropertyLookupCacheIndex
) @cold = call_slow_path(put_by_id_with_this);

handler GetByValue(
    keyed_feedback: KeyedFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    base: in Operand,
    property: in Operand,
    cache: ProfiledPropertyLookupCacheIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(get_by_value);
    };

    let slow_without_cache = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(get_by_value_uncached);
    };

    # Accesses that saw too many keys for their own cache look up own data properties in the VM's keyed property
    # lookup cache, like the runtime does: the entry is at the top bits of the Fibonacci hash of the shape and the
    # identity of the name, the word of the storage of a fly string.
    let try_vm_keyed_property_lookup_cache = |keyed_object: Object| @cold {
        guard let Value<PrimitiveString>(name_string) = load(property) else slow_without_cache;
        let keyed_name: u64 = alias(name_string.utf16_data);
        let keyed_shape = keyed_object.shape;
        let keyed_shape_bits: u64 = alias(keyed_shape);
        let keyed_mixed = u32(keyed_shape_bits ^ keyed_name);
        let keyed_hash: u32 = keyed_mixed * KEYED_PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_HASH_MULTIPLIER;
        let keyed_index: u64 = alias(keyed_hash >> KEYED_PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_INDEX_SHIFT);
        let keyed_vm = current_vm();
        let keyed_entry_address: u64 = keyed_vm.keyed_property_lookup_cache_entries + (keyed_index << KEYED_PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_ENTRY_SIZE_SHIFT);
        let keyed_entry: KeyedPropertyLookupCacheEntry = alias(keyed_entry_address);
        guard keyed_entry.property_name == keyed_name else slow_without_cache;
        guard keyed_entry.shape == keyed_shape else slow_without_cache;
        guard keyed_entry.entry_type == PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_ENTRY_TYPE_GET_OWN_PROPERTY else slow_without_cache;
        guard keyed_entry.shape_dictionary_generation == keyed_shape.dictionary_generation else slow_without_cache;
        let keyed_value = keyed_object.named_properties[keyed_entry.property_offset];
        guard keyed_value is not Value<Accessor> else slow_without_cache;
        # NB: The runtime recorded multiple keys before the access gave up on its own cache.
        record_keyed_feedback(keyed_feedback, KEYED_FEEDBACK_MULTIPLE_STRING_KEYS);
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, keyed_value);
        store(dst, keyed_value);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let try_cache = || @cold {
        guard call_interp(asm_try_get_by_value_cache) == 0 else slow;
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let try_typed_array_slow = || @cold {
        guard call_interp(asm_try_get_by_value_typed_array) == 0 else slow;
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let key = load(property);
    guard extract_tag(key) == INT32_TAG else {
        # Keys that are not array indices: the property lookup cache remembers the shapes and keys it has
        # seen, and matches string and symbol keys by identity.
        guard let Value<Object>(object) = load(base) else slow;
        let keyed_executable = exec_ctx.executable;
        let tagged_cache: u64 = alias(keyed_executable.property_lookup_caches[load(cache)]);
        guard tagged_cache != PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_KEYED_GENERIC else try_vm_keyed_property_lookup_cache(object);
        guard let property_cache = load_keyed_property_lookup_cache(cache, slow_without_cache) else slow;
        guard property_cache.key is key else try_cache;
        let shape = object.shape;
        guard property_cache.shape == shape else try_cache;
        guard property_cache.entry_type != PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_ENTRY_TYPE_GET_MISSING_PROPERTY else try_cache;
        guard property_cache.shape_dictionary_generation == shape.dictionary_generation else try_cache;
        # Values found in the prototype chain go through try_cache, which checks the chain's validity.
        guard property_cache.prototype == 0 else try_cache;
        let value = object.named_properties[property_cache.property_offset];
        guard value is not Value<Accessor> else slow;
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, value);
        store(dst, value);
        dispatch_next;
    };
    # The code unit of a string at an index, as a string. Only ASCII code units have a string ready.
    let string_index_slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(get_by_value);
    };
    let string_index = || {
        guard let Value<PrimitiveString>(string) = load(base) else slow;
        let signed_index = unbox_i32(key);
        guard signed_index >= 0 else slow;
        let unsigned_index = assume_u32(signed_index);
        guard let code_unit = load_primitive_string_utf16_code_unit(string, unsigned_index, string_index_slow) else slow;
        guard code_unit < 0x80 else slow;
        let signed_code_unit: i32 = alias(code_unit);
        let result: Value = call_helper_with_two_arguments(asm_helper_single_ascii_character_string, current_vm(), signed_code_unit);
        assert(extract_tag(result) == STRING_TAG);
        record_keyed_feedback(keyed_feedback, KEYED_FEEDBACK_PRIMITIVE_BASE);
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, result);
        store(dst, result);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    guard let Value<Object>(object) = load(base) else string_index;
    let index = u32(unbox_i32(key));
    let flags = object.flags;
    if flags lacks OBJECT_FLAG_IS_TYPED_ARRAY {
        branch_bits_set(flags, OBJECT_FLAG_MAY_INTERFERE, slow);
        match object.indexed_storage_kind {
            INDEXED_STORAGE_KIND_PACKED => @hot {
                guard index < object.indexed_array_like_size else slow;
                let indexed_elements = object.indexed_elements;
                assert(indexed_elements != 0);
                # The size above lives on the object while the capacity lives with the buffer, so
                # bound the access by the buffer that is really being addressed.
                guard index < indexed_elements.capacity else slow;
                let value = indexed_elements[index];
                record_keyed_feedback(keyed_feedback, KEYED_FEEDBACK_INT32_INDEX_PACKED);
                record_cache_value_feedback(cache, value);
                store(dst, value);
                dispatch_next;
            },

            INDEXED_STORAGE_KIND_HOLEY => {
                guard index < object.indexed_array_like_size else slow;
                let indexed_elements = object.indexed_elements;
                guard indexed_elements != 0 else slow;
                guard index < indexed_elements.capacity else slow;
                let value = indexed_elements[index];
                guard value is not Value<Empty> else slow;
                record_keyed_feedback(keyed_feedback, KEYED_FEEDBACK_INT32_INDEX_HOLEY);
                record_cache_value_feedback(cache, value);
                store(dst, value);
                dispatch_next;
            },

            _ => slow,
        }
    }

    # FIXME: Refine object to TypedArray once nominal pointer refinements
    #        can alias their source without adding a move on either backend.
    let cached_offset = object.typed_array_cached_data_offset;
    guard cached_offset != TYPED_ARRAY_CACHED_DATA_OFFSET_INVALID else try_typed_array_slow;
    let elements = primitive_storage_cage_base();
    # NB: A negative key wraps to an index below a length of 2^32.
    let signed_index = unbox_i32(key);
    guard signed_index >= 0 else try_typed_array_slow;
    let element_index: u64 = alias(index);
    guard element_index < object.typed_array_array_length else try_typed_array_slow;
    let kind = object.typed_array_kind;
    record_typed_array_keyed_feedback(elements, keyed_feedback, kind);

    let typed_array_f64_as_int = |raw: i32| {
        let produced: Value = box_i32(raw);
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, produced);
        store(dst, produced);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let typed_array_f64_as_double = |slot_f64: f64| {
        let result = canonicalize_nan(slot_f64);
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, result);
        store(dst, result);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    # FIXME: Giving each integer kind its own box-and-dispatch tail removes
    #        one taken branch per load but duplicates about 30 instructions
    #        in this hot handler. Revisit with profile data or cost-aware layout.
    let typed_array_box_int32 = |raw: i32| {
        let produced: Value = box_i32(raw);
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, produced);
        store(dst, produced);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    match kind {
        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT8 | TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT8_CLAMPED => @hot {
            let value = load_caged_u8(elements, cached_offset, index);
            let widened: i32 = alias(value);
            let produced: Value = box_i32(widened);
            record_cache_value_feedback(cache, produced);
            store(dst, produced);
            dispatch_next;
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_INT32 => {
            goto typed_array_box_int32(load_caged_i32(elements, cached_offset, index));
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT16 => {
            goto typed_array_box_int32(alias(load_caged_u16(elements, cached_offset, index)));
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_INT8 => {
            goto typed_array_box_int32(alias(load_caged_i8(elements, cached_offset, index)));
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_INT16 => {
            goto typed_array_box_int32(alias(load_caged_i16(elements, cached_offset, index)));
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_UINT32 => {
            let raw_u32 = load_caged_u32(elements, cached_offset, index);
            let uint32_to_double = || @cold {
                let slot_f64 = u32_to_f64(raw_u32);
                let result = box_f64(slot_f64);
                record_cache_value_feedback(cache, result);
                store(dst, result);
                dispatch_next;
            };
            guard raw_u32 <= INT32_MAX else uint32_to_double;
            goto typed_array_box_int32(assume_i32(raw_u32));
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_FLOAT32 => {
            let value = load_caged_f32(elements, cached_offset, index);
            let slot_f64 = float_to_double(value);
            let slot = box_f64(slot_f64);
            guard slot is not Value<NegativeZero> else typed_array_f64_as_double(slot_f64);
            guard let raw = double_to_int32(slot_f64) else typed_array_f64_as_double(slot_f64);
            goto typed_array_f64_as_int(raw);
        },

        TYPED_ARRAY_KIND_FLOAT64 => {
            let values: Sequence<Value> = alias(
                caged_primitive_storage_address(elements, cached_offset, index, 8)
            );
            let slot = values[0];
            let slot_f64 = unbox_f64(slot);
            guard slot is not Value<NegativeZero> else typed_array_f64_as_double(slot_f64);
            guard let raw = double_to_int32(slot_f64) else typed_array_f64_as_double(slot_f64);
            goto typed_array_f64_as_int(raw);
        },

        _ => try_typed_array_slow,
    }
}

handler GetByValueWithThis(

    dst: out Operand,
    base: Operand,
    property: Operand,
    this_value: Operand
) @cold = call_slow_path(get_by_value_with_this);

    kind: PutKind
) @cold = call_slow_path(put_by_value_with_this);

handler PutBySpread(

handler GetLength(
    keyed_feedback: KeyedFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    base: in Operand,
    cache: ProfiledPropertyLookupCacheIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(get_length);
    };

    let not_object = || {
        record_keyed_feedback(keyed_feedback, KEYED_FEEDBACK_OTHER_ELEMENTS);
        guard let Value<PrimitiveString>(string) = load(base) else slow;
        let length = string.length_in_utf16_code_units;
        guard length <= INT32_MAX else slow;
        let produced: Value = box_i32(assume_i32(length));
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, produced);
        store(dst, produced);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    guard let Value<Object>(object) = load(base) else not_object;
    if object.flags has OBJECT_FLAG_HAS_MAGICAL_LENGTH {
        record_keyed_feedback(keyed_feedback, KEYED_FEEDBACK_MAGICAL_LENGTH);
        let length = object.indexed_array_like_size;
        let length_double = || @cold {
            let produced: Value = box_f64(u32_to_f64(length));
            record_cache_value_feedback(cache, produced);
            store(dst, produced);
            dispatch_next;
        };

        guard length <= INT32_MAX else length_double;
        let produced: Value = box_i32(assume_i32(length));
        record_cache_value_feedback(cache, produced);
        store(dst, produced);
        dispatch_next;
    }

    record_keyed_feedback(keyed_feedback, KEYED_FEEDBACK_OTHER_ELEMENTS);
    let shape = object.shape;
    guard let property_cache = load_property_lookup_cache(cache) else slow;
    guard property_cache.shape == shape else slow;
    guard property_cache.entry_type != PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_ENTRY_TYPE_GET_MISSING_PROPERTY else slow;
    guard property_cache.prototype == 0 else slow;
    guard property_cache.shape_dictionary_generation == shape.dictionary_generation else slow;
    let value = object.named_properties[property_cache.property_offset];
    guard value is not Value<Accessor> else slow;
    record_cache_value_feedback(cache, value);
    store(dst, value);
    dispatch_next;
}

handler GetLengthWithThis(
    dst: out Operand,
    base: Operand,
    this_value: Operand,
    cache: ProfiledPropertyLookupCacheIndex
) @cold = call_slow_path(get_length_with_this);

handler GetMethod(
    dst: out Operand,
    object: Operand,
    property: PropertyKeyTableIndex,
    cache: PropertyLookupCacheIndex
) @cold = call_slow_path(get_method);

handler GetIterator(
    dst_iterator_object: out Operand,
    dst_iterator_next: out Operand,
    dst_iterator_done: out Operand,
    iterable: Operand,
    hint: IteratorHint,
    fast_array_mode_allowed: bool,
    cache: PropertyLookupCacheIndex
) @cold = call_slow_path(get_iterator);

handler GetGlobal(
    value_feedback: ValueFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    identifier: IdentifierTableIndex,
    cache: GlobalVariableCacheIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(get_global);
    };

    let realm_vm = current_vm();
    let realm = realm_vm.current_realm;
    let global_object = realm.global_object;
    let environment = realm.global_declarative_environment;
    let global_cache = load_global_variable_cache(cache);
    guard global_cache.environment_serial_number == environment.serial_number else slow;

    let try_environment = || {
        guard global_cache.has_environment_binding_index != 0 else slow;
        guard let value = load_initialized_binding(
            environment.binding_values,
            global_cache.environment_binding_index
        ) else slow;
        record_value_feedback(value_feedback, value);
        store(dst, value);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let shape = global_object.shape;
    guard global_cache.shape == shape else try_environment;
    guard global_cache.shape_dictionary_generation == shape.dictionary_generation else try_environment;
    let value = global_object.named_properties[global_cache.property_offset];
    guard value is not Value<Accessor> else slow;
    record_value_feedback(value_feedback, value);
    store(dst, value);
    dispatch_next;
}

handler ResolveGlobalBinding(
    dst: out Operand,
    identifier: IdentifierTableIndex,
    cache: GlobalVariableCacheIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(resolve_global_binding);
    };

    # A binding the cache of the SetGlobal or GetGlobal of the identifier still finds exists.
    let realm_vm = current_vm();
    let realm = realm_vm.current_realm;
    let global_object = realm.global_object;
    let environment = realm.global_declarative_environment;
    let global_cache = load_global_variable_cache(cache);
    guard global_cache.environment_serial_number == environment.serial_number else slow;

    let try_environment = || {
        guard global_cache.has_environment_binding_index != 0 else slow;
        store(dst, Value<True>);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let shape = global_object.shape;
    guard global_cache.shape == shape else try_environment;
    guard global_cache.shape_dictionary_generation == shape.dictionary_generation else try_environment;
    store(dst, Value<True>);
    dispatch_next;
}

handler SetGlobal(
    identifier: IdentifierTableIndex,
    src: in Operand,
    cache: GlobalVariableCacheIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(set_global);
    };

    let realm_vm = current_vm();
    let realm = realm_vm.current_realm;
    let global_object = realm.global_object;
    let environment = realm.global_declarative_environment;
    let global_cache = load_global_variable_cache(cache);
    guard global_cache.environment_serial_number == environment.serial_number else slow;

    let try_environment = || {
        guard global_cache.has_environment_binding_index != 0 else slow;
        let binding_index = global_cache.environment_binding_index;
        let binding_values = environment.binding_values;
        guard binding_values[binding_index] is not Value<Empty> else slow;
        guard i32(load_binding_flag(environment, binding_index)) has BINDING_FLAG_MUTABLE else slow;
        binding_values[binding_index] = load(src);
        dispatch_next;
    };

    let shape = global_object.shape;
    guard global_cache.shape == shape else try_environment;
    guard global_cache.shape_dictionary_generation == shape.dictionary_generation else try_environment;
    guard global_object.named_properties[global_cache.property_offset] is not Value<Accessor> else slow;
    guard global_cache.writes_data_property != 0 else slow;
    global_object.named_properties[global_cache.property_offset] = load(src);
    dispatch_next;
}

# The argument count of the call instruction whose argument_count field is
# `argument_count`.
inline fn call_argument_count(
    argument_count: u8
) -> u32 {
    let mut count: u32;
    load8(count, [pb, pc, argument_count]);
    count
}

# Constructs the frame of a call of the ECMAScript function `function`, whose
# executable is `executable_pointer` and asm call metadata `metadata`, and
# enters it.
inline fn enter_ecmascript_function_call(
    function: Object,
    executable_pointer: Executable,
    metadata: u64,
    dst: out Operand,
    this_value: in Operand,
    argument_count: u8,
    argument_operand_indices: Sequence<u8>,
    slow: Label
) {
    let ecmascript_function: ECMAScriptFunctionObject = alias(function);
    let mut receiver: Value = Value<Empty>;
    # NB: A sloppy callee binds it itself (see EnterCoercingThis).
    if metadata has SHARED_FUNCTION_INSTANCE_DATA_ASM_CALL_METADATA_USES_THIS {
        receiver = load(this_value);
    }
    # NB: This form keeps the extra arguments case on the fallthrough path.
    let passed_count = call_argument_count(argument_count);
    let mut formal_count: u32 = u32(metadata);
    if passed_count > formal_count {
        formal_count = passed_count;
    }
    # Construct an interpreter frame for an inline ECMAScript call.
    assert(executable_pointer != 0);
    let registers_and_locals_count = executable_pointer.registers_and_locals_count;
    let callee_slot_count = executable_pointer.registers_and_locals_and_constants_count;
    assert(callee_slot_count >= registers_and_locals_count);
    let maximum_slot_count: u32 = 4294967295;
    let available_argument_slot_count: u32 = maximum_slot_count - callee_slot_count;
    guard available_argument_slot_count >= formal_count else slow;
    let frame_slot_count: u32 = callee_slot_count + formal_count;
    # FIXME: Keep frame size materialization before the VM loads until nested
    #        arithmetic preserves that independent scheduling opportunity.
    let frame_size: u64 = alias(frame_slot_count) * SIZEOF_VALUE + SIZEOF_EXECUTION_CONTEXT;
    let stack_vm = current_vm();
    let frame_base = stack_vm.interpreter_stack_top;
    let stack_limit = stack_vm.interpreter_stack_limit;
    let frame: ExecutionContext = alias(frame_base);
    let frame_end: u64 = frame_base + frame_size;
    assert(frame_end >= frame_base);
    guard frame_end <= stack_limit else slow;
    let stack_update_vm = current_vm();
    stack_update_vm.interpreter_stack_top = frame_end;
    let frame_values = frame.slots;
    frame.slot_count = frame_slot_count;
    frame.argument_count = formal_count;
    frame.passed_argument_count = call_argument_count(argument_count);
    frame.function = function;
    let lexical_environment = ecmascript_function.environment;
    assert(lexical_environment != 0);
    frame.lexical_environment = lexical_environment;
    frame.this_value = receiver;
    frame.executable = executable_pointer;
    let empty_tag: Value = Value<Empty>;
    frame.accumulator = empty_tag;
    frame.exception = empty_tag;
    frame.this_value_register = receiver;
    frame.return_value = empty_tag;
    frame.saved_lexical_environment = empty_tag;
    frame.program_counter = 0;
    # NB: Frames get their id when something first asks (see Vm::frame_id_of()).
    frame.frame_id = 0;
    # NB: Only frames of code that can yield or await have yield fields, and the runtime makes those.
    frame.caller_is_construct = false;
    frame.frame_initialized = false;
    frame.returns_to_native_caller = false;
    frame.runs_jit_code = false;
    frame.caller_is_derived_construct = false;
    let undefined_new_target_3: Value = Value<Undefined>;
    frame.new_target = undefined_new_target_3;
    frame.caller_frame = exec_ctx;
    let [current_pc, return_pc, return_destination] = call_site_info(argument_count, dst);
    # NB: Stack traces show the caller at its program counter.
    exec_ctx.program_counter = current_pc;
    frame.caller_return_pc = return_pc;
    frame.caller_dst_raw = return_destination;
    let actual_argument_count = call_argument_count(argument_count);
    assert(formal_count >= actual_argument_count);
    let mut write_index: u64 = alias(callee_slot_count);
    let caller_values = exec_ctx.slots;
    let mut argument_index: u32 = 0;
    while argument_index < actual_argument_count {
        frame_values[write_index] = caller_values[u32(argument_operand_indices[argument_index])];
        argument_index = argument_index + 1;
        write_index = write_index + 1;
    }
    let fill_end: u64 = write_index + alias(formal_count) - alias(actual_argument_count);
    # FIXME: Keep this value outside the loop until nested constants are
    #        loop-invariant instead of being rematerialized on every iteration.
    let undefined_slot: Value = Value<Undefined>;
    while write_index < fill_end {
        frame_values[write_index] = undefined_slot;
        write_index = write_index + 1;
    }
    # FIXME: Reuse executable_pointer once keeping it live across frame
    #        construction does not exhaust the x86-64 register allocator.
    let direct_executable = frame.executable;
    assert(direct_executable != 0);
    pb = direct_executable.bytecode_data;
    switch_dispatch_table(direct_executable);
    let direct_vm = current_vm();
    direct_vm.running_execution_context = frame;
    exec_ctx = frame;
    values = exec_ctx.slots;
    enter_new_frame(direct_executable);
}

# Calls the raw native function `function`, whose entry in the native function
# table is `native_function_index`, on the lightweight frame of raw native
# functions.
inline fn call_raw_native_function(
    function: Object,
    native_function_index: u32,
    call_feedback: CallFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    this_value: in Operand,
    argument_count: u8,
    argument_operand_indices: Sequence<u8>,
    else slow: Label
) {
    let actual_argument_count = call_argument_count(argument_count);
    let native_frame_size: u64 = alias(actual_argument_count) * SIZEOF_VALUE + SIZEOF_EXECUTION_CONTEXT;
    let native_stack_vm = current_vm();
    let frame_base = native_stack_vm.interpreter_stack_top;
    let native_stack_limit = native_stack_vm.interpreter_stack_limit;
    let native_frame: ExecutionContext = alias(frame_base);
    let native_frame_end: u64 = frame_base + native_frame_size;
    assert(native_frame_end >= frame_base);
    guard native_frame_end <= native_stack_limit else slow;
    let native_limit_vm = current_vm();
    let machine_stack_limit: u64 = native_limit_vm.stack_base + VM_STACK_SPACE_LIMIT;
    assert(machine_stack_limit >= native_limit_vm.stack_base);
    guard machine_stack_limit <= fp else slow;
    let native_stack_update_vm = current_vm();
    native_stack_update_vm.interpreter_stack_top = native_frame_end;
    native_frame.slot_count = actual_argument_count;
    native_frame.argument_count = actual_argument_count;
    native_frame.passed_argument_count = actual_argument_count;
    native_frame.function = function;
    let lexical_environment = exec_ctx.lexical_environment;
    assert(lexical_environment != 0);
    native_frame.lexical_environment = lexical_environment;
    let receiver = load(this_value);
    native_frame.this_value = receiver;
    # Raw native frames deliberately have no executable.
    native_frame.executable = null;
    native_frame.program_counter = 0;
    native_frame.frame_id = 0;
    native_frame.caller_is_construct = false;
    native_frame.frame_initialized = false;
    native_frame.returns_to_native_caller = false;
    native_frame.runs_jit_code = false;
    native_frame.caller_is_derived_construct = false;
    let undefined_new_target_2: Value = Value<Undefined>;
    native_frame.new_target = undefined_new_target_2;
    let [native_pc, after_pc, destination_offset] = call_site_info(argument_count, dst);
    exec_ctx.program_counter = native_pc;
    native_frame.caller_frame = exec_ctx;
    native_frame.caller_return_pc = after_pc;
    native_frame.caller_dst_raw = destination_offset;
    let native_caller_values = exec_ctx.slots;
    let native_frame_values = native_frame.slots;
    let mut argument_index: u32 = 0;
    while argument_index < actual_argument_count {
        native_frame_values[argument_index] = native_caller_values[u32(argument_operand_indices[argument_index])];
        argument_index = argument_index + 1;
    }
    let native_running_vm = current_vm();
    native_running_vm.running_execution_context = native_frame;
    # The function runs in its own realm, which may be another one. The
    # frame keeps the caller's realm, which the return makes current again,
    # as does the runtime when it unwinds the frame of a function that threw.
    native_frame.realm_without_function = native_running_vm.current_realm;
    native_running_vm.current_realm = function.shape.realm;
    exec_ctx = native_frame;
    values = exec_ctx.slots;
    let native_function_entry = &native_running_vm.native_function_table[native_function_index & NATIVE_FUNCTION_TABLE_INDEX_MASK];
    assert(native_function_entry.type < NATIVE_FUNCTION_TYPE_COUNT);
    let native_function = native_function_entry.function;
    # FIXME: Bind native_payload directly once the allocator can keep the
    #        ABI-pinned result live alongside the native result variant.
    let mut [native_return, variant] = call_raw_native(native_function);
    let native_payload = native_return;
    variant = variant & 255;
    assert(variant < 2);
    guard variant == 0 else @cold {
        # FIXME: Pass native_payload directly once the allocator can
        #        satisfy the helper ABI without conflicting with variant.
        let helper_argument = native_payload;
        let exception_pc: i32 = call_helper_with_two_arguments(
            asm_helper_handle_raw_native_exception,
            current_vm(),
            helper_argument
        );
        guard exception_pc >= 0 else @cold {
            exit;
        };
        let exception_vm = current_vm();
        exec_ctx = exception_vm.running_execution_context;
        assert(exec_ctx != 0);
        values = exec_ctx.slots;
        let exception_executable = exec_ctx.executable;
        assert(exception_executable != 0);
        pb = exception_executable.bytecode_data;
        switch_dispatch_table(exception_executable);
        pc = exec_ctx.program_counter;
        goto_handler(pc);
    };
    let caller_frame = exec_ctx.caller_frame;
    assert(caller_frame != 0);
    let return_vm = current_vm();
    return_vm.running_execution_context = caller_frame;
    return_vm.current_realm = exec_ctx.realm_without_function;
    return_vm.interpreter_stack_top = alias(exec_ctx);
    exec_ctx = caller_frame;
    values = exec_ctx.slots;
    store(dst, native_payload);
    record_call_value_feedback(call_feedback, native_payload);
    let length: u32 = call_length(argument_count);
    dispatch_variable(length);
}

# The call cache of a call site of a frame that runs the profiling handlers:
# the function that the site called last, which it calls again with no
# checks. Frames of executables in the plain tier have no call caches, and
# their calls do all the checks.
inline fn call_cache_of_site(slot: CallFeedbackIndex) -> CallCache {
    let call_caches = exec_ctx.executable.call_caches;
    assert(call_caches != 0);
    let index: u32 = load(slot);
    let call_cache: CallCache = alias(call_caches + alias(index) * CALL_CACHE_SIZE);
    call_cache
}

# Calls the function that the site's call cache is linked to, if that is
# `callee`, with no checks.
inline fn call_through_call_cache(
    call_feedback: CallFeedbackIndex,
    callee: in Operand,
    dst: out Operand,
    this_value: in Operand,
    argument_count: u8,
    arguments: Operand[],
    slow: Label
) @profiling {
    let call_cache = call_cache_of_site(call_feedback);
    let callee_value = load(callee);
    let mut callee_bits: u64;
    mov(callee_bits, callee_value);
    if callee_bits == call_cache.callee {
        let function: Object = unbox_object(callee_value);
        let target = call_cache.target;
        if target has CALL_CACHE_TARGET_NATIVE_FUNCTION {
            let native_function_index: u32 = u32(target >> CALL_CACHE_TARGET_INDEX_SHIFT);
            let argument_operand_indices = &arguments;
            call_raw_native_function(function, native_function_index, call_feedback, dst, this_value, argument_count, argument_operand_indices) else slow;
        }
        let mut executable: Executable;
        mov(executable, target);
        let argument_operand_indices = &arguments;
        enter_ecmascript_function_call(function, executable, executable.call_metadata, dst, this_value, argument_count, argument_operand_indices, slow);
    }
}

# Links the site's call cache to `callee`, whose call target is `target`,
# unless the call feedback flags `site_flags` mark the site as polymorphic:
# relinking there would cost every call a store.
inline fn link_call_cache(call_feedback: CallFeedbackIndex, callee: in Operand, target: u64, site_flags: i32) @profiling {
    if site_flags lacks CALL_FEEDBACK_POLYMORPHIC {
        let call_cache = call_cache_of_site(call_feedback);
        let mut callee_bits: u64;
        mov(callee_bits, load(callee));
        call_cache.target = target;
        call_cache.callee = callee_bits;
    }
}

handler Call(
    call_feedback: CallFeedbackIndex,
    dst: out Operand,
    callee: in Operand,
    this_value: in Operand,
    argument_count: u8,
    arguments: Operand[]
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(asm_slow_path_call);
    };

    call_through_call_cache(call_feedback, callee, dst, this_value, argument_count, arguments, slow);

    guard let Value<Object>(function) = load(callee) else slow;
    let flags = function.flags;
    guard flags has OBJECT_FLAG_IS_FUNCTION else slow;
    let mut call_site_flags: i32 = 0;
    record_call_target(call_feedback, function, call_site_flags);
    guard flags has OBJECT_FLAG_IS_ECMASCRIPT_FUNCTION_OBJECT else invoke_try_native;
    let ecmascript_function: ECMAScriptFunctionObject = alias(function);
    let shared_data = ecmascript_function.shared_data;
    let executable_pointer = shared_data.executable;
    let metadata = shared_data.asm_call_metadata;
    guard metadata has SHARED_FUNCTION_INSTANCE_DATA_ASM_CALL_METADATA_CAN_INLINE_CALL else slow;
    guard metadata lacks SHARED_FUNCTION_INSTANCE_DATA_ASM_CALL_METADATA_NEEDS_ENVIRONMENT_OR_THIS_VALUE_RESOLUTION else invoke_interp_inline;
    # NB: A call of an ECMAScript function of another realm is the runtime's,
    #     which changes the current realm. A site's call cache is never linked
    #     to such a callee.
    let callee_realm = function.shape.realm;
    let realm_vm = current_vm();
    guard callee_realm == realm_vm.current_realm else slow;
    link_call_cache(call_feedback, callee, alias(executable_pointer), call_site_flags);
    let argument_operand_indices = &arguments;
    enter_ecmascript_function_call(function, executable_pointer, metadata, dst, this_value, argument_count, argument_operand_indices, slow);
    let invoke_interp_inline = || {
        # Let the interpreter resolve the cases that cannot use the direct
        # frame construction above, then enter the resolved callee.
        guard call_interp(asm_try_inline_call) == 0 else slow;
        let inline_vm = current_vm();
        exec_ctx = inline_vm.running_execution_context;
        assert(exec_ctx != 0);
        values = exec_ctx.slots;
        let inline_executable = exec_ctx.executable;
        assert(inline_executable != 0);
        pb = inline_executable.bytecode_data;
        switch_dispatch_table(inline_executable);
        enter_new_frame(inline_executable);
    };
    let invoke_try_native = || {
        # Construct the lightweight frame used by raw native functions.
        let flags = function.flags;
        guard flags has OBJECT_FLAG_IS_RAW_NATIVE_FUNCTION else slow;
        let raw_native_function: RawNativeFunction = alias(function);
        let native_function_index = raw_native_function.native_function_index;
        let native_target: u64 = (alias(native_function_index) << CALL_CACHE_TARGET_INDEX_SHIFT) | CALL_CACHE_TARGET_NATIVE_FUNCTION;
        link_call_cache(call_feedback, callee, native_target, call_site_flags);
        let argument_operand_indices = &arguments;
        call_raw_native_function(function, native_function_index, call_feedback, dst, this_value, argument_count, argument_operand_indices) else slow;
    };
}

handler GetObjectPropertyIterator(
    dst_keys: out Operand,
    dst_receiver: out Operand,
    object: Operand,
    cache: ObjectPropertyIteratorCacheIndex
) @cold = call_slow_path(get_object_property_iterator);

handler ObjectPropertyIteratorNext(
    dst_value: out Operand,
    dst_done: out Operand,
    receiver: in Operand,
    keys: in Operand,
    cursor: inout Operand
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(object_property_iterator_next);
    };

    # The receiver is the object being enumerated, the keys cell is the flattened
    # key snapshot for this bytecode site, and the cursor is a plain integer index
    # into that snapshot. None of this state lives in a script-visible object.
    guard let Value<Object>(receiver_value) = load(receiver) else slow;
    let receiver_object: Object = alias(receiver_value);

    let keys_value = load(keys);
    assert(extract_tag(keys_value) == IS_CELL_PATTERN);
    let cache: ObjectPropertyIteratorCacheData = unbox_object(keys_value);

    let fast_path = cache.fast_path;
    guard fast_path != OBJECT_PROPERTY_ITERATOR_FAST_PATH_NONE else slow;

    let cached_shape = cache.shape;
    assert(cached_shape != 0);
    let current_shape = receiver_object.shape;
    guard current_shape == cached_shape else slow;

    if cache.shape_is_dictionary {
        guard current_shape.dictionary_generation == cache.shape_dictionary_generation else slow;
    }

    if fast_path == OBJECT_PROPERTY_ITERATOR_FAST_PATH_PACKED_INDEXED {
        guard receiver_object.indexed_storage_kind == INDEXED_STORAGE_KIND_PACKED else slow;
        guard receiver_object.indexed_array_like_size == cache.indexed_property_count else slow;
    }

    let validity = cache.prototype_chain_validity;
    if validity != 0 {
        guard validity.valid else slow;
    }

    # The cursor is a Number. It stays an int32 while it fits, which is the only case this fast path
    # handles; the slow path widens it to a double once it no longer fits, so a snapshot larger than
    # the int32 range still enumerates to the end.
    guard let Value<i32>(cursor_index) = load(cursor) else slow;
    guard cursor_index >= 0 else slow;
    guard let next_cursor_index = checked_add(cursor_index, 1) else slow;
    let cursor_wide: i64 = i64(cursor_index);
    let unsigned_cursor: u64 = alias(cursor_wide);
    let property_value_count: u64 = alias(cache.property_value_count);
    if unsigned_cursor < property_value_count {
        let property_values = cache.property_values;
        assert(property_values != 0);
        store(dst_value, property_values[unsigned_cursor]);
        store(cursor, box_i32(next_cursor_index));
        store(dst_done, Value<False>);
        dispatch_next;
    }

    store(dst_done, Value<True>);
    dispatch_next;
}

handler IteratorClose(
    iterator_object: Operand,
    iterator_next: Operand,
    iterator_done: Operand,
    completion_type: Completion::Type,
    completion_value: Operand,
    cache: PropertyLookupCacheIndex
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(iterator_close);
    };

    # An iterator without a return method closes without doing anything, for every completion type: the
    # instruction that follows a close for a throw completion throws it again.

    # In fast array mode, the iterator register holds a number. A watchpoint set of the realm tells if array
    # iterators have a return method.
    if extract_tag(load(iterator_object)) == INT32_TAG {
        let watchpoint_vm = current_vm();
        let return_watchpoint_set = watchpoint_vm.current_realm.array_iterator_return_watchpoint_set;
        guard return_watchpoint_set != 0 else slow;
        guard return_watchpoint_set.valid else slow;
        dispatch_next;
    }

    # Other iterators: the cache of the site tells if the method is missing.
    let executable = exec_ctx.executable;
    let caches: u64 = alias(executable.property_lookup_caches);
    let cache_index: u64 = alias(load(cache));
    let cache_pointer = caches + cache_index * PROPERTY_LOOKUP_CACHE_SIZE;
    let return_method: Value = call_helper_with_two_arguments(asm_try_get_by_id_cache, load(iterator_object), cache_pointer);
    guard return_method is Value<Nullish> else slow;
    dispatch_next;
}

handler IteratorNext(
    dst: out Operand,
    iterator_object: Operand,
    iterator_next: Operand,
    iterator_done: inout Operand
) @cold = call_slow_path(asm_slow_path_iterator_next);

# IteratorStep, which unlike IteratorNextUnpack does not read the value of the result.
handler IteratorStep(
    dst_done: out Operand,
    iterator_object: inout Operand,
    iterator_next: Operand,
    iterator_done: inout Operand
) @cold = call_slow_path(asm_slow_path_iterator_step);

handler IteratorNextUnpack(
    dst_value: out Operand,
    dst_done: out Operand,
    iterator_object: inout Operand,
    iterator_next: Operand,
    iterator_done: inout Operand
) {
    let slow = || @cold {
        call_slow_path(iterator_next_unpack);
    };

    # In fast array mode, the iterator register holds the index of the next element as a number, and the next
    # register holds the array (see get_iterator() in the runtime). Holes, iterations that are done and all other
    # iterators take the slow path.
    guard let Value<i32>(index) = load(iterator_object) else slow;
    guard index >= 0 else slow;
    # NB: The done register holds a boolean.
    let iteration_done = load(iterator_done);
    branch_bits_set(iteration_done, 1, slow);
    guard let Value<Object>(array) = load(iterator_next) else slow;
    let flags = array.flags;
    guard flags has OBJECT_FLAG_HAS_MAGICAL_LENGTH else slow;
    guard flags lacks OBJECT_FLAG_MAY_INTERFERE else slow;
    let unsigned_index = assume_u32(index);

    # The array iterator reads the length of the array at each step. After the last element, the done register
    # keeps the iteration done, also if the array grows.
    if unsigned_index >= array.indexed_array_like_size {
        store(dst_value, Value<Undefined>);
        store(dst_done, Value<True>);
        store(iterator_done, Value<True>);
        dispatch_next;
    }

    let next_element = || {
        let indexed_elements = array.indexed_elements;
        guard indexed_elements != 0 else slow;
        guard unsigned_index < indexed_elements.capacity else slow;
        let value = indexed_elements[unsigned_index];
        guard value is not Value<Empty> else slow;
        guard let next_index = checked_add(index, 1) else slow;
        store(dst_value, value);
        store(dst_done, Value<False>);
        store(iterator_object, box_i32(next_index));
        dispatch_next;
    };

    match array.indexed_storage_kind {
        INDEXED_STORAGE_KIND_PACKED => next_element,
        INDEXED_STORAGE_KIND_HOLEY => next_element,
        _ => slow,
    }
}

# The LibJS optimizing JIT

This document describes how the optimizing JIT works. It is a living document: every change to the
compiler's structure updates it, and the code reads like it. Where it and the code disagree, one of
them has a bug.

The compiler is the `libjs_jit` crate (`Libraries/LibJS/JIT/Rust`). Its runtime side, which takes
snapshots, installs code, enters it and translates its state back into interpreter frames, is in
`Libraries/LibJS/Rust/src/jit`.

## 1. Overview

LibJS has two tiers: the bytecode interpreter, whose instructions keep per-site caches and
feedback, and this optimizing JIT. An executable that uses up its tier-up budget (calls and loop
iterations) is snapshotted and compiled on one of the compile threads. The interpreter keeps running
it meanwhile; the main thread installs the code when the job finishes. Loops that run long enough
enter compiled code at their back edges (on-stack replacement), generators and async functions
enter it where they resume (section 4.1), and exception handlers after their `Catch` (section 4.2). A call from compiled code into a function the interpreter
runs counts as several invocations of it (`callee-boost`): code hot enough to be compiled calls it,
so it is likely to be hot as well, and there is no baseline tier to run it in meanwhile.

There is no baseline tier. The interpreter's caches are the baseline: the JIT translates what they
saw into speculation, and leaves to the interpreter wherever a speculation fails.

## 2. Phases

| Phase | Where | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Snapshot | `jit/snapshot.rs`, `snapshot.rs` | Captures the executable, its inlining candidates, their caches and feedback, and frame layouts as plain data. The compiler never sees the heap. |
| Graph building | `builder/` | One forward walk over the bytecode in reverse post order builds SSA IR, translating caches and feedback into checks and typed nodes, inlining calls, and attaching frame states. It folds only locally, like a check of a value it knows or the unboxing of a box it just made. |
| Passes | `passes/` | Simplify the graph, one transformation per pass (section 6). The verifier checks the graph after building and after every pass. |
| Register allocation | `regalloc/` | One forward walk over the blocks in linear order, driven by the constraints each node declares. Its own verifier simulates every location. |
| Code generation | `codegen/` | Lowers each node onto a `PortableMacroAssembler`, emits sites (section 4) and the stubs that reach the runtime. |
| Install | `jit/tier_up.rs`, `jit/code.rs`, `jit/dependencies.rs` | Installs the code if every dependency still holds (section 5). |
| Run | `jit/entry_exit.rs`, `jit/translate.rs`, `jit/calls.rs` | Enters the code; leaves it at exits, leaves and calls through the translator. |

## 3. The IR

A `Graph` is a list of blocks in linear order. Every block has phis, a body of nodes and exactly
one control node. Nodes live in one arena and are named by `NodeId`. Constants belong to no block
and are rematerialized at every use. Every value has a representation (`Repr`): tagged, int32,
float64, bool or pointer. Cold blocks hold code that rarely runs (slow paths of checks); they come last
in the final block order.

Blocks without predecessors are entries: block 0, the on-stack replacement entries, the resume
entries of generators (section 4.1) and the catch entries of exception handlers (section 4.2). Every
block is reachable from one.

The compiled function's slots are SSA values. The builder tracks, per slot (the reserved registers
included), which value holds it and whether frame memory holds that value too. Values come from
frame memory (`LoadSlot`) where the code starts using it: every slot live at an entry, and the slots
a node that writes the frame wrote, right after it. Merges and loop headers never write frame
memory: a slot the paths disagree on (or a loop assigns) gets a phi, except that a slot every path
loaded, and memory still holds, is loaded again at the merge (loop invariant code motion takes such
loads out of loops, those of `Graph::unwritten_slots` even out of loops that call). The arguments and the `this` value register that no instruction writes keep
the values the function started with (`Graph::unwritten_slots`), and nothing stores to them, so the
values loaded from them need no spill slots (section 7). Frame memory is written
only where something reads it: before calls that read the frame and before `Suspend` (`StoreSlot`),
where the compiled function assigns an argument that its legacy `arguments` shows (which any code it
calls can read), and by exits and leaves through the translator.

### 3.1 Effects

`Op::info()` (`ir/info.rs`) decides, for every op in one exhaustive match, its effects
(`NodeProperties`), its exit kind, the input it refines (section 3.2), whether it ends a block, and
the inputs it takes (`Inputs`: how many, of which representations), which the verifier checks every
node against. Every pass decides what it may do with a node from its effects alone:

- **Exits.** `Op::can_eager_exit()`, whether the op has an exit kind (`Op::exit_kind()`): may exit
  before its side effects, resuming at the current bytecode (needs the eager frame state).
  `can_lazy_exit`: may need to exit after it returns, resuming after the current bytecode.
- **Call.** `is_call`: calls out of compiled code and clobbers every caller-saved register. That
  is no effect: a call without any of the other effects only computes its value, and passes treat
  it like any other node that does.
- **Memory.** `reads` and `writes`: sets of abstract locations (`ir::Locations`): `FRAME`,
  `NAMED_SLOTS` (property values), `SHAPES` (shapes and prototypes), `ELEMENTS` (element values),
  `ELEMENT_COUNTS` (element storage kind, length, capacity and the storage offset of typed arrays), `GLOBAL_BINDINGS` and `BINDINGS` (the
  bindings of declarative environments), `ITERATORS` (the state of iterators), `COLLECTIONS` (the
  entries of Map, Set, WeakMap and WeakSet objects), and `INTERRUPT`, which only `CheckInterrupt`
  writes, so that loop invariant code motion leaves it in its loop and nothing else cares. Passes ask
  one question: whether one node's writes intersect another's reads. `runs_code`: may run other
  code, which may write anything, or invalidate the compiled code. The op table below names the
  locations coarsely (Named for slots and shapes, Elements for values and counts, Any for all);
  `Op::info()` has the exact sets.
- **Allocation.** `allocates`: may allocate, so may run the garbage collector.

Global value numbering shares nodes without effects that read no memory; check elimination reuses
loads.

Equality feedback records comparisons of two objects separately from other non-numeric operands.
Loose equality that only saw pairs of objects checks both operands with `CheckObject` and compares
their identities with `TaggedEquals`. A non-object operand exits before any coercion. Strict
equality also treats this feedback as identity comparable.

`GetLength` records whether its receivers have an array's magical length property in a keyed
feedback slot. A site that only saw arrays uses `CheckArray`, `LoadElementsLength` and
`CheckNonNegativeInt32`, exiting for other receivers or unsigned lengths above `i32::MAX`.
Removing the fallback call lets pure scans hoist the length and other invariant loads.
Loop-entry frame states include inlined callees and their caller chains, so hoisted checks
can resume inside the callee. Speculation gates identify the executable as well as its pc.

### 3.2 Refinements

A node that relies on a check takes the check's value as its input, never the checked value
itself. Checks that exit (`CheckObject`, `CheckShape`, `CheckValue`, `CheckClosure`,
`CheckAccessorFunction`, `CheckElements`, `CheckTypedArray`, `CheckArray`,
`CheckNonNegativeInt32`, `CheckIdentityComparable`, `CheckAppendableArray`, `CheckBounds`,
`CheckTypedArrayStorage`, `CheckNotHole`, `CheckInitialized`) have their input 0 as their value,
refined: known to pass. `CheckInt32` refines and unboxes at once. A branch refines on its edges
with `Refine`, the textbook pi node: it takes the branch's inputs and returns input 0, at the
head of the block that only that edge reaches. So every check is a data dependency of what relies
on it: passes move or share a load exactly when they can move or share its check, without control
dependencies and without pinning loads by making them read everything.

Passes see through refinements where that is sound: check elimination keeps its facts about the
unrefined value, and leaves the uses of a check it removes on the value the check refined.
Global value numbering does not look through them, since a node shared with another of a weaker
refinement would lose its dependency. After the last optimization pass, every use of a refined
value becomes a use of the value itself (`edit::remove_refinements()`): `Refine` nodes go away,
checks lose their values, and a final round of value numbering merges the nodes that differed only
in their refinements. Register allocation and code generation never see a refinement.

### 3.3 Op reference

Exits: E = eager, L = lazy. Every node that can exit has a frame state. "Call" means `is_call`.
`cse` marks ops two of which with the same inputs compute the same value.
