//! Probes of the interpreter's property lookup caches, like its `GetById`
//! and `PutById` handlers do them: the most recently used cache entry (and
//! the entries of polymorphic and megamorphic caches) inline, the other
//! entries out of line by the runtime's cache probe.

use super::super::Codegen;
use super::super::RegisterList;
use super::super::checked_i32;
use super::super::slow_path_calls::slow_path_saved_registers;
use super::keyed::KeyName;
use super::megamorphic::MegamorphicKey;
use crate::CompileFailure;
use crate::asm::Address;
use crate::asm::Condition;
use crate::asm::Gpr;
use crate::asm::Label;
use crate::asm::PortableMacroAssembler;
use crate::asm::Scale;
use crate::ir::NodeId;
use crate::ir::value;
use crate::regalloc::Location;
use crate::snapshot::PropertyCacheKind;

/// A probe of all entries of a property lookup cache by the runtime.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(in crate::codegen) enum CacheProbe {
    GetById {
        cache: u32,
    },
    PutById,
    /// The runtime's `hasOwnProperty` (if `own`) or `in` helper, which
    /// takes the object in input 0 and the key in input 1.
    HasProperty {
        own: bool,
    },
}

/// A runtime probe of a cache probe node, out of line: from `entry`, it
/// continues at `hit` if the runtime's probe did what the node does, and at
/// `miss` otherwise.
pub(in crate::codegen) struct DeferredCacheProbe {
    pub(in crate::codegen) node: NodeId,
    pub(in crate::codegen) executable: u32,
    pub(in crate::codegen) probe: CacheProbe,
    pub(in crate::codegen) entry: Label,
    pub(in crate::codegen) hit: Label,
    pub(in crate::codegen) miss: Label,
}

/// A probe of the VM's keyed caches for a megamorphic named access, out of
/// line: the hit path of the access's own cache stays as short as without
/// it. It starts at `entry`, where the access's own cache had no entry.
pub(in crate::codegen) struct DeferredVmCacheProbe {
    pub(in crate::codegen) node: NodeId,
    pub(in crate::codegen) entry: Label,
    pub(in crate::codegen) probe: VmCacheProbe,
}

/// What a `DeferredVmCacheProbe` does with its arguments, which are those of
/// `emit_vm_named_cache_get()` (and for its lessons, the cache of the get) for
/// gets and of `emit_keyed_store_cache_put()` for puts.
pub(in crate::codegen) enum VmCacheProbe {
    Get {
        executable: u32,
        cache: u32,
        name: u64,
        output: Gpr,
        done: Label,
        miss: Label,
        fail: Label,
    },
    Put {
        base: Gpr,
        name: u64,
        source: Gpr,
        storage: Gpr,
        miss: Label,
        stored: Label,
    },
}

/// The bytes of the record the `PutById` cache probe takes: the base and
/// the value.
pub(in crate::codegen) const PUT_BY_ID_RECORD_BYTES: u32 = 16;

/// The registers of a cache fast path.
pub(in crate::codegen) struct CacheRegisters {
    pub(in crate::codegen) object: Gpr,
    pub(in crate::codegen) shape: Gpr,
    pub(in crate::codegen) entry: Gpr,
}

/// The offsets in a cache entry of the parts of an addition (see
/// `Codegen::emit_add_own_property()`).
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) struct AdditionEntryFields {
    pub entry_type: i32,
    pub prototype_chain_validity: i32,
    pub new_shape: i32,
    pub property_offset: i32,
}

impl<M: PortableMacroAssembler> Codegen<'_, '_, M> {
    fn cache_registers(&self, node: NodeId) -> CacheRegisters {
        CacheRegisters {
            object: self.temp(node, 0),
            shape: self.temp(node, 1),
            entry: self.temp(node, 2),
        }
    }

    /// Puts the address of property lookup cache `cache_index` of
    /// executable `executable` (an index into `Snapshot::executables`) in
    /// `dst`. The compiled function's is the running frame's; inlined
    /// callees' are constants.
    pub(super) fn property_cache_address(
        &mut self,
        dst: Gpr,
        executable: u32,
        cache_index: u32,
    ) -> Result<(), CompileFailure> {
        if executable == 0 {
            let running = self.frame_field(self.runtime.offsets.execution_context_executable);
            self.masm.load64(dst, &running);
        } else {
            self.masm
                .move_imm64(dst, self.snapshot.executables[executable as usize].cell.0);
        }
        self.masm.load64(
            dst,
            &Address::new(dst, self.runtime.layout.executable_property_lookup_caches as i32),
        );
        if cache_index != 0 {
            self.masm
                .add64_imm(dst, dst, i64::from(checked_i32(8 * u64::from(cache_index))?));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Loads the shape of the object in `registers.object` and the entry of
    /// property lookup cache `cache_index` for that shape into the entry
    /// register: the most recently used entry, or another entry of a
    /// polymorphic or megamorphic cache. Branches to `miss` unless there is
    /// one for the shape and its dictionary generation. Leaves the shape
    /// register free. Caches that
    /// were megamorphic when the snapshot was taken look in their hash
    /// tables first.
    fn probe_cache_entry(
        &mut self,
        registers: &CacheRegisters,
        executable: u32,
        cache_index: u32,
        miss: Label,
    ) -> Result<(), CompileFailure> {
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
        let CacheRegisters { object, shape, entry } = *registers;
        let found = self.masm.new_label();
        self.emit_load_compressed_cell(shape, &Address::new(object, self.runtime.offsets.object_shape as i32));
        self.property_cache_address(entry, executable, cache_index)?;
        self.masm.load64(entry, &Address::new(entry, 0));
        let was_megamorphic = self.snapshot[self.snapshot.executables[executable as usize].property_caches]
            .get(cache_index as usize)
            .is_some_and(|cache| cache.kind == PropertyCacheKind::Megamorphic);
        if was_megamorphic {
            // NB: The most recently used entry is also in the tables.
            let not_megamorphic = self.masm.new_label();
            self.masm.move64(scratch, entry);
            self.masm
                .and64_imm(scratch, scratch, !layout.property_lookup_cache_data_pointer_mask);
            self.masm.branch64_imm(
                Condition::NotEqual,
                scratch,
                layout.property_lookup_cache_megamorphic_tag as i64,
                not_megamorphic,
            );
            self.masm
                .and64_imm(entry, entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_data_pointer_mask);
            self.emit_megamorphic_cache_lookup(shape, entry, MegamorphicKey::Named, found, miss);
            self.masm.bind(not_megamorphic);
        }
        self.masm.branch_test64(Condition::Zero, entry, u64::MAX, miss);
        self.masm.move64(scratch, entry);
        self.masm
            .and64_imm(entry, entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_data_pointer_mask);
        self.branch_if_entry_shape(entry, shape, found);
        // The other entries of a polymorphic cache follow the most recently used one.
        self.masm
            .and64_imm(scratch, scratch, !layout.property_lookup_cache_data_pointer_mask);
        let not_polymorphic = self.masm.new_label();
        self.masm.branch64_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            scratch,
            layout.property_lookup_cache_polymorphic_tag as i64,
            not_polymorphic,
        );
        for _ in 1..layout.property_lookup_cache_polymorphic_entry_count {
            self.masm
                .add64_imm(entry, entry, i64::from(layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_size));
            self.branch_if_entry_shape(entry, shape, found);
        }
        self.masm.jump(miss);
        // Megamorphic caches keep the other shapes' entries in hash tables.
        self.masm.bind(not_polymorphic);
        self.masm.branch64_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            scratch,
            layout.property_lookup_cache_megamorphic_tag as i64,
            miss,
        );
        self.emit_megamorphic_cache_lookup(shape, entry, MegamorphicKey::Named, found, miss);
        self.masm.bind(found);
        self.branch_unless_dictionary_generation_matches(shape, entry, miss);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Branches to `miss` unless the dictionary generation of the shape in
    /// `shape` is the cache entry's. Clobbers `shape`.
    fn branch_unless_dictionary_generation_matches(&mut self, shape: Gpr, entry: Gpr, miss: Label) {
        let expected = Address::new(
            entry,
            self.runtime.layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_dictionary_generation as i32,
        );
        self.branch_unless_dictionary_generation_is(shape, expected, [shape, self.pinned.scratch], miss);
    }

    /// The address of the named property of `holder` the cache entry is for.
    /// Uses the shape register and the scratch register.
    fn cached_property_address(&mut self, registers: &CacheRegisters, holder: Gpr) -> Address {
        let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        self.masm.load32(
            scratch,
            &Address::new(
                registers.entry,
                layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_property_offset as i32,
            ),
        );
        self.masm.load64(
            registers.shape,
            &Address::new(holder, self.runtime.offsets.object_named_properties as i32),
        );
        Address::indexed(registers.shape, scratch, Scale::Eight, 0)
    }

    /// Branches to `miss` unless a `GetMissingProperty` entry for the shape
    /// of `object`, whose prototype chain validity is at `validity`, applies
    /// to it, like `get_with_property_lookup_cache()`: the object must have
    /// no other properties than those of its shape (see
    /// `branch_unless_cacheable_for_property_absence()`), and the property
    /// must also be missing from an unchanged prototype chain. Clobbers
    /// `shape` and the scratch register.
    pub(super) fn branch_unless_property_absence_applies(
        &mut self,
        object: Gpr,
        shape: Gpr,
        validity: &Address,
        miss: Label,
    ) {
        self.branch_unless_cacheable_for_property_absence(object, shape, miss);
        let offsets = self.runtime.offsets;
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        let (has_chain, done) = (self.masm.new_label(), self.masm.new_label());
        self.masm.load64(shape, validity);
        self.masm.branch_test64(Condition::NonZero, shape, u64::MAX, has_chain);
        // Entries without a prototype chain validity are for shapes without
        // a prototype.
        self.emit_load_compressed_cell(shape, &Address::new(object, offsets.object_shape as i32));
        self.masm.branch32_memory_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            &Address::new(shape, layout.shape_prototype as i32),
            0,
            miss,
        );
        self.masm.jump(done);
        self.masm.bind(has_chain);
        self.branch_unless_prototype_chain_valid(shape, miss);
        self.masm.bind(done);
    }

    /// Branches to `miss` unless the object `object` has no other properties
    /// than those of its shape, for the names `GetMissingProperty` entries
    /// can be for: only objects whose class has
    /// `ObjectMethods::is_cacheable_for_property_absence` set do. Plain
    /// objects, ECMAScript functions, arrays and String objects are told
    /// apart without loading it. Clobbers `class` and the scratch register.
    pub(in crate::codegen) fn branch_unless_cacheable_for_property_absence(
        &mut self,
        object: Gpr,
        class: Gpr,
        miss: Label,
    ) {
        let shape = class;
        let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        let offsets = self.runtime.offsets;
        if layout.object_class == 0 {
            self.masm.jump(miss);
            return;
        }
        let cacheable = self.masm.new_label();
        self.emit_load_class(shape, object);
        for class in [
            layout.object_class,
            layout.string_object_class,
            layout.string_prototype_class,
        ] {
            self.masm.move_imm64(scratch, class);
            self.masm.branch64(Condition::Equal, shape, scratch, cacheable);
        }
        let flags =
            self.runtime.dynamic_calls.object_flag_is_ecmascript_function | layout.object_flag_has_magical_length;
        if flags != 0 {
            self.masm
                .load16(scratch, &Address::new(object, offsets.object_flags as i32));
            self.masm
                .branch_test32(Condition::NonZero, scratch, u32::from(flags), cacheable);
        }
        if layout.object_methods_is_cacheable_for_property_absence == 0 || layout.class_object_methods == 0 {
            self.masm.jump(miss);
        } else {
            self.masm
                .load64(shape, &Address::new(shape, layout.class_object_methods as i32));
            self.masm.load8(
                scratch,
                &Address::new(shape, layout.object_methods_is_cacheable_for_property_absence as i32),
            );
            self.masm.branch_test32(Condition::Zero, scratch, 0xff, miss);
        }
        self.masm.bind(cacheable);
    }

    /// A `ProbePropertyCache` node: the data property, or `undefined` for a
    /// missing property, that the entry of the cache for the shape of the
    /// object (or for strings, numbers and booleans, of their prototype)
    /// has, like the interpreter's `GetById` handler finds it. The runtime
    /// probes the entries out of line where the inline probe finds none.
    pub(in crate::codegen) fn emit_probe_property_cache(
        &mut self,
        node: NodeId,
        executable: u32,
        cache_index: u32,
        property: u32,
    ) -> Result<(), CompileFailure> {
        let output = self.output(node);
        let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        let registers = self.cache_registers(node);
        let CacheRegisters { object, shape, entry } = registers;
        let (failure, done) = (self.probe_failure_label(), self.masm.new_label());
        let fail = failure.0;
        let probe = self.masm.new_label();
        self.deferred_cache_probes.push(DeferredCacheProbe {
            node,
            executable,
            probe: CacheProbe::GetById { cache: cache_index },
            entry: probe,
            hit: done,
            miss: fail,
        });

        let base = self.input(node, 0);
        self.masm.shr64_imm(scratch, base, value::TAG_SHIFT);
        let snapshot = &self.snapshot.executables[executable as usize];
        let prototypes = [
            (value::STRING_TAG, snapshot.string_prototype),
            (value::INT32_TAG, snapshot.number_prototype),
            (value::BOOLEAN_TAG, snapshot.boolean_prototype),
        ]
        .map(|(tag, prototype)| Some((tag, prototype?, self.masm.new_label())));
        let (is_object, have_object) = (self.masm.new_label(), self.masm.new_label());
        self.masm
            .branch32_imm(Condition::Equal, scratch, i32::from(value::OBJECT_TAG), is_object);
        for (tag, _, label) in prototypes.iter().flatten() {
            self.masm
                .branch32_imm(Condition::Equal, scratch, i32::from(*tag), *label);
        }
        // Doubles are numbers too.
        if let Some((_, _, number)) = prototypes.iter().flatten().find(|(tag, ..)| *tag == value::INT32_TAG) {
            self.masm.and32_imm(scratch, scratch, u32::from(value::BASE_TAG));
            self.masm
                .branch32_imm(Condition::NotEqual, scratch, i32::from(value::BASE_TAG), *number);
        }
        self.masm.jump(fail);
        for (_, prototype, label) in prototypes.into_iter().flatten() {
            self.masm.bind(label);
            self.masm.move_imm64(object, prototype.0);
            self.masm.jump(have_object);
        }
        self.masm.bind(is_object);
        self.emit_unbox_cell(object, base);
        self.masm.bind(have_object);
        // NB: The runtime also fills the VM's keyed lookup cache for the names of megamorphic caches (see
        //     `get_with_property_lookup_cache()`).
        let vm_cache_name = self.megamorphic_cache_name(executable, cache_index, property);
        let vm_cache = vm_cache_name.map(|_| self.masm.new_label());
        self.probe_cache_entry(&registers, executable, cache_index, vm_cache.unwrap_or(probe))?;
        let present = self.masm.new_label();
        self.masm.branch32_memory_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type as i32),
            layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type_get_missing_property as i32,
            present,
        );
        let validity = Address::new(
            entry,
            layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_prototype_chain_validity as i32,
        );
        self.branch_unless_property_absence_applies(object, shape, &validity, probe);
        self.masm.move_imm64(output, value::UNDEFINED);
        self.masm.jump(done);

        // Properties found in a prototype need its chain to be unchanged.
        self.masm.bind(present);
        let own = self.masm.new_label();
        self.masm.load64(
            scratch,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_prototype as i32),
        );
        self.masm.branch_test64(Condition::Zero, scratch, u64::MAX, own);
        self.masm.load64(
            shape,
            &Address::new(
                entry,
                layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_prototype_chain_validity as i32,
            ),
        );
        self.masm.branch_test64(Condition::Zero, shape, u64::MAX, probe);
        self.branch_unless_prototype_chain_valid(shape, probe);
        self.masm.move64(object, scratch);
        self.masm.bind(own);

        // NB: Accessors take the slow path, which calls them.
        let property = self.cached_property_address(&registers, object);
        self.masm.load64(entry, &property);
        self.branch_on_tag(Condition::Equal, entry, value::ACCESSOR_TAG, self.pinned.scratch, fail);
        self.masm.move64(output, entry);
        if let (Some(name), Some(vm_cache)) = (vm_cache_name, vm_cache) {
            self.deferred_vm_cache_probes.push(DeferredVmCacheProbe {
                node,
                entry: vm_cache,
                probe: VmCacheProbe::Get {
                    executable,
                    cache: cache_index,
                    name,
                    output,
                    done,
                    miss: probe,
                    fail,
                },
            });
        }
        self.bind_probe_failure(output, value::EMPTY, failure, done);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// The identity of the name at index `property` of the property key
    /// table of `executable` (see `Op::ProbePropertyCache`), if property
    /// lookup cache `cache_index` was megamorphic: such caches see more
    /// shapes than their hash tables hold, so their accesses also look in
    /// the VM's keyed caches.
    fn megamorphic_cache_name(&self, executable: u32, cache_index: u32, property: u32) -> Option<u64> {
        let snapshot = &self.snapshot.executables[executable as usize];
        self.snapshot[snapshot.property_caches]
            .get(cache_index as usize)
            .filter(|cache| cache.kind == PropertyCacheKind::Megamorphic)
            .and_then(|_| {
                self.snapshot[snapshot.property_key_names]
                    .get(property as usize)
                    .copied()
            })
            .filter(|name| *name != 0)
    }

    /// Looks up the property whose name has the identity `name` on the
    /// object in the object register in the VM's keyed property lookup
    /// cache, like the runtime's keyed get does: puts the data property it
    /// has (own, or of an unchanged prototype chain), or `undefined` where
    /// the entry says the object and its prototype chain have no such
    /// property, in `output` and jumps to `done`. Jumps to `fail` for
    /// accessors, and to `miss` where the cache has no such entry. Clobbers
    /// the cache registers and the scratch register.
    fn emit_vm_named_cache_get(
        &mut self,
        registers: &CacheRegisters,
        name: u64,
        output: Gpr,
        done: Label,
        miss: Label,
        fail: Label,
    ) {
        let CacheRegisters { object, shape, entry } = *registers;
        let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        if layout.keyed_lookup_cache_entries == 0
            || layout.keyed_lookup_cache_prototype == 0
            || layout.keyed_lookup_cache_prototype_chain_validity == 0
        {
            self.masm.jump(miss);
            return;
        }
        self.emit_load_compressed_cell(shape, &Address::new(object, self.runtime.offsets.object_shape as i32));
        // The entry: the top bits of the Fibonacci hash of the shape and the name.
        let entry_size_log2 = layout.keyed_lookup_cache_entry_size.trailing_zeros();
        let bits = layout.keyed_lookup_cache_index_bits;
        self.masm.move_imm64(scratch, u64::from(name as u32));
        self.masm.xor32(scratch, scratch, shape);
        self.masm.mul32_imm(
            scratch,
            scratch,
            layout.property_lookup_cache_megamorphic_hash_multiplier,
        );
        self.masm
            .shr32_imm(scratch, scratch, (32 - bits - entry_size_log2) as u8);
        self.masm
            .and32_imm(scratch, scratch, ((1u32 << bits) - 1) << entry_size_log2);
        self.masm.move_imm64(entry, layout.keyed_lookup_cache_entries);
        self.masm.add64(entry, entry, scratch);
        self.masm.move_imm64(scratch, name);
        self.masm.branch64_memory(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.keyed_lookup_cache_name as i32),
            scratch,
            miss,
        );
        self.masm.branch64_memory(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.keyed_lookup_cache_shape as i32),
            shape,
            miss,
        );
        let expected = Address::new(entry, layout.keyed_lookup_cache_dictionary_generation as i32);
        self.branch_unless_dictionary_generation_is(shape, expected, [scratch, shape], miss);

        let (own, inherited) = (self.masm.new_label(), self.masm.new_label());
        self.masm.load32(
            scratch,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.keyed_lookup_cache_entry_type as i32),
        );
        self.masm.branch32_imm(
            Condition::Equal,
            scratch,
            layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type_get_own_property as i32,
            own,
        );
        self.masm.branch32_imm(
            Condition::Equal,
            scratch,
            layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type_get_property_in_prototype_chain as i32,
            inherited,
        );
        self.masm.branch32_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            scratch,
            layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type_get_missing_property as i32,
            miss,
        );
        let validity = Address::new(entry, layout.keyed_lookup_cache_prototype_chain_validity as i32);
        self.branch_unless_property_absence_applies(object, shape, &validity, miss);
        self.masm.move_imm64(output, value::UNDEFINED);
        self.masm.jump(done);

        // Properties found in a prototype need its chain to be unchanged.
        self.masm.bind(inherited);
        self.masm.load64(shape, &validity);
        self.masm.branch_test64(Condition::Zero, shape, u64::MAX, miss);
        self.branch_unless_prototype_chain_valid(shape, miss);
        self.masm
            .load64(object, &Address::new(entry, layout.keyed_lookup_cache_prototype as i32));

        // NB: Accessors take the slow path, which calls them.
        self.masm.bind(own);
        self.masm.load32(
            scratch,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.keyed_lookup_cache_property_offset as i32),
        );
        self.masm.load64(
            shape,
            &Address::new(object, self.runtime.offsets.object_named_properties as i32),
        );
        self.masm
            .load64(entry, &Address::indexed(shape, scratch, Scale::Eight, 0));
        self.branch_on_tag(Condition::Equal, entry, value::ACCESSOR_TAG, scratch, fail);
        self.masm.move64(output, entry);
        self.masm.jump(done);
    }

    /// A `ProbePropertyStore` node: stores like the interpreter's `PutById`
    /// handler, and also adds properties through `AddOwnProperty` entries.
    /// The most recently used entry is checked first; the entry for the
    /// object's shape is found among the others (see `probe_cache_entry()`)
    /// otherwise. The runtime probes the entries out of line where the
    /// inline probe finds none, except in inlined callees, whose caches are
    /// not the running frame's.
    pub(in crate::codegen) fn emit_probe_property_store(
        &mut self,
        node: NodeId,
        executable: u32,
        cache_index: u32,
        name_index: u32,
    ) -> Result<(), CompileFailure> {
        let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        let (base, source, output) = (self.input(node, 0), self.input(node, 1), self.output(node));
        let registers = self.cache_registers(node);
        let CacheRegisters { object, shape, entry } = registers;
        let (failure, stored, done) = (self.probe_failure_label(), self.masm.new_label(), self.masm.new_label());
        let (others, change, transition) = (self.masm.new_label(), self.masm.new_label(), self.masm.new_label());
        let no_data_write = self.masm.new_label();
        let probe = if executable == 0 {
            let probe = self.masm.new_label();
            self.deferred_cache_probes.push(DeferredCacheProbe {
                node,
                executable,
                probe: CacheProbe::PutById,
                entry: probe,
                hit: stored,
                miss: failure.0,
            });
            probe
        } else {
            failure.0
        };

        self.unbox_object_or_branch(object, base, failure.0);
        self.emit_load_compressed_cell(shape, &Address::new(object, self.runtime.offsets.object_shape as i32));
        self.property_cache_address(entry, executable, cache_index)?;
        self.masm.load64(entry, &Address::new(entry, 0));
        self.masm.branch_test64(Condition::Zero, entry, u64::MAX, probe);
        self.masm
            .and64_imm(entry, entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_data_pointer_mask);
        self.masm.branch64_memory(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_shape as i32),
            shape,
            others,
        );
        self.branch_unless_dictionary_generation_matches(shape, entry, probe);
        // Own data properties.
        self.masm.bind(change);
        self.masm.branch64_memory_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_prototype as i32),
            0,
            probe,
        );
        self.masm.load8(
            scratch,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_writes_data_property as i32),
        );
        self.masm.branch_test32(Condition::Zero, scratch, 0xFF, no_data_write);
        // NB: The address uses the scratch register, so the tag check must not.
        let property = self.cached_property_address(&registers, object);
        self.masm.load64(entry, &property);
        self.branch_on_tag(Condition::Equal, entry, value::ACCESSOR_TAG, entry, probe);
        self.masm.store64(&property, source);
        self.masm.jump(stored);
        self.masm.bind(no_data_write);
        self.masm.branch32_memory_imm(
            Condition::Equal,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type as i32),
            layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type_add_own_property as i32,
            transition,
        );
        self.masm.jump(probe);

        // The entry for the object's shape among the others.
        self.masm.bind(others);
        let vm_cache_name = self.megamorphic_cache_name(executable, cache_index, name_index);
        let vm_cache = vm_cache_name.map(|_| self.masm.new_label());
        self.probe_cache_entry(&registers, executable, cache_index, vm_cache.unwrap_or(probe))?;
        self.masm.branch32_memory_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type as i32),
            layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type_add_own_property as i32,
            change,
        );
        self.masm.bind(transition);
        let storage = self.temp(node, 3);
        let fields = self.site_addition_entry_fields();
        self.emit_add_own_property(node, &registers, fields, source, storage, probe);
        if let (Some(name), Some(vm_cache)) = (vm_cache_name, vm_cache) {
            self.deferred_vm_cache_probes.push(DeferredVmCacheProbe {
                node,
                entry: vm_cache,
                probe: VmCacheProbe::Put {
                    base,
                    name,
                    source,
                    storage,
                    miss: probe,
                    stored,
                },
            });
        }
        self.masm.bind(stored);
        self.masm.move_imm32(output, 1);
        self.bind_probe_failure(output, 0, failure, done);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Adds the property of the `AddOwnProperty` entry in `registers.entry`,
    /// laid out like `fields` says and found for the shape of the object in
    /// `registers.object`, like `asm_try_put_by_id_cache()` does: the object
    /// takes the entry's new shape, and `source` goes in the new property's
    /// slot. Storage that must grow grows out of line (see
    /// `named_storage`), or the addition is left to `miss`. Uses `storage`
    /// and clobbers the shape register.
    pub(super) fn emit_add_own_property(
        &mut self,
        node: NodeId,
        registers: &CacheRegisters,
        fields: AdditionEntryFields,
        source: Gpr,
        storage: Gpr,
        miss: Label,
    ) {
        let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        let offsets = self.runtime.offsets;
        let CacheRegisters { object, shape, entry } = *registers;

        self.masm.branch32_memory_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            &Address::new(entry, fields.entry_type),
            layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type_add_own_property as i32,
            miss,
        );
        // Objects that may cache property additions, without a magical length
        // (whose additions depend on the key).
        let flags = layout.object_flag_may_interfere
            | layout.object_flag_requires_slow_add_own_property
            | layout.object_flag_has_magical_length;
        self.masm
            .load16(scratch, &Address::new(object, offsets.object_flags as i32));
        self.masm
            .branch_test32(Condition::NonZero, scratch, u32::from(flags), miss);
        let valid_chain = self.masm.new_label();
        self.masm
            .load64(shape, &Address::new(entry, fields.prototype_chain_validity));
        self.masm.branch_test64(Condition::Zero, shape, u64::MAX, valid_chain);
        self.branch_unless_prototype_chain_valid(shape, miss);
        self.masm.bind(valid_chain);
        self.masm.load64(shape, &Address::new(entry, fields.new_shape));
        self.masm.branch_test64(Condition::Zero, shape, u64::MAX, miss);

        // The capacity of the inline or heap storage must hold every
        // property of the new shape.
        let heap_storage = self.masm.new_label();
        let check_capacity = self.masm.new_label();
        self.masm
            .load64(storage, &Address::new(object, offsets.object_named_properties as i32));
        // NB: Inline storage starts at one of two offsets, within the object. Heap storage is outside of it.
        self.masm.sub64(scratch, storage, object);
        self.masm.branch64_imm(
            Condition::Above,
            scratch,
            i64::from(self.runtime.object_allocation.inline_storage_offset),
            heap_storage,
        );
        self.masm.load8(
            scratch,
            &Address::new(object, self.runtime.object_allocation.inline_capacity_offset as i32),
        );
        self.masm.jump(check_capacity);
        self.masm.bind(heap_storage);
        self.masm
            .load32(scratch, &Address::new(storage, layout.named_properties_capacity));
        self.masm.bind(check_capacity);
        self.masm
            .load32(storage, &Address::new(shape, layout.shape_property_count as i32));
        let has_room = self.masm.new_label();
        let grow = self.storage_growth(node, registers, fields.new_shape, storage, has_room, miss);
        self.masm.branch32(Condition::Above, storage, scratch, grow);

        self.masm.bind(has_room);
        self.emit_store_compressed_cell(&Address::new(object, offsets.object_shape as i32), shape, shape);
        self.masm.load32(scratch, &Address::new(entry, fields.property_offset));
        self.masm
            .load64(storage, &Address::new(object, offsets.object_named_properties as i32));
        self.masm
            .store64(&Address::indexed(storage, scratch, Scale::Eight, 0), source);
    }

    /// Where an entry of a property lookup cache keeps the parts of an
    /// addition.
    pub(super) fn site_addition_entry_fields(&self) -> AdditionEntryFields {
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        AdditionEntryFields {
            entry_type: layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_type as i32,
            prototype_chain_validity: layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_prototype_chain_validity as i32,
            new_shape: layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_new_shape as i32,
            property_offset: layout.property_lookup_cache_entry_property_offset as i32,
        }
    }

    /// The probes of the VM's keyed caches of megamorphic named accesses, out
    /// of line.
    pub(in crate::codegen) fn emit_deferred_vm_cache_probes(&mut self) -> Result<(), CompileFailure> {
        for deferred in self.deferred_vm_cache_probes.take() {
            self.emitting = Some(deferred.node);
            self.masm.bind(deferred.entry);
            let registers = self.cache_registers(deferred.node);
            match deferred.probe {
                VmCacheProbe::Get {
                    executable,
                    cache,
                    name,
                    output,
                    done,
                    miss,
                    fail,
                } => {
                    let lesson = (self.runtime.remember_vm_cache_get != 0).then(|| self.masm.new_label());
                    self.emit_vm_named_cache_get(&registers, name, output, lesson.unwrap_or(done), miss, fail);
                    if let Some(lesson) = lesson {
                        self.masm.bind(lesson);
                        self.emit_vm_cache_lesson(deferred.node, &registers, executable, cache, name, done)?;
                    }
                }
                VmCacheProbe::Put {
                    base,
                    name,
                    source,
                    storage,
                    miss,
                    stored,
                } => {
                    let key = KeyName::Identity(name);
                    self.emit_keyed_store_cache_put(deferred.node, base, key, source, registers, storage, miss, stored);
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// After a megamorphic named get found its property in the VM's keyed
    /// property lookup cache, having missed the tables of its cache, which
    /// is property lookup cache `cache_index` of `executable`: copies that
    /// entry into the tables (see `remember_vm_cache_get()` of the runtime)
    /// while they take such lessons, so that the get finds the property
    /// inline the next time, and continues at `done` with the value of the
    /// property still in the node's output register, which the call saves.
    /// Clobbers the cache registers and the scratch register.
    fn emit_vm_cache_lesson(
        &mut self,
        node: NodeId,
        registers: &CacheRegisters,
        executable: u32,
        cache_index: u32,
        name: u64,
        done: Label,
    ) -> Result<(), CompileFailure> {
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        let CacheRegisters { shape, entry, .. } = *registers;
        // NB: The cache is megamorphic unless something cleared it since.
        self.property_cache_address(entry, executable, cache_index)?;
        self.masm.load64(entry, &Address::new(entry, 0));
        self.masm.move64(shape, entry);
        self.masm
            .and64_imm(shape, shape, !layout.property_lookup_cache_data_pointer_mask);
        self.masm.branch64_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            shape,
            layout.property_lookup_cache_megamorphic_tag as i64,
            done,
        );
        self.masm
            .and64_imm(entry, entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_data_pointer_mask);
        self.masm.load32(
            shape,
            &Address::new(entry, layout.property_lookup_cache_megamorphic_vm_cache_lessons as i32),
        );
        self.masm.branch32_imm(
            Condition::AboveOrEqual,
            shape,
            layout.property_lookup_cache_megamorphic_max_vm_cache_lessons as i32,
            done,
        );

        let arguments = M::ARGUMENT_GPRS;
        let saved = slow_path_saved_registers::<M>().iter().collect::<RegisterList<_>>();
        self.emit_save_registers(&saved);
        let base = self.input(node, 0);
        if base != arguments[1] {
            self.masm.move64(arguments[1], base);
        }
        self.property_cache_address(arguments[2], executable, cache_index)?;
        self.masm.move_imm64(arguments[3], name);
        self.masm.move64(arguments[0], self.pinned.vm);
        self.masm.call_absolute(self.runtime.remember_vm_cache_get);
        self.emit_restore_registers(&saved, None);
        self.masm.jump(done);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// The runtime probes of the cache probe nodes, out of line.
    pub(in crate::codegen) fn emit_deferred_cache_probes(&mut self) -> Result<(), CompileFailure> {
        for deferred in self.deferred_cache_probes.take() {
            self.emitting = Some(deferred.node);
            self.masm.bind(deferred.entry);
            let pc = self.graph.node(deferred.node).pc;
            self.emit_cache_probe(
                deferred.node,
                deferred.executable,
                pc,
                deferred.probe,
                deferred.hit,
                deferred.miss,
            )?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Probes every entry of the cache with the runtime's probe; continues
    /// at `resume` if it handled the instruction, and at `slow` otherwise.
    fn emit_cache_probe(
        &mut self,
        node: NodeId,
        executable: u32,
        pc: u32,
        probe: CacheProbe,
        resume: Label,
        slow: Label,
    ) -> Result<(), CompileFailure> {
        let arguments = M::ARGUMENT_GPRS;
        let control = M::RETURN_GPRS[0];
        let allocation = self.allocation.node(node);
        let output = match allocation.output {
            Some(Location::Register(register)) => Some(Gpr(register)),
            _ => None,
        };
        let mut saved = slow_path_saved_registers::<M>();
        if let Some(output) = output {
            saved = saved.without(output);
        }
        let saved = saved.iter().collect::<RegisterList<_>>();
        self.emit_save_registers(&saved);

        let hit = self.masm.new_label();
        let base = self.input(node, 0);
        match probe {
            CacheProbe::GetById { cache } => {
                if base != arguments[0] {
                    self.masm.move64(arguments[0], base);
                }
                self.property_cache_address(arguments[1], executable, cache)?;
                self.masm.call_absolute(self.runtime.layout.try_get_by_id_cache);
                let missed = self.masm.new_label();
                self.masm
                    .branch64_imm(Condition::Equal, control, value::EMPTY as i64, missed);
                self.masm.move64(output.expect("GetById has an output"), control);
                self.masm.jump(hit);
                self.masm.bind(missed);
            }
            CacheProbe::PutById => {
                let source = self.input(node, 1);
                let record = self.locals.record;
                self.masm.store64(&self.local_address(record), base);
                self.masm.store64(&self.local_address(record + 8), source);
                self.masm
                    .load_effective_address(arguments[3], &self.local_address(record));
                let instruction = self.snapshot.executables[executable as usize]
                    .bytecode_address
                    .checked_add(u64::from(pc))
                    .ok_or(CompileFailure::InvalidBytecode {
                        pc,
                        reason: "instruction address overflows",
                    })?;
                self.masm.move_imm64(arguments[2], instruction);
                self.masm.move_imm32(arguments[1], pc);
                self.masm.move64(arguments[0], self.pinned.vm);
                self.masm.call_absolute(self.runtime.layout.try_put_by_id_cache);
                self.masm.branch64_imm(Condition::Equal, control, 0, hit);
            }
            CacheProbe::HasProperty { own } => {
                let helpers = self.runtime.intrinsic_helpers;
                let key = self.input(node, 1);
                // NB: hasOwnProperty takes the object first, `in` the key.
                let (address, first, second) = if own {
                    (helpers.has_own_property, base, key)
                } else {
                    (helpers.has_property, key, base)
                };
                // NB: Without the helper, the probe misses.
                if address != 0 {
                    let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
                    self.masm.move64(scratch, second);
                    if first != arguments[1] {
                        self.masm.move64(arguments[1], first);
                    }
                    self.masm.move64(arguments[2], scratch);
                    self.masm.move64(arguments[0], self.pinned.vm);
                    self.masm.call_absolute(address);
                    let missed = self.masm.new_label();
                    self.masm
                        .branch64_imm(Condition::Equal, control, value::EMPTY as i64, missed);
                    self.masm.move64(output.expect("probes have an output"), control);
                    self.masm.jump(hit);
                    self.masm.bind(missed);
                }
            }
        }

        // A miss restores the registers and takes the slow path.
        self.emit_restore_registers(&saved, None);
        self.masm.jump(slow);
        self.masm.bind(hit);
        self.emit_restore_registers(&saved, None);
        self.masm.jump(resume);
        Ok(())
    }
}

//! Lowering of the ops of for-in loops, which read the keys of the property
//! iterator cache (`ObjectPropertyIteratorCacheData`) of the object they
//! iterate over, like the interpreter's `ObjectPropertyIteratorNext`
//! handler.

use super::Codegen;
use crate::asm::Address;
use crate::asm::Condition;
use crate::asm::Gpr;
use crate::asm::Label;
use crate::asm::PortableMacroAssembler;
use crate::asm::Scale;
use crate::ir::NodeId;

impl<M: PortableMacroAssembler> Codegen<'_, '_, M> {
    /// Jumps to `yes` if the property iterator cache `keys` still holds the
    /// keys of the object `receiver`: the cache has a fast path, the
    /// receiver has the shape (and for dictionaries, its generation) the
    /// keys were taken from, as many packed indexed properties if the keys
    /// include those, and the prototype chain is unchanged if the cache
    /// depends on it. Jumps to `no` otherwise.
    pub(in crate::codegen) fn emit_property_iterator_cache_test(
        &mut self,
        node: NodeId,
        receiver: Gpr,
        keys: Gpr,
        yes: Label,
        no: Label,
    ) {
        let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        let (object, cache, temp) = (self.temp(node, 0), self.temp(node, 1), self.temp(node, 2));

        self.emit_unbox_cell(object, receiver);
        self.emit_unbox_cell(cache, keys);
        self.masm
            .load8(scratch, &Address::new(cache, layout.property_iterator_fast_path as i32));
        self.masm.branch32_imm(
            Condition::Equal,
            scratch,
            i32::from(layout.property_iterator_fast_path_none),
            no,
        );

        // The receiver's shape, and for dictionaries its generation.
        // OPTIMIZATION: Both shapes are compressed, so they compare before the receiver's decodes.
        self.masm
            .load32(temp, &Address::new(object, self.runtime.offsets.object_shape as i32));
        self.masm
            .load32(scratch, &Address::new(cache, layout.property_iterator_shape as i32));
        self.masm.branch32(Condition::NotEqual, temp, scratch, no);
        self.emit_decompress_cell(temp);
        let not_dictionary = self.masm.new_label();
        self.masm.load8(
            scratch,
            &Address::new(cache, layout.property_iterator_shape_is_dictionary as i32),
        );
        self.masm.branch_test32(Condition::Zero, scratch, 0xFF, not_dictionary);
        let expected = Address::new(cache, layout.property_iterator_shape_dictionary_generation as i32);
        self.branch_unless_dictionary_generation_is(temp, expected, [temp, scratch], no);
        self.masm.bind(not_dictionary);

        // Packed indexed properties, as many as when the keys were taken.
        let not_indexed = self.masm.new_label();
        self.masm
            .load8(scratch, &Address::new(cache, layout.property_iterator_fast_path as i32));
        self.masm.branch32_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            scratch,
            i32::from(layout.property_iterator_fast_path_packed_indexed),
            not_indexed,
        );
        self.masm.load8(
            scratch,
            &Address::new(object, layout.object_indexed_storage_kind as i32),
        );
        self.masm.branch32_imm(
            Condition::NotEqual,
            scratch,
            i32::from(layout.indexed_storage_kind_packed),
            no,
        );
        self.masm.load32(
            temp,
            &Address::new(object, layout.object_indexed_array_like_size as i32),
        );
        self.masm.load32(
            scratch,
            &Address::new(cache, layout.property_iterator_indexed_property_count as i32),
        );
        self.masm.branch32(Condition::NotEqual, temp, scratch, no);
        self.masm.bind(not_indexed);

        // The prototype chain, if the keys depend on it.
        self.emit_load_compressed_cell_or_branch(
            scratch,
            &Address::new(cache, layout.property_iterator_prototype_chain_validity as i32),
            yes,
        );
        self.branch_unless_prototype_chain_valid(scratch, no);
        self.masm.jump(yes);
    }

    /// `LoadPropertyIteratorKeyCount`: the number of keys of a property
    /// iterator cache, at most `i32::MAX`.
    pub(in crate::codegen) fn emit_load_property_iterator_key_count(&mut self, node: NodeId) {
        let (keys, output) = (self.input(node, 0), self.output(node));
        let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        let small = self.masm.new_label();
        self.emit_unbox_cell(output, keys);
        self.masm.load32(
            output,
            &Address::new(output, layout.property_iterator_property_value_count as i32),
        );
        self.masm.move_imm64(scratch, i32::MAX as u64);
        self.masm.branch64(Condition::BelowOrEqual, output, scratch, small);
        self.masm.move64(output, scratch);
        self.masm.bind(small);
    }

    /// `LoadPropertyIteratorKey`: the key of a property iterator cache at
    /// an index below their number.
    pub(in crate::codegen) fn emit_load_property_iterator_key(&mut self, node: NodeId) {
        let (keys, index, output) = (self.input(node, 0), self.input(node, 1), self.output(node));
        let scratch = self.pinned.scratch;
        let layout = self.runtime.layout;
        self.emit_unbox_cell(output, keys);
        self.masm.load64(
            output,
            &Address::new(output, layout.property_iterator_property_values as i32),
        );
        // NB: Int32 values only have their low 32 bits defined.
        self.masm.move32(scratch, index);
        self.masm
            .load64(output, &Address::indexed(output, scratch, Scale::Eight, 0));
    }
}

//! The sites of compiled code (see `artifact::SiteView`): where the translator finds the values of a node's frame
//! state, from the register allocation.

use ak::Zone;
use ak::ZoneVec;

use crate::CompileFailure;
use crate::artifact::ArtifactWriter;
use crate::artifact::Frame;
use crate::asm::Gpr;
use crate::code::Repr;
use crate::code::SiteKind;
use crate::code::ValueLocation;
use crate::code::VirtualObjectDescriptorKind;
use crate::ir::FrameStateId;
use crate::ir::Graph;
use crate::ir::NodeId;
use crate::ir::Op;
use crate::ir::VirtualObjectKind;
use crate::regalloc::Allocation;
use crate::regalloc::FPR_BASE;
use crate::regalloc::Location;

/// In place of the record of a frame state: it has none.
const NO_RECORD: u32 = u32::MAX;

/// What the sites of a compile are written with, in the work zone.
pub(crate) struct SiteScratch<'a> {
    /// The record of each frame state of the graph in the tables of the code, by the index of the frame state.
    frame_records: &'a mut [u32],
    /// The frame states of a chain that have no record.
    pending: ZoneVec<'a, u32>,
    /// The values of a frame at a site, as the slot in the high half and the word of the location in the low half.
    values: ZoneVec<'a, u64>,
}

impl<'a> SiteScratch<'a> {
    // NB: A compile whose graph has more frame states, or a frame state with more values or callers, fails.
    const MAX_FRAME_STATES: usize = 1 << 24;
    const MAX_FRAME_VALUES: usize = 1 << 22;
    const MAX_FRAME_DEPTH: usize = 1 << 16;

    /// What the sites of the code of `graph` are written with, which knows no records yet.
    pub(crate) fn new_in(graph: &Graph, work: &'a Zone) -> Result<Self, CompileFailure> {
        if graph.frame_states.len() > Self::MAX_FRAME_STATES {
            return Err(CompileFailure::TooLarge);
        }
        Ok(Self {
            frame_records: work.alloc_slice_fill(graph.frame_states.len(), NO_RECORD),
            pending: ZoneVec::new_in(work),
            values: ZoneVec::new_in(work),
        })
    }

    /// The record of `frame_state`, which gets one with its callers if it has none.
    fn frame_record(
        &mut self,
        graph: &Graph,
        frame_state: FrameStateId,
        artifact: &mut ArtifactWriter<'_>,
    ) -> Result<u32, CompileFailure> {
        self.pending.clear();
        let mut parent = None;
        let mut next = Some(frame_state);
        while let Some(id) = next {
            let record = self.frame_records[id.index()];
            if record != NO_RECORD {
                parent = Some(record);
                break;
            }
            if self.pending.len() == Self::MAX_FRAME_DEPTH {
                return Err(CompileFailure::TooLarge);
            }
            self.pending.push(id.0);
            next = graph.frame_state(id).parent;
        }
        // NB: The record of a frame names that of its caller, so callers come first.
        for index in (0..self.pending.len()).rev() {
            let id = FrameStateId(self.pending[index]);
            let state = graph.frame_state(id);
            let frame = Frame {
                executable: state.executable,
                pc: state.pc,
                mode: state.mode,
                passed_argument_count: state.passed_argument_count,
                legacy_arguments: state.legacy_arguments.clone(),
                parent,
            };
            let record = artifact.add_frame(&frame, state.values.iter().map(|(slot, _)| *slot), &state.in_frame)?;
            self.frame_records[id.index()] = record;
            parent = Some(record);
        }
        Ok(parent.expect("a chain has a frame state"))
    }
}

/// Where a site of kind `kind` finds the values of the frame state of `node`, one after the other in the order of
/// `Graph::frame_state_values()`.
struct Locations<'a> {
    graph: &'a Graph<'a>,
    allocation: &'a Allocation<'a>,
    kind: SiteKind,
    /// See `Graph::virtual_objects()`.
    objects: &'a [NodeId],
    exit_values: core::slice::Iter<'a, (u32, Location)>,
    /// Converts spill slots to frame offsets.
    stack_slot_offset: &'a dyn Fn(u32) -> i32,
    /// Registers that are in the saves area at the site, with the frame pointer offsets of their words there.
    saves: &'a [(Gpr, i32)],
}

impl Locations<'_> {
    /// The slot and the location of `value`, the next value.
    fn next(&mut self, value: NodeId) -> (u32, ValueLocation) {
        let (slot, location) = *self.exit_values.next().expect("every frame state value has a location");
        if let Some(index) = self.objects.iter().position(|object| *object == value) {
            return (
                slot,
                ValueLocation::VirtualObject(u32::try_from(index).expect("objects fit in u32")),
            );
        }
        let repr = self
            .graph
            .node(value)
            .repr
            .expect("frame state values have a representation");
        let location = match location {
            // NB: Stack walks and the runtime read the values of inlined call
            //     sites from the JIT frame while the call runs, without the
            //     registers. Values live across calls have stack slots.
            Location::Register(_) if self.kind == SiteKind::Call => match self.allocation.node(value).spill_slot {
                Some(slot) => ValueLocation::Stack((self.stack_slot_offset)(slot), repr),
                None => ValueLocation::Frame(
                    crate::regalloc::frame_home(self.graph, value).expect("values live across calls are spilled"),
                ),
            },
            // NB: Exits read float64 values from the floating point registers.
            Location::Register(register) => ValueLocation::Register(register % FPR_BASE, repr),
            Location::Stack(slot) => ValueLocation::Stack((self.stack_slot_offset)(slot), repr),
            Location::Frame(slot) => ValueLocation::Frame(slot),
            Location::Constant(bits) => match crate::ir::value::virtual_arguments_kind(bits) {
                Some(mapped) if repr == Repr::Tagged => ValueLocation::ArgumentsObject { mapped },
                _ => ValueLocation::Constant(crate::ir::value::boxed_constant(bits, repr)),
            },
        };
        // NB: Float64 values are in floating point registers, which are not saved.
        if let ValueLocation::Register(register, repr) = location
            && repr != Repr::Float64
            && let Some((_, offset)) = self.saves.iter().find(|(saved, _)| saved.0 == register)
        {
            return (slot, ValueLocation::Stack(*offset, repr));
        }
        (slot, location)
    }
}

/// What a site is written from.
pub(crate) struct SiteSource<'a> {
    pub graph: &'a Graph<'a>,
    pub allocation: &'a Allocation<'a>,
    /// The node whose frame state the site has.
    pub node: NodeId,
    pub kind: SiteKind,
    /// Converts spill slots to frame offsets.
    pub stack_slot_offset: &'a dyn Fn(u32) -> i32,
    /// Registers that are in the saves area at the site and not where they were allocated, with the frame pointer
    /// offsets of their words there.
    pub saves: &'a [(Gpr, i32)],
    /// Where the site keeps the lists it makes while it is written.
    pub work: &'a Zone,
}

impl SiteSource<'_> {
    /// Adds the site to the tables of the code, as the next site.
    pub(crate) fn write(
        &self,
        scratch: &mut SiteScratch<'_>,
        artifact: &mut ArtifactWriter<'_>,
    ) -> Result<(), CompileFailure> {
        let graph = self.graph;
        let frame_state = graph.node(self.node).frame_state.expect("the node has a frame state");
        let frame = scratch.frame_record(graph, frame_state, artifact)?;
        let objects = graph.virtual_objects(frame_state, self.work);
        if !objects.is_empty() && !artifact.frame_has_objects(frame) {
            let objects = objects.iter().map(|object| {
                let Op::VirtualObject { kind, allocation } = graph.node(*object).op else {
                    unreachable!("virtual objects are VirtualObject nodes");
                };
                let kind = match kind {
                    VirtualObjectKind::Object { shape } => VirtualObjectDescriptorKind::Object { shape },
                    VirtualObjectKind::Closure { sample_slot } => VirtualObjectDescriptorKind::Closure { sample_slot },
                };
                let property_count = u32::try_from(graph.node(*object).inputs.len()).expect("inputs fit in u32");
                (kind, allocation.0, property_count)
            });
            artifact.set_frame_objects(frame, objects)?;
        }
        let mut locations = self.locations(&objects);
        let start = artifact.location_count();
        let mut next = Some(frame_state);
        while let Some(id) = next {
            let state = graph.frame_state(id);
            scratch.values.clear();
            for (_, value) in &state.values {
                let (slot, location) = locations.next(*value);
                let word = artifact.location(location)?;
                if scratch.values.len() == SiteScratch::MAX_FRAME_VALUES {
                    return Err(CompileFailure::TooLarge);
                }
                scratch.values.push(u64::from(slot) << 32 | u64::from(word));
            }
            // NB: The locations of a frame are in the order of its slots, which are in the high halves.
            scratch.values.sort_unstable();
            for value in &*scratch.values {
                artifact.add_location(*value as u32)?;
            }
            next = state.parent;
        }
        // NB: The properties of the virtual objects follow the frames' values.
        for object in &objects {
            for property in &graph.node(*object).inputs {
                let (_, location) = locations.next(*property);
                let word = artifact.location(location)?;
                artifact.add_location(word)?;
            }
        }
        let inlined_frame_bytes = match graph.node(self.node).op {
            Op::CallDirect {
                inlined_frame_bytes, ..
            }
            | Op::CallNative {
                inlined_frame_bytes, ..
            } if self.kind == SiteKind::Call => inlined_frame_bytes,
            _ => 0,
        };
        artifact.add_site(self.kind, frame, start, inlined_frame_bytes)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Makes `values` the slots of the values of the compiled function's frame at the site and where the values are,
    /// in slot order.
    pub(crate) fn root_frame_values(&self, values: &mut ZoneVec<'_, (u32, ValueLocation)>) {
        let frame_state = self
            .graph
            .node(self.node)
            .frame_state
            .expect("the node has a frame state");
        let objects = self.graph.virtual_objects(frame_state, self.work);
        let mut locations = self.locations(&objects);
        values.clear();
        let mut next = Some(frame_state);
        while let Some(id) = next {
            let state = self.graph.frame_state(id);
            values.clear();
            values.extend(state.values.iter().map(|(_, value)| locations.next(*value)));
            next = state.parent;
        }
        values.sort_unstable_by_key(|(slot, _)| *slot);
    }

    fn locations<'a>(&'a self, objects: &'a [NodeId]) -> Locations<'a> {
        Locations {
            graph: self.graph,
            allocation: self.allocation,
            kind: self.kind,
            objects,
            exit_values: self.allocation.node(self.node).exit_values.iter(),
            stack_slot_offset: self.stack_slot_offset,
            saves: self.saves,
        }
    }
}
